question: Mɛyɛ dɛn de mfiridwuma ne digitall nnwinnade adi dwuma de adi kan hwɛ me ho na makura ɔkwan a ɛkari pɛ so wɔ m’adwene mu akwahosan ho?
answer: Wubetumi de mfiridwuma ne digital nnwinnade adi kan de wo ho a wobɛhwɛ adi kan na woakura ɔkwan a ɛkari pɛ so wɔ w’adwene mu akwahosan ho denam: Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ ho apps anaa dijitaal platform ahorow a wode nnwinnade a wode bedi adwene akyi, de botae ahorow sisi w’ani so, ne nneɛma a wode bɛboa wo ho a wode bedi adwennwen ho dwuma, agye w’ahome, ne yiyedi a wode bedi dwuma no so. Adwene ne ahomegye apps a wode bɛka wo da biara da dwumadi ho de adwennwen nneɛma ho, ahome a emu dɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, anaa mfonini a wɔkyerɛ kwan de ahyɛ ahomegye ne adwennwen ano aduru ho nkuran. Nkaebɔ anaa alarm a wode besisi wo mfiri ahorow so na ama woanya wo ho a wobɛhwɛ no daa, te sɛ ahomegye a wubegye, aseda a wode sua ade, anaa anigyede ahorow a ɛma w’ani gye a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu. Mfiri a wotumi hyɛ anaa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ trackers a wode bedi dwuma de ahwɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, sɛnea woda, ne akwahosan ho nsɛnkyerɛnne afoforo a ebetumi aka w’adwene mu yiyedi. Sɛ wode w’adwene besi wo intanɛt so su ne sɛnea wode di dwuma wɔ dijitaal so, na woahyɛ da apaw nneɛma a wode bedi kan de dwumadi ahorow a ɛboa w’adwene akwahosan ne wo yiyedi nyinaa bedi kan.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa nnamfo anaa m’adɔfo a ebia wɔredi nnamu nyare 'STI' a woanya no ho dwuma?
answer: Fa Mmoa Ma: Ɛnyɛ atɛn na fa nkate fam mmoa ma. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ aduruyɛ mu mmoa na sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔne wɔn nkɔ. Hyɛ Nkitahodi Ho Nkuran: Boa wɔn ma wɔne wɔn ahokafo nni nkitaho wɔ nea wɔahu ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu no ho. question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusua abakɔsɛm, awosu, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia betumi anya asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbabun benya nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so ne adwenemyare no so nsunsuanso?
answer: Abusua abakɔsɛm, awosu, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia betumi anya asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbabun benya nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho haw ne adwenemyare no so nsunsuanso kɛse. Nneɛma bi ne: Abusua abakɔsɛm a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho haw anaa adwenemyare, a ebetumi ama awosu mu su ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔde nnubɔne di dwuma no ayɛ kɛse. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, awofo adwene wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne adwenemhaw anaa adwennwen a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Asiane ahorow yi a wɔbɛte ase no betumi aboa mmabun ne wɔn mmusua ma wɔatu anammɔn a edi kan de abrɛ asiane ahorow ase na wɔahyɛ nneɛma a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban ma adwenemyare ne yiyedi ho nkuran.

Nneɛma bi ne: Abusua abakɔsɛm a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho haw anaa adwenemyare, a ebetumi ama awosu mu su ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔde nnubɔne di dwuma no ayɛ kɛse. Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, awofo adwene wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho, asetra ne sikasɛm tebea, ne adwenemhaw anaa adwennwen a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Abɔde mu nneɛma te sɛ brain chemistry, neurotansmitter dwumadi, ne nsakrae a ɛba nkwaadɔm mu wɔ nsabuo mu ka ho. Asiane ahorow yi a wɔbɛte ase no betumi aboa mmabun ne wɔn mmusua ma wɔatu anammɔn a edi kan de abrɛ asiane ahorow ase na wɔahyɛ nneɛma a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban ma adwenemyare ne yiyedi ho nkuran.

question: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa awofo ne mmabun ma w'abom adi nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho?
answer: Sukuu Nneɛma: Sukuu afotufo anaa ayarehwɛfo betumi de nsɛm ne mmoa ama. Mpɔtam Hɔ: Mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae betumi de adwumayɛbea anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow ama awofo ne mmabun. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ahorow wɔ borɔfo mu te sɛ 'Planned Parenthood' anaa ASHA de nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so ma wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Awofoɔ ne Mmabun Nhyiamu: Monkɔ nhyiamu anaa adesua ahodoɔ mu bom sua na wɔnsusu nsɛmti a ɛfa mmabunbere ho. Ayaresa Mmoa: Abusua ayaresa anaa afotu betumi aboa ma nkitahodi ne ntease atu mpɔn. Awofoɔ Nhoma ne Akwankyerɛ: Nhoma wɔ borɔfo mu te sɛ "The Care and Keeping of You" series ma mmeawa anaa "Guy Stuff: The Body Book for Boys" betumi ayɛ nneɛma a ɛbɛboa.

question: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a ebia ɛremfata anaasɛ ɛnyɛ nea asiane biara nni ho sɛ wɔde awofo anaa abusua mufo bɛhyɛ mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ mu?
answer: Yiw, tebea ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a sɛ wode awofo anaa abusuafo ɛrehyɛm ɛnya anaa ɛyɛ hu, titiriw sɛ obi betumi ayɛ wɔn bɔne anaa wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayade, wobebu wɔn ani agu so, anaa sɛ hyɛ a wode wɔn ɛhyɛ mu betumi de ɔhaw foforɔ aba. Wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa mu no, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, anaa nnwumakuo ahorow a wobetumi de mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam ama no hɔ.

question: Dɛn ne PMTCT, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ HIV ano aduro ho?
answer: Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission (PMTCT) kyerɛ nneɛma ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɛna a ɔwɔ HIV de bɛma ne ba wɔ nyinsɛn mu, awo, ne nufu mu no so. PMTCT ho hia kɛse wɔ HIV ano aduru ho efisɛ ɛboa ma wosiw HIV foforo a ɛba nkokoaa mu ano, na ɛnam so boa ma botae a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛma HIV ɔyaredɔm no aba awiei no.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akɔ so anya nsɛm a wɔahu ne nea efi mu ba wɔ nhwehwɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu dwumadi ahorow a nea aborɔfo ka no 'crisis intervention programs' na ahyehyɛ?
answer: Mmabun betumi akɔ so anya nsɛm denam: Nsɛm foforo a wobenya denam dwumadi no ho amanneɛbɔ nkrataa, wɛbsaet ahorow, anaa nea broni ka no 'social media' akwan so. Mpɔtam nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a wɔde nhwehwɛmu aba a wɔde bɛkɔ. Sɛ wɔbɛnya amanneɛbɔ anaa nwoma a wode aba no de nam abɔnten nnwumakuo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nhwehwɛmu no mu.

question: Nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe pɔtee bɛn na mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya?
answer: Mmabun wɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne nanso ɛnyɛ ne nyinaa: Nyinsɛn ano aduru (Nhwɛsoɔ; awo ano aduru, kɔndɔm, nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu) STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa. Nyinsɛn mu nhwehwɛmu ne afotu. Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde ma apemfoɔ ansa na ɔwoɔ. Nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho dwumadie (baabi a mmara ma ho kwan). Afotuo a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden , abusuabɔ, ne pene a wɔpene so

question: Dɛn ne hokwan ne asɛdeɛ ahorow a mmabun a wɔyem wɔ, wɔ ɛnanom apɔwmuden ho gyinaesie ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma ho?
answer: Mmabun a wɔyem wɔ hokwan sɛ: Wogye wɔn akwahosan ne ayaresa a wobetumi apaw ho nsɛm wɔ kwan a wɔbɛte ase so. Si gyinae wɔ wɔn apɔwmuden nsɛm ho, a ayaresa a wobɛpaw anaasɛ wobɛpow ka ho. Mpene so anaasɛ pow ayaresa nhyehyɛe ahorow berɛ a wɔabɔ asiane ne mfasoɔ ahorow a ɛwɔ so amanneɛ akyerɛ wɔn. Asɛdeɛ no bi ne: Wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ akwahosan ho gyinaesie mu sɛdeɛ wɔbɛtumi biara. Nsɛm a wobebisa na woahwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu berɛ a ɛho hia mu. Wɔn akwahosan ne wɔn asetena kwan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔn.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahyɛ me nnamfo anaa m’atipɛnfo nkuran ma wɔabɛka me ho ma wɔasua adwene pa nhyehɛe, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ meka saa akwan yi akyerɛ afoforo?
answer: Fa nhwɛso di anim: Fa adwene mu nhumu ka wo daadaa dwumadi ho na ka wo suahu ahorow kyerɛ wo nnamfo, na da mfaso a ɛwɔ so no adi ankasa. Fa akwankyerɛ ma: Fa adwene mu apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa nneɛma a ɛnyɛ den ma w’atipɛnfo, kyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wobetumi de adwene mu nhumu aka wɔn asetra ho. Si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ho so dua: Si sɛnea adwene a wɔde si biribi so betumi ama adwene mu yiyedi atu mpɔn na ama ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano no ayɛ kɛse, na ama afoforo tumi de wɔn ankasa nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho adi kan no so dua.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ ayaresabea bi yɛ nea ahobammɔ wom na agye din sɛ wotu nyinsɛn gu? (hwehwɛ tumi krataa, agyede, ayarefo nsusuwii pa)
answer: Tumi krataa: Hwɛ sɛ ayaresabea no wɔ tumi krataa a ɛfata a efi wo man akwahosan dwumadibea hɔ. question: Dɛn ne nkɔso a ɛma obi nyin, na dɛn nti na ɛba?

question: Nsonsoeɛ bɛn na ɛda nna ho nsɛm 'sexual', ɔdɔ ho nkitahodie 'romantic', ne adeɛ bi a wɔ frɛ no wɔborɔfo kasa mu sɛ 'emotional' attraction ntam?
answer: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ ɔtwetwe obi wɔ honam fam. Ɔdɔ ho akɔnnɔ: Ɔdɔ ho akɔnnɔ a wobɛte nka, te sɛ ɔpɛ a wopɛ sɛ wo ne obi bɛbɔ anaasɛ wo ne obi bɛbɔ. Nkate mu twetwe: Nkate fam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den a wo ne obi wɔ, a ɛho nhia sɛ ɛfa honam fam anaa ɔdɔ ho nkate ho.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu nsonsonoe a ɛda nneyɛe a ɛfata ne nea ɛnyɛ papa ntam wɔ nyɔnkofa  bi mu?
answer: Suban pa a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wobu wɔn ho wɔn ho ahye, ahofadi, ne atenka ahorow. Ebia nneyɛe a ɛmfata no bi ne tumidi, nsakrae, obu a wonni, anaa nhyɛso. Hwɛ sɛnea wote nka wɔ abusuabɔ no mu yiye —sɛ wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ, wobu wo, na wosom bo a, ɛda adi sɛ ɛyɛ apɔwmuden. Sɛ wote nka sɛ wodi wo so, wobu wo animtiaa, anaa wosuro a, ebia ɛnyɛ papa.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaahosan ho nimdeɛ nya tumi a mmabun tumi si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwaahosan ho no so nsunsuanso?
answer: Akwaahosan ho nimdeɛ ma mmabun ntease a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no yɛ kɛse, na ɛma wotumi hwehwɛ nneɛma a wonya fi mu no mu yiye, susuw asane ahorow ho, na wosi gyinae a ɛfata. question: Akwannya ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nneyɛe a ɛfata ho nkuran na wɔama nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ayɛ papa na wɔde aka ho no atu mpɔn?
answer: Mmabun wɔ akwannya  ahorow de wɔn ho hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ de kamfo nsɛm a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nneyɛe a ɛfata ho nkuran na wɔama nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no ayɛ papa na wɔde aka ho no atu mpɔn. Wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a mmabun di anim anaasɛ wɔafi ase, de wɔn nsa ahyɛ adesrɛ ase, de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsɔretia anaa nhyiam ahorow mu, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo adi nkitaho, na wɔde sohyial media akwan adi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔaboaboa mmoa ano ama nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa abrabɔ pa ho. Ɛdenam nsakrae a wɔde nsiyɛ kamfo kyerɛ so no, mmabun betumi ama wɔn nne ayɛ kɛse, anya gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow so nkɛntɛnso, na wɔaboa ma wɔayɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ tebea a ɛda wɔn gyinapɛn ahorow ne nneɛma a wɔde di kan adi.

question: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛka ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ, te sɛ abɔde a nkwa wom, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, ne amammerɛ?
answer: Nna mu nkyerɛkyerɛ (Sexual education anaa Orientation) yɛ asɛm a emu yɛ den a nneɛma pii bɛtumi aka ho asɛm, a nea ɛka ho bi ne:Nipadua mu nneɛma (Biological factors): Te sɛ sɛnea nipadua no teɛ (genetics), nipadua mu nkwaadɔm (hormones), ne adwene no nhyehyɛeɛ.Baabi a obi firi (Environmental factors): Te sɛ sɛnea wɔtetee wo, mpɔtam nkitahodie, ne nsɛm a woahunu pɛn.Amammerɛ mu nneɛma (Cultural factors): Afei nso mpɔtam mmara, nneɛma a wɔbu no som bo, ne sɛnea nnipa dwene fa nna ho (sexuality).Ankorankoro nsɛm (Personal experiences): Afei nso abusuabɔ ne nea ɛtwetwe obi.Ɛhia sɛ yehu sɛ nna ho gyinabea yɛ soronko ma obiara, na yɛntumi mfa asɛm baako pɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Ɛyɛ nneɛma pii a ɛbom yɛ adwuma, a nipadua mu tebea, baabi a yɛfiri, ne sɛnea obi hu ne ho ka ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Dɛn nti na awoɔ mu nkwammoa ahorow sesa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer: Awoɔ mu nkwammoa ahorow sesa wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu efisɛ wo nipadua resiesie ne ho ama mpanyin afe so ne tumi a ɛbɛma awo. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a efi amemene no mu, titiriw nea broni ka no 'pituitary gland', a ɛma nkwaadɔm a ɛka kyerɛ ntini afoforo (te sɛ awodeɛ kosua ne tɔhwɛ) ma wɔyɛ awoɔ mu nkwammoa pii na ɛkanyan nsakrae yi. Saa awoɔ mu nkwammoa a ɛkɔ soro yi ne nea ɛde nipadua mu nsakrae a worehyia no ba.

answer: Mmabun betumi aboa wɔn ho wɔn ho denam: Nsusuwii hunu ne animhwɛ a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ. Obu ne pɛyɛ a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ abusuabɔ mu Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ho. question: Kwan bɛn so na biribi tumi yɛ akwansidie ma obi faahodie a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔbɛ wo ho? Ma nhwɛsoɔ?
answer: Nhwɛsoɔ no bi ne: Sɛ wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru anaa STI nhwehwɛmu/ayaresa a nteaseɛ pa biara nni ho. Awo a Wɔhyɛ: Eyi ne bere a wɔma obi nyinsɛn a wɔmpene so, na ɛno yɛ nipadua mu ahofadie a wobu so. Nsɛm a Wonnya: Wɔmma wɔnnya ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu wɔ sukuu anaa ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe mu. Nyinsɛn a Wɔhyɛ: Wobɛhyɛ wo ma woatu nyinsɛn a ɛnyɛ wo pɛ. Wobetumi adi saa mmara sobu yi ho dwuma denam: Amanneɛbɔ a wɔde bɛma Atumfoɔ: Sɛ wuhyia mmara sobu bi wɔ ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe mu a, wubetumi abɔ ho amanneɛ akyerɛ aduruyɛ bagua anaa aban kuo a ɛfa ho no. Mmara kwan so Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ wobu mmara so denneennen a, ebia mmara kwan so mmoa ho behia. Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi: Sɛ wɔde adwene si nsɛm yi so denam akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ so a, ebetumi ama nsakraeɛ ho nhyɛso aba. Nhomasua: Mpɛn pii no, mmara so bu fi nimdeɛ a wonni, enti nhomasua dawurobɔ ahorow betumi aboa ma wɔasiw mmara so bu daakye ano.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm sɛ wɔde wɔn bɛka ho na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu?
answer: Adesrɛ ne Ɔsatu 'campaigns': Fi ase anaa boa adesrɛ ne ɔsatu a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ananmusifo pii. Di Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔfoɔ Nkitaho: Twerɛ nkrataa anaa 'email' kɔma nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a ɛkyerɛ hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔde ananmusifoɔ ahodoɔ di dwuma. Social Media Activism: Fa social media platforms di dwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu na wɔkamfo nsakrae kyerɛ. Boa Nsɛm a Ɛsono: Boa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkamfo ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm dedaw te sɛ hwɛ, kyɛ, na wɔhyɛ ho nkuran so. Nhomasua Dwumadie: Wo ne sukuu ne ahyehyɛdeɛ nyɛ adwuma de nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm ho mfonini a ɛka obiara ho na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ho ka nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua ho.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi adi kasa mu akwanside ahorow, akenkan ne akyerɛw ho haw, ne nsɛm afoforo a ɛfa nneɛma a wobetumi anya ho dwuma de ahwɛ ahu sɛ asuafo nyinaa betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ mu denneennen?
answer: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bɛtumi: Wɔde nneɛma a wɔakyerɛ aseɛ, aniwa hu mmoa nea aborɔfo ka no 'visual aids', ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahodoɔ bɛma de agye adesua akwan ahodoɔ ne kasa a wɔpɛ. Fa mmoa foforo, te sɛ obiakofo nkyerɛkyerɛ anaa kuw nketewa nhyiam ahorow ma asuafo a wɔwɔ akenkan ne akyerɛw ho nsɛnnennen anaa kasa mu akwanside ahorow. question: Dɛn ne akwanside anaa haw a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho, te sɛ nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene, wɔn ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, fekubɔ mu ntotoho, anaa suro a wosuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de boasetɔ, ne mmoa a efi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di hɔ adi akwanside ahorow yi so?
answer: Mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside anaa haw ahorow wɔ nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, te sɛ nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene, wɔn ho a wɔka wɔ ɔkwan a enye so, fekubɔ mu ntotoho, anaa atemmu ho suro a wosuro mu. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi akwanside ahorow yi so no, wobetumi anya adwene mu nhumu na wɔde wɔn adwene asi biribi so denam; akwan horow te sɛ ahome a emu dɔ anaa adwene mu nsusuwii a wɔde bedi dwuma so. Mmabun a wonya wɔn ho ayamhyehye ne wɔn ho a wogye tom no boa ma wotumi ko tia wɔn ho nsɛm a ɛnteɛ na wodi nkate a ɛne sɛ wɔmfata anaasɛ wɔn ho adwenem naayɛ so nkonim. Mmoa a wɔhwehwɛ fi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa afotufo hɔ no betumi ama wɔanya nkuranhyɛ, akwankyerɛ, ne nea wɔagye atom, na aboa mmabun ma wɔadi haw so na wɔakɔ so de wɔn ho ahyɛ wɔn nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho no mu.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn ba, na dɛn na ɛba bere a wɔnyem?
answer: Nkwaboaa: Nwotwaa ba bere a mmadwoa nkwammoaa bi hyia nkesua nkwammoaa a ɛwɔ awotwaa no mu biako mu no. Eyi taa ba bere a obi renya nna mu. Sɛ mmadwoa bi hyɛn nkesua no mu a, wɔn awosu mu nneɛma bom yɛ nea broni frɛ no 'zygote', a ɛyɛ onipa foforo nkwammoaa a edi kan. Nyinsɛn: Bere a wɔawo awo akyi no, 'zygote' no fi ase paapae ntɛmntɛm bere a ɛnam fallopian tube no mu kɔ awotwaa no mu no. Ɛbɛyɛ nea broni frɛ no 'blastocyst' na ɛde ne ho hyɛ awotwaa no mu. Afei 'blastocyst' no nyin bɛyɛ awotwaa na akyiri yi ɛbɛyɛ awotwaa. Nyinsɛn no kɔ so kosi sɛ akokoaa no bɛyɛ krado ama awo, na mpɛn pii no ɛba bɛyɛ adapɛn 40 fi brayɛ bere a etwa to no mu. Wɔ nyinsɛn mu no, ɔbea nipadua no yɛ nsakrae pii de boa akokoaa a ɔrenyin no, a nea ɛka ho ne nkwaadɔm mu nsakrae, mogya dodow a ɛkɔ soro, ne nsakrae a ɛba awotwaa no mu ma akokoaa a ɔrenyin no betumi atra mu. Saa nneɛma yi ho hia na ama nnipa awo na wɔakɔ so atra ase.

question: Dwuma bɛn na nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ di wɔ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ne wɔn abusuabɔ mu?
answer: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho bɔbea betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ mu nkɛntɛnso a ebenya so de nam: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nipasu nkɔso ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho no so. question: kwan bɛn so na asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ahyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nkuran na wɔama mmeawa ne mmabaa a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so tumi, ma wɔadi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nhomasua, akwahosan, ne sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow so?

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so ahu nsakrae a aba wɔ mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a ebetumi aka sɛnea metumi anya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no?
answer: Wubetumi akɔ so ahu nsakrae a aba wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow mu a ebetumi aka wo tumi a wode benya awo akwahosan ho nnwuma sɛ ɔbabun denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wogye di, aban wɛbsaet ahorow, ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ (UNICEF/WHO)a wɔde wɔn adwene si mmabun akwahosan ne hokwan "rights" ahorow so no akyi. Saa mmeae yi betumi de nsɛm foforo ama wɔ mmara a ɛfa ho, nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, ne mmara mu nkɔso a ɛka awo akwahosan ho nnwuma ho. Bio nso, wobɛtumi de wo ho ahyɛ ɔsatuo a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban mu, akɔ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu ahodoɔ, na woakɔka ahyehyɛdeɛ a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene asi awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm so na woakɔ so de wo ho ahyɛ mu na woanya nsɛm a ɛfa wo hokwan ne ɔhwɛ a wobɛnya ho amanneɛ.

question: Dwuma bɛn na aduan pa di wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu?
answer: Aduane pa som bo pa ara de boa apɔwmuden nyinaa, a nna ne awoɔ mu apɔwmuden mmerɛ a obi yɛ ababaawa anaa aberanteɛ (adolescence) ka ho.Aduane a ahoɔden wom ma kwan ma nna mu akwaa, "hormones," ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ nipadua mu nyini na ɛyɛ adwuma yie. Aduanepa bɛtumi aka awoɔ mu ahoɔden (fertility), ɔkyere (menstrual health), "hormones" mmerɛ, ne tumi a nipadua no wɔ sɛ ɛbɛtumi akura nyinsɛn pa mu wɔ daakye.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no boa ma nsonsonoe ba ɔhwɛ a mmabun nyamu, na nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ebetumi aboa ma wɔayi anansesɛm afi hɔ, ama nimdeɛ akɔ soro, na wɔahyɛ nneyɛe pa a ɛhwehwɛ akwahosan ho nkuran?
answer: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ahorow, nsɛm a ɛnteɛ, ne anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho no betumi anya ɔhwɛ a mmabun nya so nkɛntɛnso kɛse: Nsonsonoe a Ɛwɔ Nneɛma a Wonya Mu: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ betumi ama wɔabu wɔn animtiaa wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, na asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ esiane atemmu anaa aniwu ho suro nti. Ebia anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yarewa 'STI', ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no bɛma mmabun abam abu sɛ wobenya nnwuma a ɛho hia, na ɛde nsonsonoe aba ɔhwɛ mu. Nnwuma a Egyina Mpɔtam Hɔ: Nnwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ anansesɛm a wobeyi afi hɔ, nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ soro, ne akwahosan hwehwɛ nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmabun mu. Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ama, ama nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛw, na wɔayɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de m’afotu anaa ayaresa berɛ no adi dwuma yiye, na dɛn na metumi ayɛ wɔ nhyiam ahorow no akyi de aboa m’adwene mu akwahosan?

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabunbere ne nipadua mu nsesae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no nya nipadua su ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho sesa?
answer: Mmabunbere de nipadua mu nsakrae atitiriw te sɛ onyin a ɛyɛ hu, nna mu su foforo a ɛba, ne nsakrae a ɛba nipadua no nsusuwii ne nea ɛwom mu ba. Ntotoho: Sɛ obi de ne ho toto n’atipɛnfo anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mfonini ho a, ebetumi ama nipadua ho mfonini ho dadwen ayɛ kɛse wɔ ne babunbere mu. Bu a Wobu Wɔn Ho: Nsakrae betumi aba wɔ obu a wɔwɔ ma wɔn ho mu bere a mmabun reyɛ nsakrae wɔ wɔn nipadua a ɛresesa no mu na wɔfa asetra mu nhyɛso ahorow a ɛfa nipadua mu hwɛbea ho no.

question: Dɛn ne akwan bi a mɛfa so ama nkurɔfo ate adwenem akwahosan ho asɛm na wɔama mmoa a, wɔhwehwɛ wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ no ayɛ nea ɛfata? (nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nhyiam ahorow, sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow)

question: Dwuma bɛn na nokware di wɔ sɛnea social media (Abɛɛfo ntentan)  nkɛntɛnsofo nkrasɛm a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho no tu mpɔn mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun hu nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware ne nsɛm a wɔboa anaasɛ ɛdaadaa nkurɔfo?
answer: Nokwaredi ma abɛɛfo ntentan nkɛntɛnsofo nkrasɛm a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti ho no tu mpɔn denam: Ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so ama atiefoɔ anya wɔn mu gyidie ne nokwaredie; efisɛ atiefoɔ no ani sɔ nsɛm a ɛfiri koma mu na ɛyɛ nokware kyen nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ no so anaa nsɛm a wɔde bɔ dwa. Nkɛntɛnsofo a wɔbɛma wɔne wɔn atiefo adi nkitaho wɔ wɔn ankasa gyinabea, a wɔbɛma wɔanya tema, ntease, ne mmoa. Mmabun hu nsɛm a wɔde to gua a ɛyɛ nokware ne nea wɔboa anaasɛ ɛdaadaa obi denam: Wɔhwɛ nneɛma bi te sɛ sɛnea obi bue ne ho ano pefee wɔ nnwumakuo a ɔne wɔn bɔ mu yɛ adwuma ho, ne sɛ ɔda mfasoɔ biara a ɛyɛ ahintadeɛ adi. Bio nso, wɔhwɛ sɛ ne nsɛm a ɔka no kɔ so pɛpɛɛpɛ anaa. Wɔde nsɛm a wɔatua ho ka de abɔ dwa no toto ne nsɛm a ɔdaa ɔkyerɛw no ho, de hwɛ sɛ ne kasa kwan ne ne kyerɛw kwan no hyia ne nokwaredie a wɔnim no ho anaa.

question: Sɛn na wɔsa nna mu yareɛ (STI), na dɛn na mɛyɛ sɛ sɛ minya  bi a?
answer: Ayaresa: Wɔde  nnuru a ekum yareɛ mmoawa (antibiotics)   te sɛ  nna mu yareɛ a wɔfrɛ no borɔfo kasa  mu sɛ  chlamydia, babaso (gonorrhea) anaa nnuro a ekum HIV mmoawa. Nna mu yareɛ no bi a wɔfrɛ no borɔfo kasa  mu sɛ herpes ne HPV nni ayaresa nanso wɔbetumi de nnuro abrɛ no asi. Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ no sɛ,  wo bɛ hwehwɛ ayaresa mmoa ntɛmntɛm na di wo dɔketa ayaresa nhyehyɛeɛ no so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Fa w’aduru nyinaa na bɔ wo nna mu ɔhokafoɔ amanneɛ sɛnea  wɔbetumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔanya ayaresa sɛ ɛhia a. Twe wo ho fi nna ho kosi sɛ ayaresa no bɛwie na yareɛ no afi wo ho.

Nneɛma a wɔde hwehwɛ sɛ wɔfata: Mmabun betumi de wɔn din ahyɛ Natoional health insurance Scheme no mu Bere a wɔde wɔn din bɛhyɛ mu a wɔabue mu na ɛfata, nanso ebia bere titiriw bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde kyerɛw wɔn din wɔ asetra mu nsɛm bi ho.

question: So metumi anya telehealth services ama nhyehyɛe a wɔde di akyi anaa apɔwmuden ho ahiade a ɛkɔ so?
answer: Yiw, wobetumi de telehealth services adi dwuma de ayɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde di akyi ne apɔwmuden ho ahiade a ɛkɔ so, te sɛ atetesɛm mu nsrahwɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ ankorankoro nkyɛn no. Telehealth so wɔ mfaso titiriw ma nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ daa, nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, afotu, ne tebea horow a enni sabea a wɔhwɛ a enhia sɛ wɔtaa kɔsra wɔn ankasa. Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de ɔhwɛ a ɛkɔ so ama denam telefon so akwahosan so, de mmoa a ɛkɔ so ne hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ so ama sɛnea ɛho hia.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na me nna mu akwaahosan ne awo mu osuahu ahorow betumi aka m’adwene mu akwahosan? (adwennwen, dadwen, adwenemhaw) .
answer: Wo nna mu akwahosan ne awo mu osuahu ahorow betumi aka w’adwene akwahosan, ne nea ɛne no bɔ abira. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no ni: Adwennwen ne Dadwen: Nyinsɛn, nna mu nyarewa (STIs), anaa nipadua mfonini ho dadwen betumi de adwennwen ne dadwen aba. question: Su ahorow bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwehwɛ wɔ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa mmoa kuo bi mu na ama mahwɛ ahu sɛ meyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa ne nna mu nipasu sɛ mmabun a mete dɛmdi?
answer: Hwehwɛ saa su ahorow yi wɔ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ anaa kuo a wɔboa: Fa w’adwene si Mmabun a wɔadi dɛm so: Ɛsɛ sɛ kuw no di mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ahiade pɔtee ne osuahun ahorow ho dwuma. Hwɛ sɛ beae no yɛ nea ɛma akwaaba na ɛboa nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna. Tebea a Obuo wom: Ɛsɛ sɛ kuo no nya akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ a ɛhyɛ nkitahodie a obu wom ne kokoamsɛm ho nkuran.

question: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho ɔhaw a ɛfa abɛɛfa ntentan so nkitahodi ne apomoden mfiridwuma ho?
answer: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho ɔhaw ne na ɛfa abɛɛfa ntetan anaa abɛɛfa ntetan intanɛt so nkitahodi ne apomoden ho mfiridwuma ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho akwankyerɛ, nnwinnade, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din, te sɛ UNESCO, UNICEF, ne Wiase Apomoden Ahyehyɛde no ayɛ, a ɛde afotu a mfaso wɔ so, akwan horow, ne nneyɛe pa a wɔfa so tra ahobammɔ ne ahobammɔ mu wɔ intanɛt so ma. Afotuo dwumadie, ɔhaw ho telefon so, ne mmoa akuo a wɔyɛ wɔn ho titire wɔ intanɛt so ayayadeɛ, kɔmputa so ayayadeɛ, ne abɛɛfa ntetan ayayadeɛ mu, a wɔde kokoamu mmoa, nkateɛ mu mmoa, ne sɛ ɛho hia a wɔde wɔn kɔ nneɛma foforɔ anaa mmara kwan so mmoa ma. Abɛɛfa ntetan so nhyiamu ahorow, nkɔmmɔbɔ akuw, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim a mmabun betumi akyɛ osuahu ahorow, asesa afotu, na wɔahwehwɛ akwankyerɛ afi afoforo a wɔahyia ɔhaw a ɛte saa ara wɔ intanɛt so mmeae a wɔbɛkɔ na wɔadi abrabɔ pa ho ɔhaw ho dwuma no hɔ. Wɔhyɛ mmabun nso nkuran sɛ wɔnka ɔhaw a wohyia wɔ Intanɛt so nkyerɛ wɔn awofo, anaa ɔpanyin a wogye wɔn di mfa mmoa wɔn

question: So metumi anya nna ho apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ?
answer: Yiw, sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow pii de nna ho apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ma, a adwumayɛbea ahorow, nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ, ne nsɛm a wɔde ma ka ho. Ebia wo sukuu no de nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nipadua akwaa, mmabunbere, STIs, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ a ahoɔden wom bɛma. Bio nso, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow taa yɛ nhyiam ahorow anaasɛ wɔde nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti ho ma. Wubetumi abisa wo sukuu apɔwmuden ho adesua dwumadibea anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow de asua pii afa nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mɛtumi akasa na wɔayɛ mmara pa a ɛbɛboa me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ a ɛfa GBV ho na ɛboa wɔn a wɔ te ase (wɔde mpɔtam hɔ ananmusifo di nkitaho, fi adesrɛ ahorow ase)
answer: Hu W’Ananmusifoɔ: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa wo mpɔtam hɔ sukuu baguafoɔ anaa kuropɔn agyinatukuo ananmusifoɔ ho. Nhwehwɛmu Nhyehyɛe a Ɛwɔ Hɔ Dedaw Mu: Sua wo sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa GBV a wosiw ano ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔ te ase. Fi Adesrɛ ase: Yɛ adesrɛ krataa wɔ intanɛt so anaa krataa so a wo ne wo mfɛfo sukuufo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔkamfo nsakrae pɔtee bi kyerɛ, te sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ko tia ayayade anaa adwenemyare ho nneɛma a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu. Kasa! Kɔ baguam nhyiamu anaa sukuu bagua nhyiamu na fa obuo ko ma nsakraeɛ a ɛfa GBV ho.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi towtua, ayaresa ho banbɔ a ySSSinsurance, ne sikasɛm mu asɛyɛde afoforo a ɛyɛ den no mu bere a wɔdan kɔ mpanyin afe so na wɔde wɔn ho kɛse wɔ sikasɛm mu no?
answer: Bere a mmabun dan kɔ mpanyin afe so na wɔde wɔn ho kɛse wɔ sikasɛm mu no, wobetumi ahyia  a ɛfa towtua, broɔfo kasa a yɛfrɛ no sɛ insurance, ne sikasɛm mu asɛyɛde afoforo ho. question: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, amammerɛ a agye din, ne abɛɛfo ntentan "social media" di wɔ suban ne adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe "sexual assult" ho no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ nkrasɛm ne nsusuwii hunu a epira mu yiye na wɔakasa atia "harmful messages and stereotypes"?
answer: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ "creating Awareness", amammerɛ a agye din, ne sohyial media di dwuma titiriw wɔ suban ne adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe "sexual assult" ho no mu. Ayaresa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛfata mmabun (Youth-friendly services). Yɛbɛko atia amammerɛ a ɛsiw kwan. Mmabun a wɔbɛdi anim (Peer-led initiatives). Nkabom a yɛne awofoɔ ne dɔkotafoɔ bɛyɛ.

question: So metumi anya afotu anaa ayaresa dwumadi ahorow wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so anaa telefon so, na mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ afotu a wɔde ma wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so?
answer: Yiw, wubetumi anya afotu anaa ayaresa dwumadi ahorow wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so anaa telefon so, a ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wubenya, titiriw sɛ wowɔ akwanside ahorow te sɛ kwan wɔbɛ fa so akɔ ayersabea  anaa nhyehyɛe mu ntawaatawadi a. Mfaso a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri afotu mu ne sɛnea wotumi yɛ nsakrae, sɛnea ɛyɛ mmerɛw, ne sɛnea wubetumi anya nnwuma afi w’ankasa fie. Nanso, ebia anohyeto ahorow te sɛ haw a ebetumi aba wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nkitahodi ho, kokoam nsɛm ho haw, ne nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ ayaresa osuahu no mu sɛ wɔde toto ankorankoro nhyiam ahorow ho a. Ɛho hia sɛ wokari mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow no na wopaw ɔkwan a ɛne w’ahiade ahorow hyia yiye.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Adwene mu mmoa (emotional support) bɛn na mebehia berɛ a mayɛ "abortion" (apɔn afuru) akyi? (afotuo adwumfoɔ, anaa mmoa akuo bi)?
answer: Gyinaeɛ biara a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho a wobɛsi no bɛtumi ayɛ den ama w’adwene. Mmeaeɛ bi a wubetumi anya adwene mu mmoa a kokoamsɛm wom nie: Ayaresabea ahoroɔ no bɛma wo afotuo (counselling) ansa na woayi nyinsɛn no, ne ɛno akyi nso. Sɛ wowɔ ɔhaw biara a, wubetumi ne apɔmuden ho adwumfoɔ no anaa ɔpanyin biara a wode wo ho to no so akasa.

question: So nsɛm pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmudenn ho a ebetumi aka adwenem apɔwmuden sen afoforo? (nyinsɛn a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, STI, nna mu ayayade) .
answer: Nsɛm bi a esisi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho betumi anya adwenemyare so nkɛntɛnso kɛse: Nyinsɛn a Wɔanhyehyɛ: Atenka ne nhyehyɛe mu nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a wɔanhyehyɛ mu no betumi de dadwen, adwenemhaw, ne adwennwen aba. STI: Sɛ wohu sɛ ɔwɔ STI a, ebetumi ama wanya aniwu, afobu, ne dadwen. Nna mu Ayayade: Nna mu ayayade betumi anya adwene apɔwmuden so nkɛntɛnso bɔne a emu yɛ den na ɛtra hɔ daa. Ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ mmoa fi animdefo hɔ sɛ woanya nna mu ayayade a.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so gyina ano anaa akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho a mmabun betumi de adi nkate horow a ɛboro so anaa adwene a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho ho dwuma mprempren?
answer: Akwan a Wɔfa so Gyina Ano ne Akwan a Wɔfa so Hwɛ Wɔn Ho: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ne akwan a wɔfa so hwɛ wɔn ho adi dwuma de adi nkate horow a ɛboro so anaa adwene a ɛne sɛ wobekum wɔn ho no ho dwuma mprempren. Ebia eyinom bi ne ahomegye a emu dɔ, adwene mu nneyɛe, anigyede anaa dwumadi ahorow a wɔn ani gye ho a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, nnamfo anaa abusua mufo a wɔboa wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn, anaasɛ adwumayɛfo mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ sabi dɛmdi hokwan nkamfoɔ mu?
answer: Kɔka Nkamfo Akuo Ho: Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam anaa ɔman sabi dɛmdi nkamfo ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa akuo mu. Kɔ nhyiam, dwumadie, ne ɔyɛkyerɛ a saa akuo yi hyehyɛ no mu. Yɛ Otuhoakyɛ Adwuma: Fa wo berɛ ne wo nimdeɛ boa nkamfo mmɔdenbɔ, sɛ ɛnam dwumadie a wobɛhyehyɛ, nimdeɛ a wobɛtrɛ mu, anaa adwuma mmoa a wobɛma so. Fa Wo Nne Di Dwuma: Kasa fa sabi dɛmdi hokwan nsɛm ho wɔ wo mpɔtam ne ntentanfidie nyinaa so. Kyɛ w’ankasa abakɔsɛm na kamfo nsakraeɛ. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne Nteteeɛ: Kɔ nhyiam, nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiam, ne nteteeɛ dwumadie a ɛfa sabi dɛmdi hokwan ne nkamfo ho. Sua ade na kyerɛ afoforɔ fa hokwan a nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ sabi dɛmdi ho.

question: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma mmabun tu kɔ mmeae foforo, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛne nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ahorow di nkitaho?
answer: Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma mmabun tu kɔ mmeae foforo no bi ne; sikasɛm mu hokwan ahorow, abusua a wɔbɛsan ayɛ biako, nhomasua ho anidaso, ntawntawdi anaa ɔtaa a woguan, ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia te sɛ wim nsakrae. Eyinom ne nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ di nkitaho ɛfiri sɛ atubrafoɔ bɛtumi ahyia nsɛnnennen wɔ SRH dwumadie a wɔbɛnya wɔ mmeaeɛ foforɔ na wɔbɛtumi ahyia asiane foforɔ.

answer: Wo suahu ahorow no som bo! Sɛnea mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow boaboa mmabun nsɛm ano ni: Nhwehwɛmu: Ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu de ate w’ahiade ne nea wopɛ ase. question: Mmɔden bɛn na aban ahorow, amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akuw rebɔ de adi mmabun a, wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ahosiesie, ne wɔn a wɔtɔn wɔn wɔ Intanɛt so no ho dwuma, na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya ahobammɔ ne yiyedi wɔ dijitaal mmeae ahorow?
answer: Aban ahorow, amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akuw reyɛ adwuma de adi mmabun nna mu ɔbrasɛe ne wɔn a wɔtɔn wɔn wɔ Intanɛt so ho dwuma: Mmra ne nea wɔde di dwuma: Mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma de ako atia nna mu ɔbrasɛe, ahosiesie, ne aguadi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Intanɛt so, ne akwan a wɔfa so hyɛ mmra no mu den de di wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no asɛm. Nhumu ne nkyerɛkyerɛ: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu ɔsatu a wɔde bɛma de ama mmabun tumi anya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw ma wɔahu na wɔabɔ amanneɛ wɔ intanɛt so dwumadie ne ayayadeɛ ho. Mmoa dwumadie: Mmoa dwumadie ne mmoa nhama a wɔde besi hɔ de mmoa, afotuo, ne ahobanbɔ ama mmabun a wɔanya osuahu wɔ intanɛt so a wɔde wɔn di dwuma anaa wɔtɔn wɔn.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ manya nyinsɛn ne awo a ɛfata?
answer: Mmabun a wɔyem betumi ayɛ nneɛma bi de ahyɛ nyinsɛn ne awo a ahoɔden wom ho nkuran denam: Wɔn a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ daa ansa na wɔawo wɔn na wɔadi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nyansahyɛ ahorow akyi. Aduan a ɛkari pɛ a nnuaba, nhabannuru, aburow a wɔayam, protein a ɛnyɛ den, ne calcium pii wom a wubedi. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛkɔ so ayɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛnyɛ den pii a akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo apene so. Kwati nneɛma a epira te sɛ nsa, tawa, ne nnubɔne a wɔde gye wɔn ani. Adwennwen a wobedi ho dwuma denam akwan a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, asetra mu mmoa, ne afotu a wɔde ma sɛ ɛho hia a. Wɔn ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho wɔ awo, nufu a wɔde ma, ne mmofra a wɔawo wɔn foforo hwɛ ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛte nka sɛ wɔasiesie wɔn ho na wɔama wɔn tumi ama awofoyɛ.

question: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a mmabun hyia bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu,nna mu yare a yɛtwa no tia sɛ STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne ɛnanom akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe?
answer: Mmabun betumi ahyia mmara ne nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow bere a wɔrehwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, a nea ɛka ho ne: Mfe a wɔadi anohyeto: Mmara betumi ahyɛ mfe a ɛba fam koraa a wɔde benya nnwuma bi, asiw mmabun ahofadi ne gyinaesi ano. Awofo pene a wɔhwehwɛ: Aman ahorow bi hyɛ awofo pene ma mmabun na ama wɔanya nnwuma ahorow, na ebetumi asiw wɔn kwan sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ ɔhwɛ na wɔabu wɔn kokoam hokwan ahorow so. Ahintasɛm a wonni: Wɔ mmeae a kokoam ahobammɔ  yɛ mmerɛw no, mmabun betumi asuro sɛ wobebu kokoam nsɛm so na wɔayɛ nyiyim, na ama wɔagyae nnwuma a ɛho hia a wɔbɛhwehwɛ. Anohyeto ahorow a wɔde ma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho: Mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya nyinsɛn a woyi gu, te sɛ mmara nhyeso wom ne animtiaabu betumi de mmabun akwahosan ne wɔn yiyedi ato asiane mu, na ɛde nneyɛe a ahobammɔ nnim ne nea enye a efi mu ba aba.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi afa amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfo adwene a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wɔde di dwuma ne nea wobenya ho, na makamfo awo hokwan ne ahofadi a ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer: Edi kan, Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua amammerɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ adwene ahodoɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano ne awoɔ hokwan ho, na te sɛdeɛ ɛbɛtumi anya suban ne nneyɛeɛ so nkɛntɛnsoɔ ase. Nsɛnnennen a Wɔde Di Dwuma: kasa tia animtiaabu ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho denam nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, anansesɛm a wobeyi afi hɔ, ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso no so. Fa wo ho hyɛ Nkɔmmɔbɔ mu: Wo ne abusua mufo, atipɛnfo, mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo mmɔ nkɔmmɔ a obu wom de kamfo awo hokwan ahorow, ahofadi, ne nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya. Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri kyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam a ɛde nsɛm a edi mu ma wɔ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho. Kɔka ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, nnwuma a mmabun di anim, anaa awo hokwan ho ɔsatu ahorow a ɛyɛ adwuma de ma ankorankoro nyinaa nya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ne awo akwahosan ho dwumadie kɔ anim, a amammerɛ anaa ɔmanfoɔ suban mfa ho.

question: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛboa ma wonya adwene mu akwahosan pa, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akura wɔn adwene mu yiyedi mu anaasɛ wɔama atu mpɔn?
answer: Abusuabɔ Pa: Abusuabɔ a ɛboa a wo ne abusuafo ne nnamfo benya. Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ: Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a wobɛyɛ no daa betumi ama adwene atu mpɔn na ama adwennwen so atew. Asetra a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Aduan a ahoɔden wom a wubedi, nna a ɛfata, ne nneɛma a epira te sɛ nnubɔne ne nsa a wobɛkwati. Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ: Bere a wubegye ama dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, akwan horow a wobɛfa so agye w’ahome a wode bedi dwuma, na woadi adwennwen ho dwuma. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Sɛ worepere a, wo ne ɔpanyin anaa adwenemyare ho ɔbenfo a wogye no di bɛkasa.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ma mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔreyɛ awofo wɔ STI/HIV ano aduru ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nnwuma a wobenya ho?
answer: Mmara ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔreyɛ awofo ho esiane asɛyɛde afoforo ne mmerɛwyɛ ahorow nti: Mmabun a wɔyem anaa wɔyɛ awofo betumi ahyia atemmu anaa nyiyim a ɛfa wɔn awo ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, na ɛbɛka wɔn kwan a wɔfa so nya nna mu akwahosan ho nnwuma a ɛnyɛ atemmu. Ebia nea ɛka abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow ho ne hia a ehia sɛ wɔkari pɛ wɔ hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wodi wɔn ho so ne kokoamsɛm ne asɛyɛde a ɛne sɛ wɔbɔ wɔn mma akwahosan ne yiyedi ho ban no ho. Mmara nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛbɛma awofo de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔpene so wɔ tebea horow bi mu, titiriw wɔ aduruyɛ mu akwan horow anaa nea wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ma mmofra nkumaa ho.

question: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ama mmabun anya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ntease wom?
answer: Bu mmabun ahofadi ne akwannya  a wɔwɔ sɛ wosi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔde ama no yɛ nokware, egyina adanse so, na enni animhwɛ anaa atemmu biara. Bu mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn kokoam nsɛm bere a woresusuw nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate ho no. Sesa nsɛm ma ɛne mmabun ankorankoro amammerɛ, kasa, ne nkɔso ahiade ahorow hyia. Ma mmabun tumi ma wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ wɔn akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu denneennen na wɔkamfo wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow. Ɔkwan a egyina hokwan ahorow so a wɔbɛfa so na wɔabu sɛnea wobetumi anya bi no sɛ adum atitiriw no mu biako

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow nya mmabun a wobenya nna ne awoɔ ho apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no?
answer: Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidie ahorow betumi anya mmabun kwan a wɔfa so nya nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma so nkɛntɛnso denam adwene a wobenya wɔ nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ho nneyɛe ho so nkɛntɛnso so. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidie ahorow bi betumi abɔ nna mu apomoden ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho animtiaa anaasɛ asiw nnwuma bi a wobenya ano, bere a afoforo betumi aboa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ɔhwɛ a edi mu.

question: Dɛn na metumi ahwɛ kwan wɔ bere a matu nyinsɛn agu akyi no? (honam ne nkate fam) .
answer: Nipadua mu Ahotɔ: Ebia wobɛte akisikuru (cramping), mogya a ɛbɛtɔ wo, na wo ho ayɛ wo yaw kakra nna kakraa bi. Wo duruyɛfo de akwankyerɛ bɛma wɔ ɛyaw ano aduru ne sɛnea wo ho bɛtɔ wo ho. Nkate mu Ahotɔ: Ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ wubenya nkate ahorow bi bere a woatu nyinsɛn agu akyi, te sɛ ahotɔ, awerɛhow, anaa afobu. Sɛ wo ne ɔfotufo anaa ɔyaresafo bi kasa a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woadi wo nkate horow ho dwuma.

question: Hokwan ahorow bɛn na mmabun wɔ,wɔ ahomegye, ahomegye bere, ne bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome wɔ adwuma ho?
answer: Mmabun wɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ ahomegye bere, ne bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome wɔ adwuma ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Ahomegye bere: Ɛdenam mpɔtam hɔ adwumayɛfo ho mmara ne nnwuma gyinapɛn ahorow so no, adwumayɛfo a wonnii mfe aduonu wɔ hokwan sɛ wogye wɔn ahome daa wɔ bere a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ adwuma mu no mu na ama wɔatumi asiw ɔbrɛ ano na wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn yiyedi. Adidi mu ahomegye: Wɔtaa hwehwɛ sɛ adwumawuranom de ahomegye bere anaa awia aduan ma adwumayɛfo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so bere a wɔde nnɔnhwerew dodow bi ayɛ adwuma awie no, na wɔma wonya bere de gye wɔn ahome na wonya aduan. Bere a wɔde gye wɔn ahome: Mmabun betumi anya hokwan sɛ wogye wɔn ahome esiane nneɛma te sɛ yare, abusua mu emergency, anaa wɔn ankasa ntease ahorow nti, sɛnea wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ adwumayɛ ho apam, adwumayɛfo apam, anaa adwumayɛ ho mmara mu no.

question: Akwan bɛn na kuro manfoɔ betumi afa so de mboa ama wɔn a wɔresi sɔ a sɛbi wɔn ho a didem a so benya bambɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛhɔ yɛ fɛ na woanya mboa kuo a ɛbɛkɔ so daa?
answer: Atuhoamafoɔ Berɛ (wɔn a wɔboa/wɔn a wɔkyerɛ kwan). Sika a yɛ boano.ɔkasama dwuna a tia nyiyimu.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahoɔden ne ahotoso a mede bɛko atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso bere a meda so ara ne m’atipɛnfo nya abusuabɔ pa?
answer: Nya wo ho a wobɛte ase: Te wo gyinapɛn ahorow, nneɛma a wode di kan, ne ahye ahorow a ebetumi akyerɛ gyinaesi kwan na ama woatumi agyina ano no ase. Ntetee a ɛfa asɛm a wɔka sie ho: Fa nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a ɛyɛ den di dwuma na ama woatumi de ahotoso ada wo hye ne nea wopɛ adi akyerɛ w’atipɛnfo. Hwehwɛ abusuabɔ a ɛboa: Fa nnamfo a wobu wo gyinaesi ahorow na wɔboa no twa wo ho hyia, na ma w’atipɛnfo tebea pa. Fa w’adwene si w’ankasa nkɔso so: Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma wunya obu, ahofadi, ne ahotoso wɔ wo ho mu, te sɛ anigyede, agumadi, anaa adebɔ mu nneɛma.

question: Sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wosi gyinae wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?

question: Dwuma bɛn na abɛɛfo mfidie 'Technology' di de boa mmabun ma wonya ɔhwɛ a ɛfata, a telehealth ne online resources ka ho?
answer: Abɛɛfo mfidie te sɛ telehealth ma mmabun kwan ma wonya ɔhwɛ fi wɔn fie. Wei yi akwansidie te sɛ lore a wobɛfo ɛnam beebia wɔte nti. Telehealth boa ma wo ne ayaresafoɔ do nkɔmmɔ denam video consultations, messaging, ne phone calls. Wei boa wɔn a wɔtete nkurase paa. Online resources te sɛ websites so ma nimdie a ɛfata. Mmabun betumi ne ayaresafoɔ adi nkɔmmɔ wɔ online (appointment scheduling) na wagye mmoa ɛhia. Na ɛte mmerɛsɛeɛ so. Wɔde elcvtronic health records (EHRs) sie mmabun apɔwmuden ho nsɛm so yie. Wei ma yehu sɛ abɛɛfo mfidie di dwuma yie wɔ mmabun apɔwmudenhwɛ mu.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ma wɔate wɔn nna mu ne awo hokwan ahorow ase?
answer: Akwan a wɔbɛfa so aboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ase ni: Nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee: Yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne mpenatwe ho. question: Nsakraeɛ bɛn na ɛba mmaa awoɔ mu wɔ mmabunyɛ mmerɛ mu?
answer: Nkosua: Wɔ mmabun berɛ mu no, nkosu no fi ase nyin na ɛma nkosua fi mu ba. Wɔfrɛ saa adeyɛ yi sɛ ovulation. Awotoa: Awotoa no nyin na enyin de siesie ne ho ma nyinsɛn a ebetumi aba. Fallopian Tubes: Saa ntini yi nyin kɛse na edi dwuma titiriw wɔ nkosua a efi awotoa mu kɔ awotoa no mu no mu. Vagina: ɛtwɛ no nyin yie. Ɛsan nso yi nsuo a ɛboa nna mu agorɔ. Nufoɔ: Nufoɔ fi ase nyin nkakrankara hyehyɛ nsuo. Nkwammoa bi yɛfrɛ ɔmo estrogen ne pregesterone na adi saa dwuma yi nyinaa.

Fallopian Tubes: Saa ntini yi nyin kɛse na edi dwuma titiriw wɔ nkosua a efi awotoa mu kɔ awotoa no mu no mu. Vagina: ɛtwɛ no nyin yie. Ɛsan nso yi nsuo a ɛboa nna mu agorɔ. Nufoɔ: Nufoɔ fi ase nyin nkakrankara hyehyɛ nsuo. Nkwammoa bi yɛfrɛ ɔmo estrogen ne pregesterone na adi saa dwuma yi nyinaa.

question: Akwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ nkabom akuo (community-based organizations) ne sukuu ahodoɔ, ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ, aban mpanimfoɔ, ne afoforɔ a asɛm no fa wɔn bɔ mu yɛ adwuma de hyɛ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ den na ama eduru mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa pii nkyɛn?
answer: Mpɔtam hɔ nkabom akuo (CBOs) ne nnipa ahodoɔ a asɛm no fa wɔn ho bɔ mu yɛ adwuma de hyɛ nna ne awoɔ ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ den ama mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa. Wɔne sukuu ahodoɔ yɛ adwuma bɔɔ, de nna ho nteteeɛ a ɛdi mu ma, ma akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nneɛma ne nteteeɛ, na wɔkasa ma wɔde SRH adesua to adesua nhyehyɛeɛ mu. CBOs ne ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ nso yɛ adwuma bom de hwɛ sɛ mmofra benya ayaresa a ɛfata a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛnya, denam akwankyerɛ, nteteeɛ, ne mmoa a wɔde ma so. Bio nso, wɔne aban adwumakuo ahodoɔ hyia de kasa ma mmara a ɛboa mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa SRH ho kwan na wɔkyekyɛ sika de boa SRH nhyehyɛeɛ. Sɛ wɔne afoforɔ yɛ adwuma a, ɛma CBOs tumi nya nimdeɛ, sika, ne nkabom ahodoɔ a ɛboa ma wɔn adwuma no yɛ kɛseɛ na ɛda so.

question: Akwan bɛn na wobetumi afa so ama mmabun a wontumi nnya awofo pene sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu?
answer: Mmabun a wontumi nnya awofo pene sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu no betumi anya akwan foforo a wobetumi afa so a egyina mmara ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ wɔn mantam mu so. Ebia saa akwan yi bi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛfa atemmufo kwan so anaasɛ wobenya kokoam ɔhwɛ afi wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma a wɔde nnwuma ma mmofra nkumaa a awofo mfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu no hɔ.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na fekubɔ a ɛda aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, insurance adwumakuw ahorow, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne amanaman ntam mmoa a wɔde ma ntam no betumi aboa ma wɔatrɛw apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe ne apɔwmuden ho insurance a mmabun nya mu na wɔahyɛ wɔn sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne asetra mu nkabom ho nkuran?
answer: Aban adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi de nhyehyɛe ahorow adi dwuma de ama apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn, atrɛw insurance a wɔde tua ho ka mu, aboa sika a wɔbɔ ma mmusua a wonnya sika pii, na wɔayɛ apɔwmuden ho ka ho nhyehyɛe na ama nnwuma no ayɛ nea ne bo yɛ den na wobetumi anya bi. Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo betumi de nnwuma a wɔatew ne bo so anaasɛ wɔmfa hwee mma, hyehyɛ mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow anaa apɔwmuden akuw a wɔde fa baabiara, na wɔne sukuu ahorow, mmabun mmeae, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ayɛ biako de adu nnipa a wonnya mmoa yiye nkyɛn. Insurance adwumakuw ahorow betumi ayɛ apɔwmuden ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun a wɔde sika a wɔde tua ho ka nyinaa, sika a wɔbɔ a ne bo nyɛ den, ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano ho mfaso, ne adwenemyare ho nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ne amanaman ntam mmoa a wɔde ma no betumi de sika ama apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow, aboa mpɔtam hɔ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo, akamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae, na wɔde wɔn sika ahyɛ ano aduru foforo mu de adi akwahosan mu nsonsonoe ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ mmabun yiyedi ho nkuran.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aboa me hokafo yiyedi bere a mehwɛ m’ankasa de nso?
answer: Wo hokafo yiyedi a wobɛboa bere a wode w’ankasa de di kan no hwehwɛ sɛ wokari pɛ na wo ne afoforo di nkitaho. Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ a ɛfa wɔn ho wɔn ho ahiade, nea ɛhaw wɔn, ne nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba ho nkuran. Fa tema, adansedi, ne atie a wode nsiyɛ ma bere a wo hokafo no rehyia nsɛnnennen no. Nanso, kae sɛ ɛnyɛ wo nkutoo na wobɛhwɛ wɔn yiyedi, na ɛho hia sɛ wukura ahye mu na wohwɛ w’ankasa w’adwene, nkate, ne nipadua akwahosan so. Hyɛ suban pa, nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho, ne sɛ ɛho hia a, hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu nkuran.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka no 'media literacy skills' a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm mu wɔ kwan pa mu?
answer: Awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nea broni ka no 'media' nkɛntɛnso ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho, akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ yiye ho, na wɔahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wonbisa nsɛm na wɔnhwehwɛ nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so. Wobetumi nso ankasa ayɛ nsusuwii a ɛmu dɔ ho nhwɛso na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nea broni ka 'media literacy' ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata mfe a wɔadi na ɛnyɛ atɛn so.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de meho ahye mu a ɔka obiara ho kɛse na mede mmoa ama obi a ɔwɔ GBV a ne nipasu anaa ne fibea yɛ soronko wɔ me de ho? (ahiade ahorow a wɔte ase, osuahu ahorow a wobu) .
answer: Sɛnea wobɛboa obi a ɔrehyia GBV a ɛsono ne deɛ nie: Ahiadeɛ ahodoɔ a wobɛte aseɛ: Hu sɛ osuahu a ɛfa GBV ho no bɛtumi ayɛ soronko kɛseɛ a egyina onipa ko a ɔyɛ ne baabi a ɔteɛ so. Nhwehwɛmu na sua ɔhaw pɔtee a nnipa ahorow hyia no ho ade. Osuahu ahorow a Wobebu: Tie a wunni atɛn na gye wɔn asɛm no di. Mfa no sɛ wote biribiara a wɔafa mu no ase. Fa Mmoa Ma: Boa wɔn ma wɔne nneɛma a ɛfata amammerɛ a ebetumi de mmoa a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ama wɔn no nni nkitaho.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu kɔkɔbɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ ayayade?

question: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so ahwehwɛde ahorow a ɛfa nna mu yareɛ 'STI' nhwehwɛmu, nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa ho wɔ yɛn man anaa mantam mu?

Mpɛn pii no, wɔhwehwɛ sɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi a wɔde bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu, ahu, na wɔasa 'STI' ahorow akyi, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobenya pene a wɔde nimdeɛ agye afi onipa no hɔ ansa na wɔayɛ nhwehwɛmu anaasɛ wɔde ayaresa ama.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ, de adi dwuma, na wɔasusuw akwan a wɔfa so siw nna mu basabasayɛ ano a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho, te sɛ wɔn nhumu, osuahu, ne nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔahyɛ nsakrae ho nkuran mu?
answer: Mmabun betumi aboa ma wɔayɛ akwan horow a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho a wɔde besiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano wɔ akwan horow so, de adi dwuma, na wɔasusuw ho. Wobetumi de wɔn nhumu, suahu, ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔka akyerɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, nhyehyɛeyɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma de ahwɛ sɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no di mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ne nokwasɛm ahorow ho dwuma. Mmabun nso betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a mmabun di anim de ma nkurɔfo hu na wɔhyɛ nsakrae a ɛfa nna mu basabasayɛ ne adwenemhaw ho nsɛm ho nkuran. Eyi betumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhyiam ahorow anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ de akyerɛkyerɛ wɔn atipɛnfo ne mpɔtam hɔfo, wɔbɛkamfo nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛfa ahodwiriw ho wɔ wɔn sukuu ne ahyehyɛde ahorow mu, na wɔde atipɛnfo mmoa ne biakoyɛ ama wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no. Ɛnam wɔn nne ne wɔn adwene a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse so no, mmabun betumi adi dwuma titiriw bi wɔ akwan a wɔfa so siw nna mu basabasayɛ ano a ɛka obiara ho, ɛyɛ nea etu mpɔn a wɔbɛfa so asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔaboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no mu.

question: Dɛn ne nneɛma titiriw a ɛwɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ den na ɛyɛ adwuma yiye ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de saa nneɛma yi adi dwuma wɔ amammerɛ ne asasesin ahorow mu?
answer: Akwahosan nhyehyɛe a emu yɛ den na ɛyɛ adwuma ma mmabun SRH no wɔ nneɛma atitiriw pii: Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛ a Ɛkɔ Akyiri: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, a ɛfata mfe a obi adi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a wɔde ma. Nnwuma a Wotumi Nya: Hwɛ sɛ SRH dwumadie no wɔ hɔ, ne boɔ yɛ den, na mmabun betumi anya wɔ asasesin mu. Mmabun Mmabun Ɔhwɛ: Nnwuma a wɔde ma wɔ mmeae a ammu atemmu, kokoamsɛm, na ɛkyerɛ obu ma mmabun hokwan ne nea wɔpɛ. Ahintasɛm ne Kokoam Nsɛm: Mmabun kokoam nsɛm  a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban bere a wɔrekɔ SRH nnwuma mu no. Ntetee a Wɔde Ma a Wɔde Ma: Wɔbɛtete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ma wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu, a ɛnyɛ nyiyim a ɛfa mmabun ahiade soronko ho ama. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Mpɔtamfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ SRH dwumadie no nhyehyɛɛ, wɔde bɛma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu de ahwɛ sɛ ɛfata amammerɛ na wɔgye tom. Nhyehyɛe ne Nsɛm a Wɔka Kyerɛ: Nhyehyɛe ne sikasɛm akwan a ɛde mmabun SRH di kan na edi nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nya ɔhwɛ pa ne ɔhwɛ pa ho dwuma ho kamfo.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nea broni ka no 'community outreach programs' no ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ foforɔ yɛ adwuma bom de ma mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsiw 'STI/HIV' ano no anya nkɔsoɔ?
answer: Nea broni ka no 'community outreach programs'  ne mpɔtam hɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, sukuu ahodoɔ, ne ahyehyɛdeɛ foforɔ yɛ adwuma bom de ma mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde siw 'STI/HIV' ano no nya nkɔsoɔ denam: Wɔne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma bom de 'STI/HIV' nhwehwɛmu, ayaresa, ne afotuo dwumadie ma wɔ nhyiamu a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn, mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ, ne ayaresabea ahodoɔ a wɔde fa nnipa mu. Sukuu ahorow a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ biako de nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua nhyehyɛe, adwumayɛbea ahorow, ne ahɔho kasa ahorow a ɛfa 'STI/HIV' ano a wosiw, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, ne abusuabɔ pa ho bɛma. Yɛne ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina gyidi so, mmabun akuw, ne mpɔtam hɔ mmeae a wɔyɛ adwuma bom de du nnipa ahorow ahorow nkyɛn na wɔhyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ho nkuran denam nneɛma ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfata kasa ho. Mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ, ne asetena mu nkɛntɛnsoɔfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de ama nkrasɛm a ɛfa 'STI/HIV' a wɔsiw ano, sɔhwɛ, ne ayaresa ho no ayɛ kɛseɛ denam ɔmanfoɔ som ho amanneɛbɔ, sohyial 'media' ɔsatuo, ne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm a ɛsisi so.

question: Akwan bɛn na etumi aboa paa yie wɔ nhunu mu, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nkuranhyɛ wɔ nna ne awoɔ apɔmden a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive health' ho wɔ mmabun a watu akɔtena mmeammea foforɔ ne wɔn a wɔtutututu akwan kɔ baabi foforɔ mu?
answer: Yɛbɛfa akwan bi te sɛ: Nnwuma a atipɛnfoɔ di anim, mpɔtam nkyerɛkyerɛ ahodoɔ, nhyehyeɛ emu yɛ mmerɛ a ɛma kwan mma babun biaa nya akwanya kɔhwɛ wɔn awoɔ apɔmden a pɔtɔɔ kasa mu wɔfrɛ no 'reproductive health' mu ne amammerɛ nwoma sua ho nneɛma. Yei boa wɔn ma wɔsisi gyinaeɛ pa wɔ apɔmden ne asetena ho.

question: So mmara kwan so nsunsuanso bi wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobu mmabun kokoam hokwan ahorow so no so?
answer: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobu mmabun kokoam hokwan ahorow so no betumi ahyia mmara mu nsunsuanso, a nea ɛka ho ne nteɛso a wɔn tumi krataa bagua no de bɛma wɔn, ɔmanfo mmara mu asɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ asɛnnibea wɔ nneɛma a wɔsɛee no esiane kokoamsɛm a wɔabu so nti, ne nsɛmmɔnedie ho sobo a wobetumi de abɔ wɔn sobo sɛ mmara so bu no yɛ kokoam nsɛm ho mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔabu so a. Bio nso, wobetumi de akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow asodi ato wɔn so wɔ kokoamsɛm a wɔn adwumayɛfo anaa wɔn ananmusifo abu so no ho.

question: Sɛn na 'advertising' (dawurobɔ) ka sɛdeɛ yehu ahoɔfɛ ne nna mu akɔnnɔ?
answer: Gyinapɛn: Nsɛm a wɔde bɔ dawuro fa ahoɔfɛ ho no tumi ma nnipa nya adwen a ɛnnyɛ nokorɛ.Sɛ nea obi hu ne nipadua : Ɛma wɔn te nka sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ fɛ titiriw mmofra a wɔanyin no. Products: Wɔkyerɛ sɛ nneɛma de kyerɛ sɛ ɛbɛma wɔn ho ayɛ fɛ. Mmarima ne mmaa asɛyɛdeɛ : Wɔkyerɛ mmarima ne mmaa wɔ kwan bi so. Wei tumi ka sɛdeɛ yɛte nka fa yɛn ho ne yɛn ahoɔden (self-esteem) ho.

question: Nsɛmfua ahorow bɛn na wɔde di dwuma ma nnipa a wɔne wɔn ho da (LGBTQ+)?
answer: LGBTQ+ yɛ asɛmfua a wɔde kata nnipa a wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ /anaasɛ wɔn bɔbeasu nyɛ heterosexual anaa cisgender (a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a wɔde ama wɔn wɔ awo mu). Nkyekyɛmu ni: Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual: Wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ atifi hɔ wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ mu. Transgender: Obi a ɛsono ne bɔbeasu wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde maa wɔn bere a wɔwoo no no ho. Queer: Wobetumi de adi dwuma sɛ asɛmfua a ɛtrɛw ama obiara a ɔnyɛ heterosexual anaa cisgender.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho mmoa ne afotu adwuma de adi ɛnanom akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho dwuma, a adwennwen, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw ka ho?
answer: Mmabun betumi anya adwenemyare ho mmoa denam: Wɔn a wɔne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo bɛkasa afa wɔn nkate ne wɔn haw ahorow ho. Hwehwɛ a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo, te sɛ ayaresa ho animdefo anaa afotufo. Hotlines anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a wɔde bedi dwuma de aboa ntɛm ara. Awofo nkumaa a wɔboa akuw a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a ebia adwenemyare ho nneɛma ka ho. Sukuu afotufo anaa mpanyimfo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ wɔn akwankyerɛ. Ɛnsɛ sɛ mmabun twentwɛn wɔn nan ase sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ mmoa wɔ adwennwen, dadwen, anaa adwenemhaw ho wɔ nyinsɛn anaa awo akyi..

question: Akwan bɛn na mmabun bɛtumi afa so ne wɔn ahokafo asusuw nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho?
answer: Mmabun betumi de akwan horow adi dwuma de wɔn ahokafo asusuw nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho, a nea ɛka ho ne nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware, obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, ne gyinaesi a wɔbom si. Ɛho hia sɛ ankorankoro te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔne wɔn ahokafo besusuw nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho na wɔada nea wɔpɛ ne wɔn ahye a ɛfa nna a ahobammɔ wom ho adi. Sɛ wɔde akwanhwɛ ne ahye a emu da hɔ sisi hɔ, susuw akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so asiw nyinsɛn ano ho, na wɔabom apene akwan a wɔbɛfa so asiw ano so no betumi aboa ma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ahokafo baanu no nyinaa wɔ kratafa koro wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Bio nso, sɛ wɔde nnamyɛ tie, tema, ne ntease di dwuma a, ebetumi ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛsow aba a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho na ahyɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda ahokafo ntam no mu den.

question: Dwuma bɛn na awofoɔ, ahwɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo betumi adi wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛboa a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran bere a wobu amammerɛ mu atetesɛm ne gyinapɛn ahorow?
answer: Awofoɔ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ bɛtumi adi dwuma wɔ nkɔmmɔdi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛboa a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran berɛ a wɔbu amammerɛ atetesɛm ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ denam: Wɔbɛma mmeaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkateɛ a ɛfa nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa, ne abusuabɔ a ɛwɔ mmusua, sukuu, ne mpɔtam hɔ tebea mu. Nkitahodi, ahotoso, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho ho hia wɔ awofo ne mmofra ntam abusuabɔ mu a wosi so dua, na wɔma tebea a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. Mmabun amammerɛ mu nipasu ne osuahu ahorow a wɔtraa ase a wobegye atom na wɔagye atom, nkɛntɛnso a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ne gyinapɛn ahorow nya wɔ wɔn adwene ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a wobehu. Nhomasua a ɛkɔ so ne wɔn ho a wosusuw ho de kasa tia ankorankoro animhwɛ ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔwɔ wɔ nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho, a wɔyɛ adwene a abue ne gye a wogye tom ho nhwɛso ma awo ntoatoaso a wɔyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa. Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam a ɛka obiara ho, ɛyɛ nokware, na ɛfata mfe a obi adi, a ɛne amammerɛ mu gyidi ne nea wɔpɛ hyia bere a wɔhyɛ nneyɛe ne gyinapɛn ahorow a egyina adanse so ho nkuran no.

question: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛboa mmabun ma wɔte wɔn kɔkoamunsɛm hokwan ase bere a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden mmoa?

question: So anohyeto anaa nsɛnnennen bi wɔ telehealth ho a wɔde bedi dwuma ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma no ho?
answer: Mfiridwuma mu akwanside ahorow: Intanɛt anaa mfiri a ɛfata a wonni no betumi asiw ankorankora binom kwan sɛ wɔmfa telefon so akwahosan ho nnwuma nni dwuma yiye. Nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔnyɛ: Ebia aduruyɛ mu tebea horow bi bɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ankasa nhwehwɛmu anaasɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hu yare a wontumi nyɛ wɔ akyirikyiri. Kokoam nsɛm ho haw: Ebia ayarefo bɛhaw wɔn ho wɔ wɔn ankasa akwahosan ho nsɛm ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm ho bere a wɔde dijitaal akwan redi dwuma de abisabisa wɔn nsɛm no. Insurance a wɔde tua ho ka: Ebia ɛnyɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma nyinaa na insurance tua ho ka bere a wɔde fa telehealth so de ma no, na nhyehyɛe a wɔde tua ho ka no betumi ayɛ soronko.

question: Dɛn ne hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow a mmabun wɔ wɔ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a wobenya ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ sɛ mewɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer: Hokwan: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wonya nyinsɛn ho bammɔ nnuro ne mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛfata mmabun a, ɛho  nhia awofoɔ hɔ kwan wɔ mmea pii.  Na w'hwɛ wɔn wɔ obuo mu.  Asɛdeɛ: Sɛ wobɛsisi gyinaeɛ pa, wode bɛdi dwuma yie, na woahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛhia. Sɛdeɛ wubegye wo hokwan: Sua wo hokwan ho ade ne nyinsɛn ho bammɔ nnuro, suasua mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ mo mpɔtam hɔ no. Kasa pefee kyerɛ ayaresafoɔ no. Bɔ woho mmɔden ka deɛ ɛyɛ wo ɛne nea wopɛ kyerɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ berɛ a wobɛhyia wɔn.  Hwehwɛ akwan a wobɛfa so anya nkɔmmɔ ne nsɛm ho adesua. Sanso hwehwɛ akwan a wo ne awofoɔ bɛfa so anya adwene baako, na siesie nsɛm a ɛda mo ntam. Sɛ woko ɔhaw mu a, bisa wo mpanyimfoɔ ne nkyerɛkreɛfoɔ a ɔbɛtumi aboa wo.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwaahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya, a nhwehwɛ mu ne ayaresa ka ho, nya mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ano wɔ wiase nyinaa no so nsunsuanso?
answer: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛnya, a nhwehwɛ mu ne ayaresa ka ho, nya mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsiw nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ STI ne HIV ano wɔ wiase nyinaa so nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ denam: Ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛhunu STI, HIV, ne nyarewa foforɔ a ɛfiri nna mu ntɛm na wɔasa, a ɛtew yareɛ no so na ɛsiw nsɛnnennen ano. Nhumu, nimdeɛ, ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano a wɔde di dwuma kɛse, a nea ɛka ho ne kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, PrEP, aduru a wɔde siw ano wɔ aduru a wɔde siw ano akyi (PEP), ne akwan a wɔfa so tew ɔhaw so wɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ asiane mu no mu. Mmoa dwumadie a ɛho hia te sɛ afotuo, atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne abusuabɔ a ɛda ɔhwɛ ntam a wɔde bɛma, de ama ankorankoro tumi ma wɔasi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu akwahosan ne wɔn yiedie ho. Akwahosan ho nsonsonoe ne pɛyɛ a enni hɔ wɔ nnwuma a wobenya wɔ nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua mu, a mmea, mmabun, LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, ne nnipa a wɔte nkuraase anaa akyirikyiri mmeae ka ho no ho dwuma a wobedi.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn asi nyinsɛn a mempɛ ano?
answer: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn a wɔmpɛ ano. Akwan titiriw bi ni: Nkwammoaa a wɔde siw awo ano: Saa akwan yi de hormone di dwuma de siw ovulation (egg release) ano. nhwɛsoɔ ne nnuru a wɔde kum mmadwoa, nnuru a wɔde twitwiw ne nea wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu Akwan a wɔfa so siw ano: Saa honam fam akwanside ahorow yi siw mmadwoa kwan sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua no mu. Nhwɛsoɔ ne kɔndɔm Mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUD): Mfiri nketewa a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu de siw nyinsɛn ano. Sterilization: Oprehyɛn a wɔyɛ daa ma mmarima (vasectomy) anaa mmea (tubal ligation) de siw nyinsɛn ano. Ɛho hia sɛ wokae: Ɔkwan biara nni hɔ a etu mpɔn 100%, nanso ebinom tu mpɔn kɛse sen afoforo. Kɔndɔm nkutoo ne ɔkwan a ɛboa ma wosiw nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne nyinsɛn ano. Kɔsra akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔpɛ mmabun adamfofa wɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn hɔ no na woasusuw ho bio

question: Dɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa adwumayɛbea bi anya adwenemhaw ho amanneɛbɔ anaa nhumu?

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa ɔdɔ ahokafo de ahye a ɛfata asi hɔ na ama m’adwene mu yiedi adi kan? (ka sɛ dabi, de anohyeto ahorow si hɔ) .

question: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ yɛn nsrahwɛ a yɛkɔ daa no bɛkɔ so ayɛ beae a atemmu biara nni hɔ a mete nka sɛ wɔboa me na wobu me, bere mpo a meresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa ɛyɛ den ho no?

question: Dɛn na ebetumi afi nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔammɔ ho amanneɛ mu aba, ama nea onyaa ne ti didii mu ne ɔmanfo a wɔdɔɔso nyinaa, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wodi nsɛm yi ho dwuma ntɛm na wosiw daakye ɔhaw ano?
answer: Nna mu basabasayɛ ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔremmɔ ho amanneɛ no betumi de ɔhaw kɛse aba nea onyaa ne ti didii mu no ne ɔmanfo a wɔdɔɔso no nyinaa so. Wɔ nea onyaa ne ti didii mu no fam no, sɛ wɔremmɔ amanneɛ a, ebetumi ama wɔn amanehunu no akyɛ, akyɛ mmoa a ɛho hia a wobenya, na ama wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no aguan akontaabu, na ebetumi de afoforo ato asiane mu sɛ wobepira wɔn. Wɔ ɔkwan a ɛtrɛw so no, nna mu basabasayɛ a wonni ho dwuma no ma amammerɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ komm, asotwe biara nni ho, na wɔayɛ ayayade sɛnea ɛsɛ, a ebetumi asɛe ahotoso, ahobammɔ, ne yiyedi wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no kɔ so. Ɛho hia sɛ wodi nsɛm yi ho dwuma yiye denam mmoa a wɔbɛboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu, a wobebu wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no akontaa, na wɔde akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ano bedi dwuma de asiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano ansa na aba no so.

question: Dɛn ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea awo nhyehyɛe no mu (mfinimfini) ne akyi (akyi), na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛbom yɛ adwuma?

question: Dɛn ne nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer: Nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu yɛ aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hwɛ sɛ ebia nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm afoforo wɔhɔ anaa. Wɔho hia kɛse ma mmabun efisɛ ɛboa ma wohu STI ahorow ntɛm, ɛma wotumi sa yare wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu, na ɛma nna mu akwahosan nyinaa nya nkɔso. Saa nhwehwɛmu ahorow yi nso ma wonya hokwan kyerɛkyerɛ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho.

question: Dɛn ne atetesɛm mu bɔbea dwumadi "traditional gender roles" ne akwanhwɛ ahorow wɔ yɛn man mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka nneyɛe, nea wɔpaw , ne hokwan ahorow a ankorankoro wɔ a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu "gender identity" so nkɛntɛnso?
answer: Atetesɛm mu bɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow wɔ ɔmanfo mu no taa de nneyɛe pɔtee, dwumadi ahorow, ne asɛyɛde ahorow ma ankorankoro a egyina wɔn bɔbeasu nipasu so. Saa dwumadi ahorow yi nya asetra mu nneɛma ahorow so nkɛntɛnso, a nhomasua, adwuma, abusua mu nkɔso, ne asetra mu nkitahodi ka ho. Wobetumi asiw nneɛma a ankorankoro betumi apaw ne hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ no ano, na ahyɛ pɛyɛ a enni hɔ mu den na wɔama nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so akɔ so.

question: Awo ano aduru ahorow no bi ne dɛn?
answer: Wɔde awo ano aduru a wɔsan frɛ no nyinsɛn ano no di dwuma de siw nyinsɛn ano. Ahorow ahorow pii wɔ hɔ, na emu biara wɔ mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow. Nhwɛso kakraa bi ni: Akwan a wɔfa so siw kwan: Te sɛ kɔndɔm ne diaphragm no, eyinom siw mmadwoa kwan wɔ honam fam sɛ ɛnkɔ nkesua no mu. Akwan a wɔfa so de hormone di dwuma: Eyinom de hormone di dwuma de siw ovulation (nkesua a ɛba) ano anaasɛ ɛsakra awotwaa no mu nneɛma ma ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ mu. Nhwɛso ahorow bi ne nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, nnuru a wɔde siw awo ano, ne IUD. Abusua nhyehyɛe a efi awosu mu: Eyi yɛ sɛ worehwɛ wɔ fertile window (bere a ɛda adi kɛse sɛ wubenyinsɛn) na woakwati nna wɔ saa bere no mu.

Wobetumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne pene a wɔde nimdeɛ bɛma, ne sɛnea wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu. Ɛnam nkitahodi dwumadi ahorow, dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ so no, CSE nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ ne wɔn ho mu ahotoso de asi wɔn hokwan ahorow so dua yiye.

question: Sɛ mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ sɛ wɔne wɔn awofo bɛkasa afa nsɛmsɛm a ɛfa nsubuo ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ?
answer: Hwehwɛ Mpanyimfo a Wogye Wɔn Di: Mmabun betumi akɔ ɔpanyin afoforɔ a wogye wɔn di, te sɛ sukuu fotufoɔ, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, anaa abusua muni bi nkyɛn. Fa Nneɛma a Wɔde Yɛ Adwuma Di Dwuma: Nhoma a ahotosoɔ wom, ntentanfidie ahodoɔ, anaa ahomatorofoɔ a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ a wotumi de ho to so betumi de nsɛm ne mmoa ama. Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Sɛ wuhu nnamfo a wɔrefa osuahunu a ɛte saa ara mu na wo ne wɔn bɔ nkɔmmɔ a, ebetumi akyekye wo werɛ.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi afa so akasa de agyina hɔ ama akwanya a ɛbɛma kwan a wɔfa so kɔ ayaresabea wɔ wɔn mpɔtam atu mpɔn?
answer: Mmabun bɛtumi akasa agyina hɔ ama akwanya a ɛbɛma kwan a wɔfa so kɔ ayaresabea wɔ wɔn mpɔtam atu mpɔn denam akwan yi so: Wɔn suahu ne nsɛnnennen a ɛfa akwantu akwanside ahorow ho a wɔbɛka akyerɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow so. Sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ kasafre dwumadie anaa mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu ase a wɔasi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛtu kwantuo ho mpɔn ama mmofra a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkɔ ayaresabea. Nkrataa anaa adesrɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛw akɔma mpɔtam hɔ aban mpanyimfo de ahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn sika nsie wɔ akwantu nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a edi mmabun ahiade ho dwuma yiye mu. Sukuu so ahwɛfoɔ, mmabun ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne apɔmuden ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛyɛ adwuma abom de ayɛ akwantuo ho mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiadeɛ na wɔde adi dwuma. Nhumu a wɔbɛma wɔahu hia a ɛho hia sɛ akwantuo nya apɔmuden ho dwumadie ma mmabun na wɔtwe adwene si nkɛntɛnsoɔ a akwantuo akwansideɛ nya wɔ apɔmuden mu nsunsuansoɔ so.

question: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ayɛ bea a ɛboa na wommu atɛn wɔ fie ma m'ate nka sɛ me ho tɔ me sɛ mɛbɔ me atenka ho nkɔmmɔ na m'ahwehwɛ mmoa bere a ɛho hia?
answer: Hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛmu da hɔ ne atie yie wɔ abusua no mu, na hyɛ obiara nkuran sɛ ɔnkyerɛ ne nsusuii ne ne atenka a onsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn. Fa bere a pa so si hɔ ma abusua nkɔmmɔbɔ anaasɛ check-in a obiara betumi akyɛ ne suahun na waboa ne yɔnko. Fa nhwɛso di anim denam tema, ntease, ne obuo a wobɛda no adi ama mo ho mo ho atenka ne ne nsusuii so. Fa ahyeɛ ne akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ ma nkitahodi si hɔ na ama obiara anya tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom.

question: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ɛde nyinsɛn mu ɔhaw ba a ɛsɛ sɛ mihu? (mfe a obi adi, ayaresa tebea horow a na ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw, abusua abakɔsɛm) .
answer: Asane ahorow bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wohu ni: Mfe a wɔadi: Mmabun nkumaa paa (a wonnii mfe du nnum) betumi ahyia asiane kɛse. Aduruyɛ mu Tebea horow a Ɛwɔ Hɔ dedaw: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ eyinom so bere a wɔyem no. Abusua Abakɔsɛm: Abusua abakɔsɛm a ɛfa tebea horow bi ho no betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ no ayɛ kɛse.

question: kwan bɛn so na misi gyinae sɛ ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛfata ma me a, mɛyɛ dɛn anya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer: Apomoden ngene Ho Ɔhwɛfo: Ade a edi kan a ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ne sɛ wobɛkɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi a ɔde nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwuma ma no nkyɛn. Afotu: Wɔne wo besusuw ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no, asiane ahorow, ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so ho. Ebia afotu nso wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woasisi gyinae a ɛfata. Mmara mu Ahwehwɛde: Ɛdenam beae a wowɔ so no, ebia mmara mu ahwehwɛde ahorow te sɛ bere a wɔde twɛn anaa awofo pene a wɔde bɛma mmofra nkumaa wɔ hɔ. Mmoa Nnwuma: Ayaresabea ahorow pii de mmoa adwuma ma ansa na wɔayɛ oprehyɛn no ne bere a wɔayɛ no akyi, a afotu ne nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho ka ho. Sɛ wusi gyinae sɛ nyinsɛn a wotu gu ne ɔkwan a ɛfata ma wo a, ɛho hia sɛ wohwehwɛ ɔhwɛ fi akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a ɔfata hɔ wɔ beae a wɔagye atom

question: Dɛn ne haw ahorow a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro taa hyia, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi ho dwuma?
answer: Nyiyim ne adwemmɔne: Hwehwɛ mpɔtam ne nneɛma a wɔboa, na susuw nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho de kasa tia nsusuwii hunu na wɔhyɛ gye a wogye tom ho nkuran. Wobepue: Gye wo bere, fa w’ahobammɔ di kan, na paw bere ne beae a ɛfata a wode bɛka wo nipasu akyerɛ afoforo. Kae sɛ sɛ wubepue a, ɛyɛ w’ankasa gyinaesi, na wumfa nkyerɛkyerɛmu biara ka obiara. Adwene mu akwahosan ho haw: Kɔ adwenemyareɛ ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa mmoa akuo a wɔyɛ LGBTQ+ nsɛm ho titire nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: So akwanside anaa nsɛnnennen bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nhomasua ho nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho haw ahorow ho a wobenya mu?
answer: Yiw, mmabun betumi ahyia akwanside ahorow anaa nsɛnnennen ahorow wɔ mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔbɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn ne nhomasua ho nnwuma a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho haw ahorow ho a wobenya no mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne animtiaabu a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho, nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho nimdeɛ a wonni, akwantu ho nsɛm, sikasɛm mu ahokyere, amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu akwanside ahorow, ne kokoamsɛm ho dadwen. Bio nso, nhyehyɛe mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ ne asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden betumi aka mmabun a wobenya mmoa a wɔde ma no.

question: So ɛsɛ sɛ migye m’ahome wɔ awoɔ ano aduru a wɔde honam mu nkwammoa di dwuma ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛno betumi aka sɛnea etu mpɔn?
answer: Ɛnyɛ akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano a wɔde honam mu nkwammoa di dwuma nyinaa na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wogye wɔn ahome. Nea ɛpaapae ni: Nnuru a wɔde siw awoɔ ano/nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu a wɔaka abom (estrogen ne progestin): Pii wɔ pack a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma bere nyinaa mu, na ɛmma enhia sɛ obi kɔ nna mu. Wo ne nea ɔde mmoa ma wo no nkasa mfa akwan horow a wubetumi apaw ho. Nnuru a wɔde progestin nkutoo na ɛyɛ (minipills)/aduru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu: Wɔnom eyinom da biara da a wonnye wɔn ahome, na ebia nna a ɛkɔ so no nyɛ nea ɛkɔ so daa anaasɛ ebegyae koraa. Patch ne ring: Wɔtaa de eyinom di dwuma daa adapɛn pii a dapɛn biako ahomegye wɔ wo nna mu. Ahomegye a wubegye no betumi atew sɛnea etu mpɔn no so. Wo ne w’apomoden ho ɔyaresafo nsusuw nea wopɛ wɔ nna ho. Wobetumi akasa ama ɔkwan bi a ɛne w’ahiade hyia akyerɛ.

Wo ne nea ɔde mmoa ma wo no nkasa mfa akwan horow a wubetumi apaw ho. question: Dwuma bɛn na nsusuiɛ a ɛmu dɔ boa ma obi bu atɛntenenee, otumi siesie ɔhaw, na ohu sɛ ne ho hia?

answer: Mfiridwuma a Wɔfa: Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ mfiridwuma ho betumi anya sɛnea mmabun de abɛɛfo  mfiri di dwuma na wɔde wɔn ho to so no so nsunsuanso. question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya  nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa nnwuma sɛ ɛho hia a?
answer: Sɛ wo hia nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie a, sɛdeɛ wobɛtumi anya bi nie: - Kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ nkyɛn: Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ bi, te sɛ oduruyɛfoɔ, ɔyarehwɛfoɔ, anaa ayaresabea a wɔn ho akokwa wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho, nkɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ. - de nna mu akwahosan ayaresabea di dwuma: Ayaresabea bebree de kokoam nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie ma wɔ tebea a ɛboa mu, mpɛn pii no awofoɔ mpene mma mmabun. - hwehwe mpɔtam akwahosan ho nneɛma mu: Mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛeɛ anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ bɛtumi de nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa dwumadie ama mmabun, ɛtɔ da bi a wɔrentua hwee anaasɛ wɔbɛtew ka so. - Fa intanɛt so nneɛma di dwuma: Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow bi de nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho ma na ebetumi ama akwan horow a wobɛfa so ayɛ nna mu nyarewa (STI) sɔhwɛ nneɛma a wɔde anifere ne kokoamsɛm ayɛ a wɔde bɛkɔ wo fie.

question: Akwan ahorow bɛn na wɔfa so hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na obu wom a ɛfa amammerɛ ne ankorankoro adwene wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho ho nkuran?
answer: Tie yiye: Tie aso a wunni atɛn na ama woate afoforo adwene ase. Kasa a Obu: Fa kasa a ɛkyerɛ obu ma adwene ahorow na kwati nsusuwii hunu di dwuma. Yɛ Mmeae a Ahobammɔ: Fa mmeae a obiara bɛte nka sɛ ne ho bɛtɔ no sɛ ɔbɛka n’adwene asi hɔ. Hyɛ Nkɔmmɔbɔ Ho Nkuran: To nsa frɛ mfɛfo ma wɔnka wɔn amammerɛ mu atetesɛm anaa osuahu ahorow a ɛfa mmabunbere ho. Ma Nkɔmmɔbɔ Ho Nkɔmmɔ: Bisa nsɛm a emu da hɔ de hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu dɔ ho nkuran. Gye Nsonsonoe Tom: Si so dua sɛ nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ adwene mu no yɛ ade a ɛfata na ebetumi ama obi asua ade. Nhomasua Nhyiam: Yɛ nhyiam anaa nsɛm a wɔka fa amammerɛ ahorow ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere so ho nhyehyɛe. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔ a atipɛnfo di anim a obiara betumi aboa na wasua biribi afi ne yɔnko hɔ ho nkuran. Dwumadi a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Fa dwumadi ahorow a wɔde di dwuma di dwuma de hwehwɛ sɛnea wɔde obu bua adwene ahorow. Di Nneɛma Ahorow Ho Afahyɛ: Yɛ nhyiam ahorow a ɛhyɛ amammerɛ ahorow ho afahyɛ, hyɛ ntease ne gye a wogye tom ho nkuran.

question: Dɛn ne mmarima ne mmea awo nhyehyɛe no afa horow, na dɛn ne wɔn dwumadi ahorow?
answer: Hwaa (Testes): Wɔyɛ ɛhwa (sperm) ne nipadua mu aduru a ɛma ɔbarima ahoɔden (testosterone). Hwaa-kyi-fofonii (Epididymis): Ɛhɔ na wɔsie ɛhwa (sperm) na ɛno nso na ɛkanyan wɔn kɔ nipadua no afã horow. Vas Deferens: Ɛde ɛhwa (sperms) fi hwaa-kyi-fofonii (epididymis) no mu kɔ (urethra) no mu. prostate Gland:  ɛde dwensɔ ne ɛhwa (semen) fi nipadua no mu pue. Seminal vesticle: Ɛma nsu a ɛma mmadwoa nya ahoɔden na ɛbɔ ho ban. Seminal Vesicles: Ɛyɛ nsuo bi a ɛma ɛhwa (sperm) no aduane na ɛbɔ ho ban. Mmea Awo Nhyehyɛe: Ovaries: Ɛyɛ nkesua (eggs) ne nipadua mu aduru (hormones) te sɛ estrogen ne progesterone.Fallopian Tubes: Ɛfa nkesua (eggs) no fi nkesua-adaka (ovaries) no mu de kɔ awo-baatannua (uterus) no mu. Awotwaa (Awotwaa): Baabi a nkesua a ayɛ nyinsɛn no hyɛ na ɛnyin bɛyɛ abofra (fetus). Cervix: Awotwaa no fã a ɛwɔ fam a ɛne ɔbea awotwaa no di nkitaho. Vagina: Ɛka awotwaa no bata nipadua no akyi; nso awo kwan no. Clitoris ne Labia: Abɔnten so nneɛma a ɛka nna mu anigye ne ahobammɔ ho.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛ mehia mmara mu mmoa (legal assistance) ntɛm?
answer: Ebia mmabun behia mmara kwan so mmoa ntɛm ara sɛ wɔrehyia tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ te sɛ ayayade, ɔtow a wɔtow hyɛ wɔn so, anaa nyiyim a ɛfa wɔn nna anaa awo akwahosan ho a. question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea asɛde ne nea wɔ hwehwɛ ahorow, broni ka no 'expectations' ho no boa ma wonya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so tra hɔ?
answer: Ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho no boa ma wonya suban ne nneyɛe a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so denam tumi a ɛnyɛ pɛ a wɔhyɛ mu den ne ankorankoro ahofadi ne wɔn ahofadi a wɔto ano hyeɛ so, broni ka no 'agency'. Sɛ nhwɛso no, atetesɛm mu adwene ahorow a ɛfa mmarimayɛ ho no betumi ama basabasayɛ ne tumidi anya nkɔso, bere a ebia ɔbeayɛ ho akwanhwɛ ahorow bɛma obi a ɔnyɛ hwee ne ɔbrɛ a ɔbrɛ ne ho ase adi kan. question: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho nkuran?
answer: Nhwehwɛmu ne nwomasua: Kyerɛkyerɛ obi ho hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔma mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɛbɛtumi aba wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ho no mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wɔne ahyehyɛde afoforo a mmabun di anim, mpɔtam hɔ akuw, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkitahodi ahorow bɛyɛ biako de ahyɛ nne ahorow mu den na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae. Fa nhyehyɛeyɛfo di nkitaho: Wo ne mpanyimfo a wɔapaw wɔn nhyia, kyerɛw nkrataa, na fa wo ho hyɛ ɔmanfo nhyiam ahorow ase de kamfo nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmabun adwumayɛ, adwumayɛ, adwumayɛ ho ntetee, ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho nkuran. Media ne social media: Fa traditional media ne social media akwan di dwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ho nsɛm na wɔboaboa mmoa ano ma nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae.

question: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahwehwɛ kasa, mfonini, ne sɛnkyerɛnne kwan so nsɛm a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu  de ahu nsɛm ne adwene a ɛda adi a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer: Mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ kasa, mfonini, ne sɛnkyerɛnnede a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ  mu de ahu nsɛm ne atirimpɔw ahorow a ɛwɔ ase denam: Aso a wɔde besi kasa a ɛhyɛ nsusuwii hunu mu den anaasɛ ɛhyɛ adwene a enni mu ho nkuran no so. Nhwɛso anaa trope ahorow a ɛma nsɛm a epira a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho kɔ so tra hɔ a wobehu. Nsunsuanso a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo  nya wɔ ankorankoro gyidi, suban, ne nneyɛe so a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu yiye.

answer: Nneɛma titiriw a wɔhwɛ so na wɔsɔ hwɛ daa no bi ne: Nnwuma a wobetumi anya ne nea wobetumi anya. Ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a wɔde ma. "Client" abotɔyam ne nsɛm a wɔka. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma so. Nneyɛe ne akwankyerɛ a eye sen biara a wobedi so. question: Dɛn ne kɔkɔbɔ sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ abusuabɔ a enni  apɔwmuden anaa ayayade mu?

answer: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahohorow wɔ asɛyɛde sɛ wɔda wiase no mu nneɛma ahorow adi wɔ wɔn nsɛm mu. Anamɔn a wobetumi atu ni: Nnipa a wɔfa nnipa ahorow: Ɛsɛ sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow de talente ahorow a wɔbɛfa wɔn adwuma mu di kan, wɔ mfoninitwa afiri no anim ne akyi nyinaa, a nnipa a wofi mmusua ne amammerɛ nyinaa mu ka ho. Ntetee ne Nkateɛ Nhyiamu: Nteteeɛ ne nhyiamu a ɛfa amammerɛ ahodoɔ ho a wɔde bɛma no bɛtumi aboa adwumayɛfoɔ ma wɔate hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔde ananmusifoɔ di dwuma no ase na wɔakwati sɛ wɔbɛma nsusuwii hunu a epira akɔ so. question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔn ankorankoro nsɛm bɛyɛ kɔkoam berɛ biaa a wɔakɔhwehwɛ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ nna ne awoɔ mu apɔmuden dadwen ho?

question: Bere bɛn na mebu mensa?
answer: Ɛsono bere a abeawa biara betumi ebu nensa. Ɛtaa fi ase bere a wɔadi mfe 8 kosi 13, nanso ebetumi asi ntɛm anaa akyiri yi. Ɔkwan biara nni hɔ a wobɛfa so ahu bere pɔtee a ɛbɛba, nanso nufu a ɛbobɔ no taa yɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo kyima reba ɛntsɛ.

question: Dɛn atorɔ adwene  anaa anansesɛm ahorow na ɛfa adwenemyare ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu?
