Atosɛm ahorow bi a wɔtaa ka no bi ne adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho, te sɛ sɛnea twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho no tu mpɔn (ɔkwan a wɔfa so twe wɔn ho fi ho), nsusuwii hunu a ɛfa dwuma a mmarima ne mmea di wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu, ne gyidi ahorow a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa nna mu nyarewa "STI" a wɔde ma ho, te sɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ sɛ wowɔ ɔyere biako abusuabɔ mu a, wuntumi nnya nna mu nyarewa (STI).

question: Fa afa biara yɛ wo botae bere a woresusuw nyinsɛn mu nneɛma a wobɛpaw ho no, fa w’adwene si nsɛm ne nneɛma a wode bɛma de asi gyinae a ɛfata so.

question: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo di wɔ nna mu ɔhaw a ɛba mmabun so?
answer: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo yɛ nhwehwɛmu a edi mu, a aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm ne nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Ebia wɔbɛhyɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ lab mfa nhwɛ sɛnea hormone dodow anaa akwahosan ho agyiraehyɛde afoforo te. Wobetumi ayɛ adwene mu nhwehwɛmu de asusuw nkate mu nneɛma ho. Ayaresa: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kyerɛw nnuru (te sɛ Viagra a wɔde sa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔhaw). Ebia wɔbɛkamfo ayaresa te sɛ adwene ne nneyɛe ho ayaresa (CBT) akyerɛ wɔ adwene mu nneɛma ho. Wɔde asetra mu nsakrae ne afotu a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho nneyɛe ho ma. Nhomasua: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kyerɛkyerɛ mmabun wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nipadua akwaa, ne nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Wɔde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne STI ano a wosiw ho. Nea wodi akyi: Wɔbɛkɔ hɔ daa ahwɛ sɛnea ɛrekɔ so na wɔayɛ nsakrae wɔ ayaresa no mu sɛnea ɛho hia. Wɔde wɔn kɔ animdefo nkyɛn wɔ nsɛm a emu yɛ den ho.

question: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa Intanɛt so nneyɛe ne nneɛma a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ medi mmara so?
answer: Te mfe a wɔde pene so ho mmara a ɛwɔ wo mantam mu, a ɛkyerɛ mfe a mmara ma ho kwan sɛ  wotumi di mpamu agorɔ. Mmeae bi wɔ mmara a ɛbara sɛ wɔbɛkyɛ Nipadua mfonini a ɛkyerɛ aniwudeɛ a onipa no mmaa ho kwan, a wɔfrɛ no aweredi nguamansɛm ho mmara (revenge porn laws). Mmofra Nguamammɔ Ho Mmara: Te ase sɛ ankorankoro a wonnii mfe pɔtee bi (mpɛn pii no mfe 18) ho nsɛm a wɔda no adi pefee a wɔbɛkyɛ no yɛ mmara so bu. Intanɛt so Ayayade Ho Mmara: Mmara a ɛko tia Intanɛt so ayayade ne kɔmputa so ayayade nso fa nneyɛe a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho. Daa kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho wɔ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa Intanɛt so nneyɛe ne nna ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ho.

question: Bere bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo mu wɔ adwenemyare ho haw ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho? (dadwen a emu yɛ den, adwenemhaw, ɛyɛ den sɛ obegyina ano) .
answer: Sɛ nkate mu nsɛnnennen yɛ den a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa: Dadwen a emu yɛ den: Dadwen a ɛkɔ so daa a ɛsiw wo kwan wɔ wo daadaa dwumadie mu. Adwenemhaw: Sɛ obi te nka sɛ wayɛ basaa anaasɛ onni anidaso biara da no fã kɛse no ara, bɛboro adapɛn abien. Ɔhaw a Wobegyina Ano: Ɔpere a ɔpere sɛ obedi nkate anaa nsɛnnennen a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho dwuma.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ me nna mu nkitahodi no yɛ nea mepene so, ɛkyerɛ obu, na ɛyɛ anigye ma me ne me hokafo no nyinaa?
answer: Mpene: Hwɛ sɛ afã abien no nyinaa pene so pefee na ɛyɛ anigye ansa na wode wo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi biara mu. Bu a Wobɛma Wo Ho Wo Ho: Bu wo hokafo ahye ne n’akɔnnɔ, na di nkitaho pefee wɔ nea wohwɛ kwan ho. Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Ahobammɔ: Fa kɔndɔm anaa ahobammɔ foforo di dwuma bere nyinaa de siw STI ne nyinsɛn a wonhyɛ da ano. Kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma no ma wonya ahobammɔ abien fi nyinsɛn ne STI ho.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nna mu yareɛ nya nsunsuansoɔ  wɔ awo ne awoɔ ho apɔmuden?
answer: Nsunsunaso a Ɛwɔ Awo So: nna mu yarewa (STI) ahorow bi, sɛ wɔansa a, ebetumi ama obi ntumi nwo anaasɛ ɔhaw ahorow a ɛba bere a nyinsɛn no aba. Sɛ nhwɛso no, nna mu yarewa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ chlamydia anaa gonorrhea a wɔansa no betumi de yare a ɛma obi ho hyehye no (PID) aba mmea so, na ebetumi ama wontumi nwo. Nyinsɛn mu haw: nna mu yarewa  te sɛ nea a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ syphilis anaa HIV betumi afi ɛna mu akɔ abofra mu wɔ nyinsɛn anaa awo mu, na ɛka akokoaa no akwahosan a mmofra a wɔawo no foforo anifurae ka ho. Ntɛm a Wohu na Wɔsa: Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ no daa ne ayaresa a wɔyɛ no ntɛm betumi asiw asiane ahorow yi ano anaasɛ ɛbɛtew so.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne ahokokwaw a wɔde gyina ano, de ahwehwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu osuahu ahorow a enye te sɛ kɔmputa so ayayade, Intanɛt so ayayade, nipadua mfonini ho dadwen, ne asetra mu ntotoho mu?
answer: Awofo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano ne ahokokwaw a wɔde gyina nsɛm so de afa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu osuahu ahorow a enye mu denam: Atinka mu mmoa ne nokwaredi a wɔde bɛma bere a mmabun hyia nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm a ɛhaw adwene, ne boa a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔadi wɔn nsusuwii ne wɔn nkate ho dwuma wɔ tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom mu. Mmabun akwan horow a mfaso wɔ so a wɔbɛfa so adi nneɛma a ɛde adwennwen ba a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho ho dwuma, te sɛ ahomegye a wobegye afi sini ahorow so, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ anaa anigyede ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma, akwan horow a wɔfa so gye wɔn ahome, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa atipɛnfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn. Mmabun tumi a wɔde bɛma wɔn ma wɔakamfo wɔn ho ne afoforo wɔ intanɛt so mmeae ahorow, te sɛ nsɛm a ɛyɛ ayayade anaa nea epira a wɔbɔ ho amanneɛ, nkɛntɛnso bɔne a wosiw ano anaasɛ wonni akyi, ne mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi atumfoɔ a wɔhwɛ wɔn so anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow hɔ bere a ɛho hia no. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn ho a wobu, wɔn ho mu ahotoso, ne wɔn ho ayamhyehye a wɔbɛkyekye denam ahoɔden pa a wɔde hyɛ wɔn mu den, wɔn bo a ɛsom ne wɔn bo a wosi so dua, ne hokwan ahorow a wobenya ama wɔn ankasa nkɔso ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛda no adi a ɛboro nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkɛntɛnso so.

answer: Nhwɛsoɔ bi ne blog ahodoɔ a mmabun di anim, abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so ɔsatuo, ne mpɔtam nnwumakuo ahodoɔ a wɔyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm, wɔyɛ nhyiamu, anaa wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔde kamfo nsɛm mu de ma nkurɔfoɔ te nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho na wɔhyɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, a ɛka obiara bom nkuran. question: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a wɔfa so hu na mekasa tia animhwɛ anaa nsusuwii ahorow a ebetumi anya me gyinaesi nhyehyɛe so nkɛntɛnso?

question: Sɛ me hokafo no hyɛ me sɛ me ne no ɛnda a mempɛ a, mɛyɛ dɛn abua?
answer: Wowɔ hokwan sɛ woka sɛ dabi, bere nyinaa. Mma nte nka sɛ ɛyɛ w’asɛyɛde sɛ wo ne obi bɛda de asɔ obi foforo ani. Ma emu nna hɔ na pintinn: "Dabi" kɛkɛ yɛ. Ɛho nhia sɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ wo ho mu. question: Sɛn na mɛtumi afa nidi ne akwanya pa so ne me hokafoɔ abɔ nkɔmmɔ afa m'akɔnnɔ, nea mehwɛ kwan, ne m'ahyɛeɛ (limitations) ho?
answer: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wobue: Yɛ beae a ahobammɔ wɔ ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware. Tie a Ɛyɛ Nna: Tie wo hokafo akɔnnɔ ne n’ahye a wunsusuw ho. question: Dwuma bɛn na ɔsom di wɔ su ahorow a wɔda no adi wɔ nna ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho wɔ mmeae ahorow mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔsom mu gyidi ahorow nya nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe so nsunsuansoɔ?
answer: ɔsom mu nsunsuanso: Adwene a Ɛyɛ Katee: ɔsom mu gyidi ahorow a ɛyɛ katee betumi ama wɔafa akwan horow a wɔfa so twe wɔn ho fi ho nkutoo ne anohyeto ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho. Abrabɔ Ho Gyinapɛn: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ taa si abrabɔ pa ho gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne abusuabɔ ho so dua. Nkɛntɛnso a Ɛwɔ Nhyehyɛe So: Wɔ aman a ɔsom nya nsunsuanso kɛse mu no, ebia nhyehyɛe ahorow ne ɔsom nkyerɛkyerɛ hyia, na ɛbɛma wɔanya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ. Nkɛntɛnso a Ɛwɔ Adeyɛ So: Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: ɔsom sukuu ahorow bi de ɔsom nkyerɛkyerɛ ka nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho. Nsɛm a Wɔkamfo: ɔsom akuw betumi akamfo nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi akyerɛ, na akyerɛ sɛnea wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ te. ɔhaw: ɔsom mu gyidi ne hia a ehia sɛ wonya nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛkari pɛ no betumi ɔhaw. Amammerɛ, mmara, ne ɔsom mu nneɛma yi a yɛbɛte ase no ho hia kɛse na ama wɔatumi ayɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn a ɛkyerɛ obu, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ nea ɛfata mpɔtam hɔ tebea horow.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adan a entumi nnyina anaasɛ adan a enni hɔ ka tumi a ɔbabun betumi de n’adwene asi ne nhomasua ne daakye botae ahorow so?
answer: Dabere a entumi nnyina anaasɛ adan a enni hɔ betumi anya tumi a ɔbabun betumi de n’adwene asi nhomasua ne daakye botae ahorow so nsunsuanso kɛse denam: Adwennwen ne dadwen a ɔde bɛba so: Baabi a wɔbɛda anaa wɔbɛtra ho adwenem naayɛ betumi de chronic adwennwen aba, na aka adwenem apɔmden ne adwene a wɔde si biribi so wɔ sukuu mu. Nneɛma a wɔyɛ daa a wɔsɛe no: Tu a wɔtaa tu kɔtra baabi foforo anaa adan a entumi nnyina no betumi asɛe adesua ho su, sukuukɔ, ne kyɛfa a wonya wɔ adesua akyi, na asiw adesua mu nkɔso ne nkɔso kwan. Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma kakraa bi: Ebia adan a enni hɔ no nni nneɛma a ɛho hia te sɛ intanɛt, mmeae a wosua ade a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn, anaa nneɛma atitiriw a wɔde di dwuma, na ɛma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wobewie fie nnwuma anaasɛ wobesua ade yiye.

question: Mmara mu nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde nsa ne nnubɔne yɛ basabasayɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aka ama mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ a emu yɛ den de akyere wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no?
answer: Asotwe no gu mu ahorow a egyina beaeɛ a asɛm no siiɛ ne sɛnea asɛm no kɔɔ so. Mpɛn pii no, wɔbu nneyɛe yi sɛ bɔne a emu yɛ duru na ebetumi de mmaratodoɔ asɛm te sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ anaa mmonnaa aba. question: Dɛn nti na mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho?
answer: Mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho hia efisɛ ɛhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun nyinaa, a wɔn bɔbeasu mfa ho, nya nna ne awo apɔwmuden ho ɔhwɛ, nnwuma, ne hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ pɛ. question: Dɛn na yebetumi ayɛ de atew animtiaabu a ɛwɔ STI ho no so? (nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, nhomasua) .
answer: Yɛn nyinaa betumi adi dwuma bi wɔ animtiaabu a ɛfa STI ho a yɛbɛtew so denam: Nkitahodi a Ebue Mu: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nna mu apɔwmuden ho asɛm a yɛbɛka pefee na yɛadi nokware no boa ma wɔsɛe anansesɛm na ɛma sɔhwɛ a wɔyɛ no yɛ nea ɛfata. Nhomasua: Sɛ yesua nsɛm a edi mu fa STI ho a, ɛboa yɛn ma yɛte ase sɛ wotumi sa na ɛnyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛfɛre.

question: Dwuma bɛn na nkwammoa ahodoɔ di wɔ awo nhyehyɛe no sohwɛ mu?
answer: Mmaa: Estrogen: Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ awotwaa mu, estrogen na ɛma mmaa nna mu su a ɛto so mmienu nya nkɔso, ɛhwɛ brayɛ so, na ɛsiesie awotwaa no ma nyinsɛn. Progesterone: Ɛdi dwuma wɔ ovulation akyi, na progesterone siesie awotwaa no ma nyinsɛn na ɛboa ma awotwaa no mu ntini no kɔ so tena hɔ. Mmarima: Testosterone: Ɛwɔ testes mu, testosterone na ɛyɛ mmarima nna mu nkwaadɔm titiriw a ɛboa mmarima nna mu su a ɛto so mmienu, mmadwoa a wɔyɛ, ne nna ho akɔnnɔ nya nkɔso. Saa nkwaammoa yi bom yɛ adwuma ma mmaa brayɛ ne mmadwoa a wɔyɛ wɔ mmarima mu no yɛ adwuma. Wɔsan nso di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna mu nkɔso, awoɔ, ne awoɔ akwahosan mu.

question: Dɛn ne adwene ne atenka famu nkɛntɛnso a wiase nyinaa akwahosan ho nsɛm a egye ntɛmpɛ nya wɔ mmabun so, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyinom ka wɔn nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nneyɛe ne nea efi mu ba?

question: Nti mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ne afotu a ɛfa sɛnea wobesiw nna mu nyarewa (STI) ano ho denam abusua nhyehyɛe ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so?
answer: Yiw, mmabun betumi anya nsɛm ne afotu a ɛfa sɛnea wobesiw nna mu nyarewa (STI) ano ho denam abusua nhyehyɛe ho adwumayɛbea ahorow so. question: ɛden ma mɛ yɛ sɛ menni gyedie  ɛfa me hokafo ho nna abakɔsɛm anaa  ne nna tebea?
answer: Di nkitaho: nya bue ne nkoreɛ nkitahodie kwan so a wo ne wo hokafo nkasa fa sɛ mobɛ sɔ ahwɛ ne nna ho abakɔsɛm ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na fa nokwaredi mu. Yɛ Sɔhwɛ: Susuw ho sɛ mobɛbom ayɛ nhwehwɛmu ahwɛ sɛ obi anya nna mu kyɛfa ansa na mode mo ho ahyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu. question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa mu akwanside "language barrier" haw mmabun tumi a wɔde nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ntease, na nneɛma bɛn na wɔayɛ de ama kasa nkyerɛase ne nkyerɛase?
answer: Kasa mu akwanside betumi anya mmabun tumi a wɔde nya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma ntease no kɛse. Saa nneɛma yi boa ma wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi ne wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho yiye, ate ɔhwɛ a wobetumi apaw ase, na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.

Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔadi saa asɛnnennen yi ho dwuma no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi de kasa nkyerɛase ne nkyerɛase adwuma ama, a aduruyɛ mu nsɛm asekyerɛfo a wɔatete wɔn, adwumayɛfo a wɔka kasa abien, ne kasa mmoa nnwinnade te sɛ nkyerɛase "app" anaa 'ahomatrofon "telephone" so dwumadi ahorow ka ho. Saa nneɛma yi boa ma wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun ne wɔn mmusua betumi ne wɔn akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo adi nkitaho yiye, ate ɔhwɛ a wobetumi apaw ase, na wɔasi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.

question: So akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ayɛ ayaresa anaa nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmabun mu a wɔmpene so?
answer: Mpɛn pii no, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ntumi nyɛ aduruyɛ anaa nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmabun mu a wɔmfa wɔn ani nnye ho, gye sɛ tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ anaa tebea horow a ɔbabun no ntumi mfa pene mma na ɛho hia sɛ wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ntɛm ara na wɔasiw ɔhaw ano.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo akasa afa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna anaa adwenemyare ho?
answer: Paw Bere a Ɛfata: Hwehwɛ bere a ɛyɛ komm, kokoam bere a obiara ho adwo no na woamfa ahopere anyɛ. Di Nokware na Bue Mu: Ka w'atenka ne wo nsusuwii nokwarem, fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma na woanbɔ sobo. Fa Nhwɛsoɔ Di Dwuma: Sɛ ɛboa a, fa nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfiri nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ anaa nnamfo suahunu mu di dwuma fa hyehyɛ wo nsɛmmisa. Bisa Mmoa: Ma wonhu sɛ wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso na wuhia wɔn akwankyerɛ, nanso wopɛ sɛ wobɔ saa nsɛmti yi ho nkɔmmɔ pefee nso. Siesie Wo Ho Ma Nsɛmmisa: Ebia wɔn nso wɔ nsɛmmisa, enti momma mo ani nnye ho mma mommɔ nkɔmmɔ na munsua ade.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na adwenemyare a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho botae ahorow a ɛtrɛw ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛma yiyedi nyinaa atu mpɔn na wɔatew adwenemyare ho adesoa so wɔ ɔmanfo mu?
answer: Adwene mu akwahosan a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no ne ɔmanfo akwahosan ho botae ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛtrɛw a wɔde bɛma yiyedi nyinaa atu mpɔn na wɔatew adwenemyare ho adesoa so wɔ ɔmanfo mu no hyia denam: Mmabun tumi a wɔde gyina tebea horow ano, sɛnea wotumi gyina ano, ne adwenemyare ho nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso wɔ mmerante ne mmabaa mu, a ɛbetumi asiw adwenemyare a ebefi ase anaasɛ ɛbɛma ayɛ kɛse akyiri wɔ asetra mu no ano. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nimdeɛ ne nhumu fapem a wɔbɛkyekyere a ɛma ankorankoro tumi hu ahoyeraw ho sɛnkyerɛnne, hwehwɛ mmoa, na wonya mmoa nnwuma a ɛfata. Animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛbata adwenemyare ho a wɔbɛtew so, a ebetumi de akwanside ahorow aba ayaresa ne mmoa mu na ama asetra mu pɛyɛ a enni hɔ no akɔ so. question: Dɛn na "hokwan a wɔ wɔ sɛ wosiw HIV ano na wɔsa no yiye" kyerɛ ma mmabun?
answer: Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ wosiw HIV ano na wɔsa no yiye ma mmabun no kyerɛsɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ahu sɛ wobenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, akwan a wɔfa so siw ano, nhwehwɛmu adwuma, ayaresa, ne mmoa a wɔnyɛ nyiyim. Nea ɛka ho ne nneɛma a wɔbɛyɛ de asiw HIV yareɛ ano, ntɛm a wɔbɛhunu, ɔhwɛ pa a wɔbɛnya, ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma wɔn a wɔwɔ HIV.

question: Susu nhwehwɛmu akwan ahorow, ho a kɔkoam ayaresabea ne ofie nhwehwɛmu (sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a) ka ho.
answer: Akwan kakra wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so yɛ STI nhwehwɛmu, a ne nyinaa yɛ kɔkoam na atemmuo nnim: Ayaresabea: mmabun mmeae, mpɔtam hɔ apɔmuden ayaresabea, ma kɔkoam STI nhwehwɛmu. Ayaresabea yi wɔ apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn yie a wɔbetumi abua wo nsɛmmisa nao, ayɛ nhwehwɛmu, na wɔama wo ayaresa ɛsɛ. Ofie Nhwehwɛmu (baabi a ɛwɔ hɔ): Mmeae bi ma ofie STI nhwehwɛmu nneɛma. Nneɛma yi taa kyerɛ sɛ wobɛfa wo anom nsuo anaa dwensɔ na woasoma akɔ laboratori ma wɔahwɛ. Nsunsuansoɔ no betumi agye nna kakra. Asɛm a Ɛhia: Ofie nhwehwɛmu no rentumi nyɛ STI nyinaa nhwehwɛmu, na ebi hia sɛ wokɔ ayaresabea kɔhwɛ yareɛ no ne ayaresa.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Nnuane bɛn na ɛboa ma menyin wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer: Sɛ wubenyin wɔ apɔwmuden mu wɔ mmabunbere mu a, fa w’adwene si nnuan atitiriw yi so: Protein (Ntini): Di nam, mpataa, nkesua, bankye, atoko, ne agushie. Calcium (Nnompe): Nom nufusu na di nhaban mono anaa almond. Iron(Ahoɔden): Di nam kɔkɔɔ, bankye, ne akutu. (Ebia mmeawa nso behia nnuru a wɔde iron ma wɔn). Fruits & Veggies: Di nnuaba ahorow na woanya vitamin. Ahoɔden a Wɔde Di Dwuma: di bayerɛ, borɔde, oats, aburow, ne atoko. Srade a Ɛma Apɔwmuden: Fa paya, nnuaba, ne ngo di dwuma ma amenmen wo. Nom Nsu: Kɔ so nya nsu na kwati soda a asikyire wom.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na kasa mu akwanside ne kasa ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ no haw mmabun a wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nnwuma, titiriw ma atubrafo "immigrant" anaa mpɔtam a wɔato wɔn hintidua "marginalized" no?

Sɛ yɛbɛdi saa nsɛnnennen "challenges" yi ho dwuma a, ɛho hia sɛ wɔhyɛ kasa ahodoɔ ho nkuran na wɔde kasa nkyerɛaseɛ dwumadie, nneɛma a wɔakyerɛ aseɛ, ne nkitahodiɛ akwan a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ma na ama ankorankoro nyinaa anya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm ne dwumadie pɛpɛɛpɛ.

question: Dɛn ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea bɔbea, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono  wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔwoo no ho?

question: So ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma de adi bɔbea mubasabasayɔ (GBV) ho dwuma wɔ amammerɛ tebea pɔtee bi mu anaasɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm? (wɔhwehwɛ mmoa ntam nkitahodi ahorow a ɛfata) .

question: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wosusu ho sɛ wo ne obi a ɔwɔ bɔbeasu mu anigyeɛ anaasɛ bɔbeasu mu su foforo na ɛrehyehyɛ hɔ? (nkitahodiɛ pa, ne anidie a wɔde bɛma ahyeɛ ho)
answer: Wo sukuu nɛɛse anaa apɔwmuden adwumayɛni bɛne wo abɔ bɔbeasu mu nneyɛe ne su ho nkɔmmɔ.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akamfo nipadua no wɔ kwanpa so ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn abom akyerɛ wɔ wɔn sukuu, mpɔtam, ne asetena mu akuo ahorow mu?
answer: Nhumu a wɔbɛma: Nhyiam, adwumayɛbea, anaa ɔsatu a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfoɔ, atipɛnfo ne manmufoɔ ate nipadua mfonini ho nsɛm ne ɔmanfo ahoɔfɛ gyinapɛn ahorow ase. Wɔn ho wɔn ho anisɔ: Afoforo a wobegye wɔn atom sɛnea wɔte na wɔasɔ ahoɔfɛ ho adwene teateaa ahwɛ denam nipadua ahorow ne ne nsusuii ahorow a wɔbɛda no adi so. Ahobammɔ Beae a Wɔbɛbɔ: Mpɔtam a ahobammɔ ne mmoa a wɔde besi hɔ ama ankorankoro ate nka sɛ wogye wɔn tom na wɔsom bo, a ɛmfa ho sɛnea wɔn ho te. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Ɛhyɛ Nkuran: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nipadua mfonini, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkɛntɛnso ho wɔ sukuu, akuo, anaa mpɔtam hɔ akuo mu a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde di anim: Nipadua mu adwempa, wɔn ho a wɔgye tom, ne wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho nyinaa ho nhwɛsoɔ wɔ wɔn ankasa suban, wɔn nneyɛeɛ, ne wɔne afoforo nkitahodie mu.

question: Dɛn adi pɔtee na ɛde animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ba, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nneɛma te sɛ amammerɛ, nyamesom, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, ne asetra ne sikasɛm tebea nya saa su ahorow yi so nsusuanso?
answer: Nneɛma a ɛde animtiaabu ne nyiyim a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho ba no pɔtee yɛ  nea ɛyɛ den na ɛwɔ afã horow pii. Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow, ne atetesɛm ahorow hyehyɛ adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, ne awo ho nneɛma a wɔpaw ho, na ɛka abrabɔ pa, ahotew, ne asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow ho adwene. Asetra ne sikasɛm mu nneɛma te sɛ ohia, pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne nhomasua a wonnya betumi ama animtiaabu ne nyiyim ayɛ kɛse denam hokwan ne nneɛma a wɔbɛtew ama ankorankoro a wɔato wɔn hintidua no so. Bio nso, nyiyim a wɔyɛ wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe, mmara nhyehyɛe, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow mu no ma pɛyɛ a enni hɔ kɔ so na ɛmma mmabun nya hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nnwuma a edi mũ.

question: Adwuma ho kwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun, na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn ahu na wɔanya bi ayɛ?
answer: Nnwuma bi te sɛ; bere-fã adwuma (part-time jobs), adwuma nteteɛ (internships), nsa-ano-nnwuma (apprenticeships), nnwuma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu (freelance work), ne wɔn ankasa nnwuma nketewa a wofi ase (entrepreneurship). Wobetumi anya saa akwanya ahorow yi denam adwuma ahorow a wobesua, adwumayɛfo a wobehyia wɔn, afotu a wobebisa afi afotufo hɔ, ne adwumayɛ ho guasodeyɛ anaa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔbɛkɔ so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: ɛbɛtumi ayɛ sɛ adwenemu apomoden ho nnuru ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nkwammoa nnuru  (hormonal birth control) bi bɛtumi adi nsia anaa?
answer: Nneɛma bi a ɛfa adwene mu apɔwmuden ho aduro betumi ne honam mu nkwammoa 'hormone' a wɔde si awodeɛ ano akabom anaa asia. Wo ne dɔkota bɔ nkɔmmɔ, fa awodeɛ ano nsisi ho a, ka aduro nyinaa a wunom kyerɛ no pefee, mmfa nsie no. Obetumi aboa wo ama woanya akwan a ɛbɛyɛ adwuma yie ama wo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Dwuma bɛn na nipadua mu kasa, ɛnne a wɔde di dwuma, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu de di wɔ asɛm a wɔka de kyerɛ ne ahotoso a wɔde ma wɔ asetra mu nkitahodi ne gyinaesi mu no mu?
answer: Nipadua kasa, nne a wɔde kasa, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu de di dwuma titiriw wɔ asɛm a wɔka no denneennen ne ahotoso a wɔda no adi wɔ asetra mu nkitahodi ne gyinaesi mu no mu. Nea ɛka nipadua mu kasa a wɔka no denneennen ho ne sɛ wobɛkɔ so ahwɛ wo ho, wode nne a ɛyɛ komm na ɛyɛ pintinn bedi dwuma, na woagyina hɔ anaasɛ wobɛtra ase tẽẽ. Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛnyɛ kasa mu te sɛ anim yɛbea, nsa a wɔde yɛ ade, ne sɛnea obi gyina hɔ no betumi ada ahotoso, nokwaredi, ne asɛm a wɔka no pen adi, na ɛhyɛ nkrasɛm a wɔde ano ka no mu den.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wodi abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow ho dwuma berɛ a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna mu nneyɛe, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, anaa STI ho no?
answer: Wɔdi abrabɔ pa ne nneyɛe trenee (ethical considerations) ho dwuma bere a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe wɔ nsɛm a ɛyɛ mmerɛ te sɛ aware mu nneyɛe, awogyeɛ ano aduru (contraception), anaa nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho kwan yi so:Nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe a atumfoɔ hwehwɛ mu: Wɔhwɛ hu sɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumakuw a ɛhwɛ abrabɔ pa so (IRBs anaa ethics committees) hwehwɛ nhyehyɛe no mu na wɔgye tom, na ama wɔatumi ahu sɛ akwan a wɔfa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu no yɛ nea ɛtene na ɛremfa asiane biara mma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no.Obu, pɛ ne pɛ, ne atɛntrenee: Wɔde nnyinasosɛm a ɛfa obu, tumi a obi wɔ sɛ osi ne gyinae, mmoa a ɛbɛba, ne atɛntrenee hyɛ nhwehwɛmu no mu, na ama wɔahu sɛ wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu no wɔ kwan a ɛtene na ɛyɛ nea ɛsɛ so.Akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ ma pɛne ne kokoamsɛm: Wɔde akwankyerɛ ne nneyɛe a emu da hɔ ma, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobepue obi pɛ mu (informed consent), wɔbɛbɔ kokoamsɛm ho ban, na wɔadi mfomso anaa abrabɔ pa ho nkitahodi biara a ebetumi aba nhwehwɛmu no mu no ho dwuma.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ?
answer: Nhomasua Ɔsatu: Yɛ nhyehyɛe anaa boa ɔsatu ahorow wɔ wo sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ de hyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri ho nkuran. Kyerɛw adesrɛ anaa nkrataa kɔma sukuu so ahwɛfo anaa mpɔtam hɔ aban mpanyimfo a wɔkamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ anim kyerɛ. Kɔka ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm so, te sɛ Planned Parenthood mmabun nhyehyɛeɛ ne mmabun akwahosan akuo a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Wubetumi ne sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo no adi nkitaho na woanya nsɛm pii afa sɛnea akuw a ɛtete saa no wɔ hɔ ho. Ntrɛwmu te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beae(0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ne YMK app no betumi aboa ma wɔanya nsɛm a mfaso wɔ so a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa nhyiamu a ɛhyɛ nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ho nkuran. Fa sohyial media anaa akwan foforo di dwuma de ma nkurɔfo hu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri.

question: Nneɛma bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow betumi ayɛ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nna ne awo ho apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe bere a wɔbɔ wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho ban no?

Kokoam mmeae a wɔbɛma wɔasusuw nsɛm ne nhwehwɛmu ho. Ntetee adwumayɛfo wɔ hia a kokoamsɛm ne nidi mu nkitahodi ho hia a wɔde akwan a wɔbɛfa so abɔ kokoam nkitahodi ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma, te sɛ nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo a wɔmmɔ wɔn din. Mmabun a wobu wɔn ahofadi ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn ankasa apɔwmuden ho nsɛm a wɔda no adi so

question: Dɛn ne amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na enya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun a ɛwɔ hɔ ne emu nsɛm so nkɛntɛnso?
answer: Amammerɛ mu adwene a ɛfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho no gu ahorow kɛse wɔ mpɔtamu ahorow mu na ebetumi anya nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ ne emu nsɛm a wɔde ma mmabun no so nkɛntɛnso. Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi de ahobrɛase ne ahobrɛase di kan, bere a afoforo nso betumi akasa ama nhomasua a edi mu a nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, pene a wɔpene so, ne mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ ho nsɛm ka ho. Wɔ amammerɛ ahorow bi mu no, wobu nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ sɛ ɛyɛ ahyɛde anaasɛ ɛmfata wɔ amammerɛ mu bere a ebinom ma kwan ma wɔbɔ nna ho nkɔmmɔ. Saa adwene ahorow yi ntease ne obu a wɔde ma no ho hia na ama wɔatumi ayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a etu mpɔn.

question: Dwuma bɛn na awofoɔ, ahwɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo di wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de wɔn adwene fa pem ne wɔn adwene aka adesua nhyehyɛe no ho?
answer: Awofo, ahwɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔfo di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a wɔde ma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu no mu. Wɔn adwene fapem ne wɔn adwene a wɔde ma no betumi ama wɔanya nhumu a ɛsom bo wɔ mpɔtam hɔ gyinapɛn ahorow, amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne mpɔtam hɔfo akwanhwɛ ahorow ho. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de awofoɔ ne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ adi nkitaho denam nkɔmmɔdie, nhwehwɛmu, ne awofoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ fekuo so de aboaboa nsɛm ano na wɔahwɛ sɛ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no da ahiadeɛ ne wɔn haw a ɛwɔ nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no adi. Sukuu ne mpɔtam a wɔbom yɛ adwuma no ma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn wuranom na wobu akontaa wɔ mmabun akwahosan ne yiyedi a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran no mu.

question: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ so sɛ mɛhwehwɛ afotu adwuma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi ama me yiyedie atu mpɔn?
answer: Afotu a wobɛhwehwɛ wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho no betumi ama woanya mfaso pii na ama wo yiyedi atu mpɔn denam: Beae a ahobammɔ ne kokoamsɛm wom a wobɛma woasusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho a worensusuw ho no so. Nkate fam mmoa ne w'atenka ne osuahu ahorow a wogye tom a wode bɛma. Nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wode besi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ne wo abusuabɔ ho. Boa a ɛbɛboa wo ma woafa tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu, te sɛ nyinsɛn a wonhyɛ da, STI a wobehu, anaa abusuabɔ ho nsɛm. Wɔn ho a wobehu, ahotoso, ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina ano wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow a wobedi ho dwuma mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran.

answer: Nneɛma a Wɔde Sie Kokoamu: Hwehwe nneɛma a wɔde sie kokoamu aboafo, te sɛ  sukuufoɔ a afutufoɔ anaa ayeraɛhosa adwumayɛfoɔ. question: Dwuma bɛn na nnipa a wɔwɔ intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ mmaeɛ so nkɛntɛnso, nnipa a wɔagye din, ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Intanɛt so di wɔ mmabun suban ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho no mu?
answer: Nhwɛso a wɔyɛ: Intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ mmaeɛ so nkɛntɛnsofo ne nnipa a wɔagye din taa yɛ nhwɛsofo ma mmabun, na wonya wɔn suban ne wɔn gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna, pene, ne abusuabɔ pa ho so nkɛntɛnso denam wɔn nneyɛe, wɔn a wɔpene so, ne nkrasɛm a wɔde mena so. Nneɛma a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran: Wɔn a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso ne nnipa a wɔagye din bɛtumi ahyɛ nneɛma anaa asetra kwan a ɛfa SRH ho ho nkuran, a ebetumi akyerɛ mmabun adwene ne wɔn nneyɛe wɔ saa mmeae yi. Nhomasua mu nsɛm: Nnipa bi a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso ne nnipa a wɔagye din de wɔn nhyiam ase kamfo SRH ho nimdeɛ, nhomasua, ne animtiaabu a wɔde bɛma wɔn, na wɔma mmabun nya nsɛm a edi mu ne nhwɛso pa.

Nhomasua nhyiamu anaa nsɛm a wɔka fa nsɛmti te sɛ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan, adwene mu yiedie, ne abusuabɔ pa ho a wɔde bɛma. Ayarefo nkumaa a wɔwɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea no ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ. Ɔsom sɛ ɔkwan a ɛda akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne ayarefo a wɔrebɛn mpanyin afe so ntam, na ɛboa ma nkitahodi ne ahotoso tu mpɔn.

question: Dɛn ne nea ebetumi afi obu a wonni ma wɔn ho no mu aba wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso so, te sɛ nneyɛe a asiane wom a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu anaasɛ adwene apɔwmuden mu haw?
answer: Akokudro wɔ fam no betumi de nsunsuanso kɛse aba mmabun nna ne awo apɔwmuden mu nsunsuanso so. Mmabun a wonni obu mma wɔn ho no betumi ayɛ mmerɛw kɛse sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu nneyɛe a asiane wom mu, te sɛ nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban anaa ahokafo pii, hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nna mu dwumadi wɔagye atom bɛma , wɔahyia ɔhaw ahorow wɔ abusuabɔ pa a wobenya mu, na wɔahyia nsɛnnennen a ɛfa adwenem apwɔagye atomwmuden ho, a adwenemhaw ne dadwen ka ho.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ahyehyɛde ahorow a egyina mpɔtam hɔ ne mmabun di nkitaho de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ, wɔde adi dwuma, ne nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ ɔkwan a ntease wom so?
answer: Mpɔtam hwehwɛde ahyehyɛde ahorow (Community-based organizations) de mmabun hyɛ SRH nhyehyɛe ahorow (Sexual and Reproductive Health programs) ho adwuma mu pɛpɛɛpɛ, fi sɛnea wɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, kosi sɛnea wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne sɛnea wɔhwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma yie, de hwɛ sɛ ɛfata na ɛyɛ nea ɛsom bo.Wɔma nnipa kwan ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ gyinaesi mu, ma wɔn adwene ne wɔn nimdeɛ, na wosusuw akannifo dwuma a ɛsom bo wɔ wɔn mpɔtam mu. Eyi betumi afa mmabun afotufo kuw a wɔhyehyɛ, nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hwehwɛ nnipa adwene, ne ntetee a wɔhyehyɛ de hyɛ mmabun nkuran sɛ wɔnkasa mma wɔn ho anaa wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn mfɛfo.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akuw betumi ama mmabun wɔn ho yɛ mmerɛ anya tebea horow a ɛka obiara ho na ɛboa bere a wobu atetesɛm mu gyidi ahorow no?
answer: Sɛ wɔbɛtumi abɔ tebea horow a ɛka nnipa nyinaa bom na wɔboa no no, ɛhia sɛ wɔbɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ, nkyerɛkyerɛ, na wonya ɔpɛ sɛ wɔbɛkasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne adwemmɔne a epira. Amammerɛ anaa nyamesom akuw betumi ahyɛ gye a wogye tom ho nkuran denam ntease ne tema a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso denam nhomasua ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde bɛma nkurɔfo ate ase so. Hyɛ akannifoɔ a wɔwɔ saa mpɔtam yi mu nkuran sɛ wɔnkamfo hokwan a nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua wɔ na wɔnkasa ntia nyiyim. Fa nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodiɛ ma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom ahyehyɛdeɛ mu, te sɛ mmoa akuo, afotuo dwumadie. Awiei koraa no, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a obiara bɛka ho a wɔbɛbɔ no hwehwɛ sɛ wobu nneɛma ahorow sɛ ɛsom bo na wɔhyɛ ɔdɔ ne gye a wogye tom ma ankorankoro nyinaa ho nkuran, a mfe anaa dɛmdi mfa ho.

question: So amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu nsusuwii ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a, ebetumi aka sɛnea awofo anaa abusuafo yɛ wɔn ade wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho?
answer: Yiw, amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi anya sɛnea awofo anaa abusuafo yɛ wɔn ade wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm ho no so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Amammerɛ anaa ɔsom ahorow bi betumi asi ahobrɛase, twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho ansa na wɔaware, anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi pɔtee bi so dua, a ebetumi aka nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu nsɛm a wɔde da, ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho.

question: So mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow ma mmerante ne mmabaa hokwan ahorow, ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ wɔn gyinaesi nhyehyɛe anaa akannifo dwumadi mu? (Mmabun afotu bagua ahorow, mmabun agyinatukuw ahorow)
answer: Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow pii bu mmabun adwene sɛ ɛsom bo! Akwan bi a wobɛfa so de wo ho ahyɛ mu ni: Mmabun Afotufoɔ Badwa: Saa adwumakuo yi ma mmabun kwan ma wɔde wɔn adwene, ma wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne dwumadie ho. Mmabun Bagua: Te sɛ adwumakuo no, agyinatukuo ma mmabun akannifoɔ ne gyinaesie kwan wɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ no mu.

question: Nti mmoa dwumadie anaa afotu bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu anaa ayaresa?
answer: Aane, apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ ne ayaresabea pii ma mmoa dwumadie ne afotu ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu anaa ayaresa. Eyi bi ne: Afotu a ɛfa nna a asiane nni mu ne asiane so teew akwan ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa STI, ayaresa akwan, ne akwan a wɔfa so bɔ ho ban ho. Mmoa foforo a wɔbɛkyerɛ, te sɛ adwene mu apɔmuden afotu, nnubɔne ho ayaresa, anaa asetena mu mmoa. Mmoa akuo anaa afotu dwumadie a nnamfo de ma mmabun a wɔne STI te anaa wɔwɔ nna mu apɔmuden ho dadwen. Kɔkoam torɔfo ahoma, mmoa torɔfo ahoma, anaa intanɛt so mmeae ma nkurɔfoɔ a wɔrehwehwɛ nsɛm anaa mmoa a ɛfa STI ne nna mu apɔmuden ho.

question: Amanneɛbɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛka 'sexual health' (baanu ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne ahoɔden) ho asɛm no, sɛn na yɛbɛyɛ ahu nnaadaasɛm te sɛ asɛm a wɔama ano ayɛ kɛse dodo, obi ankasa ne suahunu a ɔde kyerɛ, anaa nea enni baabi pɔtee a asɛm no firi?
answer: Berɛ a mmofra ne mmabun rehwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa "sexual health" (baanu ntam nkɔmmɔbɔ ne ahoɔden) ho wɔ Intanɛt so anaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mmeaeɛ no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔwɛn wɔn ho yie wɔ "mfomso" (red flags) anaa nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ sɛ asɛm no nyɛ nokware yi ho:Asɛm a wɔama ano ayɛ kɛse dodo anaa bɔhyɛ ahorow: Asɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ "eduru bi yɛ anwanwasɛm" anaa ɛbɛsa yadeɛ ntɛm so.Obi ankasa ne suahunu anaa anansesɛm so a wɔde ho to so: Sɛ obi de ne ho asɛm di dwuma sen sɛ ɔde adwene anaa nhwehwɛmu a ɛfiri nnuruyɛfoɔ hɔ bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu.Baabi pɔtee a asɛm no firi (citations) a enni mu: Sɛ asɛm no nni nhyehyɛeɛ anaa baabi a wɔnyaa nsɛm no firi, titiriw mmeaeɛ a agye din a wɔde ho to so.Kasa anaa mfoni a ɛma abufuo ba mu (sensationalized language/imagery): Mfoni anaa kasahorow a ɛyɛ basabasa a wɔde twa adwene anaa ɛpɛ sɛ ɛma w’abam bu ntɛm.Sikasɛm ho anohyeto anaa adwene a ɛkɔ afa baako pɛ (commercial interests/biases): Sɛ asɛm no botaeɛ titiriw ne sɛ ɛbɛtɔn adeɛ bi sen sɛ ɛbɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm mu nokware.

question: Dɛn ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer: Awo akwahosan ho dwumadie ka ayaresa, nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mmoa dwumadie ahodoɔ a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ awoɔ yiedie ho nkuran na wɔakura mu. Saa dwumadie yi ho hia ma mmabun berɛ a wɔdi wɔn ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma wɔ nkɔsoɔ fã a ɛho hia mu, hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho.

Saa dwumadie yi ho hia ma mmabun berɛ a wɔdi wɔn ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma wɔ nkɔsoɔ fã a ɛho hia mu, hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, nyinsɛn ano aduru, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne ɔhwɛ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho.

question: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nneyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe "healthcare policies" ahorow mu ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer: Nneɛma a wobetumi anya: Hwɛ sɛ mmeae a wotumi kɔ hɔ, akwan a wɔfa so di nkitaho ( mum kasa, "Braille"), ne akwahosan ho nneɛma a mmubuafo ahorow betumi akɔ hɔ. Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm ho Nimdeɛ: Tete akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ mmubuafoɔ abrabɔ pa, ahiadeɛ pɔtee, ne nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔde bɛdi nkitaho a ɛka obiara ho. Ɔhwɛ a Ɛfa Ɔyarefo Ho: Fa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho no mu. Ahintasɛm: Ma nkɔmmɔbɔ ne aduruyɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow nyɛ kokoamsɛm, titiriw wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ nna ho.

question: Mmoa bɛn ɛwɔ hɔ ma me sɛ mehia apɔwmuden akwankyerɛ wɔ me babunberɛ mu?
answer: Sukuu pii wɔ ayaresafoɔ wɔ ɔmo asoɛyɛ wɔ betumi ama saa akwankyerɛ no. Bi so wɔ mpɔtam a wɔnya berɛ de hwɛ mmabun ho nsɛm. Internet so mmoa wɔ sites bi te sɛ HealthFinder.gov anaa local health departments so ma mmoa. Mmabun kuo so tumi boa.

question: Mmara ne anohyeto ahorow bɛn na ɛwɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ? (mfe a wɔadi anohyeto, awofo pene) .
answer: Wɔ Ghana no, nyinsɛn a woyi gu yɛ mmara kwan so berɛ a: Nyinsɛn no fi mmonnaato, abusuafo a wɔne wɔn da, anaa ɔkwasea a ɔyɛ ɔbea a ɔsɛee no. Ɔbea no nkwa anaa n’akwahosan da asiane mu. Asiane kɛse wɔ hɔ sɛ awotwaa no bɛyɛ nea ɛnteɛ. Mfeɛ ne Awofoɔ Mpene: Mfeɛ a ɛsua koraa biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ obi di ansa na watu nyinsɛn agu wɔ Ghana. Nanso, wɔtaa kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa ɔwofo anaa ɔhwɛfo bi ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ho, titiriw ma mmabun a wonni ahobammɔ.

question: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛm bi a ɛhaw me anaa nsɛmmisa bi fa sɛnea me ho bɛtɔ me bere a mayi nyinsɛn agu a anaa sɛ mihu nsesae ahorow a ɛhaw me a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer: Sɛ wowɔ nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo anaa nsɛmmisa bi fa wo ho a wobɛsan anya wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi anaasɛ wunya sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛhaw adwene a, ɛsɛ sɛ: Wo ne W’akwahosan Ho Ɔhwɛfo di nkitaho: Kɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a oyii nyinsɛn no gui anaa akwahosan ho ɔbenfo foforo nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Nsɛnkyerɛnne: Ka sɛnkyerɛnne anaa dadwen biara a worehyia no kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no pefee. Hwehwɛ Aduruyɛ mu Ahwɛyiye Ntɛm: Sɛ wote ɛyaw a emu yɛ den, mogya tu kɛse, wohu ɔyare mmoawa ho sɛnkyerɛnne, anaa sɛnkyerɛnne afoforo a egye ntɛmpɛ a, hwehwɛ aduruyɛ ntɛm ara denam frɛ a wobɛfrɛ anaa wobɛkɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn anaasɛ wobɛkɔ baabi a wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ baabi a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ ayaresa a egye ntɛmpɛ a ɛbɛn wo no so.

question: So adwumayɛfo a wɔatete wɔn na wɔhwɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuo so, anaasɛ atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ osuahu a ɛte saa ara na wodi wɔn anim?
answer: Ebia adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔatete wɔn, te sɛ afotufoɔ, asetena mu nsɛm ho adwumayɛfoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ apomoden ho akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, a wɔde akwankyerɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ, ne ɔhwɛ ma wɔ akuo nkɔmmɔdie ho na wɔbɛboa atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ foforo no, atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ osuahu a ɛte saa ara na wonya ntetee anaa mmoa a wɔde bɛma nkɔmmɔbɔ ayɛ mmerɛw, ahwɛ ahu sɛ tebea a ahobammɔ wom, na wɔde nneɛma a ɛfata ma na wodi akuw binom anim. Akwan abien no nyinaa ma mmoa ne nhumu a ɛsom bo, a ahwɛfo a wɔatete wɔn no hwɛ hu sɛ kuo no mu nkɔso no tu mpɔn na ahobammɔ wom.

question: Sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ mewɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI ) a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer: Sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI )a, ɛho hia sɛ wo bo dwo na wohwehwɛ mmoa. Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ni: Mma Nsuro: Wɔde nnuru sa nna mu yareɛ (STI) dodow no ara. Kɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo: Akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo betumi asusuw ayaresa a wubetumi apaw ho na wabua nsɛmmisa biara a wowɔ. Ayaresa: Ɛdenam nna mu yareɛ ( STI) so no, ebia ayaresa no bɛfa nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa, nnuru, anaa ayaresa afoforo ho. Ɔhokafoɔ Amanneɛbɔ: Ɛho hia sɛ wobɔ wo nna mu ahokafoɔ (wɔn) amanneɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn nso bɛtumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasa wɔn yareɛ. Eyi boa ma ɔyare mmoawa no ntrɛw. W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛ wo kwan wɔ ɔhokafoɔ a wɔmmɔ wo din ho amanneɛbɔ mu sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wobɛdi nkitaho tee a.

question: Dɛn ne mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa sɛnea mmabun benya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne awo ho apomoden ho?
answer: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano: Mmara ahorow a ɛfa sɛnea mmabun betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho no gu ahorow. Mpɔtam bi ma mmofra nkumaa kwan ma wonya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a awofo mpene so, bere a afoforo nso hwehwɛ. Apomoden asoɛe anaa ayaresabea ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu taa de kokoam nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ma. Nyinsɛn a wotu gu: Mmara a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho ma mmabun no gu ahorow pii. Mmeae bi hwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so anaa wɔbɔ amanneɛ, bere a afoforo nso ma kwan ma wɔde kokoam kwan. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ na wohwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi apomoden ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Awo Apomoden Ho Nhyehyɛe: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun nya awo apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ahorow, a STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ka ho. Mpɔtam bi wɔ mmara ahorow a ɛbɔ hokwan a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ kokoam ho ban. Ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Planned Parenthood de nsɛm ne nnwuma a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ma.

question: So nneɛma anaa wɛbsaet ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a, wokamfo kyerɛ sɛ wubenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so?
answer: Wɛbsaet ahorow te sɛ "Planned Parenthood" "Teen Talk" anaa Nna "Sex", de nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi ma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho. question: So mfe a obi adi ahwehwɛde bi wɔ hɔ na ama obi anya nna mu nyarewa "STI" nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa ho dwumadie?

question: Dwuma bɛn na amanaman ntam nkɔso adwumayɛbea ahorow, wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma, ne aman pii ahyehyɛde ahorow di wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma aman ma wɔayɛ mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛhyɛ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkuran na wɔde adi dwuma no mu?

Nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ne mmara mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ de ayi akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nkɔ hɔ no fi hɔ na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ mmabun bedi nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho dwuma. Nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa ne nneyɛe pa a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ aman ntam de ahyɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina adanse so ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde bedi dwuma ho nkuran. question: Ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa mmoa nkitahodibea ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate wɔn mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow ne akwan horow a wobetumi afa so a ɛfa awofo pene ne amanneɛbɔ ho ase?

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne nkurɔfo adi nkitaho yie na makyerɛ obu wɔ Intanɛt so afa nna ne abusuabɔ ho?
answer: Di nkitaho pefee ne nokwaredi mu bere a wobu afoforo ahye ne awerɛkyekye dodow no. Fa kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛkyerɛ obu di dwuma bere a woresusuw nsɛmti a ɛyɛ atenka a ɛfa nna ne abusuabɔ ho no. Tie afoforo adwene yie na kwati sɛ wubesusu nneɛma ho anaasɛ wobebu atɛn. Kwati nsusuii na bisa pefee sɛ wo nte biribiara ase a.

question: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mmabun atumi anya ayamhyehye ne gye a wogye tom su wɔ wɔn nipadua ho, na wɔagye nneɛma ahorow ne soronkoyɛ atom?
answer: Aseda a Wɔde Di Dwuma: Wɔn nipadua dwumadi ne nea wotumi yɛ ho anisɔ mmom sen sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene besi wɔn honam ani hwɛbea nkutoo so. Nsonsonoe a wɔkyerɛ ho anisɔ "Appreciating Differences": Nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ nipadua nsɛso, ne kɛse, ne sɛnea ɛte mu a wobehu na wɔakyerɛ ho anisɔ. Nipadua a Ɛnyɛ Akyi "Body Neutrality": Wɔn adwene a wɔdan fi sɛnea wɔn nipadua te so kɔ nea wɔn nipadua betumi ayɛ ne osuahu ahorow a ɛma wotumi yɛ so. Ɛdenam nsonsonoe ne soronkoyɛ ho anisɔ so no, mmabun betumi adɔ wɔn ho sɛnea wɔte na wɔremmu wɔn ho wɔn ho animtiaa.

question: Dɛn ne awofoyɛ, na sɛ me si gyinae sɛ mɛtoa me nyinsɛn no so na mabɛyɛ ɔwofo a, nneɛma bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ misusuw ho?
answer: Ɔwofoyɛ: Nea ɛka awofoyɛ ho ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ abofra na wɔatete no. Nneɛma a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wususuw Ho: Sikasɛm mu Gyinabea: Susuw wo sikasɛm tebea ne sɛnea wobɛhwɛ abofra no ho. Mmofra hwɛ: Sɛ ɛho hia sɛ woyɛ adwuma anaa wusua ade a, susuw akwan horow a wobɛfa so ahwɛ mmofra ho. question: Akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔfa so ma aban ahorow ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no bu akontaa sɛ wobedi wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho wɔ amanaman ntam apam ne apam ahorow ase no ho dwuma?
answer: Akwan te sɛ amanaman ntam apam, nhyiam ahorow, ne amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛma aban ahorow ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no abu akontaa sɛ wobedi wɔn bɔhyɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho no so. Eyinom bi ne Apam a Ɛfa Hokwan a Mmofra Wɔ Ho, Amanaman Ntam Nhyiam a Ɛfa Nnipa Dodow ne Nkɔso Ho, ne Nkɔso a Ɛkɔ So Daa Botae ahorow. Mmɔden a ɔmanfo ahyehyɛde ahorow bɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ so, abɔ amanneɛ, na wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban nso di dwuma titiri wɔ aban ahorow a wobu akontaa no mu.

answer: Yiw, nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi anya denam sukuu ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa nyinsɛn, awo, awofoyɛ, mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne hokwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya awo ho hwɛ a edi mũ ho ma.

question: Akwan bɛn na akyerɛkyerɛfo fa so ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa akyinnyegye ho wɔ ntentanfidie so adesua ahorow mu, te sɛ nna ho nsɛm, basabasayɛ, asɛm a wɔka kyerɛ, ne nsɛm a ɛnteɛ ho yɛ mmerɛw?
answer: Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ de akwan ahodoɔ di dwuma de boa nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkateɛ anaa akyinnyegyeɛ ho wɔ ntentanfidie so adesua mu, te sɛ nna ho nsɛm, basabasayɛ, botaeɛ, ne nsɛm a ɛntene, a nea ɛka ho ne: Fapem mmara a wɔde besi hɔ ama nkɔmmɔdie a obuo wom ne adesua tebea a ahotɔ wom na ɛka obiara ho a asuafoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi na wɔabisa nsɛm. Nsɛm a ɛfa ho a wɔde bɛma ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔahyehyɛ no wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma adwene a ɛyɛ den na egu ahorow a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate ho no tom. Nneɛma a ɛfata mfeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛfa asuafoɔ suahunu ne wɔn anigyeɛ ho a wɔde bedi dwuma. Adwene ne nne ahorow pii a wɔde bɛka nkɔmmɔbɔ ho de ahyɛ nsusuwii a ɛmu dɔ ne tema ho nkuran. Asuafoɔ a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔhwɛ anaa wɔsusu sɛ deɛ (media) mfidie so nsɛm hu asetena mu nsɛm, gyedie ne amammerɛ fa . Akwanya a wɔde bɛma asuafoɔ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ akyerɛw a ɛfa adwene ho, nsɛmma nwoma, anaa akuo nketewa nkɔmmɔdie mu de adwenedwene wɔn a susuiɛ ne atenka wɔ nsɛmti a emu yɛ duru ho.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofoɔ, wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra, ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔagyina haw a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ano?
answer: Nkitahodi a ɛyɛ pefee : Tebea a wɔabue na ɛnyɛ atɛn a wɔbɛma mmabun asusuw nneɛma a ɛhaw wɔn ne nsɛmmisa a ɛfa mmabunbere ho. Nsɛm a Wɔde Ma: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi a ɛfa nsakrae a ɛba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ho a wɔde ma, a nipadua ne nkate fam afã horow ka ho. Awerɛhyem a Wɔde Ma: Awerɛhyem ne nokware a wɔde bɛma wɔ mmabun nkate ne osuahu ahorow ho wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu. Kokoam Nsɛm a Wobebu: Mmabun kokoam nsɛm ne wɔn ahye a wobu bere a wɔda so ara wɔ hɔ ma mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a ɛho hia no. Ankasa Ho Hwɛ ho Nhwɛso: Nhwɛso a wɔde gyina apɔwmuden ano ne nneyɛe a wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho so de hyɛ yiyedi ne ahoɔden a wɔde gyina tebea wɔ nsakrae bere ahorow ano mu ho nkuran.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ada me haw anaa me suro a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nsɛmti ho akyerɛ wo, na wobɛyɛ dɛn ama m'ahu sɛ wɔbɛboa me na wɔte me ase?

question: Dwuma bɛn na media ho nimdeɛ ho nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a atipɛnfo di anim betumi adi wɔ nhumu a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, ne atipɛnfo nkitahodi pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ sukuu ahorow, mpɔtam, ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow mu?

question: Tu mpɔn Akwan bɛn so na Abusua nhyehyɛe ho horow a  wɔde si nyinsɛn ano mu, na nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi aka sɛnea etu mpɔn?
answer: Etu mpɔn: Deɛ edi Dwuma yie ne Nea Wɔtaa di Dwuma: Akwan no tu mpɔn kɛse bere a wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ (de di dwuma sɛnea wɔakyerɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ) sen sɛnea wɔde di dwuma mpɛn pii (a wosusuw nnipa mfomso ho). Nnuru a Etu mpɔn: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano: Sɛ wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ a, etu mpɔn bɛboro 90%, bere a wɔtaa de di dwuma no yɛ nea etu mpɔn bɛyɛ 91%. Kɔndɔm: Bɛyɛ 98% tu mpɔn bere a wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɛyɛ 85% tu mpɔn bere a wɔtaa de di dwuma no. LARCs (IUDs, implants): Bɛboro 99% tu mpɔn bere a wɔde di dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nea wɔtaa de di dwuma no nyinaa. Nneɛma a Ɛka Sɛnea Etu mpɔn: Nea ɛkɔ so daa: Ɔkwan no a wɔde di dwuma daa na ɛteɛ. Bere: Akwan bi te sɛ aduru no hwehwɛ sɛ wodi bere a wɔde yɛ no so denneennen. Akwahosan Tebea: Nnuru anaa apomoden ho nsɛm bi betumi aka sɛnea honam mu nkwammoa 'hormone' akwan no tu mpɔn.

question: Akwan bɛn na mpɔtam hɔfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi afa so ayɛ adwuma de ama awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun nya no atu mpɔn?
answer: Mpɔtam ne nhyehyɛɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi abom ama awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a mmabun anya no atu mpɔn denam: Sika a wɔde bɛto nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri mu wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ a ɛde awoɔ akwahosan ne hokwan ahodoɔ ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ma mu. Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa ntrɛmu a wɔbɛboa, a akwahosan asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ka ho. Nhyehyɛe ne sika a wɔde bɛma a ɛbɛma wɔanya kwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awo akwahosan ho nnwuma afoforo a mmabun bɛkamfo. Mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no mu denam wɔn adwene ne wɔn nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka wɔn tẽẽ ho no so. Nhyehyɛe mu akwanside ahorow te sɛ ohia, nyiyim, ne kar a wonni a ebetumi asiw mmabun kwan sɛ wonnya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow no ho dwuma a wobedi.

question: Ɛdeɛn ne nna mu basabasayɛ (sexual assault) wɔ mmara mu?
answer: Nna mu nneyɛeɛ a pene (consent) nni mu. Nhyɛso nna, ne nsa a wɔde keka obi nipadua ho. Ɛka nna mu mpoatwa anaa nhyɛso (sexual harassment) ho.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi nhyɛso a m’atipɛnfo anaa m’ahokafo de ma me sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhyɛ me wo nna mu dwumadi?
answer: Nkitahodi a Ɛyɛ Den: Ka w’ahye ne anohyeto ahorow kyerɛ w’atipɛnfo anaa wo hokafo pefee. Fa nsɛmfua te sɛ "Minsiesiee me ho mmaa saa" anaa "Me ho nyɛ me dɛ wɔ eyi ho" di dwuma. Atipɛnfo Mmoa: Fa nnamfo a wobu nea wopaw no twa wo ho hyia. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi nnamfo a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn a ɛte saa ara hɔ. Yɛ Akwan a Wobɛfa so Fi Mu: Di kan yɛ nhyehyɛe ma tebea horow a ebia wobɛte nka sɛ wɔahyɛ wo. Yɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wubefi hɔ anaasɛ wubeyi wo ho afi tebea horow a ɛnyɛ dɛ mu. Gye watinka di 'Trust Your Instincts': Fa wo ho to wo gut feeling so sɛ biribi nte nka sɛ ɛnteɛ a. Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi na wode w’awerɛkyekye ne wo yiyedi adi kan. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ gyinaesi mu ho ade. Te ase sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wubegyina w’ankasa akyi.

question: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mahwehwɛ na mahyɛ ntease a mewɔ wɔ m’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no mu den?
answer: Nneɛma ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo ma woahwehwɛ na woahyɛ wo ntease a wowɔ wɔ w’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho no mu den. Ebia eyinom bi ne mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne intanɛt so nsɛm a agye din, nhoma ahorow, ne nhomasua nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ ama mmabun titiriw. Bio nso, atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan so betumi ama wɔanya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi abɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔasua ade.

question: Dwuma bɛn na afotuo, nkitahodi, ne biakoyɛ betumi adi wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyɛ nnwuma, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi ne adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw, afotufo, ne atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ wɔn adwuma mu adi nkitaho?
answer: Afotuo, nkitahodi, ne adwumayɛkuw di dwuma titiriw wɔ mmoa a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔyɛ nnwuma no mu. Afotufoɔ de akwankyerɛ, afotuo, ne nhumu a ɛsom boɔ a egyina wɔn ankasa suahunu so ma, na ɛboa mmabun ma wɔdi nsɛnnennen ho dwuma na wɔsi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata. Nkitahodi ma mmabun tumi ne adwumayɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw, afotufo, ne atipɛnfo a wɔwɔ wɔn adwuma mu di nkitaho, na ɛma nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛsesa, fekubɔ hokwan ahorow, ne nneɛma a wobenya no yɛ mmerɛw. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ma mmabun a wɔyɛ nnwuma no tumi de ahokokwaw ne ahoɔden a ɛka ho di dwuma, boaboa nneɛma ano, na wodu botae ahorow a wɔbom yɛ ho yie.

question: Sɛ mmabun hyia akwanside anaa nsɛnnennen bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden, sɛ wobenya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a, anammɔn bɛn na wobetumi atu?
answer: Akwanside ne Nsɛnnennen a wobedi ho dwuma: - Mmabun a wohyia akwanside ahorow a ɛmma wontumi nnya awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe no betumi atu anammɔn pii, a nea ɛka ho ne: - Wɔhwehwɛ nnwuma foforo a wɔde ma, te sɛ mpɔtam hɔ - akwahosan ayaresabea anaa akwahosan asoɛe a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, a ebetumi de kokoam hwɛ ama mmabun. - a wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho denam wɔn ho a wɔbɛkasa akyerɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ pefee wɔ wɔn hokwan ne wɔn haw ho, na wɔabisa nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun. - a wode bɛkɔ mpaninfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn di, te sɛ sukuu afotufoɔ anaa mmabun adwumayɛfoɔ, nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. - a wode bma nyiyim anaase nnwuma a wopow biara ho amanneɛ akyerɛ atumfoɔ a wɔfata anaa ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban.

question: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee a edi mu wɔ mpɔtam ahorow?
answer: Ɔman Mmabun Adwumayɛ Dwumadie (NYEP): Aban nhyehyɛɛ yi botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛma mmabun anya nimdeɛ nteteeɛ ne adwuma a wɔde bɛto hɔ wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ mu wɔ Ghana. African Internship Academy: Saa ahyehyɛdeɛ yi ma mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ Ghana nya adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ ne adwumayɛ hokwan, boa wɔn ma wɔnya osuahu a mfasoɔ wɔ so, na wɔnya nkitahodie wɔ wɔn nnwuma a wɔapaw mu. Youth Employment Accelerator: Saa nhyehyɛe yi de mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ Ghana bata adwuma hokwan ahorow ho denam fekubɔ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ nnwuma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ so, na ɛboa ma mmabun a wonnya adwuma nyɛ dodow so tew wɔ ɔman no mu. Meltwater Entrepreneurial School of Technology (MEST): MEST de afe baako adwumayɛ nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ma mmabun a wɔwɔ Ghana, na ɛma wɔn nimdeɛ ne nneɛma a ɛhia na wɔatumi ahyɛ wɔn ankasa nnwuma ase. African Youth Initiative on Climate Change (AYICC): Saa ahyehyɛde yi ma mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ Ghana a wɔn ani gye nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa ne wim nsakrae ho hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, na ɛboa wɔn ma wonya osuahu wɔ saa adwuma a ɛrenya nkɔso yi mu.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow nya mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nsabuo, nna, ne ɔdɔ mu nkitahodie ho so nsunsuanso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ankorankoro betumi akasa atia nsusuwii hunu ne gyinapɛn ahorow a epira?

question: So hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi de asetra mu nimdeɛ adi dwuma na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ wiase tebea horow ankasa mu, te sɛ mpɔtam hɔ som adwuma anaa adwumayɛ ho ntetee?

question: Gyinapɛn ne gyidi bɛn na yɛn amammerɛ, anaa yɛn som kyerɛkyerɛ fa abusuabɔ, aware, ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho?
answer: Ebia amammerɛ ne nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ besi hia a aware, awo, ne abusua biakoyɛ ho hia so dua. Wɔtaa kyerɛw dwumadi ne asɛyɛde pɔtee bi ma ankorankoro wɔ abusuabɔ anaa twaka ne mmusua mu. question: Dɛn ne nneɛma titiriw a ɛma wosiw HIV ano yiye ma mmabun?
answer: HIV a wɔsiw ano a ɛkɔ akyiri ma mmabun no bi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so nya HIV ne akwan a wɔfa so siw ano (te sɛ kɔndɔm a wɔde di dwuma, nnuru a wɔde siw ano ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu anaa PrEP, ne akwan a wɔfa so te ɔhaw so), HIV nhwehwɛmu dwumadie a wɔbɛnya, nna mu nneyɛeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ mu a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, animtiaabuo a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma, ne hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya mmoa a wɔde bɛboa.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn a wosiw ano yɛ adwuma, na akwan bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano siw nyinsɛn ano denam mmadwoa anaa ovulation a egyae so. Akwan a wɔfa so yɛ no bi ne kɔndɔm, nnuru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, IUD, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm, nyinsɛn a wɔsɛe no, ne abɔde mu akwan.

question: Amamerɛ ne kasa-pɔtee nneɛma nea borɔfofoɔ fre no 'cultural anaa language-specific resources' bi wɔ hɔ ma mmabun wɔ wɔ mpɔtam afoforo ahorow anaa?

question: Dɛn ne nna mu ɔhaw na dɛn na ɛbɛtumi de aba?
answer: Nna mu nsɛnnennen (sexual dysfunction) yɛ ɔhaw biara a ɛba wɔ berɛ a obi rekɔ nna mu (akɔnnɔ, anigyeɛ, anigyeɛ a ɛkɔ soro paa, ne berɛ a nipadua no dwiriw ne ho). Ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛtaa si na ɛnam nneɛma ahodoɔ pii so na ɛba. Bi ne mmoa yi:Nipadua mu nneɛma (Physical factors): Yareɛ ahodoɔ, nnuru a obi nom, anaa nipadua mu nsuo (hormones) a ɛnyɛ pɛ.Adwene mu nneɛma (Psychological factors): Dadwene, suro, awerɛhoɔ a ɛmu dɔ (depression), nkitahodiɛ mu nsɛm, anaa nna mu suahu a ɛnyɛ papa a obi anya atwam.Nnuru ne nsa (Substance use): Nnuru a ɛyɛ den ne nsa betumi asɛe kwan a nipadua no yɛ adwuma wɔ nna mu.Sɛ worehyia nna mu nsɛnnennen a, ɛho hia sɛ:Wone akwahosan ho adwumfoɔ bɛkasa (dɔkota, nɛɛse, anaa mmeaeɛ a wɔhwɛ nna mu akwahosan so) na woatumi ahwehwɛ nea ɛde ba ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so asiesie.

question: Nhyehyɛeɛ anaa dwumadie bɛn na ayɛ yie a ɛma amammerɛ mu obu kɔ anim wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ mu akwahosan ho, na ɛkwan bɛn so na wobɛtumi asusu saa nhwɛsoɔ yi ayɛ bi anaa wɔasesa mu afata mmeaeɛ foforɔ?
answer: Nhyehyɛeɛ anaa dwumadie a ɛdi mu a ɛhyɛ amammerɛ mu obu ho nkuran wɔ mmabun nna ne awoɔ mu akwahosan mu no, mpɛn pii no ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ akuo, ne amammerɛ mu akannifoɔ bɔ mu yɛ adwuma. Saa nhyehyɛeɛ yi bi ne akwahosan ho ntetee nhyiamu a wɔayɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛfata amammerɛ bi, ntoboano dwumadie, anaa atipɛnfo ntetee nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ amammerɛ anaa mmusuakuo bi titire ahiadeɛ ne nea wɔpɛ. Nea ɛyɛ nhwɛsoɔ ne sɛ, dwumadie bi de amammerɛ mu anansesɛm anaa mfoni ne nnyigyei (multimedia) di dwuma de twe mmabun ne mmusua ba nkɔmmɔbɔ mu fa nna ne awoɔ mu akwahosan ho. Wobɛtumi asusu saa nhwɛsoɔ yi ayɛ bi anaa wɔasesa mu afata mmeaeɛ foforɔ denam nneyɛeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ no sɛnea ɛne mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ ne wɔn ahiadeɛ bɛhyia pɛpɛɛpɛ.

question: Sɛ wɔde toto anansesɛm ahorow bi a w'ate ho a, kwan bɛn so na nyinsɛn ho nnuro boa paa?
answer: Ɛho hia sɛ wohu nsonsonoe a ɛda nokwasɛm ahorow a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ a wɔtaa nya ntam. question: Dɛn ne 'PrEP', na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛyɛ adwuma de siw 'HIV' yareɛ ano?
answer: PrEP' gyina hɔ ma nea broni ka no 'Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis'. Ɛyɛ aduru a nnipa a wonni 'HIV' nom de tew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya HIV no so. 'PrEP' yɛ adwuma denam 'HIV' a esiw ano sɛ ɛbɛkɔ so na atrɛw wɔ wo nipadua nyinaa mu sɛ wo nya mmoawa no a. Ɛte sɛ kyɛm a ɛboa ma wobɔ wo ho ban fi 'HIV' yareɛ ho.'

'PrEP' yɛ adwuma denam 'HIV' a esiw ano sɛ ɛbɛkɔ so na atrɛw wɔ wo nipadua nyinaa mu sɛ wo nya mmoawa no a. Ɛte sɛ kyɛm a ɛboa ma wobɔ wo ho ban fi 'HIV' yareɛ ho.'

question: Asɛyɛde bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, aguade ho dawurubɔfo, ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ wɔ nna ho mfonini a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu no wɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi abu wɔn akontaa wɔ abrabɔ pa gyinapɛn ne nneyɛe ho?

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ada no adi akyerɛ m’awofo sɛ mepɛ sɛ mebɔ nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛyɛ nokware fa nna ne awo akwahosan ho a memma wɔnte nka sɛ wɔahyɛ wɔn anaasɛ wɔn ho nyɛ wɔn dɛ?
answer: Fa nkate ne obu bɛn nkɔmmɔbɔ no, na si ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubesua ade na woasisi w’akwahosan ho gyinae a ɛfata so dua. Ma w’awofo awerɛhyem sɛ wubu wɔn akwankyerɛ ne mmoa a wɔde ma wɔn no sɛ ɛsom bo, na wopɛ sɛ wo ne wɔn di nkitaho pefee de di nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm biara a ɛhaw wo ho dwuma.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’awofo abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ho no mu sɛ wɔmpene so a?
answer: Nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ho betumi ayɛ den, titiriw sɛ w’awofo mpene so a. Afotu bi ni: Yɛ wo nhwehwɛmu: Boaboa nsɛm fi mmeae a agye din. Fi ase ketewaa bi: Di kan susuw kɔndɔm ho, a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobenya na enhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw nnuru ma. Ka sɛ mobɛbom akɔ: Munsusuw ho sɛ mobɛhyɛ nyansa sɛ mombom nkɔ ayaresabea anaa apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo bi na ama wɔanya adwene a ɛyɛ nokware kɛse. Kae: Wo nna mu apɔwmuden ho hia. Wowɔ hokwan sɛ wusi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wo nipadua ho. Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wo, sɛ mpo w’awofo mpene so mfiase no a. Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛkɔ so ahu mmara kwan so nsɛm a aba foforo a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru a wobenya wɔ Ghana ho. Ebia saa nneɛma yi betumi de nsɛm a ɛyɛ foforo sen biara ama.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhomasua ne tumi a wɔde bɛhyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden a ɛka mmabun nna ne awo mu yiyedi te sɛ ohia, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a enni hɔ, ne apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe a wonnya no ho no dwuma?

question: So nneɛma pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ma LGBTQ+ mmabun bere a wɔrepaw nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano no?
answer: Bɔbeasu mu Anigye: Ɛnyɛ bɔbeasu koro mmienu ntam abusuabɔ nyinaa mu na nyinsɛn ho dadwen wɔ, nanso ahobammɔ firi nna mu nyarewa ho hia paa. Wo ne wo dɔkota nni nkitaho fa kɔndɔm ne dental dams (nneɛma a wɔde kata ɔbaa ho bere a wɔregyee n'ani) ho. Bɔbeasu mu Su: Nnipa ahorow wɔ apɔwmuden mu ahiadeɛ pii a ɛsono obiara dea. Kasa kyerɛ w’apɔwmuden  mu dwumayɛni fa sɛnea wo nipadua, nipadua mu nsuo a wogye (sɛ ɛbi wɔ hɔ a), ne sɛnea wobɔ wo bra no betumi aka awoɔ ntentenee kwan a wobɛpaw.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono mfe wɔde pene ho mmra a yɛ sononko firi nkurow nkurow mu, na dɛn ne akwankyerɛ titiriw a ɛwɔ yɛn mpɔtam hɔ?
answer: Mfe a obi adi ho mmra betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ tumidi biara mu, wɔ aman mu ne aman ahorow ntam. question: Dɛn ne mpɔtam-mpɔtam nkitahodie dwumadie, na ɛwan kwan so na eyi boa wɔ babaso ne HIV ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ho ban bɔ mu?
answer: Mpɔtam hɔ nkɔmmɔdie nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ nnwuma a ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ, wɔn a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne aban nnwumakuo hyehyɛ de nkyerɛkyerɛ, mmoa, ne nneɛma ma ankorankoro a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi boa ma wɔsiw STI/HIV ano na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ denam: Wɔnam nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu, nsɛm a wɔka, ne nhyiamu a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn so. Nsɛm, nneɛma, ne nnwinnade a wɔde besiw STI/HIV ano, asɔ ahwɛ, ne ayaresa a wɔde bɛma. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de adi amammerɛ, asetena, ne sikasɛm mu nsɛm a ɛka STI/HIV a wɔde kɔ nnipa mu ne akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔnya no ho dwuma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne adwumayɛkuo a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔdi dwuma no bɛkyekyere, a sukuu ahodoɔ, ahyehyɛdeɛ a egyina gyidie so, ne nnwuma ka ho, de akɔ nnipa ahodoɔ nkyɛn na wɔanya nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ.

Nsɛnnennen Ho Nsusuwii hunu: Fa nsiyɛ gye mfonini ahorow a enye a wɔyɛ wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne ɔmanfo mu ho kyim. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa dɛmdi ne nna ho fi mmeae a wotumi gye di.

question: So akwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma me sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ m’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu den na ɛfoa so mu?
answer: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ ma wo sɛ wode wo ho bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ anaa dwumadi ahorow a ɛhyɛ w’ankorankoro gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho mu den na ɛfoa so mu. Hwehwɛ atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo, nwomasua nhyiamu, anaa intanɛt so nhyiamu a wobɛtumi ne afoforɔ a wɔwɔ gyinapɛn a ɛte saa ara adi nkitaho. Fa wo ho hyɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyiamu anaa ɔsatuo a wɔde kamfo nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn adwene si su pa a wɔbɛnya wɔ nna ne obuo mu abusuabɔ ho no mu. Sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ hokwan ahorow yi mu denneennen a, wubetumi ahyɛ wo gyinapɛn ahorow ho ntease mu den na woanya mmoa afi ankorankoro a wɔwɔ adwene koro hɔ.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ma nhyehyɛe ne nneyɛe a ɛde kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm di kan wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu?
answer: Mmabun betumi akasa ma kokoamsɛm ne kokoam nsɛm denam: Mmabun a wɔkamfo akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si akwahosan ho nsɛm so a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatu ahorow a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ kokoamsɛm hokwan ahorow ho nkuran mu. Wɔn suahu ne wɔn haw ahorow a wɔbɛka akyerɛ nhyehyɛeyɛfo, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo. question: Nsɛnnennen anaa ɔhaw bɛn na mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu na ɛkɔ akyiri a wobenya mu esiane amammerɛ anaa Nyamesom mu ahyɛde anaa anohyeto ahorow nti?

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahu sɛ ebia wɔn apomoden ho insurance nhyehyɛe no tua nnwuma te sɛ nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awoɔ apomoden ho nhwehwɛmu ho ka?
answer: Mmabun betumi ahu sɛ ebia wɔn apomoden ho insurance nhyehyɛe no tua nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho ka denam: Wɔn insurance nhyehyɛe ho nkrataa a wɔbɛsan ahwɛ mu, a mfaso ne sika a wɔde tua ho ka (SBC) ho nsɛm tiawa ka ho, na wɔate nnwuma a wɔabɔ ho ka, sika a wɔtew fi mu, sika a wɔde bom, ne insurance a wɔde bom yɛ no ase. question: Nsɛm ne afotusem adwuma bɛn na wɔde ma mmabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu?
answer: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun a wɔresusuw ho sɛ wobeyi nyinsɛn agu no nya nsɛm ne afotu a ɛkɔ akyiri. question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe a ɛfa nyiyim ho no ka tumi a mmabun wɔ sɛ wobenya nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm?

question: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho a ɛsɛsɛ mmabun hu?

question: Dɛn ne asetena mu nimdeɛ ho nhwɛso bi, a mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ (sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, kɔmputa ho nimdeɛ, duadwumfo, ntamapam), ahokokwaw a ɛyɛ mmerɛw (sɛ nhwɛso no, nkitahodi, kuw adwumayɛ, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru), ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ (sɛ nhwɛso no, adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, aguadi, sikasɛm sohwɛ) ka ho?
answer: Mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ: Kɔmputa ho nimdeɛ: Software applications, intanɛt nhwehwɛmu, ne programming kasa atitiriw a wɔde di dwuma ho nimdeɛ. Duadwumfo adwuma: Tumi a wɔde nsa ne anyinam ahoɔden nnwinnade yɛ na wosiesie nnua adan, dan mu nneɛma, ne nneɛma a wɔde si dan mu. Nwene: Nwene mfiri a wɔde pam ade, nsusuwso a wɔkyerɛ ase, ne ntade anaa ntama a wɔboaboa ano ho nimdeɛ. Soft Skills: Nkitahodi: Nkitahodi a wɔde ano ka ne nea wɔkyerɛw mu da hɔ na ama woatumi de nsusuwii, akwankyerɛ, ne nsɛm adi yiye. Akuw adwuma: Nkɔmmɔbɔ, biakoyɛ, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ biakoyɛ mu ne mfɛfo adwumayɛfo anaa kuw no mufo. Ɔhaw ano aduro: Nsusuwii a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu, adebɔ, ne nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma de hu nsɛnnennen anaa akwanside ahorow na wodi ho dwuma. Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ: Adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe: Nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ akyiri a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a ɛkyerɛ adwumayɛ botae ahorow, akwan ahorow, aguadi ho akwan horow, ne sikasɛm ho nkɔmhyɛ ahorow. Aguadi: Nneɛma anaa nnwuma a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran, hu gua a wɔde wɔn ani asi so, ne ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran de twetwe adetɔfo. Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛe, akontaabu, ne sikasɛm ho gyinaesi a wɔde hwɛ ɛka a wɔbɔ, di sika a wonya no akyi, na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ adwuma no bɛkɔ so atra hɔ.

question: Wobɛtumi ama me nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfata mfeɛ anaa nneɛma a mede bɛsua nna mu apomoden ho adeɛ bebree?
answer: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Planned Parenthood's 'Teen Talk' anaa nna Etc.' ma nsɛm a ɛfata mfeɛ pɔtee bi fa nna mu apɔwmuden ho asɛmti ahodoɔ ho. Nhoma te sɛ brebiara de ho pɛpɛɛpɛ 'It's Perfectly Normal' a Robie H kyerew ye. Harris kyerɛw anaa 'Changing Bodies, Changing Lives' a Ruth Bell kyerɛw nso betumi ama mmofra a wɔn mfeɛ nkɔ anim nsɛm pii. Video a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ adeɛ wɔ YouTube tebea horow so no betumi de aniwa so nkyerɛkyerɛma a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho asɛmti ho ama wɔ kwan bi so a ɛyɛ anigye na ɛyɛ bɔkɔɔ sɛ wobɛte aseɛ. Hwehwɛ kanbia te sɛ Amaze.org anaa Sexplanations. Wo skuul nso betumi de nna mu apɔwmuden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ adesua anaa nnwuma a akyerekyerɛfoɔ a wɔfata di so anim.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Honam fam nsakrae bɛn na ɛba nipadua so bere a wanyinsɛn no? (hormone mu nsakrae, mu duru a ɛkɔ soro, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer: Nyinsɛn hwehwɛ sɛ nsakrae a ɛyɛ nwonwa ba wo nipadua mu, na ne nyinaa fi hormone ahorow! Nea ɛtaa ba no bi ni: Mu duru a Ɛkɔ soro: Wo mu duru bɛkɔ soro de ama wo ba a ɔrenyin no aduan pa. Eyi yɛ apɔwmuden na ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata. Nufu mu Nsakrae: Ebia wo nufu bɛyɛ mmerɛw na ayɛ kɛse de asiesie wo ho ama nufu. Yafunu Nnyin: W’awotwaa no trɛw ma akokoaa no nya baabi. Ɔbrɛ: Ebia ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wobɛte ɔbrɛ nka, titiriw wɔ ɔsram abiɛsa a edi kan no mu. Adwene mu Nsakrae: Nsakrae a ɛba nipadua mu nkwaadɔm mu no betumi ama obi anya adwene mu nsakrae, te sɛ nkate a ɔte nka kɛse anaasɛ ne bo fuw.

question: Hokwan "Rights" ahorow bɛn na mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ, wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya mu, na sɛ mihyia nyiyim anaa ayayade a, mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ hokwan ahorow yi?
answer: Ghana Amanyɔ Mmra "Constitution of Ghana" no ma ɔman mma nyinaa nya hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ, a akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ka ho. Sɛnea wobɛka wo hokwan ahorow ni: Hu Wo Hokwan: Hwehwɛ Ghana mmra ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa mmubuafo hokwan ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wobenya ho. Ayarefoɔ a Wɔkamfo Akuo: Sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a, wo ne ayarefoɔ a wɔkamfo nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no di nkitaho. Ebia wɔde akwankyerɛ bɛma wɔ sɛnea wobɛka hokwan ahorow a wowɔ ho. Kyerɛw Biribiara: Sɛ wuhyia nyiyim a, yɛ da, bere, asɛm no ho nsɛm, ne adansefo (sɛ ebi wɔ hɔ a) ho kyerɛwtohɔ.

question: Nneɛma bɛn na ebetumi anya ankorankoro bi ahyeɛ so nkɛntɛnso, te sɛ amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, n’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, osuahu ahorow a atwam, ne ahotɔ dodow, na kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi adi saa nneɛma yi so wɔ ahyeɛ a wɔbɛto na wɔakura mu?
answer: Nneɛma ahorow betumi anya ankorankoro bi ahyeɛ so nkɛntɛnso, a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, n’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, osuahu ahorow a atwam, ne ahotɔ dodow ka ho. Nneɛma ahorow betumi anya ankorankoro bi ahyeɛ so nkɛntɛnso, a amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, n’ankasa gyinapɛn ahorow, osuahu ahorow a atwam, ne ahotɔ dodow ka ho. Mmabun betumi afa saa nneɛma yi mu denam wɔn amammerɛ mu ntetee a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu, wɔn gyinapɛn ne wɔn gyidi ahorow a wɔbɛte ase, osuahu ahorow a atwam a wobedi ho dwuma, na wɔde nkakrankakra atrɛ wɔn ahotɔ mmeae mu denam wɔn ho a wobehu ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkamfo so. Mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpaninfo anaa afotufo a wogye wɔn di hɔ nso betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔafa ɔhyeɛ a wɔde besisi hɔ no so wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so.

question: Abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun ma ɛtra wɔn adwenem berɛ a wɔreyɛ abɛɛfo nneɛma, titiriw bere a wɔredi nsɛmti a ɛyɛ nkate anaa akyinnyegye a ɛfa ASRH, nna, abusuabɔ, ne nipasu ho dwuma no?
answer: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de obu, nokwaredi, ne nokware di kan bere a wɔreyɛ bɛɛfo ntentan nsɛm a ɛfa ASRH nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no. Ɛsɛ sɛ wonya pene berɛ a wɔde ankorankoro di dwuma wɔ wɔn nsɛm mu no na wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔde kokoamsɛm sie, titiriw berɛ a wɔresusuw wɔn ankasa osuahu ahorow ho no. Pɛpɛɛpɛ ne nokwasɛm mu nokwaredi na ɛho hia sen biara; ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwɛ sɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din no yɛ nokware na wɔkwati sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsusuwii hunu a epira mu. Obu a wɔde ma adwene, amammerɛ, ne nipasu ahorow ho hia; ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ mu no kwati sɛ wɔbɛma nsusuwii hunu a ɛwɔ hɔ no akɔ so anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nyiyim nneyɛe mu.

question: Sɛ ɔbabun bi yɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ ɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ a, ayaresa bɛn na wobetumi apaw, na ɛhe na wobetumi anya ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe?
answer: Sɛ ɔbabun bi yɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ ɔwɔ nna mu yareɔa, ayaresa a wobetumi apaw no bi ne: - Nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde sa ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu te sɛ chlamydia, gonorrhea, ne syphilis. - a wode ko tia mmoawa a wode sa virus STI te se HIV ne herpes. - ayaresa nhyehyɛe betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina ɔyare mmoawa pɔtee ne ankorankoro nneɛma so. - ayaresa dwumadie wo mmeaeɛ korɔ no ara bebree a wɔyɛ sɔhwɛ, a ɔmanfoɔ apomoden ayaresabea, mpɔtam akwahosan asoɛeɛ, ne ankorankoro apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ ka ho.

answer: Mmabun betumi akasa ama, ɔhwɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho akyerɛ wɔ apomoden nhyehyɛe ne ahyehyɛde ahorow mu denam wɔn suahu ahorow a wɔbɛka, ama nkurɔfo ate hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nneyɛe a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho, ne mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban mu. question: So nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ mmabun betumi anya ‘sexual reproductive health’ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?
answer: Ayaresabea ahorow a wɔde fa nnipa, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn, ne ayaresa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ telefon so boa ma wodu nkuraase. Akwahosan adwumayɛfo, mpɔtam hɔ akuw, ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo bom yɛ adwuma de ma nneɛma a wonya no tu mpɔn.

question: So akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw awo ano a ɛnyɛ kɔndɔm, bɔ obi ho ban biara fi nna ho yareɛ ho? (ebinom yɛ saa, nanso ɛnyɛ wɔn nyinaa) .
answer: Akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano dodow no ara, te sɛ aduro, IUD, anaa ade a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu no, mmɔ wɔn ho ban mfi STI ho. Wɔyɛ papa ma nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nanso kɔndɔm nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so a wɔfa so siw STI dodow no ara a ɛbɛtrɛw ano.

question: Nkyerɛkyerɛ akwan ne nneɛma bɛn na wɔde di dwuma de ma mmabun, de wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho adesua mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wɔhyɛ adesua a ɛyɛ nna, nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee, ne adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi ho nkuran?

Nnwuma a wɔde nsa yɛ te sɛ nsɛm ho ammane3bɔ mu nsɛm a wɔbɛbɔ, digyital abasɛm a wɔka ne "multimedia" nkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Nsɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu ne wiase ankasa nhwɛso ahorow a wɔde kɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ne nnyinasoahorow mu. Ahɔho kasafo, adwumayɛbea ahorow ne afuw mu akwantu ahorow a wɔde kɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu. "Multimedia" nneɛma a "video", nsɛm a woakyerɛw ne intanɛt so nso ka ho. Dwumadi a wɔde di dwuma ne nsusui a wɔde a wɔde hwehw3 adwene ahorow mu. Adesua dwumadi ahorow a wɔbom yɛ te sɛ kuw nnwuma, atipɛnfo nhwehwɛmu a wɔbom yɛ. Saa akwan yi hyɛ adesua a ɛyɛ nnam, adwene a ɛyɛ katee, ne adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi ho nkuran ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nkyerɛwee mu pɔtee, de nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow so da wɔn ankasa adwene adi.

question: Dɛn ne akwan bi a nea broni ka no 'social media' so nkɛntɛnsofo taa fa so de wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun atiefo mu na wonya wɔn so nkɛntɛnso wɔ 'ASRH' nsɛmti ho, na saa akwan yi tu mpɔn dɛn?
answer: Nea broni ka no 'Social media' nkɛntɛnsofoɔ de akwan ahodoɔ di dwuma de de wɔn ho hyɛ mmabun atiefoɔ mu na wɔnya wɔn so nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ ASRH nsɛmti ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Abasɛm a ɛyɛ nokware ne ankorankoro asɛm a ɛka wɔn akyidifoɔ na ɛma nkateɛ mu nkitahodiɛ ba. Nkitahodi nneɛma te sɛ abatow, nsɛmmisa, ne nsɛmmisa ne mmuae nhyiam ahorow a wɔde hyɛ nkuran ma wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Ɛsono sɛnea saa akwan yi tu mpɔn no gyina nneɛma te sɛ nea ɔde nkɛntɛnso no di dwuma no mu ahotoso, nokware a ɔyɛ, ne sɛnea otumi ne wɔn atiefo di nkitaho so.

question: Dɛn ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wɔm, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia?
answer: Nkyerɛase: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom kyerɛ nneyɛe ne akwan a ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da bere a wɔreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nea broni ka no  'Abstinence', Wo ne wo hokafo di nkitaho pefee fa wo nna mu akwahosan ho, to wo nna mu ahokafo dodow ano hye, fa kɔndɔm di dwuma yiye na daa, yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ STIs ho. Sɛ wowɔ STI a, kɔ ayaresa. Sɛ obi rehyɛ wo sɛ wo ne obi nna anaa ɔma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ a, ka kyerɛ no. Nea ɛho hia: Ɛbɔ ho ban fi nna mu yarewa 'STI' ho: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom boa ma wosiw STI a ebetumi de akwahosan ho haw a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ no ano. Siw Nyinsɛn a Wɔnhyɛɛ Ho Nhyehyɛe Siw: Wɔtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da nso so, na ɛma ankorankoro tumi paw awo ho nsɛm a ɛfata.

question: Dwuma bɛn na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo (Health workers) di wɔ nsɛm ne mmoa a ɛfa nyinsɛn a wɔsiw ano ho?
answer: Nsɛm ne Akwankyerɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo de akwan horow a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri ma. Wɔka sɛnea etu mpɔn, nea efi mu ba, akwankyerɛ a wɔde di dwuma, ne sɛnea ɛfata ma ankorankoro ahiade ho asɛm. Nnuru a Wɔkyerɛw ne Nea Wɔde Ma: Akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo betumi akyerɛw nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a hormone wom te sɛ nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano, nnuru a wɔde hyɛ nipadua mu, anaa nnuru a wɔde twitwiw nyinsɛn mu. Wobetumi nso afata anaasɛ wɔde akwankyerɛ ama wɔ akwanside akwan te sɛ kɔndɔm ne akwan a ɛkyɛ te sɛ mfiri a wɔde fa awotwaa mu (IUDs) ho. Akyidi ne Nhwehwɛmu: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hwɛ sɛnea nyinsɛn ano aduro reyɛ adwuma yiye na wodi nsɛm biara a ɛhaw adwene ho dwuma. Wɔde akwankyerɛ ma wɔ nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ sɛ wɔpa nnuro anaa nsɛm afoforo bi a.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amanaman ntam biakoyɛ betumi aboa ma wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a etu mpɔn adi dwuma wɔ ahye so?
answer: Mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ adwumayɛkuo mu: Nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔbɛkyɛ: Aman bɛtumi asua biribi afiri wɔn ho wɔn ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi mu no mu na wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ wɔn ankasa tebea mu. Nhwehwɛmu: Nkɔmmɔbɔ ma nhwehwɛmu mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom yɛ no tumi te ɔhaw a akwan horow nya no ase. NGO Nkɔmmɔbɔ: NGO ahorow taa yɛ biako de nhyehyɛe ahorow di dwuma wɔ aman pii so, na ɛde nimdeɛ ne nneɛma ba.

question: Dɛn ne nneɛma pa a ɛwɔ social media so wɔ SRH ho nimdeɛ, nhomasua, ne nsɛm ne nnwuma a mmabun nya wɔ wiase nyinaa no mu?
answer: Nneɛma a wobetumi anya: Social media platform ahorow ma ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw na ɛyɛ mmerɛw ma mmabun a wɔbɛfa so anya SRH ho nsɛm, nneɛma, ne mmoa nnwuma, titiriw wɔ mpɔtam a wontumi nnya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no. Atipɛnfoɔ mmoa: Intanɛt so mpɔtam ne mmoa akuo a ɛwɔ sohyial media so ma mmabun nya baabi a wɔbɛkyɛ osuahu, ahwehwɛ afotuo, na wɔanya mmoa afiri atipɛnfoɔ a wɔrehyia SRH nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara hɔ. Nhomasua ne nhumu: SRH ahyehyɛde ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ de sohyial media di dwuma de ma nkurɔfoɔ te SRH nsɛm ho, hyɛ nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri (CSE) ho nkuran, na wɔkamfo nhyehyɛɛ mu nsakraeɛ a ɛbɛma mmabun SRH aba atu mpɔn.

question: Dɛn ne mmara mu nkyerɛase ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho, a mmara, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ho a ɛkyerɛ nna mu nneyɛe na ɛbɔ ho ban fi nna mu basabasayɛ ho ka ho?
answer: Mmara kwan so nkyerɛase ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ pene a wɔpene so ho no gu ahorow gyina tumidi so, nanso mpɛn pii no, wɔkyerɛkyerɛ pene a wɔpene so no mu sɛ apam a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ, wɔde nimdeɛ, na wɔde anigye yɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nna mu dwumadi mu. Mmara, ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa nna mu dwumadi ho no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛbɔ ankorankoro ho ban afi nna mu ayayade, ne nneyɛe bɔne ho. Saa mmara ahorow yi kyerɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde pene ma kwa na wofi wɔn pɛ mu, a wɔmfa nhyɛso, ne ndaadaa so. Wobu nna mu dwumadi a wɔmpene so sɛ nna mu basabasayɛ anaa mmonnaato, na wɔn a wɔyɛ saa no betumi ahyia mmara mu nsunsuanso a emu yɛ den, a nsɛmmɔnedi ho sobo ne afiasenna ka ho.

question: Mpɛn ahe na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu sɛ ebia wɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ, titiriw sɛ wɔyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a?

question: Dɛn ne afotu adwuma, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ebetumi aboa mmabun wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan 'SRH' ho?
answer: Afotu adwumayɛbea ahorow ma mmabun nya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ na ɛboa ma wɔne oduruyɛfo a wɔatete no susuw wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho haw ahorow, atinka ahorow, ne osuahu ahorow ho. Saa nnwuma yi betumi aboa mmabun te sɛ: Kokoam tebea a wɔde bɛma de ahwehwɛ nsɛmti a ɛho hia mu. Atinka fam mmoa ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow a wɔde fa kwan so no mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nsɛm a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano aduru, nna mu nyarewa 'STI's, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho a wɔde bɛma. Mmabun a wɔbɛboa wɔn ma wɔanya nimdeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔne ahokafo adi nkitaho yiye na wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho.

question: Akwan bɛn na awofo betumi afa so adi nsɛmti a ɛhia tema anaa akyinnyegye nsem ho mfonini wɔ media mu, te sɛ nna, basabasayɛ, nnuro a wɔde di dwuma, ne adwenemyare ho dwuma wɔ akwan a ɛfata mfe a mmabun adi na ɛma denhyɛ so?

question: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkrasɛm a eye na ɛnya nkɛtɛnso pa wɔ nna mu apɔwmuden ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ mfoni ahorow a ɛyɛ animtiaabu anaa epira ho?

question: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ sɛ mepa eduro no nom bi, anaasɛ kɔndɔm no mu pae, anaasɛ mehyia ɔhaw foforo biara bere a merefa awoɔ ntentenee kwan biara so no?
answer: Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ sɛ wuhyia nsɛm bi wɔ wo nnuru a wode siw nyinsɛn ano ho ni: Nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn a wannom bere bi: Di akwankyerɛ pɔtee a ɛwɔ aduro no krataa so no akyi, anaasɛ hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ firi w'apɔwmuden  mu dwumayɛni hɔ fa aduro a woannya amnom no ho. Sɛ kɔndɔm mu pae: Twa wo ho firi mu ntɛm ara na fa foforo hyɛ mu. Sɛ wosuro sɛ wobɛnyinsɛn a, fa aduro a wɔnom ntɛm ara de siw nyinsɛn kwan ho adwene. Nsɛm afoforo: Sɛ wowɔ dadwen biara fa kwan a woapaw so no ho a, kasa kyerɛ w'apɔwmuden mu dwumayɛni. Kae: Aniwu biara nni ho sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ mmoa. W’apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafoɔ wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa wo na wadi nsɛm biara a wobɛhyia ho dwuma.

question: Dɛn ne nneɛma atitiriw bi a ɛma obi nya abusuabɔ pa, te sɛ nkitahodie, ahotoso, ne obu?

question: Sɛ mewɔ aduroyɛ mu yare bi a na ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a, so metumi akɔ so anyinsɛn dwoodwoo? (wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bi nsusu ho)

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi de m’awofoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn no ahyɛ m’akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu bere a meda so ara kura me ahofadi ne kokoamsɛm mu?
answer: W’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo a wode wɔn ho bɛhyɛ w’akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow mu bere a wokura w’ahofadi ne kokoam nsɛm mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wodi nkitaho pefee nna wode ahyeɛ sisi hɔ. Akwan bi ni: Di nkitaho pefee: Wo ne w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo nsusuw w’akwahosan ho ahiade ne nea wopɛ ho wɔ obu ne ɔkwan a ɛda adi pefee so. Fa ahye sisi hɔ: Kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a wote nka sɛ ɛyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wode bɛma w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo ne baabi a wobɛpɛ sɛ wokora kokoam nsɛm so no mu pefee. Kamfo wo ho: Fa hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wusi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ w’akwahosan ho no so dua na kyerɛ nea wopɛ wɔ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho. Hwehwɛ mmoa: Sɛ wote nka sɛ ɛnyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wo ne w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo bɛbɔ nsɛmti bi ho nkɔmmɔ a, susuw ho sɛ wode ɔpanyin foforo a wugye wo di te sɛ wo busuani, w’abusua adamfo, anaa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo bɛka ho. Hwehwɛ kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow mu: Hu kokoam nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ akwahosan ho mmeae a ɛfata mmabun na wo ne w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo nsusuw ho na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ mo ne mo ho mo ho bɛte ase. Fa wo ho hyɛ mu nkakrankakra: Fa w’awofo anaa w’ahwɛfo ka w’akwahosan ho gyinaesi ahorow ho nkakrankakra, fi ase fi nsɛmti a ɛnyɛ den pii so na bere kɔ so no, wubenya ahotoso.
