question: Sɛn na nwomasua ne adwuma nteteeɛ boa akuo a eye mmabun a wɔ hia neaɛma sokoronko ne ohaw ahorow, atubrafo, anaa wɔn a wɔte beae a ntawantawa wɔ mu?
answer: Nhyehyɛeɛ aa ama ne mu so te sɛ senea aborɔfo ka no 'STEM' ne 'vocational training' se ɛbɛ adrɛse mmabun kuokuo ahohia soronko ne ɔhaw. Nea wokaho yɛ: atufrafo a bronni bɛkasɛ 'refugee anaa immigrant' ne wɔn a wɔte beae a ntawantawa wɔ mu.Dwumadie suronko betumi ama kasa mmoa a aborɔfo bɛkasɛ 'language support',  'trauma-informed education', ne amammerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne akwan a yɛbetumi di mmabun ahyɛ adesua ne broni bɛkasɛ 'vocational systems' kɛseɛ no mu. Ebiom, mpɔtɛm nkuokuo ne 'NGOs' a wɔwɔ apɔmmuden mu tan mma mmoa ne nkitahodi ma mmabun a ɔmo ani si so a ɔmo hwehwɛ nwomasua ne 'vocational training' ho kwannya.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Asuadeɛ bɛn na yɛbɛtumi asua afiri SRH dwumadie a ɛdi mu a wɔde adi dwuma wɔ mmeaeɛ foforɔ a ntawntawdie aka no mu, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔatumi ayɛ nsakraeɛ na wɔayɛ no kɛseɛ de adi mmabun ahiadeɛ soronko ho dwuma wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu?
answer: Nsakraeɛ: Wobetumi ayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ SRH dwumadie a ɛdi mu a ɛfiri mmeaeɛ foforɔ a ntawntawdie aka wɔn no mu de adi ahiadeɛ pɔtee ne nsɛnnennen a mmabun hyia wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu no ho dwuma, a wɔsusu amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn, asetena mu nkɔsoɔ, ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ ho. Mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu: Nkitahodiɛ a wɔne mpɔtam hɔfoɔ bɛnya, a mmabun ankasa ka ho, hwɛ sɛ SRH dwumadie no fa nsɛm a ɛfa ho, ɛfa amammerɛ ho, na ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ wɔ mmeaeɛ a ntawntawdie aka. Tumi a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu: Sika a wde bɔto ntetee ne tumi a wɔde bɛhyɛ mpɔtam hɔ apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo ne mpɔtam hɔ adwumayɛfo mu no ma wonya nimdeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛma SRH dwumadie no yie, wɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛyɛ den mpo.

question: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mihu fa awoɔ nhyehyɛe nipadua ne nipadua ho, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea awo akwaa ka ho?
answer: Sɛ yɛbɛte awo nhyehyɛe no nipadua ne nipadua mu nkwaadɔm ase a, nea ɛka ho ne sɛ yebehu nea ɛfa: Mmarima Awo Akwaa: Nea ɛka ho ne mmadwoa (a ɛma mmadwoa), awo akwaa yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ epididymis (beae a mmadwoa nyin), vas deferens (a ɛde mmadwoa kɔ), ne ɔbarima akyi berɛmo (a ɛde mmadwoa ma bere a ɔreto mma). Mmea Awo Akwaa: Nea ɛka ho ne mmadwoa (a ɛma nkesua),  awo akwaa a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ fallopian tubes (a ɛde nkesua kɔ awotwaa mu), awotwaa (beae a nkesua a wɔahyɛ no ma de nkesua hyɛ nipadua mu na enyin), awotwaa (awotwaa no bue), ne awotwaa (awo kwan ne baabi a ɔne obi da).

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwvso fo "mentors" betumi ama mmabun anya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ na wɔaboa wɔn ma wɔasusuw wɔn haw ahorow, nsɛmmisa, ne osuahu ahorow a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu akwahosan ho a wonsuro atemmu, animtiaabu, anaa nyiyim?

Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔbɛma ayɛ nea ɛfata: Afotufo ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho no yɛ nea ɛfata, na wɔma mmabun awerɛhyem sɛ wɔn suahu ne wɔn nsɛmmisa no yɛ nea ɛfata na ɛfata sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene si so. question: Sɛn na mmabun bɛboa wɔ asetena mu mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ (social protection programs) ho nhwehwɛmu, nsusuwii, ne nnyigyeiɛ (advocacy) mu, na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no hyia wɔn haw ne wɔn hokwan a ɛresakra daa no?

question: Amammerɛ mu amanneɛ bɛn na ɛfa mpanin mu kɔ ho a ɛsɛ sɛ menya ho nimdeɛ?
answer: Amanneɛ: Amammerɛ bi wɔ amanneɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛkyerɛ mpanin mu kɔ, te sɛ Dipo, bragoro, quinceañeras anaa bar/bat mitzvahs. Afahyɛ: Amammerɛ mu afahyɛ betumi ayɛ aduane anaa nhyiam a wɔde kae obi nsakraeɛ. Ntadeɛ: Wɔbetumi ahyɛ amammerɛ mu ntadeɛ anaa ahyɛnsodeɛ wɔ mpanin mu kɔ amanneɛ bere mu. Honhom Mu Nneyɛeɛ: Amanneɛ a ɛfa honhom anaa mpaebɔ ho betumi aka mpanin mu kɔ ho wɔ amammerɛ bi mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, mpanyimfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ nimdeɛ ne nyansa a ɛfa mpanin yɛ ho bere a wɔreyɛ panyin.

messages.content: Amammerɛ mu amanneɛ bɛn na ɛfa mpanin mu kɔ ho a ɛsɛ sɛ menya ho nimdeɛ?

Afahyɛ: Amammerɛ mu afahyɛ betumi ayɛ aduane anaa nhyiam a wɔde kae obi nsakraeɛ. Ntadeɛ: Wɔbetumi ahyɛ amammerɛ mu ntadeɛ anaa ahyɛnsodeɛ wɔ mpanin mu kɔ amanneɛ bere mu. Honhom Mu Nneyɛeɛ: Amanneɛ a ɛfa honhom anaa mpaebɔ ho betumi aka mpanin mu kɔ ho wɔ amammerɛ bi mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Wɔ amammerɛ bi mu no, mpanyimfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ nimdeɛ ne nyansa a ɛfa mpanin yɛ ho bere a wɔreyɛ panyin.

question: Nhwɛso ahorow bɛn na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔka nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, ne nneɛma ahorow a egu ahorow ho mfonini pa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahyɛ mfonini ahorow a ɛtete saa ho nkuran na wɔaboa?
answer: Nna mu akwahosan, pene a wɔpene so, ne nneɛma ahorow a ɛwɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu ho mfonini pa betumi ayɛ: TV so dwumadi anaa sini ahorow a ɛkyerɛ nkitahodie pa, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, ne pene a obiara pene so. Social media ɔsatu ahorow a ɛhyɛ nipadua mu nneɛma pa ne pene ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkuran. Intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛde nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu na ɛka obiara ho ma a wɔde wɔn ani asi mmabun so. Mmabun betumi ahyɛ mfonini ahorow a ɛte saa ho nkuran na wɔaboa denam: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm pa a ɛkasa tia nsusuwii hunu a ɛkasa tia na ɛhyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho adwene pa a wɔbɛkyɛ na wɔama ayɛ kɛse no so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbɔ de gyina nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nkuran sɛ wɔmfa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mfonini a edi kan na obu wom nni kan. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsusuwii a ɛyɛ katee na ɛhyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ asɛyɛde mu ho nkuran mu kyɛfa a wobenya.

question: Sɛn na mmabun bɛkasa yie fa nna mu apɔwmuden 'sexual health' ho bere a obiara kasa kwan yɛ soronko sso de akyerɛ wɔn awofo, ahwɛfo, wɔn yɔnko ne obiara.
answer: Wɔbetumi ayɛ wei wɔ ɔkwan bi te sɛ : Wobetie afoforo adwene kyerɛ na woahu sɛ obiara ne ne kasa kwan. Bisa nteaseɛ (Seeking clarification) - sɛ wonte aseɛ a, wobebisa bisa nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Fa mmoa di dwuma (Resources) - fa nwuma anaa abɛɛfo dwumadi so nneɛma anaa kasa nkyerɛkyerɛmufo aboa nkitahodi a wobedi no ayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne nhyehyɛeyɛfo betumi abom adi akwantu akwanside ahorow ho dwuma na wɔama nna ne awo ho akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a mmabun betumi anya no atu mpɔn?
answer: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ bɛtumi abom adi akwantuo akwansideɛ ho dwuma na wɔama mmabun nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie a wɔbɛtumi anya no atu mpɔn denam: Wɔbɛyɛ adwuma abom wɔ nnwuma a wɔde bɛtrɛ akwantuo akwan a mmabun bɛtumi apaw mu, te sɛ shuttle ne kaa a wɔde fa nnipa, anaa telehealth a wode bɛn dwuma. Sika ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛboa akwantuo ho mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛma mmabun te sɛ kaa boa a wobɛte so ne ade. Kaa akwantuo ho nsusuiɛ a wɔde bɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛyɛ ho, ahwɛ sɛ wɔdi akwantuo akwansideɛ ho dwuma sɛ mmɔdenbɔ a ɛtrɛ a wɔde bɛma mmabun akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ atu mpɔn no fã. Mpɔtam hɔ nnwumakuo, sukuu, ne mmabun ananmusifoɔ a wɔne wɔn bɛdi nkitaho de apɛ mmabun akwantuo ho ahiade ho mmuaeɛ na aboa mmabun wɔberɛ a worehwehwɛ mmoa ɛwɔ wɔn nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie.

question: Dɛn na pintinn gyinae kyerɛ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ sɛ obi yɛ anaasɛ ɔyɛ basabasa wɔ asetra mu nkitahodi ne gyinaesi mu?
answer: Pintinn gyinae yɛ nkitahodi kwan a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wobɛda w’adwene, wo nkate, ne w’ahiade adi wɔ ɔkwan a emu da hɔ, tẽẽ, na obu wom so bere a wobu afoforo hokwan ne ahyeɛ nso. Ɛsono sɛnea wobɛyɛ obi a ɔnyɛ hwee, baabi a ebia wobɛkwati sɛ wobɛda w’ahiade anaa w’adwene adi na ama ntawntawdi ankɔ so, ne sɛnea wobɛyɛ basabasa, baabi a wubetumi ada w’ahiade adi wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛma woabu w’ani agu hokwan anaa nkate a afoforo wɔ so no ho.

question: Adwene a mede si biribi so betumi aboa me ama m’adwene atu mpɔn na mede m’adwene asi biribi so, titiriw bere a wɔreyɛ sɔhwɛ anaa tebea horow a nhyɛso kɛse wom?
answer: Adwene mu nneyɛe tete w’adwene a wode si biribi so denam kyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo sɛ wode wo nhumu bɛhyɛ mprempren bere yi mu no so. Adwene a wɔde di dwuma daa no betumi ama adwene mu dwumadi ahorow te sɛ adwene a wɔde si biribi so, nkae, ne gyinaesi atu mpɔn. Akwan te sɛ adwene mu home anaa nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu apɔ mu ateneatene betumi aboa ma w’adwene adwo na wode w’adwene asi baabi, na ama ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wode w’adwene besi biribi so bere a woreyɛ sɔhwɛ anaa nhyɛso kɛse tebea horow no.

question: So atipɛnfo mmoa akuw yɛ kokoamsɛm, na akwankyerɛ bɛn na wɔde asi hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no yɛ kokoam ne ahobammɔ?
answer: Atipɛnfo mmoa akuo taa kura kokoamsɛm mu de ayɛ tebea a ahobammɔ ne ahotoso wom ama wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no. Ahwɛfoɔ nso de mmara a ɛwɔ aseɛ di dwuma de kura kokoamsɛm mu na wɔde anifere di mmara sobuo biara ho dwuma.

question: Dɛn ne nna mu nyarewa (STIs) na mɛ yɛ dɛn asiw ano?
answer: Nna mu nyarewa (STIs), a broni atwa so sanso frɛ no (STDs) yɛ nyarewa a mpɛn pii no ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so trɛw, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu, akyi berɛmo, anaa anom ka ho. Saa nyarewa yi betumi afi mmoawa, mmoawa, anaa mmoawa a wɔsɛe nnɔbae mu aba, na sɛ wɔansa a, ebetumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba. Nna mu yareɛ 'STI' a ɛtaa ba no bi ne nea broni ka no 'chlamydia', 'gonorrhoea', 'syphilis', 'genital herpes', 'human papillomavirus' (HPV), ne nea broni atwaso ka no 'HIV/AIDS' ayo Akwan bi a wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ 'STIs' no ano ni: Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho: Ɔkwan a etu mpɔn sen biara a wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ  ano ne sɛ wɔne ɔhokafo a ɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ anaa nea wonnim ne STI tebea no bɛtwe ne ho afi nna mu dwumadi (wɔn awotwaa mu, akyi, anaa ano). Fa Kɔndɔm Di Dwuma: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm di dwuma bere nyinaa na ɛteɛ bere a woreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a, ebetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ  'STI' no so kɛse. Fa nea broni ka no 'latex' anaa 'polyurethane' kɔndɔm di dwuma ma ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna wɔ ɔbea awotwaa mu anaa akyi berɛmo mu, na fa kɔndɔm anaa nsensan a wɔde hyɛ mu di dwuma ma nna a wɔde ano ka. To Nna mu Ahokafo ano hye: Sɛ wunya nna mu ahokafo kakraa bi a, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nna mu yareɛ  'STI' ahorow no so. Ɔyere biako a wo ne ɔhokafo a wayɛ nhwehwɛmu ahu sɛ onni 'STI', nna mu yareɛ nso betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ no so. Nkitahodi: Wo ne w’ahokafo a wo ne wɔn da no nkasa pefee na wodi nokware fa nna mu yareɛ, sɔhwɛ, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Hyɛ mo ho mo ho nkuran sɛ wɔnkɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa wɔ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho. Yɛ Sɔhwɛ: Yɛ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho nhwehwɛmu daa, titiriw sɛ wo ne ahokafo pii renya nna mu kyɛfa anaasɛ woanya nna a wɔammɔ ho ban a. 'STI' pii mfa sɛnkyerɛnne biara mma, enti nhwehwɛmu nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ahu wo nna mu yareɛ  'ST'I tebea. Nea broni ka no 'Vaccination': 'Vaccines' a broni ka no wɔ hɔ a wɔde besiw nna mu yareɛ  'STI' ahorow bi ano, te sɛ nea broni ka no 'HPV ne hepatitis B'. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa mfa ho sɛ ebia vaccination no fata wo anaa. Kwati sɛ Wobɛkyɛ Nhama: Sɛ wode nnubɔne a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu di dwuma a, ɛnkyɛ nnade anaa nnubɔne ho nneɛma afoforo da. Nnade a wɔkyɛ no betumi de nna mu yareɛ 'STI' te sɛ 'HIV' ne 'hepatitis B ne C'. Fa Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Ahobammɔ De Di Dwuma: Kwati nna mu nneyɛe a asiane kɛse wom, te sɛ nna a wo ne wo hokafo pii bɛbɔ a wommɔ ho ban anaasɛ wo ne obi bɛda bere a woanom nnubɔne anaa nsa. Fa w’adwene a eye sen biara di dwuma na fa w’akwahosan ne ahobammɔ di kan. Akwahosan Ho Nhwehwɛmu a Wɔyɛ Daa: Kɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn kɔhwɛ wɔn daa na wɔnyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano. Sɛ wohu nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho sɛnkyerɛnne anaasɛ woahyia nna mu yareɛ 'STI' a, hwehwɛ aduruyɛ ntɛm ara. Ɛdenam nna a ahobammɔ wom a wobɛyɛ, nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ daa, na wo ne w’ahokafo a wo ne wɔn da no adi nkitaho pefee so no, wubetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nna mu yareɛ 'STI' so no so na woabɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho ban. Sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo wɔ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ano aduru ho a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa nna mu akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bɛkasa de agye akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.

Nna mu nyarewa (STIs), a broni atwa so sanso frɛ no (STDs) yɛ nyarewa a mpɛn pii no ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so trɛw, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu, akyi berɛmo, anaa anom ka ho. Saa nyarewa yi betumi afi mmoawa, mmoawa, anaa mmoawa a wɔsɛe nnɔbae mu aba, na sɛ wɔansa a, ebetumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba. Nna mu yareɛ 'STI' a ɛtaa ba no bi ne nea broni ka no 'chlamydia', 'gonorrhoea', 'syphilis', 'genital herpes', 'human papillomavirus' (HPV), ne nea broni atwaso ka no 'HIV/AIDS' ayo Akwan bi a wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ 'STIs' no ano ni: Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi ho: Ɔkwan a etu mpɔn sen biara a wɔfa so siw nna mu yareɛ  ano ne sɛ wɔne ɔhokafo a ɔwɔ nna mu yareɛ anaa nea wonnim ne STI tebea no bɛtwe ne ho afi nna mu dwumadi (wɔn awotwaa mu, akyi, anaa ano). Fa Kɔndɔm Di Dwuma: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm di dwuma bere nyinaa na ɛteɛ bere a woreyɛ nna mu kyɛfa a, ebetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ  'STI' no so kɛse. Fa nea broni ka no 'latex' anaa 'polyurethane' kɔndɔm di dwuma ma ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna wɔ ɔbea awotwaa mu anaa akyi berɛmo mu, na fa kɔndɔm anaa nsensan a wɔde hyɛ mu di dwuma ma nna a wɔde ano ka. To Nna mu Ahokafo ano hye: Sɛ wunya nna mu ahokafo kakraa bi a, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nna mu yareɛ  'STI' ahorow no so. Ɔyere biako a wo ne ɔhokafo a wayɛ nhwehwɛmu ahu sɛ onni 'STI', nna mu yareɛ nso betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ no so. Nkitahodi: Wo ne w’ahokafo a wo ne wɔn da no nkasa pefee na wodi nokware fa nna mu yareɛ, sɔhwɛ, ne nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho. Hyɛ mo ho mo ho nkuran sɛ wɔnkɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu daa wɔ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho. Yɛ Sɔhwɛ: Yɛ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho nhwehwɛmu daa, titiriw sɛ wo ne ahokafo pii renya nna mu kyɛfa anaasɛ woanya nna a wɔammɔ ho ban a. 'STI' pii mfa sɛnkyerɛnne biara mma, enti nhwehwɛmu nkutoo ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ahu wo nna mu yareɛ  'ST'I tebea. Nea broni ka no 'Vaccination': 'Vaccines' a broni ka no wɔ hɔ a wɔde besiw nna mu yareɛ  'STI' ahorow bi ano, te sɛ nea broni ka no 'HPV ne hepatitis B'. Wo ne w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa mfa ho sɛ ebia vaccination no fata wo anaa. Kwati sɛ Wobɛkyɛ Nhama: Sɛ wode nnubɔne a wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu di dwuma a, ɛnkyɛ nnade anaa nnubɔne ho nneɛma afoforo da. Nnade a wɔkyɛ no betumi de nna mu yareɛ 'STI' te sɛ 'HIV' ne 'hepatitis B ne C'. Fa Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna a Ahobammɔ De Di Dwuma: Kwati nna mu nneyɛe a asiane kɛse wom, te sɛ nna a wo ne wo hokafo pii bɛbɔ a wommɔ ho ban anaasɛ wo ne obi bɛda bere a woanom nnubɔne anaa nsa. Fa w’adwene a eye sen biara di dwuma na fa w’akwahosan ne ahobammɔ di kan. Akwahosan Ho Nhwehwɛmu a Wɔyɛ Daa: Kɔ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkyɛn kɔhwɛ wɔn daa na wɔnyɛ nna mu akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde siw ano. Sɛ wohu nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ho sɛnkyerɛnne anaasɛ woahyia nna mu yareɛ 'STI' a, hwehwɛ aduruyɛ ntɛm ara. Ɛdenam nna a ahobammɔ wom a wobɛyɛ, nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ daa, na wo ne w’ahokafo a wo ne wɔn da no adi nkitaho pefee so no, wubetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya nna mu yareɛ 'STI' so no so na woabɔ wo nna mu akwahosan ho ban. Sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm bi a ɛhaw wo wɔ nna mu yareɛ 'STI' ano aduru ho a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa nna mu akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bɛkasa de agye akwankyerɛ ne mmoa.

question: So nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ mantɔw mu a wɔyɛ de mmabun nna ne awo apwmuden nsɛm ho?
answer: Aane, mpɛn pii no, nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wɔyɛ de ma mmabun nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden so. Saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi betumi de kokoam nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade soronko a nea ɛka ho ne afotuo fa nyinsɛn ho nnuro, STI nhwehwɛmu, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmudenn ho nsɛmti ho.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ den sɛ yɛbɛka a ɛkyerɛ obuo ma me gyinapɛn, gyidie, ne nipasu?
answer: Sɛ wobɛnya nna mu yareɛ (STI) nhwehwɛmu dwumadie a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛyɛ nkateɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ de nnwuma a ɛfata na ɛyɛ pɛ ma a onipa no bɔbeasu, abusuakuo, asetena mu gyinabea ne afoforo mfa ho. Nhwehwɛmufoɔ: Hwehwɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ anaa ayaresabea ahodoɔ a wonim sɛ wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfa amammerɛ ho ma nnipa ahodoɔ. Bisa Nsɛm: Ansa na wobɛyɛ nhyehyɛe akɔhwɛ no, bisa osuahu a nea ɔde mmoa ma no wɔ bere a ɔne ankorankoro a wofi wo amammerɛ mu yɛ adwuma ne sɛnea wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔte nka wɔ gyinapɛn ne gyidi ahorow ho. Da W’ahiade adi: Ka wo gyinapɛn, wo gyidi, ne wo nipasu kyerɛ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ayaresabea adwumayɛfo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi asiesie wɔn kwan no ma ɛne w’ahiade ahorow ahyia. Hwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ: Hwehwɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a wodi ankorankoro a wofi wo akuw ahorow mu a wɔwɔ ahiade ahorow ho dwuma no hɔ. Fa Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Ma: Sɛ wuhyia amammerɛ mu nkate a enni hɔ wɔ wo nsrahwɛ no mu a, fa nsɛm a ɛma denhyɛ ma akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo anaa ayaresabea mpanyimfo no de hyɛ nkɔso a ɛba wɔ wɔn nnwuma mu ho nkuran.

question: Dɛn ne mmara mu nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa awo ho ayaresa ne abusua sie ma mmabun?
answer: Mmara kwan so nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa awo ho ayaresa ne abusua sia ma mmabun ho no gu ahorow gyina tumidi ne tebea pɔtee bi so. Wɔ mmeae pii no, ebia mmofra nkumaa bɛhwehwɛ sɛ awofo pene so anaasɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu na ama wɔanya awo ho ayaresa anaa abusua kyekye ho akwan horow. Nanso, ebia nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsono mmabun a wɔama wɔn ahofadi anaasɛ wobu wɔn sɛ mmofra nkumaa a wɔn ho akokwaw. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun ne wɔn mmusua te mmara mu ahwehwɛde ne nea ɛkyerɛ wɔ awo ho ayaresa anaa abusua sie akwan ahorow, a nsɛm a ɛfa pene, kokoamsɛm, ne sikasɛm mu asɛyɛde ahorow ho ka ho.

question: Mmabun a wokum wɔn ho abu so deɛ, na asiane ahorow bɛn na ebetumi ama mmerante ne mmabaa anya adwene anaa nneyɛe a ɛbɛma wɔakum wɔn ho?
answer: Nnipa a wokum wɔn ho yɛ ade titiri a ɛhaw mmabun, na ɛsono sɛnea wɔyɛ no wɔ ɔmantam ne nnipa dodow mu. Asiane a ɛtaa ba ma mmerante ne mmabaa nya adwene anaa nneyɛe a ɛma wokum wɔn ho ne adwenemyare (te sɛ adwenemhaw anaa dadwen), nnuro a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so, osuahu ahorow a ɛyɛ awerɛhow (te sɛ ayayade), abusua mu ntawntawdi, anaasɛ dwumadi a ɛnkɔ yiye, abusuabɔ mu nsɛm, LGBTQ+ nipasu, ne akwan a wɔfa so kum wɔn ho a wobenya.

question: Nnwuma ahorow bɛn na ɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa awo akwahosan "reproductive health" ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mmabun?
answer: Akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛkɔ akyiri ka nneɛma ahodoɔ ho, te sɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛdi kan, dwumadie a wɔde siw ano (te sɛ nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfoɔ ho ban ne nhwehwɛmu), adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa, nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, afotuo, ne asetena mu nnwuma (te sɛ mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so anaa adan ho). Saa dwumadie yi boa awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma mmabun denam nneɛma a ɛka wɔn awoɔ akwahosan mu nsunsuansoɔ, te sɛ adwenemyareɛ, asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ akwahosan, ne nneɛma ne mmoa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛnya no so. Sɛ nhwɛso no, adwenemyare ho mmoa betumi adi nsɛm te sɛ adwenemhaw anaa dadwen a ebetumi aka awo akwahosan ho gyinaesi ho dwuma, bere a nna ho akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma mmabun nya nimdeɛ ne ahokokwaw a wɔde bɛpaw wɔn awo akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛfata.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛka wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan mu, ankorankoro ne kuw nyinaa?
answer: Ankorankoro, mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ mu denam nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ, wɔn akwahosan ho nneɛma a wɔde nea broni ka no 'informed choices', ne wɔn ahiade ahorow a wɔbɛkasa ma akyerɛ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow mu no so. question: Dɛn ne nea efi abusuabɔ a ɛnteɛ mu ba, a nkate, nipadua, ne adwene mu akwahosan so nkɛntɛnso ka ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de wɔn yiyedi ne ahobammɔ adi kan?
answer: Nea efi abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa mu ba no betumi ayɛ: - Nkate mu Nsunsuanso: Awerɛhow, dadwen, obu a ɛba fam wɔ ne ho, ne tew a ɔtew ne ho esiane nsakrae, tumidi, anaa nkate mu ayayade nti. - Nipadua mu Nsunsuansoɔ: Nipadua mu opira a ɛfiri basabasayɛ anaa basabasayɛ mu ba wɔ abusuabɔ no mu, ne akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfa adwennwene ho. - Adwene mu Akwahosan Nsunsuansoɔ: Asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ obi bɛnya adwenemhaw, adwenemhaw a ɛba wɔ adwenemhaw akyi (PTSD), ne adwenemyareɛ foforɔ a ɛnam bere tenten a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneɛma a ɛnyɛ papa mu nti. - Asetena mu Nsunsuansoɔ: Twe a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi asetena mu dwumadiɛ ho, nnamfofa a ɛyɛ den, ne ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛgye afoforo adi ɛnam osuahu bɔne a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ no mu nti. Mmabun betumi de wɔn yiyedi ne ahobammɔ adi kan denam abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ papa ho sɛnkyerɛnne a wobehu, mmoa a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi mpanyimfo anaa adwumayɛfo a wogye wɔn di hɔ, ne ahye a wɔde besi hɔ de abɔ wɔn ho ban afi ɔhaw foforo ho no so.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na animtiaabu a ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho no betumi ahaw me ne afoforo ntam abusuabɔ?
answer: Animtiaabu a ɛwɔ nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho no betumi aka wo ne afoforo ntam abusuabɔ wɔ akwan bi so: Suro a wusuro sɛ wɔbɛpow: Ebia wobɛhaw wo ho sɛ wo hokafo bebu wo atɛn. Abusuabɔ mu nhyɛso: Nna mu nyarewa (STI) a wɔbɛda no adi no betumi de adwennwen aba abusuabɔ mu.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn adi akasakasa a me ne m’abusuafo anaa me nnamfonom ntam wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no ho dwuma?
answer: Nkitahodi a Wobue Mu: Fa obu bɔ nkɔmmɔ ahorow, tie na te ase sen sɛ wubegye akyinnye. Hwehwɛ Nneɛma a Wɔbom Yɛ de de siw nsonsonoe ano. question: Dɛn ne ehu anaa nneɛma a ɛhaw nkurɔfo a wɔtaa suro wɔ sɛnea wobepue no ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer: Suro anaa dadwen a wɔtaa suro wɔ sɛ wobepue ho ne abusuabɔ a wɔbɛhwere ne ahobammɔ ho haw. Ɛho hia sɛ wudi saa dadwen ahorow yi ho dwuma denam mmoa a wobɛhwehwɛ afi ankorankoro ne afotufo a wogye wɔn di a wodwen wo yiyedi ho ankasa hɔ no so. Bio nso, sɛ wode nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho a, ebetumi aboa wo ma woapaw nneɛma a ɛfata.

question: Ɛdeɛn na ɛsɛ se me yɛ wɔ berɛ a wɔrehyɛ me ama madi mpaso agorɔ a mempɛ?
answer: Hu tebea no : Tie woakoma.Sɛ ɛnyɛ a ɛnyɛ. So wo ho dua: Ka sɛ 'daabi' anaa sɛ 'gyae' . Firi hɔ: firi adi wɔberɛkuro a wahu basabasayɛ betumi asi. question: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ HIV anaa STI foforɔ so?
answer: Mmara gu ahorow. Pii hwehwɛ sɛ woka kyerɛ wo hokafoɔ. Sɛ obi di nkogu a, ebetumi ama wɔabɔ wɔn sobo wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi ho. Asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ sɛ wɔyɛ ahwɛyie (kɔndɔm/nnuru/aduruyɛ ho afotuo). Bɔ wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no amanneɛ.

question: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so hyɛ awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkuran na wɔte awoɔ mu haw so ma mmabun?
answer: Akwan a wɔfa so hyɛ awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nkuran na wɔte awoɔ mu haw ho nsɛm a ɛba mmabun mu so no bi ne: Wɔde nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a edi mũ bedi dwuma wɔ sukuu ahorow mu a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ bragorɔ, nyinsɛn ano siw, STI a wosi ano, ne peneyɛ. Awo akwahosan ho dwumadie a ɛfata mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔanya, a kokoam afotuo, nyinsɛn a anosiw, STI nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa, ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhwehwɛmu ka ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi a wɔde nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware, ahokokwaw, ne nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma asi gyinaeɛ a ɛfata wɔ wɔn nna mu agodie ne yiedie ho. Asetena mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden te sɛ ohia, nhomasua a wonnya, ne animtiaabu a ɛma nsonsoneɛ ba awoɔ mu no ho dwuma a wobedi. Mpɔtam a wɔboa, a abusua mmoa, atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nnwumapa mu, a ɛhyɛ suban ne nneyɛe pa a ɛfa nna, mpenatweɛ, ne awoɔ pa ho nkuran a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso. Peer eductaors a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ awoɔ pa a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran mu.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na akokoaa nyin wɔ awotwaa/ yafunu mu?
answer: Nkosua a ɛne bɛrima mu nsuo ehyia no, fa fallopian tube no mu kɔtɔ awotwaa no mu. Akokoaa a ɔnhyɛɛ aseɛ nnyiniiɛ yie no (Embryo) nya aduane firi ɛna no mogya mu nam akwaa titiriw bi a yɛfrɛ no placenta (nyinsɛn mu nsuo anaa ntonko) so. Bɛyɛ nnawɔtwe aduanan mu no, embryo no nyin na ɔsesa bɛyɛ akokoaa.

answer: Ɛsɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmufo nya pene a wɔanya nimdeɛ fi mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn  mmara kwan so no hɔ ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nhwehwɛmu mu: Wɔde nsɛm a emu da hɔ na ntease wom ma wɔ atirimpɔw, akwan horow, asiane ahorow, ne mfaso horow a ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu no so ho, na ama mmabun atumi asi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn kyɛfa a wobenya no ho. question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ menya nyinsɛn ano aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ (anɔpa-akyi aduru) sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru no adi nkogu anaasɛ me ne obi bɛda a wɔmfa ahobammɔ nni dwuma a?
answer: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wunya anɔpa aduru a wɔde di dwuma akyi no ntɛmntɛm a, wubetumi akɔ nnurutɔnbea dodow no ara mu wɔ mmɔnten so na woatɔ wɔ aduruyɛdan mu. Wɔtaa de Levonorgestrel (ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔfrɛ no Levonelle) ne ellaOne nyinaa ma. Ɛsɛ sɛ wo ne nnuruyɛfo bi kasa fa w’akwahosan ho ansa na woanya wo nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ. Akwahosan Ho Dwumadifo: Kɔ ayaresabea ahorow, ayaresabea ahorow, anaa nnuruyɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛ mu. Akwahosan adwumayɛbea dodow no ara de nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a nea ɛka ho ne nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ntɛm ara ma. Awo akwahosan ho nnwuma, yɛ kokoamsɛm. Mmoa: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ankorankoro anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wogye wɔn di hɔ sɛ ɛho hia a. Di adwumayɛfoɔ di nkitaho wɔ telefon a wɔde telefon so a 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma) ne PPA Yenkasa dijitaal beaeɛ (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) ka ho.

question: Atosɛm akɛse a nkurɔfo gye di wɔ awo nhyenhyɛe a broni frɛ no 'birth control' ano aduru ho no bi ne dɛn?
answer: Atosɛm a wɔtaa ka no bi ni: Awo ano aduru ma wo mu duru a broni frɛ no 'birth control' yɛ kɛse. (Ɛnyɛ nokware bere nyinaa) Kɔndɔm brɛ anigye ase. (Asɛmti, hwehwɛ akwan horow a wobɛfa so!) "Twe-firi mut" kwan no tu mpɔn. (Ɛnyɛ nea wotumi de ho to so koraa, paw ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so!) Sɛ woyera aduru biako a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ nyinsɛn betumi aba ntɛm ara. (Mpɛn pii no ɛnte saa, di a broni frɛ no "missed pill" akwankyerɛ akyi.) Awo ano aduru ma ɛyɛ den sɛ wubenyinsɛn akyiri yi. (Akwan dodow no ara yɛ nea wotumi dannan.)

question: Asetena mu mmoa ahorow bɛn na ɛho hia ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ne nsɛm a wobenya mu?
answer: Asetena mu mmoa ahodoɔ a ɛho hia a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho dwumadie ne nsɛm a wɔbɛnya mu no bi ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa nkitahodiɛ, abusua nkitahodiɛ ne akwankyerɛ, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ, ne afotuo dwumadie a ɛde akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ma a wɔmfa atemmuo mma.

question: Mfeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea obi bɛtumi anya mmoa, mmara kwan so  ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfoɔ ho dwumadie bi wɔ hɔ, na hokwan bɛn na mmabun wɔ wɔ peneɛ ne kokoamsɛm ho berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa?
answer: Mfeɛ a ɛhyɛ anohyira ne kyɛfa a obi wɔ sɛ ɔnya mmara mu mmoa ne kwan-ma-ho (advocacy) dwumadie no gyina ahyehyɛdeɛ anaa dwumadie biara ne ne mmara so. question: Dɛn ne asetena mu ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ne yiyedi?
answer: Asetena mu ahobanbɔ nhyehyeɛ yɛ nnwuma a aban, ahyehyɛdeɛ, anaa mpɔtam hɔfoɔ de di dwuma de mmoa a egyina sikasɛm, honam fam, anaa dwumadi so ma ankorankoro anaa akuo a wɔn ho yɛ den wɔ ɔmanfoɔ mu. question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ahyɛ pɛyɛ ne nnipa nyinaa nkabom ho nkuran wɔ m’abusuabɔ mu na makamfo abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa a ɛkɔ so wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ?

question: Mmara bɛn na ɛfa awofo pene anaa amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ awo ho akwahosan ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono sɛnea tumidi te?
answer: Mmara a ɛfa awofoɔ tumidie anaa amanneɛbɔ ho mmerɛ a mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ (adolescents) rehwehwɛ nna mu apɔwmuden mmoa no gu ahorow gyina baabi a wowɔ.Mmeaeɛ bi hwehwɛ sɛ awofoɔ ma kwan anaa wɔbɔ wɔn amanneɛ ansa na wɔanya mmoa bi, te sɛ nyinsɛn-tu anaa nyinsɛn ho banbɔ nnuru. Nanso, mmeaeɛ afoforɔ nso ma kwan ma mmaayewa nya saa mmoa yi wɔ kokoam mu a awofoɔ nnim. Saa mmara yi bɛtumi nso ama mmaa a wɔnyini koraa (minors) kwan ma wɔafa kɔɔto (judicial bypass) so anaa wɔahwehwɛ kwan foforɔ a wɔbɛfa so anya tumidie, a ɛgyina obiara tebea pɔtee so. Ɛhia paa sɛ wosua mmara a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ na ama woate wo ho kwan ne akwan a wobɛtumi afa so aseɛ

question: Dɛn ne akwan ahorow bi a wɔfa so siw nnuru bɔne a wɔde di dwuma ano na wɔhyɛ adwenemyare a wɔde gyina ano no ho nkuran wɔ mmabun mu?
answer: Akwan a wɔfa so siw nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ano na wɔhyɛ adwenemyare a wɔde gyina ano wɔ mmabun mu no bi ne: Wɔnam nhyehyɛe ahorow a egyina sukuu so, mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow, ne awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu so akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun asiane ne nea efi nnuru a wɔde di dwuma mu ba ho. Senea wɔkyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea wogyina ano ne akwan a wɔfa so gyina tebea horow ano de boa mmabun ma wodi adwennwen ho dwuma, wogyina nsɛnnennen ano, na wɔfa nkate a emu yɛ den so. Atipɛnfo ntam abusuabɔ pa ne sohyial network ahorow a ɛboa a ɛhyɛ nneyɛe pa ho nkuran na ɛmma nnubɔne a wɔde di dwuma ho nkuran a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso. Adwene mu akwahosan ho nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a wɔde bɛma, a afotuo, ayaresa, ne atipɛnfoɔ mmoa akuo ka ho. Mmabun a wɔbɛma wɔn tumi ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ nnuru a wɔde di dwuma ho na wɔde wɔn adwenemyare ne wɔn yiedi adi kan.

question: So mmoa akuw, atipɛnfo nkitahodie, anaa mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi anya wɔ bere a wɔde di akyi ne bere a wɔde hwɛ akyi no mu?
answer: Yiw, mpɛn pii no, mmoa akuw, atipɛnfo nkitahodi, ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma wɔ hɔ a mmabun betumi anya wɔ bere a wɔde di akyi ne bere a wɔde hwɛ akyi no mu. Saa nneɛma yi ma mmabun nya hokwan ne afoforo a wɔahyia nsɛnnennen a ɛte saa ara di nkitaho, kyɛ wɔn suahunu, nya adansedi ne mmoa, na wonya nneɛma ne nsɛm foforo a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔn ho atɔ wɔn na wɔanya yiyedi.

question: Mmara ahorow bɛn na ɛkwan da ho ma mmabun aa wɔ fa nna mu ne awoɔ mu apɔmmuden haw?
answer: Mmara mu gyinafoɔ. Mmoa wɔ awoɔ hokwan mu (nyinsɛn ano sie/nyinsɛn ano sie). Ko tia nyiyimu. Mmoa wɔ ɔhwɛ mu. Mmoa a wɔnya a awofoɔ nnim.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano no hyɛ mmarimayɛ pa ho nkuran na ɛkasa tia mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn a epira "harmful gender norms" ne nsusuwii hunu a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so tra hɔ?
answer: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw ano no hyɛ mmarimayɛ pa ho nkuran na ɛkasa tia ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira denam: Ɛho hia sɛ abusuabɔ pa ne obu wom a egyina pɛyɛ, pene, ne nkitahodi so si so dua, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nhumu a wɔde bɛma wɔ nkɛntɛnso bɔne a atetesɛm mu mmarimayɛ gyinapɛn ahorow te sɛ basabasayɛ, tumidi, ne nkate mu nhyɛso a ɛba ankorankoro yiyedi ne abusuabɔ so no ho. Mmarima a wɔpow mmarimayɛ a awuduru wom na wɔda tema, mmerɛwyɛ, ne obu ma afoforo adi ho nhwɛso pa ne nhwɛso ahorow a wɔbɛtwe adwene asi so. Mmarimaa ne mmerante a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu sɛ ayɔnkofo ne wɔn a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobesiw nna mu basabasayɛ ano mu, na wɔama wɔn tumi ma wɔakasa atia nneyɛe ne suban a epira wɔ wɔn atipɛnfo mu. Ahokokwaw ne akannifo hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛma mmarimaa ne mmerante ma wɔanya asetra mu nkate mu nimdeɛ pa, te sɛ tema, nkitahodi, ne ntawantawadi ano aduru, a ɛma mmarimayɛ a ɛwɔ apɔwmuden nya nkɔso.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: ɛden ne nsɛm titiriw bi a esisii ne bi wɔ wɔn a wɔadi dem abakɔsɛm mu wɔ Ghana a asiesie hokwan ne sɛnea wotumi hu ankorankoro a wɔadi dɛm?
answer: Wɔ Ghana no, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm anya abakɔsɛm a ɛfa animtiaabu ne nyiyimu ho akyɛ. Nanso, mmɔdenbɔ ahodoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ wɔ mfeɛ no mu, na wɔda so ara rebɔ de ahyɛ wɔn hokwan ahodoɔ ho nkuran na wɔabɔ ho ban. Nsɛntitiriw bi ni: 1960 mfeɛ no: Wɔde Ghana Fekuo a ɛhwɛ wɔn a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nipadua mu no sii hɔ. 2006: Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no gye UN Apam a ɛfa Hokwan a Nnipa a Wɔadi M dɛm wɔ (CRPD) no toom. 2007: Wɔhyɛɛ Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm Mmara (Act 715) no sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ hokwan a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ no ho nkuran. Wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu, wɔ akwahosan ho atenaeɛ no mu, mmabun a wɔadi dɛm betumi abisa mmoa wɔ apomoden asoɛe ahorow mu na aboa wɔn ma wɔaka wɔn ahiade ho asɛm yiye akyerɛ apomoden ho adwumayɛfo.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛboa ma yesua ade fa pene so (consent) ne nnamfofa pa ho?
answer: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Planned Parenthood, Scarleteen, ne Love is Respect ma nsɛm  a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ pene so, nnamfofa pa, ne nna mu apɔmuden ho. Nwoma te sɛ "The Consent Guidebook" a Erin Tillman kyerɛwee ne "Yes Means Yes!: Visions of Female Sexual Power and A World Without Rape" a Jaclyn Friedman ne Jessica Valenti kyerɛwee ma nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu dɔ wɔ pene so ne nna mu basabasayɛ banbɔ ho. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ, ne sukuu betumi ayɛ nhyiam, mmoa akuo, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ.

question: Dwuma bɛn na nkitahodie akwan horow, te sɛ direct anaa indirect communication, di wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ brayɛ, nyinsɛn ho nnuro, ne nna mu mpenesoɔ?
answer: Nkitahodi akwan horow, te sɛ direct anaa indirect communication, di dwuma titiriw wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ brayɛ, nyinsɛn ho nnuro, ne nna mu mpeneso ho no mu. Wɔ amammerɛ ahorow a wobu nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ sɛ ɛyɛ kokoam anaa sensitive mu no, ankorankoro betumi de indirect language anaa nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw so aka nsɛm yi ho asɛm, na wɔde wɔn ho ato nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛda adi pefee so de ada ntease adi. Nea ɛne eyi bɔ abira no, amammerɛ ahorow a nkitahodie kwan a ɛkɔ tẽẽ kɛse wom no betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa saa nsɛmti yi ho, na ama ntease ne nkitahodi a emu da hɔ ayɛ mmerɛw. Saa nsɛm nketenkete yi a wɔbɛte ase wɔ nkitahodi akwan horow mu no ho hia na ama wɔatumi abɔ nkɔmmɔ na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ nna ne awo akwahosan ho ade a etu mpɔn.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn afi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase afa nna ne abusuabɔ a me ne me hokafo wɔ ho?
answer: Hwehwɛ bere ne beae pa: Paw bere a mobɛhome bere a mo baanu nyinaa nni nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene. Fi ase ketewaa bi: Ɛho nhia sɛ wuhuruw kɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a emu dɔ mu ntɛm ara. Ka nsɛm a ɛreba, sini ahorow a woahu, anaa nneɛma a nnipa nyinaa ani gye ho ho asɛm. Eyi betumi ama awerɛkyekye ama nkɔmmɔbɔ a, emu dɔ akyiri yi. Bue w’ano na di nokware: Ka wo nsusuwii, wo atinka ne wo botae ahorow ho asɛm ankasa. Fa "Me" nsɛm di dwuma: Eyi boa ma wokwati sɛ ɛbɛyɛ te sɛ nea ɛyɛ sobo. Sɛ nhwɛso no, "Mete nka sɛ mewɔ abusuabɔ kɛse bere a yɛyɛ atuu" sen sɛ "Wompɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ atuu da." Bisa nsɛm a wɔabue ano: Eyi hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛboro "yiw" anaa "dabi" mmuae ho nkuran. Bɔ mmɔden sɛ "Dɛn na w'adwene wɔ ho...?" anaa "Wo te nka dɛn wɔ... ho?" Afei nso, hyɛ wo hokafo (hokafo) nkuran sɛ wɔne ɔpanyin bi a wogye no di nsusuw eyi ho sɛ mo baanu nyinaa da so ara rebɔ mmɔden sɛ mubehu nea mobɛyɛ a.

question: So ɛyɛ nokware sɛ akwan bi a wɔfa so siw awo ano nso, betumi abɔ wɔn ho ban afi nna mu nyarewa (STI) ho?
answer: Bere a akwan bi a wɔfa so siw awo ano, te sɛ mmarima ne mmea kɔndɔm, bɔ wɔn ho ban fi nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho no, Ɛho hia sɛ wode kɔndɔm di dwuma daa, na ɛteɛ na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu nyarewa (STIs) no so atew, bere mpo a wɔde akwan foforo a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano redi dwuma de asiw nyinsɛn ano no.

question: Nhwehwɛmu kwan bɛn ne nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛ (indicators) bɛn na wɔde gyina so bu dwumadi a ɛfa ntetee ne tumi a wɔhyɛ mu (capacity building) ho ntɛm, sɛ ɛreboa ama mbabaa baabaayɛ ne awo mu akwahosan (ASRH) atu mpɔn?
answer: Nhwehwɛmu Akwan: Nhwehwɛmu akwan a wɔtaa fa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu no bi ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔayɛ ne akyi, nhwehwɛmu, akuo a wɔde wɔn adwene si so, ne nsɛmbisa de susu nsakraeɛ a ɛba nimdeɛ, suban, ne nneyɛeɛ a ɛfa ASRH ho. question: Mɛyɛ dɛn anya ayaresafoɔ a me mfɛre sɛ mɛka me babunyɛ ho asɛm akyerɛ wɔn?
answer: Bisa abusuafoɔ anaa nnamfoɔ na wɔnkerɛ wo. Hwehwɛ ayeresafoɔ a wɔhyɛdaa hwɛ mmabun ho nsɛm akyikwan. Yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ na mo nhyia nni ho nkɔmmɔ ansaana wo atu anamɔn biara. Gye wo ho di na pɛ ayaresafoɔ a obetie wo, abu w'asumasɛm na ɔmma wo mfɛre.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmeae a ahobammɔ "safe space" wɔ ne mmoa akuw ma hokwan ahorow a wɔde bɛkyekye "building" adamfofa ne asetra mu nkitahodi wɔ mmabun a woadi dɛm mpɔtam hɔ no mu?
answer: Mmeae a ahobanbɔ wɔ "Safe Space" ma hokwan ahorow ma: Osuahu ahorow a wɔkyɛ: Nkitahodi a wɔne afoforo a wɔte nsɛnnennen ne nkonimdi ahorow a ɛwɔ dɛmdi asetra mu ase. question: So nnwinnade anaa nhwehwɛmu bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu wɔ abɛɛfo ntetan anaa Intanɛt so a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw wɔn adwene mu apomoden ho?
answer: Nnwinnade anaa nhwehwɛmu a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu wɔ intanɛt so wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw wɔn adwene mu apomoden ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ adwenemyare a ɛtaa ba te sɛ adwenemhaw, dadwen, adwennwen, ne nnuru a wɔde di dwuma, a ɛma nsɛmmisa a wɔn ankasa de hwehwɛ yare no ho sɛnkyerɛnne na wɔde nsɛm ma. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ ma adwene mu apomoden pɔtee te sɛ adidi mu haw, adwenemhaw, ADHD, anaa PTSD, a ebia nea ɛka ho ne gyinapɛn a wɔde hwehwɛ yareɛ, sɛnkyerɛnne a wɔde hwɛ, ne asiane ho nhwehwɛmu. Adwene ne nneyɛe ho ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din pii de nnwinnade a wɔde hwehwɛ nneɛma mu wɔ Intanɛt so ma wɔ wɔn wɛbsaet ahorow so, na saa nnwinnade yi taa de nsɛm a ɛfa anammɔn a edi hɔ a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwehwɛ mmoa anaa mmoa a egyina nea efi mu ba so ma.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, ne gyinapɛn ahorow nya abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan (ASRH) nneyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ wiase mmeae ahorow ho no so nkɛntɛnso?
answer: Amammerɛ mu gyidi ahorow, gyinapɛn ahorow, ne gyinapɛn ahorow nya abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa ASRH nneyɛe ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ho so nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ wiase nyinaa: Adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna ho: Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ nna ho no gu ahorow kɛse, na ɛka adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna mu akwahosan, nyinsɛn ano a wosiw, nyinsɛn a woyi gu, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea dwumadi ahorow ho. Nneɛma a wɔabara ne atetesɛm: Amammerɛ mu ahyɛde ne atetesɛm mu nneyɛe betumi akyerɛ nneyɛe a ɛfa nna ne awo ho, na aka nsɛm ne nnwuma a wobenya. Nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ho so: Amammerɛ mu nneɛma ne nnipa afoforo te sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, nyamesom, ne asetena mu sikasɛm tebea di nkitaho, na ɛka ASRH nnwuma a wobenya ne ahofadi a wɔde si gyinae.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi agyina nipadua mu nsakrae a ɛba bere a wɔadu mpanyin afe so te sɛ nyin a ɛyɛ hu, akisikuru, ne nipadua mu nhwi no ano?
answer: Nsɛm hwehwɛ: Mmabunbere ne nea efi mu ba ho ade a wobesua denam nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so te sɛ nhoma, wɛbsaet, anaa mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di so. Ahotew Ho Nhyehyɛe a Wɔde Besi Hɔ: Ahotew ho su pa a wɔde bedi dwuma de adi nipadua hua, akisikuru, ne ahotew ho haw ahorow ho dwuma. Ntade a Ɛyɛ Fɛ a Wobɛpaw: Ntade a ɛyɛ fɛ a wobɛhyɛ a ɛbɛma nsakrae a ɛba nipadua no kɛse ne ne nsusuwii mu. Aduruyɛ mu Afotu a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ afotu ne ayaresa a wobɛpaw wɔ nneɛma pɔtee bi a ɛhaw adwene te sɛ akisikuru anaa nipadua mu nhwi a ɛboro so ho. Mmɔborɔhunu a Wɔde Ma Wɔn Ho: Sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyehye wɔn ho na wogye tom sɛ nipadua mu nsakrae yɛ ade a ɛfata wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.

question: Dɛn ne akwan bi a wɔfa so di nna mu ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma wɔ nketahodi a ɛyɛ papa na ɛboa no mu?
answer: Nkitahodi a Emu da hɔ: Wo ne wo hokafo nka nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na fi nokwaredi mu. Munsusuw akɔnnɔ, ahye, ne nneɛma a ɛhaw adwene ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ atemmu so. Monhwehwɛ Mmoa bom: Munsusuw ho sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo sɛ awarefo. Obi a onim adwuma no betumi ama nkitahodi ayɛ mmerɛw na ɔde akwan horow a wɔbɛfa so adi nna mu ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma ama. Nhomasua ne Ntease: Bom sua nna mu akwahosan ne nneɛma a ɛma obi ntumi nyɛ adwuma yiye ho ade. Sɛ yɛte ase sɛ nna mu ɔhaw abu so na wotumi sa a, ebetumi atew animtiaabu so. Tema ne Mmoa: Monte mo ho mo ho nkate ne ne suahu ase na mommoa. Fa boasetɔ ne ahwɛyiye bɛn nna mu abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den. Hwehwɛ Nneɛma a Wobɛfa So: Fa w’adwene si nna mu dwumadi ahorow a ɛnyɛ nea ɛhyɛn mu a ɛyɛ anigye na ɛma abotɔyam so. Sɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ne abusuabɔ ahorow a ɛsonosonoe hwɛ.

question: Dwuma bɛn na nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri di wɔ awo ho atɛntrenee a, wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ma mmabun mu?
answer: Nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri di dwuma titiriw wɔ awo mu atɛntrenee a wɔhyɛ ho nkuran ma mmabun te sɛ; nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a edi mu a wɔde ma, tumi a ɛma mmerante ne mmabaa tumi si gyinae a ɛfata, obu a wɔde ma wɔ nnipa ahorow ne osuahu ahorow ho, ne mmarima ne mmea ho gyinapɛn ne nsusuwii hunu a epira a wɔsɔre tia no so.

question: Dɛn nti na sika a wɔbɛkora so ho hia mmabun, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛboa ma wonya sikasɛm mu ahoɔden?
answer: Sika a wɔbɛkora so ho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden nya nkɔso denam: Sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ a wɔbɛkyekye so: Sika a wɔbɛkora so no ma wonya ahobammɔ ma ɛka anaa tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔnhwɛ kwan, ɛtew ahotoso a wɔde to afoforo so na ɛma ahofadi ho nkuran. Sikasɛm mu botae ahorow a wobedu ho: Sikakorabea ma mmabun tumi di wɔn apɛde te sɛ nhomasua, akwantu, adwumayɛ, anaa ofie wurayɛ akyi, na ɛma wonya ahofadi kɛse na wonya abotɔyam. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛbɔ: Sika a wɔbɛboaboa ano no bue apon ma daakye akwanya ahorow, te sɛ sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri mu, adwuma bi a wobefi ase, anaasɛ ahonyade a wobenya bere tenten, sikasɛm mu nkɔso ne yiyedi a ɛbɛtra hɔ akyɛ a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɔso.

Sika a wɔbɛkora so ho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma sikasɛm mu ahoɔden nya nkɔso denam: Sikasɛm mu ahobammɔ a wɔbɛkyekye so: Sika a wɔbɛkora so no ma wonya ahobammɔ ma ɛka anaa tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ a wɔnhwɛ kwan, ɛtew ahotoso a wɔde to afoforo so na ɛma ahofadi ho nkuran. Sikasɛm mu botae ahorow a wobedu ho: Sikakorabea ma mmabun tumi di wɔn apɛde te sɛ nhomasua, akwantu, adwumayɛ, anaa ofie wurayɛ akyi, na ɛma wonya ahofadi kɛse na wonya abotɔyam. Hokwan ahorow a wɔbɛbɔ: Sika a wɔbɛboaboa ano no bue apon ma daakye akwanya ahorow, te sɛ sika a wɔde bɛhyɛ nhomasua a ɛkɔ akyiri mu, adwuma bi a wobefi ase, anaasɛ ahonyade a wobenya bere tenten, sikasɛm mu nkɔso ne yiyedi a ɛbɛtra hɔ akyɛ a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɔso.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi asua sɛnea wɔbɛsakra wɔn asetrade ho nimdeɛ ma ɛne adwumayɛfo gua so nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ, mfiridwuma mu nneɛma foforo, ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso a ɛresakra no ahyia?

question: Dɛn ne mmara kwan so hokwan ahorow a nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ wɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu, a ɔhwɛ a wobenya ne ahobammɔ a wɔde bɛma wɔ nyiyim ho ka ho?
answer: Ayaresa a Ɛsɛ sɛ Obiara Nya (Access to Care)Nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm (disability) ne akuo afoforɔ a wɔadi wɔn abira no wɔ mmara mu kwan sɛ wɔnya ayaresa, a oprehyɛn ne adwene mu apɔwmuden mmoa ka ho; ɛmfa ho sɛ mmeaeɛ bi bɛtumi anya akwansideɛ no. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmeaeɛ a wɔfa kɔ adan mu ne mmeaeɛ a wɔpue firi mu yɛ baabi a ɛfata nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm na ama wɔn a wɔde nneɛma te sɛ "wheelchair" di dwuma ne afoforɔ anya kwan pa.Banbɔ firi Nyiyim Ho (Protections Against Discrimination)Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔne nnipa nyinaa di no pɛpɛɛpɛ a nyiyim biara nnim. Wɔatete ayaresabea adwumayɛfoɔ (health professionals) sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma mma obiara, ɛmfa ho sɛnea nnipa no gu ahorow fa.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi agyina m’ananmu ahwɛ ahu sɛ menya nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛfata mfe a madi afiri m’awofo, sukuu ahorow, ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ?
answer: Wo ne w’awofo nni nkitaho pefee wɔ ɔpɛ a wowɔ sɛ wubenya nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a woadi no ho, na bisa wɔn mmoa wɔ nneɛma a wotumi de ho to so a wubenya mu. Boa ma wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ nna ho apɔmuden ho adeɛ yie wɔ wo sukuu mu. Wo bɛtumi ayɛ eyi sɛ wo de wo ho bɛhyɛ sukuufoɔ mpanimfoɔ kuo mu, anaa wo bɛtwerɛ krataa akɔma sukuu no adwumayɛfoɔ mpanimfoɔ, anaa wo bɛdɔm mmoakuo a wɔgyina hɔ ma nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛte saa. Sɛ wo kɔ ayaresabea nso a, paem sɛ wo hia nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nna ho apɔmuden ho, na bisa wo dɔkota anaa ayarehwɛfoɔ no sɛ wɔmma wo nhoma anaa mmoa biara a ɛbɛboa wo ma woasua pii afa ho.

question: Sɛ mihyia nyiyim anaa mmara mu haw a ɛfa me bɔbeasu anaa dɛmdi ho a, mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmara kwan so mmoa?
answer: Mmara Dwumadibea: Hwehwɛ mmoa fi mmara anaa nnipa hokwan ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa mmara kwan so mmoa fekuw ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ mmara kwan so mmoa a wɔde ma akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wohyia nyiyim anaa mmara mu nsɛnnennen no hɔ. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Hwehwɛ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so nneɛma ne mmoa nhama a ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛbɔ nkurɔfo amanneɛ de ma, a ebetumi ama wɔanya nsɛm, mmoa, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmara kwan so mmoa. Nhwɛso bi ne, dwumakuo a yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ the Ark Foundation no de mmara kwan so mmoa ma akuw a ɛtete saa.

question: Dɛn ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu? (ɔbarima, ɔbea,bɔbeasu ho nsesae- transgender , sɛ wonnyɛ ɔbaa anaasɛ ɔbarima- non-binary, ne nea ɛkeka ho)
answer: Bɔbeasu yɛ wo mu atenka a ɛne sɛ woyɛ ɔbarima, ɔbea, abien no nyinaa, anaasɛ wonyɛ emu biara. Ɛsono ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde ma wɔ awo mu, a egyina nipadua mu nipadua so. Nsɛmfua bi a ebia wubehyia ni: Ɔbarima/Ɔbea: Atetesɛm mu akuw ahorow a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho. Bɔbeasu ho nsesae: Obi a ɛsono ne bɔbeasu wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔde maa no bere a wɔwoo no no ho. sɛ wonnyɛ ɔbaa anaasɛ ɔbarima: Obi a ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea nkutoo mu. Ebia wɔbɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ abien no nyinaa, wɔ baabi a ɛda ntam, anaasɛ wonni ɔbarima anaa ɔbea koraa.

question: kwan bɛn so na wɔde STI/HIV akwansidie nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie ka mmabun akwahosan ho dwumadie foforɔ te sɛ awoɔ akwahosan ne adwenem apɔwmuden dwumadie ho?
answer: Wɔtaa de STI/HIV akwansidie nkyerɛkyerɛ dwumadie ka mmabun akwahosan ho dwumadie foforɔ ho denam: Nnwuma a wɔde bɛbom: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ bɛtumi ama mmabun akwahosan ayaresabea a ɛkɔ akyiri a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa bɛtumi anya nnwuma ahodoɔ bi, a STI/HIV nhwehwɛmu, afotuo a ɛfa nyinsɛn mu nnuro ho, adwenem apɔwmuden ho mmoa, ne akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ wɔ beaeɛ baako a ɛfata ka ho. Ntetee a wɔde ma wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a nnuroyɛfo, ayarehwɛfo, afotubɔfoɔ, ne atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo ka ho, betumi anya ntetee wɔ mmabun akwahosan ho nneɛma pii mu de ama ɔhwɛ a edi mũ na wɔadi mmerante ne mmabaa ahiade ahorow a ɛka bom ho dwuma. Nkitahodi a wɔde kɔma wɔn: Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ, sukuu ahorow, ne adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo ayɛ biako de akwan a wɔbɛfa so de wɔn akɔma mmabun a wohia nnwuma titiriw a ɛboro ɔhwɛ a edi kan no so, te sɛ ayaresa a wɔde sa adwenemyare ho nsɛm anaa mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho. Ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ no biako: Akwahosan akuw betumi ayɛ ankorankoro hwɛ nhyehyɛe ama mmabun a ɛfa wɔn akwahosan ho haw soronko ho, a STI/HIV ano aduru ho akwan horow, awo akwahosan botae ahorow, ne adwene mu yiyedi ka ho, a wɔne aberante ne wɔn mmoa kuw no abom ayɛ adwuma.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwehwɛ mmoa afi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di, afotufo, anaa ntamgyinafo hɔ bere a ntawaawdi ahorow bɛyɛ den dodo anaasɛ ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔn ankasa besiesie, na nneɛma anaa mmoa adwuma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔanya wɔn ntawatawadi ano so ho nimdeɛ?

question: Dɛn ne brayɛ no fã ahorow, na ɛtaa di bere tenten ahe?
answer: Brayɛ mmere: Wɔkyekyɛ brayɛ no mu akwan horow pii: Brayɛ Fa: Da a edi kan a ɛba brayɛ mu no na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wofi ase. Saa fã yi taa di nnafua mmiɛnsa kosi nnafua nson.   Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu  Follicular Phase: Sɛ obi kɔ brayɛ akyi a, nipadua no fi ase siesie ne ho ma  nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ ovulation. Nkwammoaa a ɛma awotwaa no kanyan awotwaa no ma ɛyɛ ntini (nkotoku a nkesua wom).   Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu Ovulation: Bɛyɛ kyinhyia no mfinimfini (mpɛn pii no da a ɛto so du-nan  wɔ nnafua aduonu-nwɔtwe mu) no, woyi nkesua biako a ɛho akokwaw fi awotwaa mu. Wɔfrɛ eyi ovulation.   Nea yɛfrɛ no wɔ broɔfo kasa mu sɛ Luteal Phase: Bere a ovulation akyi no, follicle a hwee nni mu no dan biribi a wɔfrɛ no  wɔ broɔfo kasa mu corpus luteum, a ɛma honam nu nkwammoa ahorow siesie awotwaa no ma nyinsɛn a ebetumi aba. Sɛ Nyinsɛn Ba a: Sɛ wɔde mmadwoa ne nneɛma a wɔde hyɛ awotwaa mu na ɛma ɛwo no yɛ frɔmfrɔm a, nyinsɛn no fi ase. Sɛ ɛnte saa a, corpus luteum no sɛe, honam mu nkwammoa  dodow so tew, na brayɛ mmere  no fi ase bio.  Brayɛ mmere: Brayɛbea no tenten betumi ayɛ soronko, nanso mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ bɛyɛ nnafua aduonu-nwɔtwe. Nanso, ebetumi adi nnafua aduonu-baako kosi aduasa-nnum na wɔda so ara bu no sɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛfata.

question: Aboafo nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔrebusa mu afa wɔn nna ne akɔnnɔ ho ?
answer: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho akɔnnɔ betumi adi dwuma titiriw wɔ mmabun nna mu apomodenn ne abusuabɔ mu denam nkɛntɛnso a ebenya so: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nipasu nkɔso ne obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho no so. Nna mu apomoden ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne apomoden ho nnwuma a wobenya. Abusuabɔ mu nkɔso ne nkitahodi a wɔne ahokafo di. Osuahu ahorow a ɛfa nyiyim, animtiaabu, ne nnipa kakraa bi adwennwen ho. Boa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ne mpɔtam hɔ nkitahodi. Mpene, ahye, ne abusuabɔ pa a wɔbɛte ase na wɔafa so. Ɛho hia sɛ mmabun nya nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mu na ɛyɛ ne mmoa adwuma a ɛfa wɔn ahiade ne osuahu soronko ho .

question: Dwuma bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ di wɔ adwene a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho a wɔma ɛkɔ so tra hɔ no mu na ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa ma wɔako atia saa ade yi?
answer: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo taa yɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ho mfonini wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ pefee so. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa: Nhwehwɛmu a ɛyɛ katee: Bisa sɛnea wɔde dɛmdi ne nna gyina hɔ ma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu. Hwehwɛ Ananmusifoɔ Ahodoɔ: Boa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkyerɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ akwan a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛka obiara ho. Kasa: Kasa tia mfonini ahorow a enye wɔ sohyial media so anaasɛ denam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wobɛkɔ so adi nkitaho tẽẽ no so.

question: Sɛ obi a minim no rehaw anaa wɔreyɛ no basabasa wɔ Intanɛt so esiane ne nna ho akɔnnɔ, bɔbeasu, anaa ne nna ne awo akwahosan ho nneɛma afoforo nti a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer: Fa wo mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ ma onipa a ɔrehyia ɔhaw anaa asisifo no, na ma wonhu sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno nkutoo na wowɔ hɔ sɛ wobɛboa no. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wonsiw nea ɔhaw no anaa osisifo no kwan anaasɛ wɔmfa mmɔ ne amanneɛ, na sɛ wuhu suban no wɔ Intanɛt so a, w’ankasa susuw ho sɛ wobɛyɛ saa. Hyɛ onipa no nkuran sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi ɔpanyin, ɔfotufo, anaa mmoa ahyehyɛde a wogye no di a wɔn ho akokwaw wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ ahorow anaa intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho no hɔ.

question: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodibea bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma masua pii afa digital akenkan ne akyerɛw ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu?
answer: Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Common Sense Media, NetSmartz, ne StaySafeOnline de afotuo, video, ne nsɛm a ɛfa intanɛt so ahobanbɔ ho ma. Ntrɛwmu: Nnɔmba te sɛ Cyberbullying Hotline (1-800-420-1479) anaa National Runaway Safeline (1-800-786-2929) betumi de mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ama. Sukuu Nhyehyɛe: Sukuu pii wɔ nhyehyɛe anaa afotufo a wobetumi akyerɛkyerɛ digital akenkan ne akyerɛw ne intanɛt so ahobammɔ ho ade. Awofoɔ Akwankyerɛ: Awofoɔ anaa ahwɛfo bɛtumi ayɛ adeɛ a ɛsom bo a wɔde bɛsua intanɛt nneyɛeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ ho.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn na mahye asi hɔ na makura mu wɔ m’abusuabɔ mu?
answer: Hunu anaa nim wo bebiaa woano si: Hu nea ɛma wo ho tɔ wo ne nea ɛmma wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ. question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne me nnamfo ne m’abusuafo aka me nyinsɛn no ho asɛm?
answer: Sɛ wo ne w’adɔfo bɛkasa afa wo nyinsɛn ho a, ebetumi ayɛ den, nanso wɔn mmoa a wubenya no ho hia. Afotu bi ni: Paw obi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso: Wo ne w’adamfo, w’abusua muni, anaa ɔpanyin foforo a ɔboa wo nkasa. Di nokware na ka w’ani: Ka wo nkate ne wo haw ahorow no pefee ne nokwaredi mu. Fa nea wopɛ sɛ woka no di dwuma: Eyi betumi aboa wo ma woanya ahotoso kɛse wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ no mu.

question: Dɛn nti na me nipadua hua mprempren yi?
answer: Nipadua hua fi fifiri ne mmoawa a ɛwɔ wo honam ani a ɛfrafra. Wɔ wo babunbere mu no, wo nipadua no ma fifiri pii fi awoɔ mu nkwamoa ahorow nti, titiriw bere a woreyɛ nnam anaasɛ wo ho yeraw wo no. Fifiri no ankasa nni hua biara, nanso mmoawa a wɔwɔ wo honam ani no bobɔ mu ma ɛbɛyɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ hua. Ɛno nti na ebia wubehu nipadua hua, titiriw wɔ wo nsateaa ase no. Ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo nipadua no renyin. Wobetumi adi nipadua hua ho dwuma denam samina a ekum ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde guare mprenu (anɔpa ne anwummere) daa aa wode mmoa sa samina. question: Dɛn ne apaɔwmuden ho ahiade pɔtee bi anaa nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm, na mɛyɛ dɛn atumi ne m’apɔwmuden ho ɔyaresafo abɔ ho dawuro?
answer: Wo Nipadua Ho Ntease: Ka nsɛmmisa anaa dadwen biara a wowɔ wɔ nna mu nkɔsoɔ ne nipadua mu nsakrae a ɛfa wo dɛmdi ho ho asɛm. Hwehwɛ awoɔ nhyɛsoɔ nnuro na susu wo daakye nyinsɛn ho, susuw wo dɛmdie so ho. Adwene mu Apɔwmuden: Wo ne wo ayaresafoɔ nkasa fa adwenemyareɛ ho dwumadie a wobɛnya ho sɛ ɛhia a. Yɛ Wo Nhwehwɛmu: Sua nna mu akwahosan ne dɛmdie hokwan ahorow ho ade wɔ Ghana. Eyi ma wo tumi sɛ wo ne nea ɔde mmoa ma wo no bɔ nkɔmmɔ a ntease wom. Siesie Ɔkasa Nsɛntitiri: Di kan kyerɛw nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm pɔtee bi a ɛhaw adwene to hɔ na ama woahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔadi ho dwuma. Fa Obi a Ɔboa no Bra: Susu ho sɛ wobɛma w’adamfo anaa w’abusuani bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso bɛka wo ho akɔ bere a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔbɛboa wo ma woabɔ w’ahiade ho ban.

question: Asiane ahorow, ɔhaw, ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ahorow bɛn na ebetumi aba a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm, intanɛt so, ne nkitahodie site ahorow a mede me ho bɛhyɛ mu wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, kokoam nsɛm, mfidie so ayayade, ne ntentanfidie so ahobammɔ ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa me ma madi nsunsuanso yi so?
answer: Asiane, haw, ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii a ebetumi aba a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu nsɛm ne intanɛt so a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho no bi ne: Kokoam nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun yɛ ahwɛyiye wɔ ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ wɔ intanɛt so ho na wɔhu kokoam nsɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ nkitahodie site ahorow so de abɔ wɔn ntentanfidie so nipasu ho ban. Intanɛt so ayayade: Intanɛt so ayayade betumi aba wɔ abɛɛfo ntentanfidie so anaa ntentanfidie nkitahodie beaeɛ ahodoɔ, enti ɛho hia sɛ wɔbɔ ayayade nneyɛe ho amanneɛ na wohwehwɛ mmoa fi mpanyimfo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ so a wogye wɔn di hɔ. Digitals ahobammɔ: Ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun de Intanɛt so su horow a ahobammɔ wom di dwuma, te sɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a asiane wom a wɔbɛkwati, ahwɛyiye a wɔbɛyɛ bere a wɔne ahɔho di nkitaho wɔ Intanɛt so, ne nsɛm anaa mfonini ahorow a ɛho hia a wɔbɛkwati. Atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne dijitaal nsunsuanso: Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasusuw intanɛt so nsɛm ho yiye na wɔako atia atipɛnfo nhyɛso bɔne anaa nkɛntɛnso a epira, na ahyɛ gyinaesi a nimdeɛ wom ne abɛɛfo ntentanfidie nkitahodie a asɛyɛde wom ho nkuran.

question: Sɛ mihyia animtiaabu anaa nyiyim a ɛfa STI a wɔahu ho a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer: Kɔ nnamfo, anaa mmoa akuw a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wobetumi de ntease ne mmoa a ɛnyɛ atemmu ama no nkyɛn. Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo STI ho asɛm na yi anansesɛm ahorow fi hɔ na ama animtiaabu so atew. question: Asiane ne akwansideɛ bɛn na ebetumi aba wɔ sikasɛm mu nnwuma a wɔde di dwuma mu, te sɛ sika a wɔbɔ, mfɛntom a wɔbɔ, sika a wɔbɔ boro so, ɛka, nsisi, nnipa a wowia, anaa nsisi?
answer: Bere a sikasɛm ho adwumayɛ ma mfaso horow no, ɛde asiane ahorow nso ba te sɛ: Ka a wɔbɔ: Sikakorabea ahorow betumi agye sika wɔ akontaabu a wɔde siesie, sika a wɔbɔ boro so, anaa nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho. Mfaso: Sɛ wobɔ bosea denam bosea anaa credit card so a, ebetumi ama woagye mfɛntom. Sika a Wɔbɔ boro So: Sɛ wɔsɛe sika pii sen nea ɛwɔ akontaabu no mu a, ebetumi ama wɔabɔ ka kɛse wɔ sika a ɛboro so ho. Ɛka: Sɛ obi bɔ bosea boro nea obetumi so a, ebetumi ama wabɔ bosea na ne sikasɛm mu ahokyere aba. Nsisi, nnipa a wowia, ne nsisi: Ebia nsɛmmɔnedifo de wɔn ani si ankorankoro so de sikasɛm mu nsisi anaa korɔnbɔ, na ehia sɛ wɔma wɔn ani da hɔ na wɔyɛ ahwɛyiye bere a wɔrehwɛ akontaabu ne ankorankoro ho nsɛm so no.

question: Dɛn na nea broni ka no 'intersectionality' kyerɛ wɔ dɛmdi ne nna ho nsɛm mu?
answer: Nea broni ka no 'Intersectionality' kyerɛ sɛnea asetra mu nkyekyem ahorow te sɛ abusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, kuw, ne nna ho nsɛm a ɛka bom, a ebetumi ama nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka bom na egyina wɔn ho wɔn ho so a ɛfa nyiyim anaa ɔhaw ahorow ho aba. Wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ne nna mu nipasu ho no, 'intersectionality' gye tom sɛ ankorankoro osuahu ahorow no nam nipasu afã horow pii so na ɛyɛ, ɛnyɛ wɔn bɔbeasu anaa nna ho akɔnnɔ nkutoo.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya mmoa efi mpɔtamfoɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbabun a ɔwɔ dɛmdi?
answer: Sɛ́ ɔbabun a ɔte ase a wadi dɛm no, mmoa ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a wubenya no betumi ayɛ nea ɛho hia kɛse ma wo yiyedi ne wo tumi. Akwan bi a wobɛfa so anya mmoa ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ni: 1. Ɔman Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Ahyehyɛde ahorow: Hwehwɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfa wo dɛmdi ho pɔtee, te sɛ Ɔman Autism Fekuw anaa Ntini mu Ntini a Ɛyɛ Fɛ Fekuw. 2. Mpɔtam Hɔ Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm Akuo: Hwehwɛ intanɛt so anaa kɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ mmubuafoɔ adwumayɛbea hɔ kɔhwehwɛ mmoa akuo a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. Wɔ Ghana wobetumi ne Disability Council adi nkitaho ama mmoa dwumadie 3. Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm ho nsɛm ho Ahyehyɛdeɛ: Ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ Disability Rights Education and Defence Fund anaa National Disability Rights Network betumi de nsɛm ne mmoa ama. 4. Intanɛt so Mpɔtam ne Nhyiamu: Kɔka intanɛt so nhyiamu, sohyial media akuo, anaa intanɛt so mmoa akuo ho na wo ne afoforɔ a wɔwɔ suahunu a ɛte saa ara nni nkitaho. 5. Afotu ne Ayaresa: Hwehwɛ mmoa a efi animdefo hɔ fi ɔyaresafo anaa ɔfotufo a ne ho akokwaw wɔ adwuma a wɔne mmabun a wɔadi dɛm yɛ mu hɔ. 6. Atipɛnfo Afotu Nhyehyɛe: Hwehwɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛne wo ne atipɛnfo afotufo a ɔwɔ dɛmdi anaa osuahu a ɛte saa ara hyia. 7. Ahomegye ne Ahomegye Dwumadi: Hwehwɛ agodie a ɛma wotumi sesa wɔn ho, adwinni ho nhyehyɛe, anaa dwumadi afoforo a wɔayɛ ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm. 8. Nsraban ne Dwumadie a ɛfa Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm ho: Kɔ ahuhuro nsraban anaa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔayɛ ama wo dɛmdi, na ama woanya tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho. 9. Mpɔtam hɔ Mmofra a Wɔadi dɛm Dwumadibea: Kɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ mmubuafoɔ adwumayɛbea hɔ kɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma, dwumadie, ne mmoa a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ. 10. Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ: W’akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne nsɛm a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔma mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie. Kae sɛ, sɛ wubenya mmoa ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma a, egye akokoduru ne wo ho a wobɛkamfo. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ a wubetumi anya mu bi.

question: Dɛn na ɛsi wɔ berɛ a ɔbarima rema ne ho so (ejaculating)
answer: Berɛ a ɔbarima rema ne ho so (ejaculation) no, ɛyɛ berɛ a "semen" pue firi ne mu; eyi yɛ nsuo a "sperm" (ɔbarima mu nsuo/aba) wom. question: Dɛn ne sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ pa ne obuo wom?
answer: Ahotoso ne obuo: Wote nka sɛ wowɔ ahobammɔ na wo ho tɔ wo sɛ woyɛ wo ho. Wo hokafo (hokafo) tie wo, wobu w’adwenkyerɛ sɛ ɛsom bo, na wɔnhyɛ wo mma wonyɛ biribiara. Nokwaredi ne nkitahodi a emu da hɔ: Mobetumi ne mo ho mo ho abɔ biribiara ho nkɔmmɔ pefee na momfa nokwaredi afa biribiara ho, a mo nkate ne mo ahiade ka ho. Pɛyɛ ne atɛntrenee: Wote nka sɛ wowɔ asɛm a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ abusuabɔ no mu. Wɔbom si gyinae, na suban biara nni hɔ a ɛhyɛ so. Mmoa ne nkuranhyɛ: Mokyekye mo ho mo ho na mohyɛ mo ho mo ho nkonimdi ho afahyɛ. Wote nka sɛ wɔboa wo ma wodi wo botae ahorow akyi. Ahye a ɛfata: Mo baanu nyinaa bu mo ho mo ho mo honam ne nkate fam ahunmu. Wote nka sɛ ɛyɛ wo dɛ sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi wɔ nneɛma a wunsiesiee wo ho mmaa ho.

question: Dɛn ne adwene a ɛnteɛ anaa anansesɛm a wɔtaa nya wɔ dɛmdi ho a ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu?

ANANSESƐM:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no ntumi nyɛ adwuma anaasɛ wonni nyansa pii. NOKWARE:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no tumi yɛ adwuma na wɔn ani da hɔ te sɛ obiara. 2.MYTH: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm da adi bere nyinaa. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm pii yɛ nea wontumi nhu, te sɛ adwenemyare anaa nyarewa a enni sabea. 3.MYTH: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no wɔ akokoduru a ɛkanyan adwene. .NOKWARE:Nkurɔfo a wɔadi dɛm nyɛ abran anaasɛ nhyɛsofo esiane wɔn dɛmdi nkutoo nti. 4. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ ankorankoro awerɛhosɛm. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu 5.ANANSE: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm yɛ adesoa ma ɔmanfo. NOKWARE:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm yɛ ɔmanfo a wɔboa. 6. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ "wodi so nkonim". NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm nyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ "wodi so nkonim", na mmom ɛyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ wogye tom. 7.ANANSE: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no nyɛ wɔn a wɔn ani gye nna ho anaasɛ wɔn ani nnye wɔn ho. NOKWARE:Nkurɔfo a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ ne wɔn ho a ɛyɛ fɛ te sɛ obiara 8. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm fi awofo a wɔnyɛ papa anaa awosu mu nkwaadɔm bɔne. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm no mfi awofo a wɔnyɛ papa anaa awosu mu nkwaadɔm bɔne, na mmom ɛyɛ awosu mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu 9. ANANSESƐM:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ntumi nsi wɔn ankasa gyinae. ANANSESƐM:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no ntumi nyɛ adwuma anaasɛ wonni nyansa pii. NOKWARE:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no tumi yɛ adwuma na wɔn ani da hɔ te sɛ obiara. 2.MYTH: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm da adi bere nyinaa. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm pii yɛ nea wontumi nhu, te sɛ adwenemyare anaa nyarewa a enni sabea. 3.MYTH: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no wɔ akokoduru a ɛkanyan adwene. .NOKWARE:Nkurɔfo a wɔadi dɛm nyɛ abran anaasɛ nhyɛsofo esiane wɔn dɛmdi nkutoo nti. 4. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ ankorankoro awerɛhosɛm. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ adebɔ mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu 5.ANANSE: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm yɛ adesoa ma ɔmanfo. NOKWARE:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm yɛ ɔmanfo a wɔboa. 6. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ "wodi so nkonim". NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm nyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ "wodi so nkonim", na mmom ɛyɛ biribi a ɛsɛ sɛ wogye tom. 7.ANANSE: Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm no nyɛ wɔn a wɔn ani gye nna ho anaasɛ wɔn ani nnye wɔn ho. NOKWARE:Nkurɔfo a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nna ho akɔnnɔ ne wɔn ho a ɛyɛ fɛ te sɛ obiara 8. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm fi awofo a wɔnyɛ papa anaa awosu mu nkwaadɔm bɔne. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm no mfi awofo a wɔnyɛ papa anaa awosu mu nkwaadɔm bɔne, na mmom ɛyɛ awosu mu ade a ɛwɔ nnipa ahorow ahorow mu 9. ANANSESƐM:Nnipa a wɔadi dɛm ntumi nsi wɔn ankasa gyinae. NOKWARE:Nkurɔfo a wɔadi dɛm tumi si wɔn ankasa gyinae ne nea wɔpaw 10. ANANSESƐM:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ aduruyɛ mu asɛm, ɛnyɛ asetra mu asɛm. NOKWARE:Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm yɛ aduruyɛ ne asetra mu asɛm, na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔfa ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so de ka obi ho na wotumi nya bi.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn akyerɛ m'adwene ne me hyeɛ akyerɛ nnamfo, hokafoɔ ne ahokafo a  me ne wonwɔ nna mu nkitahodi ɛfa nna mu nsɛm a  m’ani gye  ho?
answer: Fa "me"kasafua  di dwuma . Ka nokware/kasa pefee. Hyehyɛ ahyeɛ a emu da hɔ. Tie wɔn yie.

question: Dɛn ne nsunsuansoɔ bɔne a mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu adwennwen (puberty stress) bɛtumi de aba adwene mu ahoɔden so wɔ bere tenten mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi de wɔn ho hwɛ ne atenka mu yiedie adi kan?
answer: Asiane a Ɛkɔ Anim a Ɛwɔ Adwene ne Nkate Mu: Adwennwen a ɛkyɛ anaa enni sabea wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no betumi ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obenya adwenemyare te sɛ dadwen, adwenemhaw, anaa adidi mu haw no ayɛ kɛse. Nkɛntɛnso a Enya wɔ Bu a Wobu Ho: Adwennwen a ɛkɔ so ne osuahu ahorow a enye a wonya wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no betumi anya obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho, nipadua ho mfonini, ne yiyedi nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso akosi mpanyin afe so. Abusuabɔ mu Nsɛnnennen: Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobegyina adwennwen a efi mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ano no betumi aka abusuabɔ a ɛda wɔne abusuafo, nnamfo, ne ɔdɔfo ntam. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho a wɔbɛhwɛ ne nkate mu yiyedi adi kan denam: Wɔn ho a wɔde bedi dwuma: ayamye ne ntease a wɔde bedi wɔn ho dwuma, titiriw wɔ mmere a adwennwen anaa ɔhaw wom mu. Mmoa a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di te sɛ nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa afotufo a wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ mmoa ne akwankyerɛ bere a ɛho hia no. Akwan a Wɔfa so Gyina Ayaresa Mu a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Hyehyɛ Mu: Akwan a ɛfata a wɔfa so gyina ano te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ahomegye, adebɔ mu nsɛm a wɔda no adi, ne asetra mu abusuabɔ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ na wɔde adi dwuma de adi adwennwen ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ nkate mu yiyedi ho nkuran. Ahye a Wobɛhyehyɛ: Ahye a wode besi hɔ wɔ tebea horow anaa abusuabɔ a ɛhaw adwene ho na wode dwumadi ahorow a ɛde anigye, abotɔyam, ne ahomegye ba di kan.

question: Ntetee anaa nhomasua bɛn na apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo hia na wɔde ɔhwɛ a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho ama mmabun?
answer: Apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛfo hia ntetee anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ ɔhwɛ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa adwenemhaw ho, adwenemhaw ho nhwehwɛmu ne, nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwenemhaw so, amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ, nnipa ntam nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ, ahyeɛ a wɔde besi hɔ, ne wɔn ankasa hwɛ ho. Nhomasua ne ɔhwɛ a wɔbɛkɔ so ayɛ nso ho hia na ama wɔakura ahokokwaw ne tema mu wɔ adwuma a wɔne mmabun a wɔahaw no yɛ mu.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahu sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi wɔ ayɔnkofa pa?
answer: Obu a Wɔde Ma Wɔn Ho Wɔn Ho: adwene, wɔn atenka, ne wɔn ahye. Ahotoso: Wɔn ho a wogye di na wɔte nka sɛ wogye wɔn di. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn. question: Dɛn ne intanɛt ne "digital" abrabɔ pa, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer: Intanɛt ne digyital abrabɔ pa ka nnyinasosɛm ne akwankyerɛ a ɛfa asɛdeɛ ne obuo nneyɛeɛ ho wɔ digyital mmeaeɛ"digital spaces". Wɔho hia wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛkora kokoamsɛm, kokoamsɛm, ne ahobammɔ so bere a wɔrenya nsɛm, wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa, na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ mu wɔ Intanɛt so no.

question: So mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a  ɛmma wɔmfa ɔman sika nni dwuma wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma mu?
answer: Mmara anaa nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa sika a ɔman de boa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho no gu ahorow egyina ɔman anaa ɔmantam no so. Mmeae bi wɔ mmara a ɛbara anaasɛ ɛbara sɛ wɔmfa ɔman sika te sɛ Medicaid nni dwuma mma nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho adwuma gye sɛ wɔ mmonnaato, abusuafo a wɔne wɔn da, anaa wɔde wɔn nkwa to asiane mu. Saa anohyeto ahorow yi betumi de sikasɛm mu akwanside ahorow aba ankorankoro a wɔrehwehwɛ nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho hwɛ so, titiriw wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to ɔman insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow so de tua apomoden ho ka no. Ɛho hia sɛ wuhu mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa ɔman sika a wɔde boa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nnwuma wɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ne sɛnea ebetumi anya ɔhwɛ a wobenya so nkɛntɛnso.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abɛɛfo ntetan nsɛm a wɔbɔ betumi ama mmabun tumi ma wɔabɛyɛ nsakrae ho adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ nnam, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ, ne wɔn a wɔkamfo asetena mu nsakrae pa kyerɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam, sukuu ahorow, ne ɔmanfo a wɔtrɛw mu?
answer: Nhyiamu a wɔbɛma mmabun atumi akyɛ wɔn nsɛm, akasa ama wɔn hokwan ahorow, na wɔaboaboa afoforo ano atwa ASRH nsɛm ho ahyia denam abɛɛfo ntetan ɔsatu ne dwumadi so. Nkɔmmɔbɔ ne nkitahodi hokwan ahorow a wɔne atipɛnfo, afotufo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo bɛhyɛ ho nkuran de ama nne ahorow ayɛ kɛse na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae. Abɛɛfo ntetan dwuma adebɔ a wɔde bɛka mmabun akannifoɔ a wɔtrɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu de ayɛ adwuma, tumi, ne asetena mu asɛdeɛ ho adwene.

question: Dɛn ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu (STIs), na dɛn nti na ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ho nhwehwɛmu?
answer: STI yɛ nyarewa a ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so, a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a efi ɔbea no awotwaa mu, akyi berɛmo mu, anaa anom ka ho. Ebetumi afi mmoawa mmoawa ahodoɔ. STI a wɔbɛyɛ ho nhwehwɛmu no ho hia efisɛ: Ebia STI pii remfa sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛda adi mma, na ɛde ɔyare a wonim ho hwee aba. Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ de hu wo tebea no ma wonya hokwan hu ntɛm na wɔsa no yare ntɛm a ebetumi asiw akwahosan mu nsunsuanso a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ, te sɛ awo a wontumi nwo, yare a ɛma obi ho hyehye no wɔ akyi berɛmo mu ne ade. Nhwɛhwɛ mu ma wotumi sa yare wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw STI mu akɔ wɔn a wɔne wɔn da mu no so, na ɛma nna mu akwahosan ne yiyedi nyinaa nya nkɔso.

question: Nneɛma anaa mmoa kuo nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mehu nyinsɛn ho haw ahorow  na manya ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ansa na wɔawo?
answer: Nneɛma ne Mmoa: Akwahosan ho dwumayɛni: W’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo no yɛ ade titiriw a wode bedi dwuma wɔ nyinsɛn ho haw ahorow ho. Wobetumi de akwankyerɛ ama, abua nsɛmmisa, na wɔadi nsɛm biara a ɛbɛsɔre ho dwuma. Adesua a Wɔyɛ Ansa na Wɔawo: Ayaresabea ne mpɔtam hɔ mmeae pii de adesua a wɔyɛ ansa na wɔawo ma. question: So yebetumi de botae ahorow asi yɛn ani so wɔ check-ins ho, te sɛ nsɛmti pɔtee bi ho nkitahodie a yɛbɛma ayɛ kɛse anaasɛ tumi a yɛde bedi ɔhaw ahorow ho dwuma na yɛabom asi gyinae yie?

question: So hokwan ahorow wɔ hɔ ma nsaano-adesua anaa dwumadi ahorow a mfaso wɔ so wɔ asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua mu?
answer: Yiw, asetra mu nimdeɛ ho adesua taa de osuahu mu adesua dwumadi ahorow te sɛ asɛde agorɔdi, kuw nkɔmmɔbɔ, ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne asetra mu nsusuwii ankasa ka ho. Mmabun betumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ dwumadi ahorow te sɛ ankorankoro nkɔso nhyehyɛe a wɔbɛyɛ, nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a etu mpɔn a wɔde bedi dwuma denam dwumadi ahorow a wɔyɛ so, ne mpɔtam hɔ som adwuma ahorow a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu. Nsaano mu adesua ma nteaseɛ, akoraeɛ, ne asetena mu nimdeɛ a wɔde di dwuma wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu no yɛ kɛseɛ.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na honam mu nkwammoa ahorow ka m’ahoɔden ne sɛnea meda?
answer: Nkwammoaa betumi anya w’ahoɔden ne sɛnea woda bere a worekɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu so nkɛntɛnso kɛse: Estrogen a ɛkɔ soro ma mmeawa nya ahoɔden kɛse sen sɛnea wɔtaa yɛ bere a testosterone dodow a ɛkɔ soro wɔ mmarimaa mu no betumi ama wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkɔ akyi no akɔ soro. Onyin a Ɛma Wonyin: Onyin hormone a ɛba bere a woadu mpanyin afe so no betumi ama woate ɔbrɛ nka kɛse bere a wo nipadua nyin ntɛmntɛm no. Melatonin: Nsakrae a ɛba hormone dodow mu nso betumi aka wo nna. Ebia melatonin, hormone bi a ɛma woda no yɛ adwuma wɔ mmere ahorow mu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na ɛde nsakrae aba bere a wote nka sɛ woada anaasɛ woanyan no mu. Circadian Rhythm: Nsakrae a ɛba wo nipadua mu no betumi asɛe wo nipadua no awosu mu nna ne ɔsɔre kyinhyia no bere tiaa bi, na ama ayɛ den sɛ wobɛda anaasɛ wobɛsɔre wɔ mmere a wɔtaa nya no mu. Sɛ wode nna ho nhyehyɛe si hɔ daa, kwati caffeine ne ɛlɛtrɔnik mfiri ansa na woada, na woayɛ baabi a wobɛda a, ebetumi aboa ma nna atu mpɔn wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu.

question: Dɛn ne mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa adwuma bi a ɛwɔhɔ ma wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛ wɔn so mu, na sɛ ɛho hia a, ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi?
answer: Mpɔtam hɔ nneɛma ne mmoa dwumadie a ɛwɔ hɔ ma wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nsa ne nnubɔne a wɔde tow hyɛɛ wɔn so no betumi ayɛ: Ɔhaw ho telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfoɔ ne mmoa telefon a wɔde akasamafo a wɔatete wɔn a wɔbɛtumi de mmoa ne nsɛm ama ntɛm ara na ɛyɛ adwuma. Afotu ne ayaresa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔyɛ adwuma titiriw wɔ adwenemhaw a wɔsan nya ne wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu ho. Aduruyɛ adwuma ma nneɛma ahorow, broni ka no 'Medical services', baabi a wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no betumi anya ayaresa, asɛnnibea adanse a wɔbɛboaboa ano, ne mmoa a wɔde di akyi. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ne akuw a wɔboa wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu titiriw, a wɔde atipɛnfo mmoa, mmara kwan so mmoa, ne nneɛma foforo a wobenya ma. Mmara kwan so mmoa ayaresabea ahorow anaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔde mmoa ma wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi ho atɛntrenee nhyehyɛe no mu a wɔbɛfa so, a polisifo amanneɛbɔ a wɔde bɛma ne ahyɛde a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban a wɔhwehwɛ ka ho. Mmabun betumi anya saa nneɛma yi denam mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di te sɛ awofo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu afotufo a wobetumi aboa ma wɔde wɔn abata nnwuma a ɛfata ho no so. Wobetumi nso ahwehwɛ nsɛm wɔ Intanɛt so denam wɛbsaet ahorow ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din a wɔatu wɔn ho ama sɛ wɔbɛboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu no so.

question: Akwan bɛn na mɛtumi afa so ama m’adwene mu apɔmuden ne yiedie atu mpɔn wɔ mpanin mu kɔ mu?
answer: W’adwene mu akwahosan ne wo yiyedi a wobɛhwɛ so wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no ho hia kɛse ma yiyedi nyinaa. Akwan bi ni: Wo ho a wobɛhwɛ: Gye bere ma dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho, mu te sɛ anigyede, adwinni, nnwom, anaa akenkan. Nipadua mu Akwahosan: Fa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ daa, nnuan a ahoɔden wom, ne Mm nna a ɛfata di kan. Nipadua akwahosan boa ma obi nya adwene mu yiyedi. Adwene ne Ahomegye: Fa adwene mu nhumu akwan, ahome a emu dɔ, anaa adwennwen nko di dwuma na ama adwennwen so atew na ama w’adwene atu mpɔn. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Ka wo nkate ne wo haw ho asɛm kyerɛ mpanyimfo a wowɔ wɔn mu ahotoso, nnamfo, anaa ɔfotufo bi. Ɛho nhia sɛ wo nkutoo na wofa nsɛnnennen mu. To Screen Time: Tew screen bere so wɔ mfiri ahorow so na gye w’ahome wɔ sohyial media so. Bere pii a wɔde hwɛ screen so betumi aka adwenemyare.Fa Daa Si Hɔ: Sɛ wowɔ da biara da dwumadi a, ebetumi ama woayɛ nhyehyɛe na woagyina pintinn, na ɛno betumi ama adwene mu yiyedi atu mpɔn. Anigyede ne Adebɔ: Fa wo ho hyɛ adebɔ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma w’ani gye te sɛ akyerɛw, mfoniniyɛ, anaa nnwom a wobɛbɔ mu. Sua Nneɛma a Wobɛtumi Agyina Ano: Yɛ akwan pa a wobɛfa so agyina ano a wobɛfa so adi adwennwen ho dwuma, te sɛ ahome a wobɛhome a emu dɔ, kyerɛwtohɔ a wobɛkyerɛw, anaa wo ne w’adamfo bi a wobɛkasa. Anamɔn a wobɛyɛ ntɛm de ahwɛ w’adwene mu akwahosan no betumi anya w’anigye ne sɛnea wubetumi agyina ano nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso pa.

answer: Wɔboaboa 'facilitators' (nhyehyeɛ/akwantuo). Nateka mu mmoa. Wɔkasa ma wo. Hyɛ wo nkuran.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn na m'anya SRH mmoa a ɛyɛ kokoam na ɛfata mmabun?
answer: Mmabun betumi anya saa mmoa yi afi skuul ne mpɔtam ayaresabea. Hotlines ne abɛɛfo ntentanfidie a yɛfrɛ no ''internet'' so tumi boa. Youth-friendly clinics so boa ma mmabun ka wɔn haw a fɛreɛ biara nnim.

question: So nsɛnnennen pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a LGBTQ + mmabun, mmabun a wonni afie, anaa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm hyia bere a ɛfa bɔbeasu mu atirimɔdensɛm (GBV) ho no? (mmerɛw a ɛkɔ soro, nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde boa a wonni) .

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi m’ankasa me gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow akyi bere a meda so ara ne m’atipɛnfo anya ayɔnko pa?
answer: Paw wo adwumakuw no nyansam: Fa nnamfo a wobu wo gyinapɛn ahorow na wɔboa no twa wo ho hyia, na hyɛ nneyɛe pa ne gyinaesi ho nkuran. Di wo ho nokware: Fa wo gyidi ne wo gyinapɛn "values" ahorow di kan, sɛ ɛsono w’atipɛnfo de mpo a, na kwati sɛ wubegyae mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛfata.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi apɛ m’ankasa adwenemyare ho ahiade ahorow a mɛkamfo akyerɛ no mu berekro a meboa ɔbabun a ɔte ase a sebi wɔadi dɛm no nso?
answer: Ɛho hia sɛ wohwɛ wo ho bere a woreboa ɔbabun a wadi dɛm no. Sɛnea wobɛkari pɛ ni: Fa ahye sisi hɔ: Ɛnyɛ hwee sɛ wobɛka sɛ dabi bere a wuhia ahomegye no. Di nkitaho pefee: Ka w’ahiade ne nea wuntumi nyɛ ho asɛm kyerɛ ɔbabun no.

question: Dɛn ne anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa atia saa nsusuwii a ɛnteɛ yi na wɔakamfo ntease a ɛyɛ nketenkete wɔ adwuma a wɔn a wɔhwɛ no betumi adi wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ a wosiw ano no ho?
answer: Anansesɛm anaa adwene a ɛnteɛ bi a ɛfa ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho no bi ne: Atosɛm: Sɛ wɔn a wɔrehwɛ wɔ awerɛhyem wɔ tebea no ho nkutoo a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho gye mu. Atosɛm: Bere nyinaa na nea ɔhwɛ no de ne ho gye mu no hwehwɛ sɛ wohyia nea ɔyɛɛ bɔne no tee. Atosɛm: Asiane wɔ hɔ a obi a ɔhwɛ no de ne ho gye mu na entu mpɔn. Atosɛm: Ɛnyɛ m’asɛyɛde sɛ mede me ho bɛhyɛ obi foforo tebea mu. Mmabun betumi akasa atia saa adwene a ɛnteɛ yi denam ntease nketenkete a wɔbɛma anya wɔ wɔn a wɔhwɛ no de wɔn ho gye mu ho, si hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔbom yɛ ade so dua, boa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu, na wɔde ahobammɔ di kan bere a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu no so.

question: So kasasin anaa kasa pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a metumi de afi nkɔmmɔbɔ no ase wɔ obu ne bɔkɔɔ kwan so?
answer: Wubetumi afi ase denam biribi te sɛ, "Madwen m'akwahosan ho pii nnansa yi, na na mepɛ sɛ me ne wo kasa fa nsɛmmisa bi a mewɔ fa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho." "Me" nsɛm a wode bedi dwuma no betumi aboa ma woada wo atinka ne w'adwene adi a woremfa asodi no nto so anaasɛ wommɔ sobo.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn de me ho ahyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkamfo mmabun nna ne awo hokwan ahorow ho nkuran na wɔabɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ me mpɔtam hɔ no mu? (Wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow tu wɔn ho ma, nhyiam ahorow a wɔkɔ)
answer: Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛfa so de wvn ho ahyɛ mu: Wo ne Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wotu wɔn ho ma: Ebia mpɔtam hɔ ASRH ahyehyɛde ahorow behia mmoa wɔ nsɛm a esisi, sohyial media, anaa adwumayɛ ho nnwuma mu. Nhyiam anaa Nhyiam Ahorow a Wobɛkɔ: Kyerɛ wo mmoa na wo ne afoforo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ wɔ baguam nhyiam ahorow ase no nni nkitaho.

question: Dɛn nti na 'hormone' nti me nya akisikuru 'acne' mpofirim?
answer: Hormone' ahorow, titiriw 'testosterone', betumi akanyan wo honam ani ngo ntini ahorow no ma ayɛ ngo pii. Saa ngo a ɛboro so yi, ne honam ani nkwammoaa a awuwu no betumi asiw (akyere) ntini no mu na ama obi anya akisikuru. Akisikuru taa ba wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu efisɛ hormone dodow sakra, na ngo a ɛkɔ soro no betumi ama akisikuru, akisikuru tuntum, ne fitaa aba. Sɛ wohwɛ wo honam ani denam samina a ɛnyɛ den anaa ade a wɔde tew ho a wode bɛhohoro brɛoo so, na wode nneɛma a oduruyɛfo a ɔhwɛ honam ani yare kamfo kyerɛ a wode bedi dwuma no betumi aboa ma woadi akisikuru ho dwuma.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn aboa nnamfoɔ anaa sɛ tipɛnfoɔ a wɔwɔ nnipadua mu haw?
answer: Tie wɔn a wummu wɔn atɛn na hyɛ wɔn nkuran. Hyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔnhu wahyeɛ na boa wɔn ma wɔnsua sɛdeɛ yɛkasa. Kyerɛ wɔn baabi a wɔbɛnya mmoa.

question: Nnwuma anaa mmoa foforo bɛn na wɔtaa de ma ka dabere ne adan ho mmoa ho de di mmabun a wɔwɔ ɔhaw tebea horow mu ahiade ahorow nyinaa ho dwuma?
answer: Ebia wobetumi anya dabere ne adan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛho ka sua anaasɛ wɔrentua hwee mma mmabun a wontumi ntua ho ka. Mpɛn pii no, aban banyɛbea ne ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔnyɛ adwuma mfa hwehwɛ mfasoɔ (nonprofit organizations) ma atenaeɛ a yɛntua hwee anaa yɛtua sika kakra bi ma wɔn a wɔhia mmoa.Bio nso, sika mmoa ahyehyɛdeɛ, mpɔtam hɔ nneyɛeɛ, ne mmoa sika a ɛfiri mmaa mmaa bɛtumi atua ɛka a ɛfa atenaeɛ, aduane, akwantuo, ne nneɛma titiriw foforɔ a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ ahohia mu hia ho.

question: So wobetumi de nnuro a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ adi dwuma sɛ awo ano aduru a wɔde siw ano daa, anaasɛ wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma bere ne bere mu wɔ tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ mu nkutoo?

question: Dɛn ne ahye a ɛfata a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde si hɔ wɔ abusuabɔ a wɔne nnipa a wɔwɔ nna mu osuahu ahorow gu ahorow mu?
answer: Bu wɔn akwantu no: Obiara hwehwɛ nna mu wɔ n’ankasa ahoɔhare so. Kwati nhyɛso anaa atemmu. Di nkitaho pefee: Ka w’anidaso ne ahotɔ dodow ho asɛm. Tie wɔn de na bu wɔn ahye nso. Fa w’adwene si nea wokyɛ so: Sɛ́ anka wobɛtwe adwene asi nsonsonoe ahorow so no, fa w’adwene si nea mobom ani gye ho ne nea ɛma mo abusuabɔ mu yɛ den no so. Mommom sua ade: Momma mo ani nnye ho sɛ mubesua wɔn nna mu osuahu ahorow a momfa mo ho nhyɛ mu. Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ohu nneɛma pii a, ebetumi ama yɛanya ntease. Fa ahye a mo nyinaa hyia: Monnye ntom wɔ obu suban a ɛfa obiara ho, a osuahu mfa ho (e.g., pene, nkitahodi).
