question: Dɛn ne nna mu nyarewa (STIs) na mɛyɛ dɛn asiw bi ano?
answer: STI yɛ nyarewa a efi onipa biako hɔ kɔ foforo mu denam nna mu nkitahodi biara a ɛyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a efi awotwaa mu, akyi berɛmo mu, anaa anom. STI ahorow a ɛtaa ba no bi ne chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis, HPV (onipa papillomavirus), HIV/AIDS (nnipa nipadua mu nkwammoaa a ɛko tia nyarewa mmoawa), ne herpes. Sɛ obi nya STI a, obetumi ada sɛnkyerɛnne ne nsɛnkyerɛnne adi anaasɛ ɔrenkyerɛ sɛnkyerɛnne biara ntɛm ara. Sɛ ɛhaw wo sɛ ebia wowɔ STI a, ɛho hia sɛ wokɔ akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo no kɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu foforo. STI a Wobesiw Ano: Ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so sen biara a wobɛfa so asiw STI ano ne sɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi nna mu nkitahodi biara ho. Nanso, sɛ wo ne obi da a, fa kɔndɔm di dwuma. Sɛ wode kɔndɔm di dwuma a, ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya STI ne nyinsɛn nso so. Kɔndɔm: Sɛ wode kɔndɔm (latex anaa polyurethane) di dwuma bere nyinaa na wode di dwuma bere nyinaa wɔ nna mu adeyɛ biara mu a, ebetumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya STI so kɛse. Dental dams: Dental dams yɛ plastic ahinanan a wɔde di dwuma bere a wɔde ano reda de ayɛ akwanside wɔ w’ano ne wo hokafo no hokafo awotwaa ntam. ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi benya STI bere a wɔde ano reda no so. Nkitahodi: Wo ne wo hokafo (hokafo) nkasa pefee ne nokwaredi mu fa nna mu akwahosan ho nsɛm ne nhwehwɛmu a wobɛyɛ sɛ ebia wowɔ STI ho. Sɛ woyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ wowɔ STI a, ɛho hia sɛ wodi ayaresa no so na wowie na woma wo hokafo nso gye ayaresa. Vaccination: Vaccines betumi abɔ wo ho ban afi STIs binom te sɛ HPV ne Hepatitis B. Kɔ akwahosan asoɛe a ɛbɛn wo na wo ne mmabun akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo nkasa ma wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne vaccination.

question: Asɛyɛde bɛn na nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔyɛ ne wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma no wɔ wɔ hwɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ ma wɔayɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm ho mfonini a edi mu na obu wo mu no mu?

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi adi atenka fam nsɛnnennen a ɛba bere a me ne obi bɛbɔ ne ɔdɔ mu abusuabɔ bere a meyɛ ɔbabun no ho dwuma? (pow, ahoɔyaw, nkitahodi) .
answer: Pow yɛ asetena fã a ɛfata. Sua biribi fi mu na kɔ w’anim. Fa w’adwene si obuo a wubenya wɔ wo ho so. Ahoɔyaw: Wo ne wo hokafo nkasa mfa ahobammɔ a wunni ho. Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee betumi aboa ma wɔanya ahotoso. Nkitahodi: Fa nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a ɛfata di dwuma de siesie ntawntawdi na fa fapem a ɛyɛ den ma mo abusuabɔ. kasa kyerɛ mmabun akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo wɔ intanɛt so anaa ankasa

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi akasa ama  nhyehyɛe ne mmara ahorow a ɛbɔ wɔn hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ ano aduru ne nhomasua ho nnwuma a edi mũ ho ban bere a wobu abrabɔ pa nnyinasosɛm ahorow te sɛ ahofadi ne kokoamsɛmu?
answer: Mmabun betumi akasa afa wɔn hokwan ahorow denam: Mmara, nhyehyɛe, ne akwankyerɛ ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ne mmabun hokwan ahorow ho a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho no so. Akuo a mmabun di anim a wɔkasa akyerɛ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, de wɔn ho ahyɛ ɔsatuo mu, na wɔde wɔn suahunu ne wɔn adwene akyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ, apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ. Mpanyimfo a wɔboa, mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne mmara ho abenfo a wɔbɛyɛ biako de ayɛ nhyehyɛe ho nyansahyɛ ahorow a egyina adanse so ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛde mmabun a wobenya nna mu apomoden ho nnwuma a edi mu di kan. Dawurubɔ kuro ntentan, abasɛm, ne nhyiamu afoforo a wɔde bedi dwuma de ama nkurɔfo ate ase, akasa atia animtiaabu, na wɔaboaboa ɔmanfo mmoa ano ama nna mu apomoden ho nhyehyɛe ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfata mmabun.

question: Hyɛ mmabun nkuran ma wɔne apomoden ho ɔbenfo bi nsusuw asiane ahorow ne nea ɛhaw wɔn ankorankoro ho mfa nkyerɛ wɔn ankasa akwankyerɛ.
answer: Onipa biara ne nyinsɛn yɛ soronko. Ebia nea ebetumi ayɛ asiane ama obiako no renyɛ obi foforo. Ɛho hia sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bi susuw w’ankorankoro asiane ne nea ɛhaw wo ho. Wobetumi: Asusuw wo tebea pɔtee no ho: Wɔbɛsusuw w’aduruyɛ ho abakɔsɛm, w’asetena mu su, ne w’abusua abakɔsɛm ho na wɔate w’ankorankoro asiane ahorow ase. Fa akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wo ho ma: Wobetumi agyina asiane ahorow a ɛwɔ wo so so akasa ama nneyɛe pɔtee bi anaa nsakrae a wobɛyɛ na ama nsɛnnennen a ebetumi aba no so atew. Bua wo nsɛmmisa: Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wubebisa nsɛm a ɛfa dadwen biara a wowɔ ho.

question: Dɛn ne ɔhaw anaa akwanside ahorow a atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo betumi ahyia bere a wɔde nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛm rekɔma wɔn atipɛnfo no?
answer: Ebia ɔhaw no bi ne: Nsɛm anaa nneɛma a ɛyɛ nokware a wonnya. Animtiaabu ne adwenem naayɛ a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nsɛmti ho. Ɔsɔretia anaa ɔsɔretia a efi atipɛnfo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo hɔ. Ntetee anaa mmoa a anohyeto wom a wɔde ma atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo. Amammerɛ anaa asetena mu gyinapɛn ahorow a esiw nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho no kwan.

question: Dɛn ne nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ, na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun a wɔayi nyinsɛn agu?
answer: Nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ (PAC) kyerɛ aduruyɛ ne atinka fam mmoa a wɔde ma ankorankoro bere a wɔayi nyinsɛn agu akyi. Ɛho hia kɛse ma mmabun a wɔayi nyinsɛn agu efisɛ: Ɛboa ma wɔn nipadua ne nkate fam yiyedi. Ɛde ayaresa a ɛho hia ma de di nsɛnnennen anaa nsunsuanso bɔne biara ho dwuma. Ɛde mmoa ne akwankyerɛ ma de boa mmabun ma wɔkyerɛ wɔn atinka ne atinka ahorow a ɛfa nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho osuahu no ho. Ɛma wɔn ho tɔ wɔn na ɛboa mmabun ma wɔsan fi wɔn dwumadi ahorow a wɔtaa yɛ no ase a biribiara nhaw wɔn. Ɛboa ma wosiw nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da

question: Ɛdeɛn ne kokoam yɛ a yɛka no brɔfo mu 'confidentiality'  wɔ ayaresa mu, na adɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun?
answer: Kokoam mu nsɛm 'confidentiality' yɛ asɛdeɛ a ɛda ayaresafoɔ so sɛ wɔbɛbɔ ayarefoɔ kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Ɛho hia ma mmabun efisɛ ɛma wɔtumi kɔ ayaresabea kɔhwehwɛ mmoa (te sɛ awoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ho) a wɔnsuro sɛ obi bɛte wɔn asɛm. Nanso, hyɛ no nsow sɛ mmara tumi ma kwan ma wɔpae mu ka kokoam nsɛm bi.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi adi nnipa ne osuahu ahorow a ɛda ntam, a abusuakuo, mmusuakuw, nyamesom, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea ka ho ho dwuma, de ahyɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛka obiara ho na ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu ama mmabun nyinaa ho nkuran?
answer: Ɛsɛ sɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no di nnipa a wɔyɛ ne osuahu ahorow a ɛda ntam, a abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, nyamesom, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne asetra mu sikasɛm tebea ka ho ho dwuma, de hyɛ ɔhwɛ a ɛka obiara ho na ɛfata wɔ amammerɛ mu ho nkuran ma mmabun nyinaa denam: Ahorow a wogye tum: Mmabun nipasu ne osuahu ahorow a ɛtwam a wogye tum no hwɛ hu sɛ wɔayɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow no sɛnea ɛne wɔn soronko no hyia ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ. Nsonsonoeɛ a wɔbɛdi ho dwuma: Nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ ASRH dwumadie ne nea ɛfiri mu ba a wɔbɛhunu wɔ akuo ahodoɔ mu na wɔadi ho dwuma no boa ma pɛyɛ a ɛnni hɔ no so tew na ɛma apomoden mu pɛyɛ nya nkɔsoɔ. Nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho ahyɛ mu: Mmeae a mmabun bɛte nka sɛ wɔsom bo, wobu wɔn, na wɔte wɔn ase no hyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ ASRH nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, na ɛde apomoden mu nkɔso pa ba.

question: So afotu anaa ayaresa ho nhyehyɛe "counseling and therapy sessions" ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔboa wɔn wɔ Intanɛt so no?
answer: Yiw, virtual afotu anaa ayaresa dwumadie bi wɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔpɛ intanɛt so mmoa. Saa dwumadie yi taa de: "Video" anaa telefon so nhyiamu a wɔne ayaresa anaa afotufoɔ a wɔwɔ tumi krataa yɛ, a ɛma kokoamsɛm ne kwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya adwenemyareɛ ho mmoa. Intanɛt so akwan a ahobanbɔ wom a wɔde bɛyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔakɔ, wɔne ayaresa ho adwumayɛfoɔ adi nkitaho, na wɔanya ayaresa ho nneɛma ne nnwinnadeɛ. Flexible options for therapy modalities, including individual afotu, abusua ayaresa, ne kuw ayaresa, a wɔayɛ ama mmabun ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ. Beae te sɛ "Tranquil Therapeutic Consult" wɔ Adjiriganor, Accra (Tel: 0244 956 907/ 054 715 0192 / 027 299 8593) de ankorankoro ne virtual afotuo dwumadie ma nnipa a wɔadi mfeɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa. Afotufoɔ a wɔwɔ ɔman ahokwasan nhwehwɛmu "Ghana Health Service" nso abue wɔn ani ama virtual nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ client pɛ a.

question: Nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow bɛn na akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔyɛ ma mmabun taa tua ho ka?
answer: Akwahosan ho insurance nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ ma mmabun taa tua nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho ka, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne afotu. Nhwehwɛmu, nhwehwɛmu, ne ayaresa a wɔde ma wɔ nna mu nyarewa (STIs) ho. Awo akwahosan ho nhwehwɛmu, a wɔn baabi baabi (pelvic) mu nhwehwɛmu ne Pap smear ka ho. question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na m’adwene mu apɔmuden ka me nna ne awo apɔmuden a mepaw? (adwenemhaw a ɛka sɛnea wɔhwɛ wɔn ho, nipadua mfonini a ɛka nna mu abusuabɔ)

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nnuru anaa nea broni ka no 'supplements' nnuru ne awo ano aduru a ɛma nipadua a aborɔfo ka no 'hormonal birth control' no yɛ adwuma di nkitaho?
answer: Nnuru anaa a aborɔfo ka no 'supplements' nnuru bi a wɔde ka ho betumi ne awo ano aduru a ɛma nipadua no yɛ adwuma a aborɔfo ka no 'hormonal birth control' di nkitaho, na ɛtew sɛnea etu mpɔn no so. Nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ ni: Ka nnuru ne nnuru a wɔde ka aduan ho a wonom nyinaa ho asɛm kyerɛ w’akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma obi, nnuru a wɔtɔn, ne nhabannuru a wɔde ma. Wobetumi ahwɛ sɛ ebia nkitahodi ahorow betumi aba na wɔakamfo nnuru foforo anaa akwan a wɔfa so siw awo ano sɛ ɛho hia a. Nnyae nnuru anaa nnuru a wɔde ka aduan ho biara nom a wonkɔ wo duruyɛfo nkyɛn.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, asetra, ne mfiridwuma mu nneɛma hyehyɛ mmabun osuahu ahorow wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer: Amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow, asetra mu nkɔso, ne mfiridwuma mu nkɔso na ɛkyerɛ mmabun osuahu ahorow a ɛfa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdeɛ ho wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho. Amammerɛ mu adwene wɔ nna ho betumi anya nsɛm a ɛwɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so ne sɛnea wobu no so nsunsuanso. question: Dɛn ne ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo (prenatal care), na dɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun a wɔnyem?
answer: Prenatal care: Nkyerɛase: Ɔhwɛ ansa na wɔawo no fa aduruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu ne akwankyerɛ a wɔde ma ankorankoro a wɔnyem de hwɛ hu sɛ wobenya nyinsɛn ne awo a ɛfata. Nea ɛho hia: Hwɛ Apɔwmden so: Ɛboa ma wɔhwɛ nea onyinsɛn no ne akokoaa a ɔrenyin no nyinaa apɔwmuden. Sɛ wohu ɔhaw anaa yareɛ bi a ntɛm a, ɛma ahwɛfoɔ tumi de wɔn ho gye mu wɔ berɛ a ɛsɛ mu. Nhomasua ne Mmoa: Ɛma nkyerɛkyerɛ pa fa wɔ aduane, apɔw-mu-tentennee, malaria ano siw ne nsɛmti a ɛfa nyinsɛn ho. Te Asiane So: Ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔhaw ahorow bi ba berɛ a wɔnyem, ne awoɔ mmerɛ mu no so.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mpɔtam hɔ akannifo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow betumi aboa ma nkurɔfo ate nsɛmti ne nsɛm a ɛfa mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho?
answer: Nkyerɛkyerɛ ne Nhyiamu: Akannifoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ama nhyiamu wɔ sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ mmeaeɛ de akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere ho. question: Nsusuasɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ nna mu dwumadi a wɔmmɔ ho ban, te sɛ nyinsɛn ne nyarewa a wonya fi nna mu yareɛ (STI) mu?
answer: Nyinsɛn: Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban, baabi a wɔmfa nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano nni dwuma no betumi ama wanyinsɛn. Eyi ba bere a mmadwoa ma ɛwo bi nyinsɛn wɔ ɔbea awo nhyehyɛe mu no. Nyinsɛn betumi de nipadua, nkate, ne asetra mu nsakrae aba, na ehia sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe na wosiesie wɔn ho yiye. Nna mu Nyarewa (STI): Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna a wɔmmɔ ho ban nso de ankorankoro to asiane mu sɛ wobenya nna mu yareɛ' STI'. Eyinom yɛ nyarewa a ɛnam nna mu nkitahodi so nya. STI ahorow a ɛtaa ba no bi ne chlamydia, akisikuru, akisikuru, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu akisikuru, HIV/AIDS, ne HPV (Human Papillomavirus). Sɛ wɔansa STI ahorow no betumi de akwahosan ho haw a emu yɛ den aba, a nea ɛka ho ne awo a wontumi nwo, yare a ɛma obi ho hyehye no wɔ akyi berɛmo mu, awotwaa mu kokoram (a efi HPV mu), ne asiane a ɛkɔ soro sɛ wobenya HIV. question: Mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ obi hwehwɛ sika ho afotuo firi adwumfoɔ hɔ, na ɛkwan bɛn so na mmabun bɛtumi anya saa nnwuma yi bi sɛ ɛho hia wɔn a?
answer: Sika ho afotuo anaa mmoa a obi bɛhwehwɛ afiri adwumfoɔ hɔ betumi ama mmabun anya akwankyerɛ a ɛfa wɔn ho, nneɛma a ɛyɛ papa a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma, ne nimdeɛ a ɛfiri adwumfoɔ hɔ de aboa wɔn ma wɔasi sika ho gyinaeɛ a ɛfata.Sika ho afotufofoɔ tumi de mmoa ma wɔ nneɛma ahodoɔ mu te sɛ:Sika a wɔde yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ (budgeting)Sika a wɔde hyɛ adwuma mu (investing)Ɛka a wɔbɛtumi atua anaa wɔahwɛ so (debt management)Pɛnkyina ho nhyehyɛeɛ (retirement planning)Ɛno nyinaa gyina obiara botaeɛ ne tebea sononko so.Mmabun betumi anya saa nnwuma yi denam:Banka ahodoɔ (banks)Sika korabea ahodoɔ (credit unions)Sika ho nhyehyɛeɛ nnwumakuo (financial planning firms)Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfasoɔ (nonprofit organizations) a ɛde sika ho afotuo anaa mmoa a ɛnni sika anaa ne boɔ yɛ den ma.Nea ɛka ho ne sɛ, nwomasua asoɛeɛ pii ne mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ yɛ nhyiamu anaa ntsetsee a ɛfa sika ho nimdeɛ ne nehwɛso ho nsɛm, a ɛtumi yɛ mmoa a ɛho hia paa ma mmabun a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn sika ho nimdeɛ ne nsaano adwuma kɔ so

question: Ɛhe na mmabun betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm ara, na akwan horow bɛn na wobetumi afa so, te sɛ nea broni ka no 'over-the-counter pills', nnuru a wɔkyerɛw ma wɔn, anaa kɔbere IUD  nea broni ka no 'copper IUD' a wɔde hyɛ mu?
answer: Mmabun betumi anya nnuru a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano ntɛm ara afi mmeae ahorow, a nnurutɔnbea ahorow, akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo, ayaresabea ahorow a wɔyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe, ne ɛtɔ mmere bi mpo a sukuu anaa kɔlege akwahosan asoɛe ahorow ka ho. question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun tumi siesie ntawntawdi biara a ɛda wɔn ankasa gyidi ne wɔn som mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne deɛ wɔn som mu mpaninfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ fa nna ne awoɔ ho nyansafuɔ gyinaeɛ ho?
answer: Mmabun betumi asiesie ntawntawdi a ebetumi aba wɔn ankasa nyamesom gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow ne ne deɛ wɔn som mu mpaninfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ fa nna ne awoɔ ho nyansafuɔ gyinaeɛ ho denam, adwenem nhwehwɛmu, ne nkɔmmɔdie a wɔbɛfa mu. question: Nkwammoaa bɛn na ɛka ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na dɛn na ɛyɛ?
answer: Ntini ahorow pii na ɛka ho wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu, na emu biara wɔ dwumadi pɔtee bi: Estrogen: Saa hormone yi na ɛma mmeawa nufu nyin, wɔn asen trɛw, ne mmea nna mu su afoforo a ɛto so abien. Ɛsan nso di dwuma wɔ brayɛ a ɛhwɛ so no mu. Testosterone: Saa hormone yi na ɛma ɛnne no mu dɔ, anim ne nipadua mu nhwi nyin, ntini nyin, ne mmarima nna mu su afoforo a ɛto so abien. Nkwammoaa a Ɛma Onyin: Sɛnea edin no kyerɛ no, onyin hormone na ɛma onyin ntɛmntɛm wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Ɛkanyan nnompe, ntini, ne akwaa ahorow nyin. Adrenal Hormones: Nkwammoaa a adrenal glands no yɛ te sɛ cortisol ne DHEA nso kɔ soro wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu. Saa nkwaadɔm yi betumi aka adwene, ahoɔden dodow, ne sɛnea nipadua no yɛ n’ade wɔ adwennwen ho. Saa nkwaadɔm yi bom yɛ nsakrae a ɛkɔ so wɔ wo nipadua mu wɔ wo mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu no ho nhyehyɛe. Bere a ɛtɔ mmere bi a nsakrae yi betumi ate nka sɛ ɛyɛ den dodo no, ne nyinaa yɛ adeyɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛma obi nyin no fã.

question: Dwuma bɛn na pene a wɔpene so di wɔ ɔhaw ne basabasayɛ a wosiw ano wɔ abusuabɔ ne nna mu nkitahodie mu?

question: Sɛn na amammerɛ mu nnyinasosɛm ne gyinapɛn nya nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna ho apene so (consent), nna mu atirimɔdensɛm (sexual violence), ne nna mu mogyahyehyɛeɛ anaa ɔtaa (harassment) ho wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ mu?
answer: Amammere mu atetesɛm ne gyinapɛn ahodoɔ nya nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa kwan mma (consent), nna ho mmonnaatoɔ, ne nhyɛsoɔ ho wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu so tumi denam: Sɛnea wɔbu mmarima ne mmaa dwuma, tumi, ne ayɔnkofa a ɛde ba akyerɛ (Dictating attitudes): Eyi bɛtumi aka sɛnea nkurɔfoɔ te kwan mma ne suban a ɛfata ase no.Amuo anaa animguaseɛ a atwa nna ho nsɛm ho ahyia so tumi (Influencing stigma): Eyi bɛtumi aka sɛnea wɔn a asɛm no ato wɔn pɛ sɛ wɔba abɔ amanneɛ na wɔhwehwɛ mmoa no.Akwan a mpɔtam fa so yɛ nna ho nsɛm ho biribi a wɔayɛ no (Shaping responses): Ebi ne sɛ, ebia wɔbɛgye nea asɛm no ato no adi, wɔbɛboa no, na wɔabɔ no ho ban, anaasɛ wɔbɛbɔ no soboɔ na wɔabu no animguaseɛ.Kwan a wɔfa so te kwan mma, nna ho mmonnaatoɔ, ne nhyɛsoɔ ase a nnyinasoɔ ne amammere, nyamesom, ne atetesɛm (Providing frameworks): Wɔde saa nnyinasoɔ yi na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm no mu.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya ahye a ɛfata wɔ nna mu abusuabɔ mu na makura mu? ɔkwan bɛn so na metumi aka ho asɛm yiye?

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akyerɛ sɛ mewɔ kwan ahorow sɛ ɔbabun a wadi dɛm wɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea?

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ako ama  mmoa ne nhyehyɛe ɛwɔ  nyinsɛnyiguoɔ akyi  akɔ soro ama mmabun a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam anaa me mantam mu?
answer: Wubetumi ako ama sɛ  wɔanya nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho nnwuma a akɔ soro wɔ: Nhumu a wobɛma akɔ soro: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo mpɔtam hɔfo hia a nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ ho hia ne hia a ehia sɛ wonya nnwuma a wobetumi anya ama mmabun. Fa nsɛm ma wɔ baabi, bere ne ɔkwan a wobɛfa so anya nnwuma a ɛtete saa Ho a wo ne Ahyehyɛde ahorow no bedi nkitaho: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ awo akwahosan ahyehyɛde ahorow anaa akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no nyɛ biako na ama nkurɔfo ate ase na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a ɛbɛma nyinsɛn a woyi agu akyi hwɛ a wobenya no tu mpɔn. Mpɔtam Hɔ Ananmusifoɔ a Wobɛdi Dwuma: Kɔ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ayɛfoɔ anaa ananmusifoɔ nkyɛn ma wɔnkyerɛ wo haw ahorow na wɔkamfo sika anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛkɔ soro ama nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ adwuma. W’asɛm a Wobɛka: Sɛ wote nka sɛ wo ho tɔ wo a, ka w’ankasa osuahu ahorow wɔ nyinsɛn a woyi gu akyi hwɛ a wubenya ne nkɛntɛnso a enyaa w’akwahosan ne wo yiyedi so de maa nkurɔfo hui na ɛtew animtiaabu so. question: Gyinaɛ bɛn na amammerɛ wɔ fa SRH ayaresa hwehwɛeɛ ho, na dɔkotafoɔ bɛyɛ dɛn aboa?

question: Dwuma bɛn na nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban te sɛ HPV aduru no di wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne STI a wosiw ano mu?
answer: Nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban te sɛ human papillomavirus (HPV) aduro no di dwuma titiriw wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne STI a wosiw ano mu. HPV aduro no boa ma wɔbɔ obi ho ban fi mmoawa ahorow a ɛde nyarewa ba. Ɛdenam HPV a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban ansa na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ nna mu so no, ankorankoro betumi atew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya mmoawa no na wɔde akɔ wɔn ahokafo nkyɛn no so. Bio nso, sɛ wɔde nnuru a wɔde bɔ obi ho ban fi ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nyarewa afoforo te sɛ hepatitis B ho a, ebetumi ama ahobammɔ a ɛwɔ ɔyare mmoawa a wobetumi de akɔ nna mu no ayɛ kɛse bio.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ mmeae a wɔboa anaa mpɔtam a wɔbu nneyɛe a ɛma wosusuw nneɛma ho sɛ ɛsom bo, hyɛ ho nkuran, na wodi ho afahyɛ sɛ ɔkwan a ɛfa biribiara ho a wɔfa so hyɛ adwenemyare, yiedi, ne mmabun nkɔso pa ho nkuran?

Eyi bɛtumi ahwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ atipɛnfo mmoa akuw, afotu nhyehyɛe ahorow, anaa nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔde wɔn adwene si adwenemyare, yiyedi, ne mmabun nkɔso pa so. Sɛ wɔyɛ mmeae a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔwɔ ahobammɔ sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi, akyɛ wɔn suahu ahorow, na wɔaboa wɔn ho wɔn ho a, ɛma wɔte nka sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn dea na wɔama wɔn tumi. Mpanyimfo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo a wɔhyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wonhu mmabun mmɔdenbɔ wɔ nneyɛe a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho a wɔde bedi dwuma mu na wɔagye atom no hyɛ hia a ɛho hia no mu den na ɛhyɛ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn nyɛ wɔn mma kɛse wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.

question: Dɛnna mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a anohyeto wom kyerɛ wɔ mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso ho, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi afa mmara mu nsakrae so adi eyinom ho dwuma?
answer: Mmara ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a anohyeto wom betumi anya mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan mu nsunsuanso so nkɛntɛnso bɔne denam nsɛm a ɛfata a wobenya, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe a ahobammɔ wom, ne nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a wɔbɛto ano hye so. Mmara mu nsakrae ho hia na ama wɔadi kwan ahorow a mmabun wɔ sɛ wonya akwahosan, nhomasua, ne ahofadi no so.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na abusua nhyehyɛe ne nna ho nkɔmmɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa ɔbea ne ɔbarima nna ho, ne abusuabɔ pa ho hyia?
answer: Ma nkurɔfo nhu hia a abusua nhyehyɛe ho hia ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so ma mmabun. Nhomasua Ɔsatu: Yɛ ɔsatu anaa nhyiam ahorow ho nhyehyɛe de hyɛ nhomasua ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma a wobenya ho nkuran. Fa Atumfoɔ Di Dwuma: Wo ne mpɔtam hɔ atumfoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe no kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛma abusua nhyehyɛe ho nnwuma a wobenya no atu mpɔn. Nneɛma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma: Mmoa akuw: Kɔka anaa yɛ mmoa akuw a wɔkamfo awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow kyerɛ. Ahyehyɛde Ahorow a Wɔnnyɛ Mfaso: Hwehwɛ akwankyerɛ fi ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfaso a wɔde wɔn adwene si nna mu akwahosan ne abusua nhyehyɛe ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo so no hɔ.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na sukuu ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow betumi aboa ma wɔabɔ mmɔden sɛ wobesiw "HIV" ano na wɔasa mmabun yiye?
answer: Sukuu ne nwomasua asoɛeɛ bɛtumi aboa ama wɔanya "HIV" ano aduru ne ayaresa mmɔdenbɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri ama mmabun denam nna mu akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa mfeɛ pɔtee a wɔde bɛka adesua nhyehyɛeɛ no ho, ama wɔanya nna mu akwahosan ho dwumadie wɔ beaeɛ hɔ anaa ɛnam nnipa a wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ akɔma wɔn so, ɛsɛ sɛ SHEP Ntamgyinafoɔ di anim wɔ nteteeɛ a ɛfa adwumayɛfoɔ ne asuafoɔ ho wɔ HIV ho nimdeɛ ho, ne sukuu tebea a ɛboa na ɛka obiara ho.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nyiyim ahorow a ɛka bom, te sɛ mmusua mu nyiyim, tumidi, ne adesuakuw mu nyiyim ma nyiyim a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn mu ba no yɛ kɛse, na akwan bɛn na wɔfa so di pɛyɛ a enni hɔ yi ho dwuma?
answer: Nyiyim ahodoɔ a ɛbom ba, te sɛ abusua-nyiyim (racism), dɛm-die nyiyim (ableism), ne ohia ne ahonyadeɛ mu mpapahwee (classism), hyɛ mmaa ne mmarima nyiyim ne anim-mmanneɛ mu den. Eyi ma nnipa a wɔhyia nyiyim ahodoɔ pii no hyia mpanneɛ ne mpapahwee foforɔ a ɛboro deɛ ankorankorɛ hyia so.Ɛhia sɛ yɛfa akwan a ɛka asɛm ahodoɔ yi bom (intersectional approaches) na yɛatumi adi saa nneyɛeɛ a emu yɛ duru yi ho dwuma, na yɛahwɛ sɛ mmɔden a yɛbɔ de hyɛ mmarima ne mmaa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ nkuran no ka obiara bom na pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ wom. Eyi hwehwɛ sɛ yɛhu na yɛdi nipasu ne osuahu ahodoɔ a ɛbom ba onipa so ho dwuma, na yɛadwene sɛnea tumi ne kwan pa a binom wɔ no kyekyɛ wɔ asetena mu ahodoɔ mu, na yɛahyɛ mmara ne dwumadie a ɛbɛdi nyiyim ne mpapahwee nnyinasoɔ titiriw ho dwuma.Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi agyina ama saa nkabom kwan yi de atia mmarima ne mmaa nyiyim ne anim-mmanneɛ denam mpɔtam a wɔbu wɔn abamfoɔ nne a wɔbɛma so, mmoa a wɔde bɛma dwumadie a ɛdi nyiyim nkabom ho dwuma, ne nhyɛsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛma mpapahwee kɔ so dabiara a wobɛtia.

question: Dɛn ne telehealth(akwahosan mmoa a yɛnam mfiridwuma so nya), na ɛyɛ adwuma dɛn?
answer: Telehealth kyerɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma a wɔde telefon so nkitahodi mfiridwuma di dwuma wɔ akyirikyiri. Ɛma ayarefo tumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo susuw ho denam video so frɛ, telefon so frɛ, anaa nkrasɛm a ahobammɔ wom a enhia sɛ wɔkɔsra wɔn ankasa. Telehealth ma ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ obi benya aduruyɛ ho afotu, ahwehwɛ yare no, ayaresa, na wahwɛ so afi ne fie anaa beae biara a intanɛt anaa telefon so nkitahodi wɔ hɔ. Nanso, ebia ɛho behia sɛ ɔbabun kɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea hɔ kɔyɛ nipadua mu nhwehwɛmu bere a ɛho hia no

question: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsɛnnennen nea broni ka no 'dilemma' anaa nsemmisa a ɛtaa ba a mmabun betumi ahyia wɔ wɔn mmabunbere mu?
answer: Peneeɛ: Nea pene kyerɛ ne sɛnea wɔbɛka ahye ahorow ho asɛm wɔ abusuabɔ mu ntease. Ahintasɛm: Kokoam nsɛm a ehia ne hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔhwehwɛ mmoa anaa akwankyerɛ fi mpanyimfo hɔ a wɔbɛkari pɛ. Nyamesom mu Ntawntawdi: Nyamesom nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ankorankoro gyidi anaa osuahu ahorow ntam ntawntawdi a wɔde di dwuma. Atipɛnfo Nhyɛso: Sɛnea wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ade wɔ atipɛnfo nhyɛso a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe anaa sɔhwɛ ho ho gyinaesi. Intanɛt so Suban: Abrabɔ pa a wosusuw ho wɔ Intanɛt so, te sɛ ankorankoro ho nsɛm a wɔde ma anaasɛ nkitahodi a obu wom a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ, asetra, ne nhyehyɛe mu nneɛma nya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi anya, ɛka obiara ho, ne sɛnea etu mpɔn wɔ tebea horow ne mpɔtam ahorow mu no so nsusuanso, na anammɔn bɛn na mmabun betumi atu de adi akwanside ahorow ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ pɛyɛ ne ahorow ahorow a ɛwɔ saa mmeae yi mu no ho nkuran?
answer: Amammerɛ, asetena, ne nhyehyeɛ mu nneɛma bɛtumi anya nsusuansoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ mmeaeɛ a ahobanbɔ wɔ a wɔbɛtumi anya, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ adwuma yie wɔ tebea ahodoɔ ne mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu. Mmabun betumi adi akwanside ahorow ho dwuma na wɔahyɛ pɛyɛ ne ahorow ahorow ho nkuran wɔ saa mmeae yi mu denam nneyɛe a ɛfa amammerɛ ho na ɛfa ahodwiriw ho a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ, nyiyim ne adwemmɔne a wɔbɛkasa atia, ne akuw a wɔato wɔn hintidua nne a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛse no so. Wɔbɛtumi ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔde nnwuma ma ayɛ adwuma abom de ahunu na wɔadi nhyehyɛeɛ mu akwansideɛ a ɛmma obi nya kwan ne kyɛfa a ɔnya, te sɛ kasa mu akwansideɛ, sikasɛm mu nsonsonoeɛ, ne ananmusifoɔ a wɔnni ho dwuma. Ɛdenam akwan horow a wɔfa so di nkitaho ne nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛka obiara ho a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran so no, mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ no yɛ nea ankorankoro nyinaa gye akwaaba na ɛyɛ nea wobetumi akɔ hɔ, a wɔn fibea anaa wɔn nipasu mfa ho.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ne adwuma ahorow anaa akuw afoforo a wɔwɔ me mpɔtam hɔ ayɛ adwuma de ayɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so siw GBV ano? (adwumayɛ ne fekubɔ) .
answer: Hwehwɛ nnwumakuo Ahorow a Ɛwɔ Hɔ Dedaw: Hwehwɛ wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so anaa bisa wɔ mpɔtam hɔ mmeae ahorow sa nnwumakuo ahorow reyɛ adwuma wɔ GBV ano aduru ho. Kɔ hu wɔn na ka sɛ wobɛboa! Wo ne Sukuu ahodoɔ nyɛ adwuma: susu nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyiamu anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa GBV ano aduru ho ma asuafoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Mmabun ne Mpanyimfo Nkitahodi: Fa nyansahyɛ ma sɛ wo ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mpanyimfo di wɔn anim nyɛ biako mfa nyɛ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri (mpanyimfo akwankyerɛ + wo mmabun adwene).

question: Dɛn ne nneɛma bi a ebetumi afi nna ho gyinaesi mu aba, nea eye ne nea enye nyinaa, na mɛyɛ dɛn asusuw ho?
answer: nsunsuanso pa: Nkate fam abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ne abusuabɔ a ɛda wo ne wo hokafo ntam. Obu a wubenya wɔ wo ho ne ahotoso a wowɔ wɔ wo nna mu. Abusuabɔ a ɛda wo ne wo hokafo ntam no mu ayɛ den denam osuahu ahorow a wobɛkyɛ so. Nsunsuanso a enye: Asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ ne sɛ obi benya STI ne nyinsɛn a wɔanhyɛ da. Nkate mu nsunsuanso te sɛ nnuho anaa afɔdifɛɛ. Nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ so, a ntawntawdi anaa ntease a ɛnteɛ ka ho. Nsunsuanso no mu nsusuwi: Dwene nneɛma a ebefi wo gyinaesi ahorow mu aba mprempren ne daakye ho. Susuw sɛnea asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba no ne wo gyinapɛn ne wo botae ahorow hyia no ho. Nsɛm a Wobɛhwehwɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho fa akwan a wɔfa so siw nyinsɛn ano ne akwan a wɔfa so bɔ ho ban ho. Te asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba wɔ nna mu dwumadi ahorow mu no ase. Nkɔmmɔbɔ: Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa mfa asiane ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so ho. Hwehwɛ afotu fi ankorankoro a wogye wɔn di a wɔwɔ osuahu wɔ nna ho gyinaesi mu hɔ.

question: So akwan anaa dwumadi ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a m’abusua betumi abom ayɛ de ama yɛn adwenemyare ahorow atu mpɔn na ahyɛ yɛn abusuabɔ mu den?

question: Sɛn na yɛtete akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne sukuu adwumayɛfoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbetumi ahunu nsɛnkyerɛne wɔ adwenemyareɛ mu na watumi aboa asuafoɔ wɔ berɛ a ɛsɛ mu?
answer: Akyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa sɛnkyerɛnne ho. Kwan a wɔfa so kasa. Nwuma a wɔne afutufoɔ bom yɛ. Sukuu hyehyeɛ mu akwankyerɛ. Sukuu mu bammɔ.

question: Sɛ meyɛ nhwehwɛmu hu sɛ mewɔ STI a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ, na ayaresa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ?
answer: Sɛ nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ wowɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI) bi a:Hwehwɛ Ayaresabea Hwɛ: Kasa kyerɛ w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ ntɛm pa ara na moadi akwan a wobɛfa so asa yareɛ no ne anamon a ɛsɛ sɛ wotu ho nkɔmɔ.Di Aduroyɛ Akwankyerɛ So: Di akwankyerɛ a w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ de bɛma wo no so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Yei bɛtumi aka nnuru te sɛ "antibiotics," "antivirals," anaa "antiretrovirals," a ɛgyina nna mu yareɛ pɔtee a wowɔ no so.Bɔ Wo Nna mu Akunneaba (Partners) Amanneɛ: Bɔ obiara a wo ne no ana mmoa nna mu nkitahodie mmerɛ tiawa bi a atwam yi amanneɛ fa yareɛ no ho, na ama wɔn nso akɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu, na sɛ ɛhia a, wɔanya aduro na yareɛ no ammɛtrɛ kɔ baabiara.Yɛ Nna a Ahobammɔ Wom: Twentwɛn wo ho firi nna ho anaa fa "condoms" di dwuma yie mmerɛ biara na ama yareɛ no ammɛtrɛ ankɔ afoforɔ so mmerɛ a worenye aduro no.Aduroyɛ ahorow gu ahorow a ɛgyina nna mu yareɛ ko a wowɔ ne nneɛma afoforɔ so, enti ɛhia paa sɛ wo ne w’ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ bɔ mu yɛ adwuma na moanya aduro nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata wo paa.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi afa tebea horow a hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔpene so na wosi gyinae no betumi ne ɔmanfo anaa amammerɛ mu gyinapɛn ahorow abira mu?
answer: Yiw, ahyehyɛde ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔafa hokwan ahorow a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm ne nnwuma a wonya no mu. Ebia eyinom bi ne: Ayaresabea ahorow a ɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa adamfofa anaa apɔwmuden ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde kokoam nnwuma ne mmoa ma mmabun. Ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔnyɛ adwuma a mfaso wɔ so ne akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ de wɔn adwene sii nna ne awo apɔwmuden hokwan ahorow a mmerante ne mmabaa nya so. Hotlines anaa intanɛt so nneɛma a ɛde nsɛm, mmoa, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow ma. te sɛ Agoo SHE+ online platform denam 5100 a wobɛfrɛ so, YENKASA Nnɔmba a wontua hwee(0800202010), GHS-YMK ne nea ɛkeka ho Sukuu mu apɔwmuden asoɛe anaa afotufoɔ a wɔbɛtumi de akwankyerɛ ne mmoa ama asuafoɔ wɔ nnwuma a wɔbɛnya mu.

question: Dɛn ne akwan bi a mɛfa so ama ahotoso ne obuo ama yɛn ho yɛn ho wɔ m’abusuabɔ mu, ahyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, na me ne m’ahokafo anaa m’atipɛnfo abom asusuw asiane ahorow ho na wɔadi ho dwuma?
answer: Akwan a wɔfa so nya ahotoso ne obu ma wo yɔnko wɔ abusuabɔ mu, hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee, na wo ne ahokafo anaa atipɛnfo bɛbom asusuw asiane ahorow ho na wɔadi ho dwuma no bi ne: Ahye a emu da hɔ a wode besi hɔ: Ka w’ahye ho asɛm na di afoforo de ho asɛm, na woayɛ fapem a ɛbɛma ahotoso ne obu ama wo ho wo ho wɔ abusuabɔ mu. Tie a wode nsiyɛ: Tie wo hokafo anaa w’atipɛnfo adwene, nea ɛhaw wo, ne nea ɔpɛ, na da tema ne ntease adi. Nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee: Di nokware na da adi pefee wɔ wo nsusuwii, wo nkate, ne w’atirimpɔw ho, na hyɛ nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne ahotoso a wowɔ wɔ abusuabɔ mu ho nkuran. Gyinaesi a wɔkyɛ: Fa wo hokafo anaa w’atipɛnfo ka gyinaesi nhyehyɛe no ho, bom nsusuw asiane ahorow ho, nsusuw akwan horow a wobetumi afa so ho, na hwehwɛ ano aduru a wɔn baanu nyinaa pene so. Adwene a enhyia a wɔde obu ma: Gye adwene a ɛsonsonoe tom na bu no, de wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ mu na wɔyɛ apam bere a ɛho hia de siesie ntawntawdi anaa nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ asiane ho adwene mu.

question: Nneɛma anaa mmoa nkitahodi bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wohia mmoa a wɔde bɛfa ɔkwan a wɔfa so nya dabere ne adan ho dwumadie no mu?
answer: Mmabun betumi anya nneɛma ahorow ne mmoa nkitahodi ahorow de aboa wɔn ma wɔafa ɔkwan a wɔfa so nya dabere ne adan ho nnwuma mu: Mmoa ahomatrofo: Mpɔtam hɔ mmoa telefon anaa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo betumi de mmoa, nsɛm, ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn kɔ dabere ne adan ho nnwuma a ɛfata mu ntɛm ara. Asetra mu nnwuma ahorow: Aban adwumayɛbea ahorow anaa asetra mu nnwuma dwumadibea ahorow betumi de mmoa ama wɔ adan ho akwammisa, sikasɛm mu mmoa, ne mmoa afoforo a wɔde ma mmabun a wohia mmoa no ho. question: Akwan ahorow bɛn na yɛbɛfa so agyina nyiyimu ne osuahunu bɔne a ɛfa awoasɛm ho apomuden ho ano?
answer: Hwehwɛ Mmoa: kɔ nnamfo, abusuafo, anaa afotufo a wotumi de wɔn ho to wɔn so a wɔte ase na wonni atɛn nkyɛn. Atipɛnfo mmoa akuw anaa intanɛt so nhyiam ahorow betumi ama biakoyɛ ne ntease ama. Kyerɛkyerɛ Wo Ho: Sua hokwan ahorow a wowɔ ne nneɛma a wubetumi anya ho ade. Sɛ wunim hokwan ahorow a wowɔ a, ebetumi ama woanya tumi a wode bɛkasa atia nyiyim. Wo Ho Hwɛ: Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi ahorow a ɛma obi nya yiyedi te sɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, anigyede, ahomegye anaa adwennwen mu. Fa ayamhyehye ne nsɛm pa a wɔde si so dua di dwuma. Kamfo Nsakrae: Fa wo ho hyɛ akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ anaa ɔsatu ahorow a wɔko tia animtiaabu ne nyiyim mu. W’asɛm a wobɛkyɛ no betumi ama nkurɔfo ate ase na ɛde nsakrae aba. Adwumayɛfo Mmoa: Afotu betumi ama wɔanya akwan horow a wɔfa so gyina ano ne baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi adi osuahu ahorow ho dwuma. Fa telefon a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), ne PPA Yenkasa abɛɛfo ntentan beae (0800202010, whatsapp-0245118228) so ne afotufo di nkitaho.

question: Ne me kyɛ adwene a ɛfa asetra mu nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ apɔwmuden, ne sɛnea ebetumi anya STI asiane so nkɛntɛnso ho asɛm.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn betumi aboa mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ wɔ abusua no mu na wɔahyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea dwumadi ne akwanhwɛ ahorow ho ho nkuran?

Mmofra a wɔbɛma wɔn nhwɛsoɔ ahodoɔ ne mmarima ne mmaa dwumadie a ɛnyɛ atetesɛm mu dwumadie. Mmofra ahofadi ne gyinaesi a wɔbɛboa a ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho. Tebea a ahobammɔ ne mmoa wom a wɔbɛma mmofra ada wɔn adwene adi wɔ ahofadi mu a wonsuro sɛ wobebu wɔn atɛn anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ nyiyim.

question: Dɛn ne hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ pene a wɔde ma a nimdeɛ wɔ mu ne gyinaesi wɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer: Hokwan ahorow a wowɔ wɔ pene a wɔde ma wɔ nimdeɛ mu ne gyinaesi a wosi wɔ apɔwmuden ho no bi ne: Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wɔbɔ wo amanneɛ wɔ w’ayaresa tebea, ayaresa a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa, ne asiane ne mfaso a ebetumi aba ho. Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wubisa nsɛm na wohwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu fa w’apɔwmuden  ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho. Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wusi gyinae wɔ w’apɔwmuden ho, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wobɛpene ayaresa so anaasɛ wobɛpow, bere tenten a wobu wo sɛ wofata sɛ woyɛ saa no. Hokwan a wowɔ sɛ wode ɔpanyin anaa ɔkamfofo a wogye no di bɛka w’apɔwmuden ho gyinaesi ahorow ho, sɛ wopɛ anaasɛ ɛho hia a.

question: Nnyinasosɛm titiriw bɛn na ɛwɔ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ayɛ wɔn sika a wobenya ho nhyehyɛe de ayɛ sikakorabea de adi kan?
answer: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛe a etu mpɔn no hwehwɛ sɛ: Sika a wonya ne ɛka a wɔbɔ no akyi di: Wɔkyerɛw sika a wonya fi mu nyinaa na wɔkyekyɛ sika a wɔsɛe no mu akuwakuw de ate sika a wɔsɛe no ase na wɔakyerɛ mmeae a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nsakrae. Sika a wɔsɛe no: Sika a wɔbɛkyekyɛ ama ɛka a ɛho hia (ahiade) ne sika a wɔsɛe no wɔ wɔn pɛ mu (nea wɔpɛ) bere a wɔhwɛ hu sɛ wɔbɛkora sika a ɛdɔɔso a wɔde bedu sikasɛm botae ahorow ho no. Nhwehwɛmu ne nsakraeɛ: Sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɛhwɛ mu daa, nsakraeɛ a ɛhia a wɔbɛyɛ, na wɔakɔ so abu akontaa wɔ sikasɛm botaeɛ ho. Nneɛma a egye ntɛmpɛ ho nhyehyɛe: Sikakorabea a wɔbɛhyehyɛ de atua ɛka anaa ɔhaw ahorow a wɔnhwɛ kwan, na ama sikasɛm mu ahotɔ ne asomdwoe aba.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne abusua mufo betumi abɛyɛ wɔn a wɔboa mmabun a wɔadi dɛm mpɔtam hɔfo na wɔakamfo wɔn hokwan ahorow?
answer: Trɛw Nhumu mu: Kyerɛkyerɛ afoforo hokwan ne ahiade ahorow a mmabun a wɔadi dɛm wɔ wɔ nna ho. Nsɛnnennen Ho Nsusuwii hunu: Kasa tia nyiyim na hyɛ adwene a ɛka obiara ho wɔ dɛmdi ne nna ho nkuran. Boa Nhyehyɛeɛ a Ɛka Nnipa Ka ho: Kamfo nhyehyɛɛ a ɛbɛma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm anya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ.

question: Sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi de saa nneɛma yi adi dwuma yie?
answer: Sikasɛm mu mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ hɔ a wɔde bɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya nhomasua ne adwumayɛ ho ntetee. Eyinom bi ne sika a wɔde ma, mmoa a wɔde ma, sukuufo bosea, adwuma-adesua nhyehyɛe, ne sikasɛm mu mmoa a nhomasua asoɛe ahorow, aban ahyehyɛde ahorow, 'NGO' ahorow, ne ankorankoro ahyehyɛde ahorow de ma. Mmabun betumi afa saa nneɛma yi so yiye denam nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ akwan a ɛwɔ hɔ a wobetumi afa so, ntease a wɔbɛte wɔ fata a wɔfata ne akwammisa nhyehyɛe ho, akwankyerɛ a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi sukuu afotufo anaa sikasɛm mu mmoa ho afotufo hɔ, ne akwammisa nkrataa a wɔde bɛma wɔ bere ano na wɔawie no so. Bio nso, wobetumi ahwehwɛ sika foforo a wobenya te sɛ nnipadɔm sika ho nhyehyɛe, mpɔtam hɔ sika a wɔde ma, ne adesua mmoa nhyehyɛe ahorow a adwumawura boa a broni ka no 'employer-sponsorship tuition assistance programs'.

question: Mmara kwan so ahobammɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a wɔyem a wɔpaw sɛ wɔbɛfa wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma anaasɛ wɔbɛyɛ awofo, na nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔasisi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ wɔn awo akwan horow ho?
answer: Mmabun a wɔayem na wɔapaw sɛ wɔbɛma obi agye wɔn ba no ayɛ ne dea (adoption) anaa wɔbɛtete wɔn ba no ara no wɔ mmara mu ahobammɔ a ɛma wɔn kwan sɛ wɔsi wɔn ara wɔn gyinae, na wɔnya mmoa dwumadi ahorow, eyinom bi ne:Hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔsi wɔn ara wɔn pɛ so gyinae: Wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔsi gyinae a ɛfata wɔ kwan a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔfa so wɔ wɔn awo ho (reproductive options), sɛ ɛyɛ obi a obegye ba no ayɛ ne dea (adoption), wɔn ara wɔn mma ntetee, anaa mpopae (abortion). Ɛsɛ sɛ wosi saa gyinae yi wɔ wɔn pɛ mu a obiara nhyɛ wɔn, mpiar wɔn, anaa nnye wɔn nkyim.Akwanya a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔnya afotu, mmara mu mmoa, ne asetena mu mmoa: Wɔwɔ kwan sɛ wɔnya afotu ne mmara mu mmoa a ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔate wɔn hokwan ahorow ase, na wɔahu akwan horow a wobetumi afa so anya mmoa a ɛbɛma wɔatumi asi gyinae pa. .

question: Dwuma bɛn na atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔkasa ma mmofra (youth advocates), ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim betumi adi wɔ akwahosan nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔbɛhyɛ mu den ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ na ama mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan atu mpɔn no mu?
answer: Atipɛnfo akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne wɔn a wɔkasa ma mmofra (youth advocates), ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a mmabun di wɔn anim di dwuma titiriw wɔ apɔmuden nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔhyɛ mu den ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae a wɔbɛkamfo akyerɛ na ama ASRH atu mpɔn no mu. question: Fa nneɛma ma afotuo a wɔde ma ansa na wɔanyinsɛn a ebetumi aboa mmabun ma wɔasiesie wɔn ho ama nyinsɛn a ahoɔden wom sɛ wɔresusuw ho a.
answer: Sɛ woresusuw nyinsɛn ho a, afotu a wode ma ansa na woanyinsɛn no betumi aboa wo ma ɛyɛ nwonwa. Nneɛma bi ni: Nea broni ka no 'Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana' (PPAG): Ebia wɔde afotuo a wɔde ma ansa na wɔanyinsɛn (ebia ɛsono sɛnea ɛwɔ hɔ). Frɛ wɔn mmoa telefon (0244312151) na bisa (Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8am-5pm). Nea broni ka no 'Ghana Health Service' akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ne sukuu yareɛbea no de afotuo ma mmabun ansa na wɔanyinsɛn a wontua hwee. Ka w’akwahosan ho ɔyarehwɛfo anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo kasa Awo a wɔde hwɛ ansa na wɔayɛ no ho hia ma nyinsɛn nyinaa, nanso ɛho hia titiriw sɛ wowɔ asiane bi a. Sɛ wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bɛkasa a, ɛma wotumi de akwankyerɛ a ɛfata ma wɔn na wodi asiane ahorow a ebetumi aba ho dwuma. Sɛ woresusuw ho sɛ wubenyinsɛn a, afotu a wode ma ansa na woanyinsɛn no betumi ama woanya nsɛm a ɛsom bo ne mmoa.

question: Mmoa bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ ma mmabun a atipɛnfoɔ nhyɛso ɛreha wɔn ne nsunsuansoɔ a ɛde ba adwenemyare so?
answer: Sukuu akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ: Sukuu akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ betumi aboa, akyerɛkyerɛ kokoam ne nneɛma ahodoɔ bi so betumi aboa asuafoɔ a watipɛnfoɔ rehyɛ wɔn so ne wɔn a wɔwɔ adwenemhaw. Asoeɛ a wɔhwe adwenemhaw so ahomatorofo: Asoeɛ ahomatorofo bi te sɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ mmofra ho nsɛm, kokoam mmoa a wɔde boa mmabun wɔ ɔhaw mu (0800678678). Kuo a wɔboa: Sɛ wode woho bɛhye atipɛnfoɔ kuo a wɔn a wɔnimde wɔ adwenemhaw mu da ano, ɛbetumi aboa ama woatumi akyɛ suahunu, anya mmoa asane nso asua akwan ahodoɔ a wobetumi ako tipɛnfoɔ nhyɛsoɔ so. Ntentanfidie so mmoa:Ntentanfidie so kuo ahodoɔ a ɛhwɛ adwenemhaw na wɔboa atipɛnfoɔ betumi aboa wɔ ama wonsɛm a ɛho hia, afutusɛm ne ntipɛnfoɔ nkitahodie ama mmabun a wɔrehwehwɛ mmoa afiri wɔn atipɛnfoɔ hɔ ne adwenem apɔmden ho nyinaa. Mpɔtam kuo: Mpɔtam kuo ahodoɔ te se asɔrekuo ne ade betumi aboa aso nhyɛsoɔ a tipɛnfoɔ deba ne mmabun adwenem apɔmdensɛm ho nyinaa.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi aboa na wɔakamfo wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu "survivors" wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ 'sexual violence" mu, ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so na wobu wɔn ho nkuran, na wɔkasa tia suban ne nneyɛe a epira 'harmful attitudes" a ɛma nna mu basabasayɛ kɔ so wɔ wɔn sukuu, mmusua, ne mpɔtam hɔ?
answer: Mmabun betumi aboa na wɔakamfo wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu basabasayɛ mu "sexual violence", ahyɛ amammerɛ a ɛma wɔpene so na wobu wɔn ho nkuran, na wɔkasa tia suban ne nneyɛe a epira denam: Gyidi ne wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu a wɔbɛboa wɔn: Tie wɔn a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu no a wonni atɛn, de mmoa ne nea wɔagye atom ama, na wɔahyɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi mpanyimfo a wogye wɔn di anaa mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow hɔ. Atipɛnfo Nkyerɛkyerɛ: Fa atipɛnfo nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe, nsɛm a wɔka, anaa sohyial media ɔsatu ahorow so ma nkurɔfo nhu nna mu basabasayɛ, pene a wɔpene so, ne abusuabɔ pa ho. Mmonnaato Amammerɛ a Ɛyɛ Nsɛnnennen "Challenging Rape Culture": Kasa tia mmonnaato :"rape" ho asodi a wɔde to wɔn so, aguaman a wɔhyɛ wɔn aniwu, ne mmonnaato amammerɛ afoforo a ɛwɔ sukuu, mmusua, ne mpɔtam hɔ. Mpene a Wɔhyɛ Ho Nkɔso: Kamfo nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ a ɛka ho ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, ahye, ne abusuabɔ a obu wom ho. Wo ho a wode bɛhyɛ mu: Kɔka nhyehyɛe ahorow a sukuufo di anim ho, tu wo ho ma ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a wɔboa wɔn a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no, na fa wo ho hyɛ mmɔden a wɔbɔ de siw nna mu basabasayɛ ano na wɔhyɛ tumidi ho nkuran no mu.

question: Ahobammɔ ho haw bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa akwantu a mmabun betumi apaw bere a wɔrenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho?
answer: Aane, ebia ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa akwantu a mmabun betumi apaw bere a wɔrenya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow ho, a nea ɛka ho ne: Asiane a ɛwɔ akwanhyia anaa opira mu bere a wɔde ɔmanfo kar anaa kar a wɔde fa nnipa di dwuma, titiriw ma mmabun a wɔn nkutoo tu kwan. Nneɛma a wobetumi de akɔ mmeae a ahobammɔ nnim anaasɛ wonnim bere a wɔnantew anaa wɔde sakre rekɔ akwahosan ho mmeae ahorow, titiriw wɔ mmeae a nsɛmmɔnedi dɔɔso anaa kar akwan a ɛyɛ kyenkyenenn no. Ankorankoro ahobammɔ ne kokoam nsɛm ho dadwen, titiriw ma mmabun a wotu kwan kɔ akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ mmeae a wonnim anaasɛ wɔde kar ho nhyehyɛe di dwuma ne ahɔho. Asiane a ɛwɔ ɔhaw anaa nyiyim mu, titiriw ma mmabun a wofi nnipa a wɔato wɔn hintidua anaa wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ a ebia wobehyia adwemmɔne anaa ayayade bere a wɔde akwantu ho nhyehyɛe redi dwuma no.

question: Dɛn ne nna mu akwahosan pɔtee no bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho ma mmabun a wɔadi dɛm?
answer: Nneɛma ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wosusuw ho a egyina dɛmdi pɔtee no so. Nsɛntitiriw bi ni: Nkitahodi: Nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee ne ɔhokafo ho hia na ama wɔanya nna mu osuahu a ahobammɔ ne anigye wom. Sɛnea Wotumi Nya: Susuw nipadua mrɛ bere ahorow ne hia a ehia sɛ wonya mmeae a wotumi kɔ hɔ ma wo ne obi bɛbɔ abɛn no ho. Ɛyaw ano aduru: Mmofra a wɔadi dɛm bi betumi ama obi ate ɛyaw bere a ɔne obi reda. Wo ne oduruyɛfo nkasa mfa akwan horow a wɔfa so siw ɛyaw ano ho. Mfiri a ɛboa: Ebia mfiri a ɛboa wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa wɔ nna mu dwumadi mu. Wo ne akwahosan ho ɔbenfo bi hwehwɛ akwan horow a wobetumi apaw mu.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi aka m’ahiadeɛ ne m’ahyeɛ ahorow ho asɛm atwa nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho nkɔmmɔbɔ ho ahyia, berɛ a mimmu w’awerɛkyekye ne ahyeɛ nso?
answer: Ka w’ahiade ne w’ahye ahorow ho asɛm wɔ nsɛmti a ɛho hia a wo ne w’awofo besusu ho pefee ne nokwaredi mu no ho. Fa "Me" nsɛm no da w'atenka ne nea wopɛ adi, si so dua sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛma denhyɛ mu berɛ a wobu mo ho mo ho ahotɔ nso. Gye w’awofo ahiadeɛ ne n’ahyeɛ nso tom, na mombom  hwehwɛ kari pɛ a ɛbɛma wɔatumi adi nkitaho pefee berɛ a wodi mo ho mo ho atenka ne ahyeɛ ni.

question: So nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate kwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔde kokoam nsɛm ne kokoamsɛm sie wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu no ase?
answer: Aane, nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔate hokwan a wɔwɔ wɔ kokoamsɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho ase, a nea ɛka ho ne: Nhomasua nneɛma ne wɛbsaet ahorow a ɛde nsɛm a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho mmara ne hokwan ahorow ho ma Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe a egyina sukuu so a ɛka ho ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa kokoamsɛm ho Afotu adwuma ne mmoa akuw a wɔyɛ wɔn ho titiriw wɔ nna ne awo akwahosan ho ma mmabun Akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo a wɔde kokoam nsɛm ho nhyehyɛe ne akwan horow a wɔfa so sie ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a emu da hɔ ma

question: Sɛ mebu me nsa berɛ a minni fie a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?
answer: Sɛ wobu wo nsa bere a wunni fie a, mma ne ɛnhaw wo! Nea wubetumi ayɛ ni: Sɛ wowɔ pad anaa ntama a, fa di dwuma. Sɛ wunni brayɛ ho nnuru biara a, bisa w’adamfo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo bi sɛ wɔwɔ bi anaa. Sɛ wuntumi nnya pad anaa ntama a , wubetumi de tiafi krataa a wɔabobɔw adi dwuma sɛ bere tiaa mu adeyɛ kosi sɛ wubetumi anya nneɛma a ɛfata a wode bɛkɔ brayɛ mu. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wode kotoku anaa bag ketewa bi a wɔde ntama kakraa bi a bɛhyɛ mu, enti woasiesie wo ho bere nyinaa. Wubetumi nso ne sukuu ɔyarehwɛfo anaa ɔfotufo bi akasa afa nnuru a wɔde bɛyɛ wo ho yiye.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono ɔhwɛ a wɔde adwenemhaw ho nsɛm di dwuma wɔ akwan horow a wɔfa so hwɛ mmabun akwahosan ho wɔ amanne kwan so no ho?
answer: Ayaresa a ɛhyɛ amanehunu nso (Trauma-informed care) yɛ soronko wɔ kwan a yɛfa so hwɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa akwahosan daa no ho. Deɛ ɛma ɛyɛ soronko ne sɛ, saa kwan yi hu na ɛdi nsunuansoɔ a nnyigyeɛ ne amanehunu kɛseɛ bi (trauma) de ba obi asetena ne n'akwahosan so ho dwuma.Ɛsi so dua sɛ yɛbɛte obiara nea ɔfamu ne n'ahiadeɛ ase wɔ ne mmerɛ a ɔfaa amanehunu mu no ho, mmom nnyɛ sɛ yɛbɛdwene yadeɛ no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nkoara ho. Saa ayaresa kwan yi nso de ahotɔ, gyidie, ne nkabom di kan wɔ kwan a yɛfa so sa yadeɛ anaa yɛma obi ho dwo no mu.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahunu mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nteteeɛ (internships) wɔ wɔn mpɔtam?
answer: Mmabun betumi ahunu mmabun adwumayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nteteeɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam denam akwan ahorow so, a ebi ne: Sukuu ne kɔlɛgye adwuma mmoa: Sukuu pii ma nneɛma, nhyiam, ne adwuma ho amanneɛbɔ de boa asukuufoɔ ma wɔhunu nteteeɛ ne adwuma hokwan a ɛfa wɔn adesua ho. Intanɛt so adwuma mmeae ne wɛbsaet: Wɛbsaet te sɛ Indeed, LinkedIn, Glassdoor, ne Idealist kyerɛ nteteeɛ ne adwuma ho amanneɛbɔ a efi adwumawura, adwuma, ne mmeae ahorow pii. Nkitahodiɛ: Adwuma nkitahodiɛ a wɔbɛhyehyɛ denam abusua, nnamfo, akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, anaa mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ so betumi ama akwankyerɛ ne nneɛma a ɛfa nteteeɛ hokwan ne adwumawura a wɔbɛtumi ayɛ adwuma ama wɔn ho. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ ne adwuma: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnhwehwɛ mfasoɔ, mpɔtam hɔ mmeae, aban adwumadibea, ne adwuma a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ betumi ama nteteeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, adwuma nhyiam, anaa adwuma hokwan a wɔayɛ ama mmabun pɔtee.

question: Wubetumi aka sɛnea yɛn abusua no gyinapɛn ahorow asiesie wo gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ne abusuabɔ ho no ho nhwɛso ahorow bi akyerɛ me?
answer: Nhwɛsoɔ ne sɛ, sɛnea yesi obu ne nkitahodi so dua no anya ɔkwan a mefa so di abusuabɔ ho dwuma, baabi a mede ntease ne pene a me yɔnko bedi kan di kan no so nkɛntɛnso. Yɛn bo a yɛasi wɔ nhomasua ne asɛyɛde ho nso akyerɛ me gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata a mɛhwehwɛ bere a ɛho hia no kwan.

question: Dɛn ne akwan foforo bi a wɔfa so di dwuma wɔ aman ahorow so de di nsɛmti a ɛho hia te sɛ pene, nna ho akɔnnɔ, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ho dwuma?
answer: Akwan foforɔ: Nkitahodiɛ Nhyiamu: Dwumadie binom de nkitahodiɛ nhyiamu di dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛ pene a wɔpene so ne abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ papa. Intanɛt so Nneɛma: Wɛbsaet ne app ahorow de kokoam nsɛm ma mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn nna ho akɔnnɔ anaa wɔn bɔbeasu mu. Atipɛnfo Nhomasua: Nhyehyɛe ahorow a atipɛnfo di anim betumi ama wɔanya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi asusuw nsɛmti a ɛho hia ho

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde nipadua mfoni kyerɛ no so nkɛntɛnso, na ɔkwan bɛn so na eyi nya mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu so nkɛntɛnso?
answer: Amammerɛ ne ɔmanfo gyinapɛn ahorow nya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nipadua mfoni ahorow so nkɛntɛnso kɛse, na ɛka mmabun a wofi amammerɛ ahorow mu wɔ akwan horow so denam: Ahoɔfɛ ho adwene ne gyinapɛn ahorow a ebia ɛsono wɔ amammerɛ ahorow mu a wɔhyehyɛ, na ɛde nipadua ahorow, ahoɔfɛ, ne nea wɔpɛ ho mfoni ahorow ba wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu. question: Mɛyɛ dɛn bere a me ho asɛe?
answer: Sɛ wodi bra nkekae ho dwuma a, ebetumi ayɛ abofu, nanso afotu bi ni: Yɛ ade ntɛm: Fa nsuonwini hohoro nkekae no ntɛm ara sɛnea wubetumi. Kwati nsu a ɛyɛ hyew, efisɛ ebetumi ama nkekae no ayɛ kɛse. Adi a wɔde yi nkekae: Fa ade a wɔde yi nkekae anaa samina gu nkekae no so na ma ɛntra hɔ simma kakraa bi ansa na woahohoro. Ahwɛyiye: Hyɛ ntade ase a ɛyɛ tuntum anaa nsusuwso ne ase wɔ wo nna mu na ama nkekae no renhu kɛse. Ahiade kotoku: Fa kotoku ketewaa bi a ɛwɔ ntade ase ne pioto a ɛho nhia sie wo baage anaa adaka mu ma tebea horow a egye ntɛmpɛ. Kae sɛ obaa biaa ho tumi sɛe, enti bɔ mmɔden sɛ w'an nniwu . Ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛwɔ brayɛ mu, na sɛ woyɛ ahwɛyiye kakraa bi a, ɛnyɛ den sɛ wubedi ho dwuma.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi anya adwenemyare ho nsɛm a edi mu na ahotosɔ wɔ mu wɔ abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn so?
answer: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wunya adwenemyare ho nsɛm a wotumi de ho to so na wotumi de ho to so wɔ Intanɛt so a, susuw afotu a edidi so yi ho: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a efi mmeae a agye din te sɛ aban adwumayɛbea ahorow, adwenemyare ho ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne nhomasua asoɛe ahorow hɔ. Hwɛ sɛ ebia nsɛm a egyina adanse so a nhwehwɛmu afoa so na adwenemyare ho adwumayɛfo a wɔfata akyerɛw anaa wɔasan ahwɛ mu anaa. Hwɛ yiye wɔ nsɛm a ɛnteɛ anaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa ho na hwehwɛ mmeae a wonya fi mu yiye ansa na wode wo ho ato so ama adwenemyare ho nsɛm.

question: Su anaa nneyɛɛ ahorow bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hwehwɛ wɔ ɔfotufo bi mu bere a wɔrehwehwɛ akwankyerɛ wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne gyinaesi ho, te sɛ ahotoso, tema, adwene a enni atɛn, ne nna ne awo akwaa apɔmuden ho nimdeɛ?

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa ma nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde ko tia asisifo wɔ me sukuu anaa mpɔtam hɔ?

question: Dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ mmabun hu fa awo a wobetumi apaw ne nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu, a ɛyaw ano aduro, awo mmoa, ne awo a wɔde oprehyɛn yɛ ka ho?

Ɛyaw ano aduru: Nneɛma a wubetumi apaw bi ne nnuro (te sɛ epidurals) anaa akwan a ɛnyɛ nnuru (te sɛ ahomegye apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, aduru a wɔde twitwiw nipadua no, ne aguare a ɛyɛ hyew). Adwumayɛfo Mmoa: Awogyefo, doula, anaa abusua muni bi a ɔboa no betumi de nkate ne honam fam mmoa ama bere a ɔrewo no. Cesarean Birth (C-Section): Oprehyɛn a wɔyɛ bere a wontumi mfa awo a wɔde fa ɔbea no awotwaa mu no ntumi nyɛ yiye anaasɛ asiane biara nni ho no. Wobetumi ayɛ eyi ho nhyehyɛe anaasɛ wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe bere a wɔrewo no. Mmabun betumi ne wɔn akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo asusuw akwan horow yi ho na wɔayɛ awo nhyehyɛe a ɛkyerɛ nea wɔpɛ wɔ awo ne awo ho.

question: So metumi ako ama akyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho adesua a edi mũ nka adesua nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ me sukuu mu no ho? (Mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe ne akwan a wɔfa so kamfo nkurɔfo ase) .

question: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ ahobammɔ abien a wɔde di dwuma so sen nyinsɛn a wobesiw ano kɛkɛ? (STI ho asiane a ɛso tew)

question: Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ hokwan ma mmabun sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ara wɔn nipadua ho gyinaeɛ wɔ wɔn nna ne awo mu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe mu a wobedi akyi?

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na wiase nyinaa nkabom ne adwumayɛkuw ahorow boa mmɔden a wɔbɔ de gyina nnipa hokwan ahorow, mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ, ne asetra mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran wɔ ASRH nhyehyɛe, nhyehyɛe, ne nneyɛe mu?

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi abom ayɛ adwuma de ama obu, ahotoso, ne biakoyɛ aba wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma a ɛfata amammerɛ mu de ma mu?
answer: Mmabun ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfo betumi abom ayɛ adwuma de ama obu, ahotoso, ne biakoyɛ anya nkɔso wɔ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho nnwuma a ɛfata amammerɛ mu denam nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee na ɛyɛ nokware a wɔde bedi dwuma, atie wɔn ho wɔn ho adwene denneennen, ne obu a wɔde bɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho amammerɛ mu gyidi ne gyinapɛn ahorow so. Saa ara nso na mmabun betumi aka wɔn ankasa ahiade ne nea wɔpɛ ho asɛm, de wɔn apomoden ho osuahu ahorow ho nsɛm ama, na wɔne wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no ayɛ biako de ayɛ ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛfa wɔn ankasa ho a ɛda wɔn amammerɛ mu nipasu ne gyinapɛn ahorow adi. Ɛnam adwuma a wɔbom yɛ sɛ ahokafoɔ so no, mmabun ne apomoden ho adwumayɛfoɔ bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ nna ne awoɔ apomoden ho dwumadie bɛdi obuo, ɛka obiara ho, na ɛyɛ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ ho dwuma.

question: Mpɛn pii no, sika ahe na wɔbɔ wɔ nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ho? (ka akwan horow a wontua hwee anaa nea ne bo nyɛ den ho asɛm sɛ ɛwɔ hɔ a)
answer: Nna mu yareɛ nhwehwɛmu ho ka betumi ayɛ soronko a egyina beae ne nhwehwɛmu ko a wɔyɛ so. Nkyekyɛmu bi ni: Aban Ayaresabea ne Ayaresabea: Eyinom taa yɛ nhwehwɛmu a wontua hwee anaasɛ ɛho ka sua. Awoɔfoyɛ a Wɔayɛ Ho Nhyehyɛe: PPAG de sɔhwɛ a ne bo nyɛ den a wobetumi atew sika so ama mmerante ne mmabaa ma. Di wɔn ho nkɔmmɔ na woanya bo pɔtee ho nsɛm. Ankorankoro Ayaresabea: Mpɛn pii no, eyinom bo yɛ den sen nea aban no betumi apaw. Ɛyɛ papa sɛ wubedi kan afrɛ ayaresabea hɔ abisa wɔn bo ho asɛm.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na afotu adwuma betumi aboa me ma makɔ ayɔnkofa, nkitahodi, ne gyinaesi a ɛfa nna ho no mu?
answer: Afotuo dwumadie bɛtumi aboa wo ma woafa abusuabɔ, nkitahodiɛ, ne gyinaesie a ɛfa nna ho dwumadie ho te sɛ: Beaeɛ a ahotɔ wɔ a wɔbɛma woatumi ahwehwɛ nkateɛ, dadwen, ne akɔnnɔ a ɛwɔ abusuabɔ mu. Akwankyerɛ a wɔde bɛma wɔ gyinaesi a wɔde nimdeɛ asi wɔ nna mu dwumadi, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne pene a wɔpene so ho. Abusuabɔ mu nkɔso a ɛyɛ papa, ahye, ne obu a wɔde ma wɔn ho wɔn ho a wɔhwehwɛ mu. Nsɛnnennen te sɛ atipɛnfo nhyɛso, asetra mu gyinapɛn ahorow, ne amammerɛ mu nkɛntɛnso a ɛwɔ nna mu nneyɛe/dwumadi ahorow so a wobedi ho dwuma.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na nhwehwɛmufo betumi de mmabun ahyɛ wɔn nhyehyɛe mu sɛ ahokafo wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ. Nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan nsɛmti ho de ahwɛ ahu sɛ woagye wɔn gyinapɛn ato mu?
answer: Mmabun a wɔbɛto nsa afrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ nhwehwɛmu no fã nyinaa mu, efi nhwehwɛmu nsɛmmisa a wɔbɛhyehyɛ so kosi nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ mu ne nea wɔahu a wɔbɛkyerɛ ase so. Nhwehwɛmu akwan a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, te sɛ akuw a wɔde wɔn adwene si so nkɔmmɔbɔ, nsɛmbisa, anaa adeyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, a ɛma mmabun tumi ma wɔkyɛ wɔn suahu ne wɔn nhumu a wɔde bedi dwuma. Abusuabɔ a ahotoso wom a wɔbɛma anya, nkitahodi a ɛda adi pefee a wɔbɛma anya nkɔso, na wɔanya mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ a mmabun te nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn sɛ wɔbɛda wɔn adwene adi. Ntetee ne mmoa a wɔde bɛma mmabun ma wɔanya nhwehwɛmu ho nimdeɛ, adwene a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho yiye, ne ahotoso a, wɔwɔ wɔ tumi a wɔde bɛboa nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu. Hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔahu no mu wɔ akwan ne nhyiamu a ɛyɛ mmerɛ a ɛkɔ mmabun ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu no nkyɛn na ɛka wɔn ho.

question: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛtumi si mmabun kwan ma wɔntumi nnya mmoa a ɛho hia wɔ berɛ a wɔresiesie wɔn ho (aftercare) no mu, na akwan bi nso wɔ hɔ a yɛbɛtumi afa so asiesie

question: Dɛn ne apɔwmuden ho nimdeɛ mu nneɛma atitiri a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho?
answer: Nipadua ne nipadua mu nneɛma a ɛfa nna ne awoɔ akwaa ho ntease. Nimdeɛ a ɛfa akwan a wɔfa so si nyinsɛn ano, STI, nyinsɛn, ne awoɔ ho. Nna mu hokwan ahorow, mpeneso, ne nkitahodie pa ho nimdeɛ. Ahokokwaw a wɔde nya nna ne awoɔ akwahosan ho nsɛm na wɔsɔ hwɛ mu. Tumi a wotumi ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo ne n’atipɛnfo di nkitaho yie wɔ nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho.

question: So nsɛmti anaa afa ahorow pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwaahosan ho a ɛfa mmabun a wɔn mfe akɔ anim ho kɛse?

question: Sɛ mewɔ nsɛmmisa bi a ɛfa nna mu apomoden ho nanso mete nka sɛ me ne m’awofo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ me no bɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ a, dɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ meyɛ?

answer: Nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa nsusuwii hunu ne nyiyim ho no betumi ama mmabun a wɔadi dɛm anya tumi wɔ akwan horow pii so: Obu a Wɔde Ma Wɔn Ho a Ɛkɔ Anim: Sɛ wɔte wɔn hokwan ahorow ase a, ebetumi ama wɔanya ahotoso ne wɔn ho a wɔbɛkamfo wɔn ho nimdeɛ. question: kwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn wɔ gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa wɔn nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ho no mu?
answer: Mmabun betumi ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛte wɔn nne na wɔabu wɔn denam: Nsɛm a wobebisa ne nsɛm a wɔbɛhwehwɛ afi akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo hɔ. Nea wɔpɛ, nea ɛhaw wɔn, ne ahyeɛ a wɔbɛda no adi pefee. question: Dwuma bɛn na mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, nyamesom ahyehyɛde ahorow, ne atetesɛm mu ayaresa di wɔ abrabɔ pa ho gyinapɛn ne adwene a wɔwɔ wɔ ASRH ho a wɔhyehyɛ mu, na ɔkwan bɛn so na wobetumi de wɔn ho a wɔde bɛhyɛ mu no adi dwuma de ahyɛ apɔmuden mu nkɔso pa ho nkuran?

Nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔbɛbu wɔn: Adwene ahodoɔ a wɔbɛhunu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ na wɔde nne a ɛwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ adi dwuma de ahyɛ akwan a ɛka obiara ho, a egyina hokwan so wɔ ASRH ho nkuran.

answer: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ awo akwahosan ho nsɛm a ɛtaa ba no bi ne: Nsu a ɛba ɔbea no awotwaa mu a ɛnyɛ ne kwan so, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu nkekayɛ, ne ɛyaw a ɛba bere a ɔrebu nsu anaasɛ ɔne obi ada no betumi akyerɛ sɛ ɔwɔ STI. question: Bere bɛn na wɔde si nyinsɛn ano a egye ntɛmpɛ di dwuma wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono sɛnea etu mpɔn a egyina sɛnea wɔde di dwuma ntɛm so?
answer: Nyinsɛn ano a wosiw ntɛm no tu mpɔn kɛse bere a wɔfa no ntɛm ara wɔ nna a wɔammɔ ho ban akyi, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye no, wɔ nnɔnhwere 72 mu, ɛwom sɛ akwan horow bi betumi ayɛ nea etu mpɔn kosi nnanu de. question: kwan bɛn so na wɔsa STI ahorow? (nnuru a ekum ɔyare mmoawa, ne nea ɛkeka ho) .
answer: Ɛsono sɛnea wɔsa STIs a egyina ɔyare mmoawa pɔtee no so: Bacterial STIs (Chlamydia, Gonorrhea): Wɔde nnuro a ekum ɔyare mmoawa sa eyinom yare. Viral STIs (HPV, Herpes): Aduru biara nni hɔ a wɔde sa ɔyare mmoawa a wɔde yare mmoawa ba, nanso nnuru betumi adi sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow no ho dwuma na ɛtew asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya ɔyare no so. Parasitic STIs (Trichomoniasis): Wɔde nnuru sa eyinom yare.

question: Dɛn ne adwenemyare, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛsono no wɔ atinka mu osuahu ahorow a ɛfata ho?
answer: Adwene mu yare yɛ tebea horow a ɛka nsusuwii, atinka, ne nneyɛe, na ɛde ahoyeraw ne da biara da dwumadi a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ba. Wɔyɛ soronko wɔ atinka mu osuahu ahorow a ɛyɛ daa ho wɔ sɛnea emu yɛ den, bere tenten a egye, ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ da biara da asetra so no mu. Bere a ɛyɛ ade a ɛfata sɛ obi benya awerɛhow, adwennwen, anaa dadwen bere ne bere mu no, adwenemyare no fa sɛnkyerɛnne ahorow a ɛkɔ so daa na emu yɛ den a ɛmma ontumi nyɛ adwuma yiye ho.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wɔn, akyerɛkyerɛfo, nyamesom akannifo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo betumi aboa mmabun ma wɔanya akwahosan ho nimdeɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho?
answer: Fa wo ho hyɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛda adi pefee na ɛnyɛ atemmu a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho mu. Ma kwan ma wonya nneɛma ne nsɛm a ɛyɛ nokware na ɛfata mfe a obi adi. Hyɛ nsɛmmisa ne nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa nna mu akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho nkuran. Kamfo kyerɛ sɛ wɔmfa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ mma wɔ sukuu ne mpɔtam hɔ. Boa mmabun ma wɔhwehwɛ akwahosan ho nnwuma na wɔmfa akwahosan nhyehyɛe no mu. Yɛ suban ne nneyɛe a ɛfata a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nhwɛso.

question: Dɛn ne gyidie ahorow bi a ɛfa LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho wɔ amammerɛ anaa nyamesom fekuw mu, na kwan bɛn so na wobetumi adi ho dwuma?
answer: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuw kura gyidi ahorow pii a ɛfa LGBTQ+ ankorankoro ho. Nhwɛsoɔ bi a wɔtaa yɛ nie: Afɔbuo: Nyamesom binom nnye mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ntom na Nyamesom Afoforo gye LGBTQ+ nipasu tom kɛseɛ. Kommyɛ: Ebia amammerɛ ahorow bi renka LGBTQ+ nsɛm ho asɛm pefee. Saa Gyidie Yi a Wodi Ho Dwuma: Nkɔmmɔdie a amu da hɔ: Hyɛ nkɔmmɔdie a obuo wom a ɛfa LGBTQ+ hokwan ahodoɔ ho wɔ amammerɛ ne nyamesom akuo mu. Nhomasua: Kyɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nna ho akɔnnɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ ahunahuna so. Fa W’adwene Si Gyinapɛn Ahorow a Wɔbom Yɛ So: Si gyinapɛn ahorow a wɔbom yɛ te sɛ ɔdɔ, obuo, ne ayamhyehye so dua. Ayɔnkofoɔ a Wɔbɛhwehwɛ: Kyerɛ nyamesom akannifoɔ anaa amammerɛ mu nnipa a wɔabue wɔn ani ama nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa LGBTQ+ a wɔde wɔn bɛka ho ho. Nkɔso yɛ nkakrankakra, na atenka yɛ ade titiriw.

question: Dɛn ne akwan pa a yebetumi afa so agyina adwennwen anaa dadwen a atipɛnfo nhyɛso de ba no ano?
answer: Akwan bi ne: Sɛ gye w'ahome yie, ebetumi aboa ma wo ntini adwo na woatew adwennwen so. Anigyede anaa dwumadi ahorow a w’ani gye ho a wode wo ho bɛhyɛ mu: Nneɛma a w’ani gye ho a wobɛyɛ no betumi atwetwe w’adwene afi nsusuii bɔne so na ama w’adwene akɔ so. panin a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso a wo ne no bɛkasa: Sɛ woka w'atenka kyerɛ ɔpanin bi a wogye no di, te sɛ ɔwofo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, anaa ɔfotufo a, ebetumi ama woanya mmoa ne akwankyerɛ. Adwene mu nsusui anaa nsusuii a wode bedi dwuma: Adwene mu akwan horow betumi aboa wo ma woakɔ so atena hɔ na wode w’adwene asi biribi so, na ɛbɛtew dadwen nkate so. Botae ahorow a wobetumi de asi w’ani so: Botae ahorow a wobetumi adu ho a wode besisi w’ani so no betumi ama woate nka sɛ wotumi di so na woatumi ayɛ biribi.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akɔ so ahu nsakrae anaa nsɛm foforo a aba wɔ STI nhwehwɛmu akwankyerɛ ne nyansahyɛ ahorow a wɔde ma mmabun mu?
answer: Sɛnea wobɛkɔ so anya amanneɛbɔ foforɔ fa nna mu nyarewa (STI) nhwehwɛmu ne akwankyerɛ foforɔ ho:Di Mmeaeɛ a Wɔdie Wɔn Ho To Won So Akyi: Ma w’ani nna hɔ na hwehwɛ nsɛm foforɔ firi mmeaeɛ a atentenenee wom te sɛ aban apɔwmuden adum (government health agencies), ayaresabea akɛseɛ a wɔagye din, ne nhoma a adɔkotafoɔ akyerɛw.Kyerɛw Wo Din na Nya Amanneɛbɔ: Kyerɛw wo din na ama woanya nsɛm foforɔ afiri akuo a wɔapaw wɔn ho ama nna mu apɔwmuden anaa mmaayewa ne mmeranteɛ apɔwmuden ho nsɛm.Bisa Ayaresabea Hwɛfoɔ: Mmerɛ biara a wobɛkɔ ayaresabea nhwehwɛmu no, bisa ayaresabea hwɛfoɔ no sɛ nsakyeraeɛ anaa akwankyerɛ foforɔ bi aba nna mu nyarewa nhwehwɛmu ho anaa.Fa Amanneɛbɔ Mmeaeɛ (Hotlines) Di Dwuma: Telefon namba ahorow te sɛ 0540-118-999, 5100 (wɔn a wɔde MTN di dwuma), ne PPAG Yenkasa Digital Center (0800202010, anaa WhatsApp 0245118228) ma akwankyerɛ a emu dɔ fa nna mu nyarewa nhwehwɛmu ho.Fa Abɛfo Ntentan So Nyansa Di Dwuma: Hwehwɛ aban apɔwmuden adum anaa ayaresabea akɛseɛ ntentan so kratafa (websites) a wɔtumi tintim akwankyerɛ foforɔ mmerɛ biara.Kɔ Nteteeɛ ne Nhyiamu Ahorow: Kɔ nteteeɛ (workshops) anaa nhyiamu (seminars) a ɛfa nna mu apɔwmuden ho, baabi a animdefoɔ bɛtumi adi nkɔmɔ fa nna mu nyarewa nhwehwɛmu ne akwankyerɛ foforɔ a aba ho.

question: Sɛn na 'gender inequality' (pɛyɛ a enni mmarima ne mmaa ntam) ne nyiyimu foforo bɔ mu kanyan SRH?
answer: Sɛ woyɛ ɔbaa na woyɛ ohiani, anaa wofiri abusua bi mu a, wuhyia nsɛnnennen mmɔho mmienu. Wei siw wo kwan sɛ wonya ayaresa, nwomasua, ne mmoa. Ɛma SRH apɔwmuden kɔ fam ma wɔn a wɔwɔ tebea saa mu.

question: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛkyerɛ mmoa anaa nhyehye a sukuu node wɔn ho gye mu no mu ɔhaw ahorow de ma mmabun a wɔrehyia nna mu basabasayɛ anaa ayayade no?
answer: Mmoa anaa nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho gye mu ho nhwɛso betumi ayɛ: Kokoam afotu ne atinka fam mmoa a wɔde bɛma. Ayaresa ne asɛnnibea nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛma ayɛ mmerɛw. Boa a wɔbɛboa ma wɔabɔ nsɛm a esisi ho amanneɛ akyerɛ atumfoɔ. Ahobanbɔ nhyehyɛe ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ mmoa adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔde ma. Nhomasua nhyiam ahorow a wɔbɛyɛ a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, abusuabɔ pa, ne ankorankoro ahobammɔ ho.

question: Wobɛyɛ dɛn adi ntawntawdi anaa adwene a enhyia ho dwuma wɔ nkitahodie a ɛfata mu?
answer: Wɔ nkitahodie a ɛyɛ papa mu no, wobu ntawntawdi sɛ hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛma wɔanya nkɔso na wɔate ase. Fi ase denam nsiyɛ a wode betie mo ho mo ho adwene a wontwa na no anaasɛ mmu atɛn so. Fa "Me" nsɛm da wo nkate ne wo ahiade adi, na bom nyɛ adwuma hwehwɛ ano aduru a edi wo haw abien no nyinaa ho dwuma. Kae sɛ wobɛkɔ so akyerɛ obu, kwati soboɔ bɔ, na yɛ woadwene sɛ mobɛtumi ayɛ adwenekro.

question: Dɛn ne abrabɔ pa ho nsusuwii ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ankorankoro a wɔma mmeae a ahobammɔ wɔ, te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo, afotufo, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifo, wɔ, na ɔkwan bɛn so na mmabun betumi abu wɔn ho ne afoforo akontaabu wɔ nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa pene a wɔpene so, kokoamsɛm, ne obu a wɔwɔ ma nnipa ahorow ne ahofadi ho a wodi akyi no ho?
answer: Nnipa a wɔhyehyɛ mbea a banbɔ wom, te sɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, afotufoɔ, ne mpɔtam hɔ akannifoɔ, wɔ abrabɔ pa ho dwumadie ne asodie sɛ wɔbɛma kwan mma (consent), asɛm-sie, ne obu ama nnipa ahodoɔ ne obiara ne ne ho so tumi ayɛ adwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ beaeɛ a nkɔmhyɛfoɔ bɛte nka sɛ wɔwɔ banbɔ, mmoa, ne ahoɔden na wɔatumi akyɛ wɔn osuahu na wɔahwehwɛ mmoa sɛ ɛhia a.Mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi ahwɛ sɛ wɔne afoforɔ bɛyɛ nea ɛtene denam kwan mma amammuo a wɔbɛhyɛ ho nkuran, nneyɛeɛ anaa adwene bɔne a wɔbɛtia, ne obu ne nneyɛeɛ pa a wɔbɛgyina ama no wɔ saa mbea yi. Bio koraa no, wɔbɛtumi akasa sɛ wɔhunu sɛ obi abu kwan mma so, wɔapa asɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsie mu, anaasɛ nyiyim bi rekɔ so; na wɔne mpanyimfoɔ ne wɔn mfɛfoɔ abom ayɛ adwuma de asiesie saa nsɛm yi na wɔahwɛ sɛ obiara kwan ne n'animuonyam wɔ hɔ dabiara

question: Nneɛma bɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa mmabun ma wɔanya awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe?
answer: Mmabun betumi anya awoɔ apɔwmuden ho nhyehyɛe denam nneɛma ahorow so, a nea ɛka ho ne: Akwahosan asoɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ sukuu mu, mpɔtam hɔ ayaresabea ahorow, ne ɔmanfo akwahosan dwumadibea ahorow. Planned Parenthood ne awoɔ apɔwmuden ho ahyehyɛde afoforo a wɔde kokoam nnwuma ma mmabun. Ntrɛwmu a wɔde frɛ nkurɔfo ne intanɛt so dwumadibea ahorow a ɛma nsɛm, mmoa, ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn kɔ awoɔ akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow. Mmabun ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne akuo a wɔkamfo kyerɛ a ebia wɔde nneɛma ne mmoa bɛma wɔ ɔhwɛ a ɛfata a wobenya mu.

question: Dɛn ne akwahosan ho nimdeɛ, na adɛn nti na ɛho hia ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan?
answer: Akwahosan ho nimdeɛ kyerɛ tumi a obi tumi nya akwahosan ho nsɛm, te ase, na ɔde di dwuma de si gyinae a ɛfata wɔ n’akwahosan ho. Ɛma wotumi te wɔn nipadua ase, paw nneɛma a ɛfata, na wonya akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛfata.

question: Dɛn ne nneɛma pa anaa mfaso horow bi a efi nkitahodi a emu gyinaeɛ yɛ pintinn mu ba wɔ abusuabɔ mu, te sɛ obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho a ɛkɔ anim, obu a obi wɔ ma ne yɔnko, ne ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim?
answer: Nneɛma pa a efi nkitahodi a ɛyɛ katee mu ba wɔ abusuabɔ mu bi ne, obu a obi wɔ ma ne ho ne ahotoso a ɛkɔ anim, obu ne ntease a ɛwɔ ankorankoro ntam, ntawntawdi ano aduru ho nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ anim, ne sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye sɛ wobenya nneɛma a ɛma wɔn ho wɔn ho abotɔyam a ɛkɔ soro. question: Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn atumi de mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nne ne osuahu ahorow asi nna ne awo akwahosan ho nkɔmmɔbɔ mu?

question: Si so dua sɛ nyinsɛn ano aduru a wɔpaw no yɛ gyinaesi a ɛma tumi a ɛma mmabun tumi di wɔn awo akwahosan so.
answer: Nyinsɛn ano a wobɛpaw no yɛ gyinaesi a ɛma tumi! Nea enti a ɛte saa ni: Awo akwahosan sohwɛ: Nyinsɛn a wosiw ano ma wutumi di w’awo akwahosan so na woyɛ wo daakye ho nhyehyɛe. question: Dwuma bɛn na dijitaal anansesɛmka ne sohyial 'media' so dwumadi betumi adi wɔ nsɛm a wɔma nkurɔfo hu na wɔkasa ma mmabun nna ne awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho?
answer: Dijitaal abasɛm ne sohyial media dwumadie di dwuma titire sɛ wɔpɛgya nhumu ne wɔkasa ma awoɔ akwahosan hokwan denam: Nne a wɔato wɔn hintidua a wɔbɛma ayɛ kɛseɛ ne ankorankoro nsɛm a wɔbɛkyɛ de akasa atia animtiaabuo na wɔahyɛ obiara a wɔbɛka ho no ho nkuran. Mmoa ne biakoyɛ a wɔbɛboaboa ano denam intanɛt so ɔsatu, nea broni ka no 'hashtag', ne kankabi ahorow so. Nhyiamu a wɔbɛma ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔkamfo wɔn ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwumaden no akyɛ nsɛm, nneɛma, ne ɔfrɛ a wɔde frɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ. Ɛne nhyehyeɛ ayɛfo ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no di nkitaho de nya nhyehyeɛ gyinaesie so nkɛntɛnsoɔ na wɔhyɛ nsakraeɛ pa ho nkuran wɔ 'ASRH' nnwuma mu.

question: So mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔkɔ nkurɔfo nkyɛn ho nhyehyɛe ahorow betumi de kokoam nnwuma a ɛfata mmabun ama?

question: Dɛn ne nna ho akɔnnɔ na ɛyɛ dɛn na ɛba? (kyerɛkyerɛ mu yie, a ɛnyɛ nea ɛmu da hɔ so)
answer: Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna ho akɔnnɔ yɛ anigye anaa anigye a obi nya wɔ nna mu dwumadi ho. Ebetumi aba esiane nneɛma pii nti, te sɛ honam fam nsa a wɔde ka obi, emotional connection, anaa mpo sɛ wuhu biribi a ɛyɛ anigye. Ebia wo nipadua no bɛyɛ ho biribi denam nsakrae te sɛ koma a ɛbɔ kɛse, ahome a ɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm, anaa mogya a ɛkɔ w’akyi berɛmo mu no so. Eyi nyinaa yɛ ade a ɛfata na ɛyɛ nna mu mmuae kyinhyia no fã.

question: Sɛn na wɔde yɛn amammere ne mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm fra nketekete (life skills) ho nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu?
answer: Wɔyɛ no ma ɛfata amammerɛ. Wɔde nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ di dwuma. Nkɔmmɔbɔ fa gyidie ho. Afotufoɔ firi mmeammea ahorow.

question: So mmara ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔde nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho nsɛm bɛkɔ asɛnnibea, na ɔkwan bɛn so na ɛka tumi a wɔn a woannyaa wɔn ti andidii mu 'victims' no wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ atɛntrenee?
answer: Mmara a ɛfa bere a wɔde yɛ adwuma no gu ahorow wɔ tumidi ahorow mu na ebetumi asiw bere a wobetumi de nna mu ɔbrasɛe ho nsɛm adi dwuma no ano hye. question: Tebea horow bi wɔ hɔ a ebia ɛho renhia sɛ wɔbɔ obi ho ban abien? (nkitahodie a ɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho yɛ biako ne sɔhwɛ) .
answer: Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, ebia ahobammɔ abien ho renhia. Nhwɛso biako ni: Nkitahodie a ɛda ɔyere biako ntam ne nnansa yi STI nhwehwɛmu: Sɛ wo ne ɔhokafo biako wɔ nkitahodie a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ, a wɔde wo ho ahyɛ mu, na wɔayɛ mo baanu nyinaa nhwehwɛmu nnansa yi sɛ wowɔ STI ho nhwehwɛmu a, ebia asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wubenya ɔyare no bɛyɛ ketewaa koraa. Nanso, wo ne wo duruyɛfo nkasa na ɔnhwɛ wo tebea pɔtee no na hwɛ sɛ ebia wɔda so ara kamfo ahobammɔ abien kyerɛ anaa. Kae sɛ, wɔ nkitahodie a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu mpo mu no, tebea horow a wɔnhwɛ kwan betumi asɔre. Ɛyɛ papa bere nyinaa sɛ wo ne wo hokafo no susuw w’awerɛkyekye dodow a ɛfa nyinsɛn ano aduru ho no ho.

question: Dwuma bɛn na  ho so hwɛ di wɔ adwennwen ano aduru mu, na dɛn nneyɛe bi na wɔde hwɛ wɔn ho a mmabun betumi de ahyɛ wɔn nneyɛe mu?

question: So mmara kwan so akwanside ahorow anaa nhyehyɛe mu nsɛnnennen bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma ɛyɛ den ma mmabun sɛ wɔbenya nyinsɛn a woyi gu ho nhyehyɛe ahorow?

question: Ahokokwaw pɔtee bɛn na wobu no sɛ ɛho hia na ama mmabun adi yie wɔ adwumayɛ mu anaasɛ wɔafi wɔn ankasa nnwuma ase?
answer: Ahokokwaw a ɛho hia a ɛbɛma adwumayɛfo adi yie no bi ne mfiridwuma ne brɛoo ho nimdeɛ: Mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ: Eyinom yɛ adwuma pɔtee bi ho nimdeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ ma adwuma pɔtee bi anaa nnwuma bi, te sɛ kɔmputa ho nimdeɛ, duadwumfo adwuma, nsu ho adwuma, anyinam ahoɔden ho nimdeɛ, ntadepam, aduannoa ho nimdeɛ, ne kar a wosiesie. Ahokokwaw a ɛyɛ mmerɛw: Eyinom yɛ nnipa ntam nkitahodi, ne nneyɛe ho nimdeɛ a ɛma nkitahodi a etu mpɔn, biakoyɛ, ne ɔhaw ahorow ano aduru yɛ mmerɛw wɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow mu. question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ anaa nyamesom mu gyidi nya su horow a wɔwɔ wɔ nna mu nneyɛe a ahobammɔ wom ho so nkɛntɛnso, na mɛyɛ dɛn ahu a ɛsonsonoe a me ne me hokafo anaa mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ no so?
answer: Amammerɛ mu Nkɛntɛnso: Amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow betumi ayɛ soronko kɛse, na ɛka adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ nna, nyinsɛn a wosiw ano, ne nna mu akwahosan ho. Ntease: Kyerɛkyerɛ wo ho sɛnea amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow kyerɛkyerɛ su horow a ɛfa nna ne nyinsɛn ano ho. Nkɔmmɔbɔ a Wobue Mu: Wo ne wo hokafo nka wo gyidi ne sɛnea ebia ɛsono no ho nkɔmmɔ a emu da hɔ na ɛkyerɛ obu. Nsiesiei: Hwehwɛ nsɛm a adwene hyia na hwehwɛ apam mu sɛ nsonsonoe wɔ adwene mu a, te sɛ akwan a wɔfa so bɔ wɔn ho ban a wogye tom wɔ amammerɛ mu a wobɛhwehwɛ. Hwehwɛ Mmoa: Kɔ mpanyimfo, afotufo, anaa nyamesom akannifo 'religious elders' a wogye wɔn di nkyɛn kɔhwehwɛ akwankyerɛ ne mmoa wɔ nsonsonoe ahorow yi a wobɛfa so adi mu no mu.

question: Dɛn na ɛde nsakrae a ɛfa honam mu nkwammoaa 'hormone' ho ba me nipadua mu, te sɛ nufu nyin anaa nne a ɛsakra?
answer: Honam mu nkwammoaa te sɛ estrogen (mmeawa) ne testosterone (mmarimaa)na ɛma nsakrae a wuhu wɔ mmerantebere ne mmabaabere mu ba: Estrogen: Saa hormone yi na ɛma mmeawa nufu nyin. Ɛma nufu no mu ntini ne ntini no nyin na srade hyɛ mu ma. Estrogen nso di dwuma wɔ brayɛ a ɛhwɛ so no mu. Testosterone: Saa hormone yi na ɛma mmarimaa nne sesa. Testosterone ma ɛnne nhama no ware na ɛyɛ den, na ɛma ɛnne a emu dɔ ba. Ɛsan nso ma anim ne nipadua mu nhwi nyin, ntini nyin, ne mmarima nna mu su afoforo a ɛto so abien.

question: Ɛdɛn ne nna ho akɔnnɔ pagyya ho mmuae a mmarima ne mmea nya?
answer: Mmarima Nna mu Mmuae: Anigye: Mogya a ɛkɔ soro wo ɔbarima no ne sɛbi 'kɔti' mu ma no pagya, na ɛma ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu ɔsɔretia. Plateau: Wɔma ɛsɔre no kɔ so, na ebia awotwaa no bɛbɛn nipadua no. Orgasm: Nkwammoaa a ɛnam ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna so fi adi, na anigye a emu yɛ den ka ho. Nsiesiei: San kɔ tebea a na ɛte kan no mu, refractory bere ansa na arousal betumi aba bio. Ɔbea Nna mu Mmuae: Anigye: Mogya a ɛkɔ soro kɔ awotwaa ne ɔbea awotwaa afasu mu, srade a wɔde gu mu. Asasetaw: Clitoris no yɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw kɛse, ɔbea no awotwaa afasu hohoro, na nufu no betumi ayɛ kɛse. Orgasm: Ntini a ɛwɔ akyi berɛmo mu a ɛtwetwe denneennen, nhyɛso ne anigye a ɛba. Nsiesiei: San kɔ tebea a ɛfata mu nkakrankakra, clitoris ne vagina san kɔ tebea a edi kan a ɛkanyan no mu.

question: So nnipa akuo pɔtee bi wɔ hɔ a wohyia nsɛnnennen soronko wɔ STI ahorow ano sie ho? (mmabun, nna ho adwumayɛfo, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm) .

question: Anamɔn bɛn na metumi atu de asiw Intanɛt so ayayade anaa nkɔso a mempɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho ano?
answer: Siw ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneyɛe a ɛhaw adwene anaa ɛmfata mu wɔ Intanɛt so no kwan anaasɛ yi wɔn adamfo. Bɔ ɔhaw anaa kɔmputa so ayayade ho amanneɛ kyerɛ asɛnka agua no so ahwɛfo anaa wɔn a wɔhwɛ so. Fa wo ho to wo nkate so na kwati sɛ wo ne ankorankoro a wɔma wote nka sɛ wo ho nyɛ wo dɛ anaasɛ wonni ahobammɔ no bedi nkitaho. Hwehwɛ mmoa fi ɔpanyin anaa ɔfotufo bi a wowɔ ne mu ahotoso hɔ sɛ wunya ɔhaw wɔ Intanɛt so anaa nkɔso a wompɛ a ɛfa nna ne awo akwahosan ho nsɛmti ho a.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn atumi akasa atia nyiyimu anaa animtiaabu a ɛfa nna ne awo apomoden ho nsɛmti ho wɔ me mpɔtamu hɔ? (Wɔhyɛ nnipa nyinaa bom ne obu a wɔde ma) .

question: Sɛ yɛhwɛ tetefon so mmoa mmeae a wɔboa nnipa wɔ ahokyere mu yi a, aso wɔgye nnipa biara tom na wɔbu obiara nneyɛeɛ ne n'asetena mu nsɛm (LGBTQ+ foɔ, abibifoɔ ne mmusuakuo ahorow, atubrafoɔ, atuofofoɔ, nnipa a wɔwɔ dɛm, ne nnipa a wɔbu wɔn animtiaa wɔ amansan mu no nyinaa) anaa?
answer: Aane, tetefon so mmoa mmeae a wɔboa nnipa wɔ ahokyere mu no asi wɔn bo sɛ wɔbɛgye nnipa biara atom na wɔabu obiara nneyɛeɛ, n'asɛm ne n'asetena mu nsɛm ni. Mmoa adwumayɛfoɔ nya nteteeɛ wɔ amammerɛ mu nimdeɛ ne nkateɛ ho de hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛtumi de mmoa a ɛfata ama ankorankoro a wɔfiri mpɔtam nyinaa, a LGBTQ+ ankorankoro, nnipa a wɔn kɔla yɛ kɔkɔɔ anaa tontom, atubrafoɔ, aguanfoɔ, nnipa a wɔadi dɛm, ne nnipa foforɔ a wɔato wɔn hintidua ka ho. Mmabun betumi abisa mmoa afiri adwumayɛfoɔ amammerɛ mu ahoɔden ho asɛm anaa wɔahwehwɛ mmoa nhama a ɛka wɔn botaeɛ pefee sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nneɛma ahodoɔ ne nnipa nyinaa a wɔbɛka wɔn ho wɔ wɔn asɛmpatrɛ nsɛm anaa nsɛm a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfoɔ nkuran mu.

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na amammerɛ ne nyamesom mu gyidi ahorow nya awofoɔ adwene wɔ pene ne amanneɛbɔ a wɔde ma wɔ mmabun apɔwmuden ho nnwuma ho no so nkɛntɛnso?

question: Dɛn ne akwan horow bi a mmabun betumi afa so aka wɔn ahye ho asɛm pefee na wɔahwehwɛ pene wɔ Intanɛt so nkitahodi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne kasa a emu da hɔ a wɔde bedi dwuma, wɔne onipa foforo no akɔhwɛ, na wɔabu wɔn ahofadi?
answer: ɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa bɛtumi aka wɔn hyeɛ ho asɛm pefee na wɔahwehwɛ kwan mma (consent) wɔ intanɛt so nkitahodi mu no, wobɛtumi ayɛ eyinom:De Kasa a ɛmu da hɔ adi dwuma (Use Explicit Language): Kyerɛ deɛ wopɛ, deɛ w'ani gye ho, ne wo hyeɛ pefee denam kasa a ɛkɔ asɛm no mu tẽẽ na ɛnyɛ nnaadaa so.Hwɛ mu dabiara (Check-In Regularly): Kɔ so ara bisa onipa a ne ho asɛm wɔ hɔ no dabiara na hwɛ sɛ n'ani gye ho na wagye atom sɛ ɔbɛkɔ so anae.Bu Obiara ne ne ho so tumi (Respect Autonomy): Bu obiara tumi a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔsi ne gyinaeɛ denam ne gyinaeɛ ne ne hyeɛ a wobɛdi no ni, mpo sɛ ɛne wo deɛ nyɛ pɛ a.Si Hyeɛ na Bu Hyeɛ (Set and Respect Boundaries): Ka wo hyeɛ ho asɛm pefee kyerɛ afoforɔ na bu afoforɔ nso wɔn hyeɛ; twe wo ho firi obiara nhyɛsoɔ ho kɔ nneyɛeɛ a ɔnte nka sɛ n'ani gye ho mu.

question: Nsunsuansoɔ bɛn na ebetumi aba sɛ wɔannkora apɔmuden mu asumasɛm so yie, ma mmabun ne apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa?
